highlights.summary:
Identified as an ‘Institute of Eminence', the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (Chennai IIT Madras or IITM) was established in 1959 as a public technical & research university. It is the third IIT to be set up by the Government of India & is autonomous in nature. Chennai IIT Campus, through its 18 departments, 4 national & 11 institute research centres offers various full-time/ part-time/ online courses at PG, UG, & doctoral levels across the Engineering, Science, Humanities, Management, and various other streams. OpenAI has recently announced its first Learning Accelerator in India in collaboration with IIT Madras, Chennai. The available flagship programmes are BTech and MBA.
Located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, the Indian Institute of Technology IIT Madras campus is home to India’s first university-based research park- IITMR. IIT Madras Research Park (IITMRP) aims to build a knowledge & innovation ecosystem. IIT Madras has been ranked 180 by the QS World University Rankings 2026. IIT Madras has been ranked 1 under the Engineering category by NIRF 2025. Madras IIT recently launched the country's first online BSc Programme in Programming in Data Science. IIT Madras Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: The best campus in India, and very good.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80% of people go for higher studies in India and abroad. The highest package offer is 42LPA, and the lowest is around 6 to 7LPA. Top recruiters included TCS, Wipro, L&T, and Accenture. 60% of people got internships in many companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities in the department and library include Wi-Fi. Everything is good and well. The hostel is maintained well and nicely, with a mess, food, good infrastructure, AC classrooms, and facilitated labs. Medical facilities and sports facilities are also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Best faculty well connected to the students. Everyone is well qualified and good in some semesters. Due to the workload, we get less time to prepare for this semester. Basically, a student is a mistake, remaining all good. All teachers have a Foreign degree.
detailed_review.Other: Excellent events.

reviews.review_title: Overall best college for M.A. In Economics Course.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are excellent for our department. Students of finance are assigned to companies related to finance. The typical salary varies between approximately 15-25 LPA. PSUs visit our college for hiring purposes as well. The top packages reach as much as 3 LPA. Approximately 71-76% of students secure placements annually. 59% of learners obtained internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is located in the northeast, and connectivity to the rest of India is limited. Thus, there were few female students on campus. Hotels were good. Each student is given an individual furnished room. Each hotel has a mess area, restaurant, and TV room. The food is awesome. It will take some time to adjust the menu for other public school students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in my department are good. They help others. Most of them give good grades compared to teachers in other departments. Many of us from our branch pursue activities such as software or non-teaching activities. Having this branch gives them enough time to prepare, as the classes are not so busy. Semester exams are easy. Almost everyone passes, but there are exceptions everywhere.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering + M.Tech. in Applied Mechanics
reviews.review_title: Great campus life with good placements and strong academic support.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% of students got placed. The highest package was 18 LPA, the lowest 5 LPA, average salary was 9 LPA. Top companies like L&T, ISRO, and DRDO. 60% of students got internships in same companies. Roles offered were design engineer, research associate, and tech consultant. It's quite good here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Department had good labs, classrooms with AC and projector, and Wi-Fi all around. Library was big with many books. Hostel rooms were fine, and shared type. Mess food was okay, sometimes good, sometimes not. Medical help was available 24X7. Many sports ground and gym were also there. It's quite good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were helpful and well-qualified. Most of them were Ph.D. holders. Teaching quality was good. Course was updated and useful for the industry. Exams were tough, and need to study well. Around 85-90% of students pass. Some subjects were really challenging. It's nice here.
detailed_review.Other: It offered applied mechanics course at IIT Madras. I chose this course because I liked mechanics and research. Best thing was the exposure and advanced labs. Course should include more industry projects. Campus life was great. Crowd was smart. Fests like Saarang and Shaastra were awesome. It had good Wi-Fi and greenery all around. Buses and auto facilities were available outside. Scholarships were also provided. Lots of clubs and activities were there for all interests.

reviews.review_title: Life at IITM is like your dream college life.

detailed_review.Placements: Total 92% of the students in our department got placed in the last year. Top recruiting companies for our department are ITC, RIL, HUL, Nestle, and P&G. Top roles offered in this course are FMCG, energy and fuels, pharmaceuticals, and chemicals. The highest package offered is 36 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 11.5 LPA. The average package offered is 18 LPA. 55% of the students got placed in internships last year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Institute Wi-Fi is present in all public places. Labs and classrooms are very well maintained and mostly air-conditioned. Library is open from 8:00 AM to 11:30 PM, and it is air-conditioned too. Hostel facilities are moderate, and we come to the hostel mostly for sleeping. We stay in the library most of the time. The quality of food available is also moderate. The institute hospital is very good, like a multi-specialty hospital. All types of sports are played here like cricket, football, badminton, chess, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are very helpful and friendly. All teachers are qualified and knowledgeable too but everyone has a different teaching style. The course curriculum is mostly relevant. Some topics are not that much relevant but they may be relevant in the future according to the interests of each student. The students become industry-ready. Semester exams are moderately difficult. Pass percentage is above 95%.
detailed_review.Other: Chemical Engineering is an interdisciplinary subject with its application in every other field. The best things about this course are that you can apply for both core profile and non-core profile simultaneously with the same efficiency. Technical fest Shaastra and cultural fest Saarang are held in January, when the institute is filled with joy and happiness.

reviews.review_title: A must experience campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Firstly, the department of medical sciences and technology was launched in the year 2023, which means the 1st batch of students is currently in their third year, so as of now, none of the students have received placements from our department. But the department does organize internships in various hospitals partnered with our department. Some of which are SRM Institute of Medical Sciences, AIIMS Delhi, VHS hospital, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the infrastructure in our department is top-notch, with table Wi-Fi connections, AC classrooms, and lab facilities for various subjects. All the students will be provided with hostels at the time of admission. There are single, double, triple, and quadruple sharing rooms. In each room, a cot, a cupboard, a study table with a chair, a socket, and LAN facilities will be provided. Hostels also have a basketball court, lawns, and various games, including board games. Mess can be selected by the students during each month according to their preference. The institute also has a hospital, which is open 24X7.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty members are highly qualified, and as our department is interdisciplinary, both doctors and engineering domain professors give lectures to us. Course curriculum includes subjects of both engineering and medicine, and the curriculum is specially designed by the professors of AIIMS Delhi, along with the founder of the department, so that it aligns with the vision of our department. Semester exams are not that difficult. Exams will either be multiple choice or subjective, depending upon the professor and the subject. The rule of relative grading is being followed for evaluation.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as it was a new as well as an interdisciplinary field. The best thing about the course is that we gain hands-on lab experiences as well as in-depth knowledge about various fields of engineering and medicine. I believe this makes our opportunities vast and not limited. Campus is famous for its technical fest Shaastra, and the cultural fest Saarang. Campus has a lot of facilities, including a gymkhana, stadium, sports complex, volleyball and basketball courts, and a central library. There are various clubs also including coding, music, dance, fine arts, and many more.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely beautiful campus with wildlife.

detailed_review.Placements: Internship is mostly based on software companies; not many core companies come even for core courses. Applying for out-of-campus placements is recommended. Better to have other options in hand. Roles in software companies would generally be developers. And engineering roles are fewer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Courses in my branch are difficult; others are pretty okay. Infrastructure depends on the branch you are in. Aerospace has a very mediocre infrastructure. Coming to the hostel, it is okay. I can't describe it as good exactly. Food is edible, extra in the mess would be good, food courts have good food. Medical facilities are good, and they have good sports facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers mostly say you are independent; they don't force you to study, you have to study on your own; they will be there to explain the contents, that's all. Sometimes, the explanations aren't so well-structured either. Your grades are completely based on how you study and spend time on the subject (and also on the mood of the paper corrector). The courses are structured well; they give you good insights. The difficulty of the course is pretty high, as well as the exams. The pass percentage is pretty decent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I wanted to be an astronaut since my childhood, but coming here, I realized that what I want and what the course is about are completely different. I highly recommend people look deeply into what they're getting into so that they won't regret it later. But the coursework is pretty engaging; if you like Physics and Maths, you'd love the content.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 95% of students are placed in my course. Highest salary package is 24 LPA, and lowest salary package is 4 LPA. All top companies are recruiting through campus interviews. All roles that have been offered by companies. Good surroundings and supporting staff from placement.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Infrastructure of hostel is too good and neat and clean. There will be a single room also available in the hostel. Classroom is near and good. 
Labs with all facilities. Library has been quiet and peaceful. Canteen facilities are super on campus and worth money.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helping all students to improve their skills and be well taught. Quality of teaching is highly capable and useful. Some difficulties in semester, but pass percentage is maximum of students who will clear all subjects.

reviews.review_title: Good college, but you need to read and enjoy as well.

detailed_review.Placements: About 60% of students got placed. The average is around 16 LPA, the highest is 45 LPA, and the lowest is 7 LPA. Top core companies like Reliance, BPCL, CPCL, Schlumberger, and many more visit our college. Around 10 to 15 people got internships in ITC, Reliance, etc. Top roles offered are consulting analyst and assistant engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Madras has good classrooms, fast Wi-Fi, nice labs, and a big library. Hostels are clean with 24-hour water, power, and internet. Mess food is clean and okay, with different food choices. Canteens have many tasty options. There is a free campus hospital and ambulance. Sports grounds, gym, and games are also available for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers at IIT Madras are knowledgeable and supportive. The course curriculum is well-structured, updated, and helpful for both jobs and higher studies. Exams are tough and need proper preparation and regular study to do well. Classes are held regularly, and attendance is important. Assignments and projects help in a better understanding of the subjects. Overall, the academic environment is competitive and encouraging.
detailed_review.Other: I have no choice to make. Currently, I'm working on my academics.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Best college with best placement rates.

detailed_review.Placements: Last Year 2024 B.Tech CSE package was 52.32 LPA. Media placement package is 37 LPA. So we can guess placements are top-level. Top level MNCs come to campus from all types of companies. You just have to study, focus, and make yourself industry-ready that's it.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Best infrastructure I have ever seen in my whole life. Every type of facility is available to students. IITM will give you everything, you just have to study and enjoy on campus. First time you enter the campus, you will find yourself in jungle.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are top-notch. The latest curriculum which makes students industry-ready with great internships in MNCs also. Semester exams are little bit tough as you know IITM level exam but if will study, you can easily crack them. Best tip just follow professor's lectures, don't miss classes, do all assignments and boom.
detailed_review.Other: Top level fest like Sarang is conducted.

reviews.review_title: Overall, best college for MS in electrical engineering course.

detailed_review.Placements: About 73% of the students from our course got placed. The highest salary offered was 24 LPA, and the lowest salary offered was 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Qualcomm, Emerson, Aerotek, etc. Approximately 65% of students from our study received internship opportunities. Top roles offered to students were R&D engineer, power engineer, and so on.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In our college, classrooms were very primitive but labs had all the latest equipment for students from IIT to do their research. The quality of mess food varies greatly depending on where you come from. North Indians find it difficult to change their diet. Hostel furniture was quite outdated. Washing machines were exceptional, and western toilets were never expected.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some travels were extremely difficult, and it takes an once to get through. You will meet professional teachers on campus. The courses were continually relevant to current industry trends. The only constraints were the number of options available to us based on our mental abilities. The semester tests were more difficult, with a pass rate of approximately 56%.

reviews.review_title: Life at IITM was lit from 2022 - 2026.

detailed_review.Placements: From my seniors batch, about 70% of students got placed. Rest of them went through higher studies. The highest package is 2 crore for Quant Firms. The lowest is 6 LPA as our college placement cell doesn't allow companies offering less than 6 LPA. Median would be 18 LPA - 20 LPA. Top roles offered in software, finance, consulting, FMCG management, and product management.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in every hostel. Labs are up to date in equipments and technology. Classrooms are okay, some are without ACs so it gets hot. Mess food is okay in quality. Sports facilities are abundant, and you can play your favourite sport. There is a hospital on campus which is sufficient for mild diseases.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers have PhDs and are respected in their fields. My course is very relevant to chemical engineering industry. You can also take up research projects with the professor to learn more. Semester exams are okay in difficulty, not too hard or easy either.
detailed_review.Other: Chemical engineering is a literally course that allows you to explore beyond academics, especially extracurriculars. Fests are lit, of course. Both the technical and cultural fests are attended by thousands, and other college students attend too.

reviews.course: Discontinued (Jun 2025)- Bachelor of Science in Programming and Data science
reviews.review_title: Read this before enrolling in IIT Madras BS degree in data science and application.

detailed_review.Learning Experience: IIT Madras BS degree in data science and application is an online program that you can study from any location (also from abroad). All course is published prerecorded on the website of IIT Madras. There is a live doubt-solving lecture on Google Meet or Zoom. It is an online program so there is no need to go, it has campus in Madras but the exams are conducted offline. There are various centers for the exam also in other countries. Its fees are affiliated, also there is a scholarship upto 75%. The total fee is 3-3.5 lakhs for the whole degree.
detailed_review.Placements: There is very good placement support. I am not saying the best. But here the average package is 10 LPA. This is definitely better than tier 3 colleges but not like IITs offline program.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of this program are from IIT Madras (offline program). They are very good faculty members of this program. There are two teachers in one lecture. They explained the topic in conversational way. Personally, I like that approach to teaching. Eligibility to write the final exam, average of the best 5 out of the first 7 weeks of weekly assignment scores less than 40/100, and attendance in one of the 2 quizzes. The calculation of final course score T for eligible students is as T 0.1GAA + max (0.6F + 0.2 max (Qz1, Qz2, 0.4F + 0.2 Qz1 + 0.3 Qz2)
detailed_review.Course Support: There is good course support online. Definitely, it can't be comparable to IIT Madras offline degree. But there are regular doubts support online classes.

reviews.review_title: Very beautiful and calm, has very good faculty, and has all you need,

detailed_review.Placements: Most of the people get placed, but the number of people getting placed through core jobs is very low, people lose interest over time and choose non-core jobs, and many do get internships in pretty decent companies, the average was around 17-18 Lacs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are top-notch. The hostels could be improved but value for money, the facilities of all the grounds are good and well maintained, has a lot apart from academics, the library is big and has a lot of things, Wi-Fi has some problems now and then but in general it is good enough, quality of food depends on the mess we choose.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers are great, highly qualified, and a good place to learn, mostly friendly but few are too strict, the curriculum of the course is good but as always this could be improved, sem exams are tough and competitive, most of the paper has only problems, mostly no descriptive questions.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life would be great, clubs would help you find your interest, and the campus is undoubtedly beautiful. Fests and events are more than enough that you can't attend all.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My honest review about my college.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement committee at IIT Madras was highly determined and committed to placing students in the best industrial organizations. The committee organized various mock events to groom students to be industry-ready and future-ready. Some of the top recruiters at IIT Madras were Qualcomm, Intel, Samsung, MaxLinear, SanDisk, MediaTek, Redpine Signal, Analog Devices, TI, and Cypress Semiconductor.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In the college, the hostel facilities were good enough, with all the facilities available for students. The food in the mess was also good—hygienic and full of taste.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum was difficult, and so were academics. Faculty members held PhDs in their respective areas and were experts in their fields. Term exams and internal assessments were all planned and scheduled accordingly. Home Science College was a government college, so faculty members were highly educated, and many of professors had completed their PhDs in their subjects, which was beneficial for the students. They were true professionals and well-experienced, providing full guidance to their students. The curriculum of the M.Tech CSE program focused on imparting knowledge about coding, HTML, XML, AI, ML, JavaScript, .NET, etc. Faculty members at IIT Madras were very knowledgeable and qualified. They provided a great deal of education to students in the best possible way. They used business lectures, questionnaires, presentations, etc., and other methods to teach the course concepts.

reviews.course: Discontinued (Jun 2025)- B.Sc. in Data Science and Applications
reviews.review_title: BS Degree : Value for money , Pros and Cons

detailed_review.Learning Experience: The course content are provided by NPTEL. The teachers are IITian, very well qualified. The challenges which comes to the way is that, as it is an online degree. It sometimes get boring, so you have to take care of it.
detailed_review.Placements: You should not depend wholely on the campus placement. You need to search other places as well. Because as it is a new degree, there are fewer companies visiting. But I won't deny, students are getting placed from this degree in a very large amount.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is good there. English is quite boring, but other subjects are interesting and the lectures are interesting too. The program is very structured with weekly assignments and quizzes.
detailed_review.Course Support: The support team is very cooperative. We have a whole department for support. The email and contact be it WhatsApp or text messaging system is available 24/7.

reviews.course: Discontinued (Jun 2025)- B.Sc. in Data Science and Applications
reviews.review_title: I would like to summarise saying everything is valuable. It's really good.

detailed_review.Learning Experience: The course is really valuable for our career. Lectures are well described. They are really good and well designed.
detailed_review.Placements: I can't say it's the best as we lack some practical exposure, but I'm pretty sure in future it will shine.
detailed_review.Faculty: Quality of lectures is really good. Faculty is supportive. Assignments and proper exams are there.
detailed_review.Course Support: Lectures are provided, live sessions and open sessions are held. We get instant help.

reviews.review_title: Our college has an excellent research focus, great campus life, and decent infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: In my batch, about 78% of the registered candidates got placed. The average package was 16.08 LPA and the median was 17.5LPA. One of my friends got the highest package in our batch in a Dubai-based start-up company with a package of about 60 LPA. The roles offered vary on the career path chosen by aerospace engineers, those who chose core jobs were offered roles like structural analyst, and design while others who have taken up jobs in the data science and software-developed sectors, roles include machines learning engineer and data analyst. Some candidates also secured PPOs as product managers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In our department, classrooms are decent and not on par with other departments and modern standards. Most of the academic buildings are Wi-Fi enabled. For first-year common courses and a few interdisciplinary courses, there are state-of-the-art lecture halls. There are North Indian and South Indian messes both further separate as veg/non-veg. A biweekly fixed menu is followed, and the food is average to good depending on the day. There are also 2 food courts in the academic zone and hostel zone, and a restaurant called zaitoon in the hostel zone. The restaurant is affordable and serves good food.
detailed_review.Faculty: All professors in our department are PhDs. While some are good at teaching, most of them are decent at best but they are backed by good research experience. The quality of the teaching is unfortunately also affected by the outdated courses which doesn't make the aerospace curriculum industry relevant. Students will have to do research under professors and publish papers to be eligible for good post-graduate opportunities. Coming to the exams, following what is taught in the class is usually sufficient. The difficulty of the exams can be considered between average-tough. There is no pass percentage, depending on the professor.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I was interested in physics. The course contains a lot of engineering problems where physics is extensively used. The best thing about this course is that it is also mathematically demanding and will be useful in learning CS courses if one chooses to. I wish the course had more emphasis on the industry requirements such as drone designing, UAVs, and clubbing recent developments like AI and ML to make the learning more practical. The campus is beautiful, we have wildlife living alongside us, bringing us closer to nature.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Madras - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: About 50-60% of students get placements in many companies. 150-180 companies visit the college for placements. The highest package offered in 2024 is 4.3 LPA by a Japanese company. The average package is 18 LPA regardless of branch. The lowest package is 6 LPA. For my course, the top recruiting companies are Tata and Momentive. Many students got internships this year along with me in companies like ITC, Jaguar, and BCG. Top roles offered are software, data analysis, and finance roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi overall on campus and in hostels too. We have a library where we get every book for the courses we do. Comics and storybooks are also available. We have centralised AC classrooms for some departments. We have a hospital inside our campus, and it is guided by professional doctors. We have a North and South mess where we get veg and non-veg foods separately. We have a sports complex and many grounds for different sports. We have grounds and many indoor sports in our hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very friendly with students. They even give us their hands-on working projects for the sake of students, which is very useful in internship and placement times. In the course curriculum, we have hands-on experience in everything we do, projects we do on it, and presentations. We have 2 quizzes and 1 end-semester basic. Sometimes, it depends on the professors. The pass percentage is 35%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college as per the NIRF ranking and the best course I got here is mechanical engineering. We have many labs where we see things and how they work. We also have workshops. There is everything that makes us improve in each part of the course. We have a cultural fest named Saarang and a technical fest named Shaastra, which I am a part of. We have many clubs where interested students can take part in. Scholarship is based on the quota for SC, ST, and EWS with parental income less than 1 lakh. The tuition fee is Rs. 7,500, and for others, it is 1 lakh per semester, and the hostel is the same for everyone.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great infrastructure, crowd, and pros.

detailed_review.Placements: A lot of students are interested in core to go for higher studies to learn and work in their desired area. For MME, the placement percentage including core and non-core is 70% out of the registered students. For the MME B.Tech department, the highest salary package offered is 24 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 8 LPA. Firms are Jaguar, Tata Steel, Arthur D Little, ICICI Bank, KPMG, Delloite, Air India, Accenture, Zomato, and many more. Approximately 50% of students got internships. The top roles offered are SDE, analyst, and graduate engineer trainee.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Madras has great infrastructure. The new academic buildings give you a foreign university feel. All rooms are air-conditioned. Recently, 3 new buildings are added and for some buildings, the construction is still going on. The hostel facilities are also fine. Some hostels are newly built and the majority are renovated but they give you hostel vibes rather than 10 floors hostel. Each hostel has a gym, pool, and area to play cricket and football. It has OAT and SAC. Roads are amazing. It has all grounds for sports to play football, hockey, basketball, and badminton.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very passionate and have been in foreign universities for Ph.D.s and research work. Some professors help students a lot for their professional growth and mental well-being. The course curriculum is going to change for the 2028 batch to make students industry-ready. The difficulty of the semester depends on the courses and professors. In a semester, you may have some difficult courses where you have to attend compulsory and some are very hill. The pass percentage falls around 85-95% for a tough course and generally 100% for easy courses.
detailed_review.Other: Just because of the brand name I chose IIT Madras and because of some big name who did MME in their graduation. The best things are choosing electives for core subjects, taking courses as an alternative for projects, and opportunities for higher studies. The campus is very well-connected and easy to reach. The campus crowd and surroundings are amazing and push you to do something great in the future. There are so many opportunities to pursue extracurricular activities through clubs and sports. The institute provides scholarship support through the government and alumni.

reviews.review_title: Exploring excellence: Academic and innovation frontiers of IIT Madras.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2023-24, there were 445 offers and 407 PPOs including 15 international offers. Out of these, 25 offers were provided with a salary package of more than 1 crore per annum. More than 480 companies like Microsoft, Google, Oracle, Texas Instruments, Nvidia, Qualcomm, Samsung, Morgan Stanley, etc., visited the IIT Madras for placements. The average salary package offered is 22.31 LPA. About 778 internship offers are provided. Almost 90% of students got placed in our course and the remaining went to pursue higher studies and civil services. The salary packages offered range from 9-85 LPA. The top roles offered are SDE, IC design engineer, RF engineer, embedded programmer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT M has 16 male hostels and 6 female hostels. Each hostel has a 24-hour hot water supply both for drinking and bathing. Each hostel is equipped with many sports facilities like badminton courts, table tennis, etc. For freshers, it has a triple-sharing room, and from the 2nd year onwards, it has double or single rooms. Air-conditioner facility is not provided. Each room has a high-speed LAN port. Classrooms have high-speed Wi-Fi and air-conditioners. EE department has a lot of research labs too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The student-to-faculty ratio is 1:10. The EE department has the highest number of faculty members in the institute and the most funded for research and innovation. Almost all professors in EE, have done their master's or PhD from the USA. The course curriculum is revised periodically, but even though there is a gap between academics and industry. Exams are tough and there is very high competition among students to get good grades.
detailed_review.Other: I have a great passion for the evolving field of the semiconductor industry. The freedom offered to students is comparable to other colleges. There is no entry or exit time for the hostel and for campus. Food courts and canteen are open almost 24x7. Every event, innovation club, placement, and campus welfare club is coordinated by a dedicated group of students who inculcate leadership skills.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: The Indian Institute of Madaras stands as one of the top engineering institutes in India. The institute is a residential institute located in Chennai. The IIT Madras campus is known for its 617 acres of rich greenery and serenity. The institute has nearly 550 faculties , 8000 students and 1250 administrative & and supporting staff and is a self-contained campus. There are a total of twenty academic departments and a few research centres in various disciplines of engineering and pure sciences, with nearly 100 laboratories .
Check out the campus tour of IIT Madras in the videos below:

sections.heading: IIT Madras Campus Highlights
text: The IIT Madras campus is home to 300 species of trees and plants, a wide variety of native wild species, which are unique to the tropical, dry evergreen vegetation, including the most elegant antelopes in the world - the Blackbuck and 100 species of birds seen at different times of the year.

The IIT Madras Campus is well connected to all means of transport, it is situated 10 km away from the Chennai Airport, 12 km from the Chennai Central Railway Station, and Kasturba Nagar is the nearest station on the Chennai MRTS Line. The campus is also well connected with the city buses.
The IIT Madras offers a wide range of facilities and activities to its students, faculty and staff members. Refer to the table given below to check the important highlights of IIT Madras campus:

sections.heading: IIT Madras Hostel
text: IIT Madras has a total of 22 hostels built for its students pursuing Undergraduate and Postgraduate courses . Students admitted to the first year of the Undergraduate course at IIT Madras are allotted a shared accommodation. Further in the subsequent years, the students are allotted single, double, or triple sharing rooms, depending on their hostels. Out of the 22 hostels, 16 are for males and 6 are for females. All the hostels are named after the mighty rivers of India.

sections.heading: IIT Madras Hostel Facilities
text: Hostels at IIT Madras offer various facilities to the students, such as Wi-Fi connectivity, a Library, a Garden and more. There is a common room in each hostel where all the hostel-level meetings take place. The hostellers celebrate festivals such as Holi, Pongal, Onam, Diwali, and New Year’s Eve. sections.heading: IIT Madras Hostel Life
text: The hostel at IIT Madras has everything a student would require to live comfortably and focus on their studies without any disruptions. Each student gets a cot, a table and chair, an almirah, and all electrical facilities with a LAN port with high-speed internet. Each hostel has a common room consisting of TV, table tennis, pool and foosball tables. For outdoor games, the hostels have a courtyard that serves as a football and cricket ground, and separate basketball and badminton courts are also available.

sections.heading: IIT Madras Library
text: IIT Madras Central Library is well-equipped with modern facilities. It is a five-storey, fully air-conditioned and wifi enabled facility that contains a myriad of resources, including CD-ROMs, online databases, audio-video cassettes, books, e-journals, patents, e-standards, theses, reports, monographs, full-text and bibliographical databases among others. It has subscriptions to famous research journals, including e-subscriptions to a palette of journals.

The library has different sections- Textbook/Reference, General Stacks, Reading Halls, Journals and Current Periodicals, a Media Research Centre (which regularly screens educational and scientific videos), and a Book Bank, among many others.
IIT Madras students by default become members of the Central Library and can avail access to reference materials and books/journals from other libraries in the city as well.
The Central Library at IIT Madras was awarded the Wiley Library Award 2019 in the 'Digitally Transformed Academic Library (Government)' category.

sections.heading: IIT Madras Sports Facilities
text: IIT Madras offers some excellent sports facilities on campus, including an Olympic-standard swimming pool, a well-equipped gymnasium, the impressive IIT-Chemplast cricket ground, a vast stadium, and a high-tech wood-floored multipurpose indoor stadium.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Environmental Engineering and Management
reviews.review_title: If you are passionate about this course, then join this by clearing the GATE.

detailed_review.Placements: In M.Tech, students become eligible for placement from the 3rd semester in the M.Tech programme. Accenture, Flipkart, Deloitte, etc., companies have visited the college for placement, and almost 75% students get placed. The highest package is 25 LPA, and the average package is 8 LPA. 75-85% students get placed in IIT New Delhi in the M.Tech programme. The companies that provide internships to students are Celebal Technology, Deloitte, TCS, Mu Sigma, etc., and a trainer internship is provided to the deserving candidates. Some companies offer a stipend, while some internships are unpaid.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The gym facility is available inside the campus for hostelers, the cafeteria is also there, and library facilities are also available. They are open till 6 pm every day. The hostel facility is quite affordable, but the buildings are old and in need of significant repair. The mess serves decent food. Wi-Fi all over the campus with cctv security. Classrooms are world-class, all-digital facilities available. The campus is big.
detailed_review.Faculty: The timing is enough to prepare for the semester examination, and the difficulty level is moderate. If we study, we can pass the exam with good marks. The faculty-to-student ratio is good, and there are individual faculty members for every subject in M.Tech.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course because it will give me a lot of exposure in environmental engineering, and the placement is also good compared to other courses. The teaching method should be improved by adding practical knowledge and skills rather than theoretical knowledge.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Environmental Engineering and Management
reviews.review_title: Totally satisfied with this college. You have to secure an AIR of 1200 or below to get admission.

detailed_review.Placements: 100% of students get placed in our course. The highest package offered is 3.4 crore per annum, and the lowest package is 15 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Google, ISRO, Microsoft, DRDO, and Wipro. 100% of students get placement in the 1st year itself. Top roles offered at our college are Project Manager, Director, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure in our course/department include fully air-conditioned rooms, 24-hour Wi-Fi with 250 Mbps speed. The library contains all national and international books. Labs are fully equipped with all required items. The mess and canteen food quality and quantity are very good and affordable.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is very good. They provide 24/7 support. This course is curriculum-relevant. It makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are really hard. They are mostly open-book tests, and still, 30% of students cannot pass. You have to clear your concepts to pass.

reviews.review_title: The faculty in the Civil Engineering is excellent.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80-85 percent of Civil Engineering students at IIT Delhi get placed each year, with average packages around 18 LPA-20 LPA, the lowest near 7 LPA-8 LPA, and exceptionally high crossing above 1 crore per annum in rare cases. Top recruiters include consulting, tech, and PSU companies such as BCG, American Express, Microsoft, IOCL, and BPCL. Many students also secure internships in similar firms, with roles in consulting, project engineering, infrastructure management, and design. sections.heading: Introduction
text: The Indian Institute of Technology Delhi is not only known for its academic excellence but is also well renowned for its world-class infrastructure. The institute has a separate administrative unit that oversees all the planning, designing, and construction of new infrastructural facilities on the IIT Delhi campus . The institute has all the basic amenities, including well-equipped classrooms, sports and recreation facilities, and a sports complex, etc., to promote holistic development among the students. To learn more about the IIT Delhi infrastructure , read this article.
Check out the review of IIT Delhi around its faculty, placements campus and more:

sections.heading: IIT Delhi Campus Highlights 2024
text: Spread across 325 acres of land, IITD is situated in Hauz Khas, New Delhi. It has two satellite campuses in Sonipat and Jhajjar . The institute is well connected with the city by metro, bus, and other transport options. From food and banks to hospitals, the IIT Delhi campus is equipped with all basic amenities where students can focus on their studies by fulfilling their personal needs. The campus of IITD consists of hostels , the Mess Karmachari Quarters , academic blocks , the Research and Innovation Park , etc. Some of the key highlights are tabulated below:

tables.IIT Delhi Campus Highlights: Library, Cafeteria, Hostel, Sports Complex, Auditorium, Research centres, Banks, Medical services, Gym, etc.

sections.heading: IIT Delhi Hostel & Residential Facilities
text: The institute offers several residential programs for which it provides in-campus hostel facilities for the students. Its residential infrastructure is designed in a way to offer a better and more comfortable lifestyle to the students, faculties, and staff. The accommodations are fully furnished and include all the basic amenities. All the IIT Delhi hostels run in cooperative mode, wherein the operations are handled by elected student leadership under the guidance of designated faculty members. The Board of Hostel Management (BHM) purviews the operations. Each student representative is responsible for taking care of administrative matters at the hostel level.

IIT Delhi has 13 hostels for boys and 5 separate hostels for girls. IIT Delhi hostel rooms are spacious and well-maintained to fulfil both academic and social needs. IIT Delhi hostel facilities include a reading room, a dining hall with a mess, an indoor games room , etc. Since the institute has limited space for on-campus accommodation, the hostels are provided to the students on a sharing basis . For candidates enrolling in UG courses, non-air-conditioned accommodations are available as of now. However, there are air-conditioned common areas available on the hostel campus.

Besides hostels, the institute has separate accommodation for the faculty members. Namely Gulmohar and Amaltas , the faculty rooms are available inside the IIT Delhi campus. Including both old and new campuses, a total of 600 in-campus houses are designed to provide accommodation to the faculty members. These houses have basic electrical equipment (like fans and tube lights) and water supply. The residential area of the institute consisted of the following:

sections.heading: IIT Delhi Hostel Life
text: Hostel life at IIT Delhi is a blend of modern facilities and at-home comfort along with 24x7 security. Students enjoy their graduation by collaborating with each other in the hostels. Apart from studies, the student's reviews on Shiksha tell various fun stories of students. Read how was the first year of Anagh Prasad (JEE Main 2013 Topper) at IIT Delhi .
Check out a video on a student's life at IIT Delhi:

sections.heading: IIT Delhi Academic and Research Facilities
text: The IITD campus is divided into three areas, namely, residential, academic, and hostel . Talking about the academic area, it is spread across 61.1 acres, and it has multiple buildings and complexes that provide students with high-quality education and research facilities. The academic and research facilities of IIT Delhi provide a perfect environment for education and innovation at the same time. The institute has a Central Research Facility (CRF) centre inside its Hauz Khas campus. A newly constructed CRF building at the Sonipat campus is also operational, where the latest equipment, such as the Atomic Force Microscope, Amersham Typhoon Biomolecular Imager and Blue Diode Laser System with Welding Head , among other latest technologies, are available for use. Such high-end research facilities provided at the IIT Delhi campus promise to improve the efficiency of research as well as meet international standards. The academic area of the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi consists of the following entities:

sections.heading: IIT Delhi Library
text: IIT Delhi has a Central library along with the departmental libraries. For providing world-class education and bringing knowledge to the students, the library is subscribed to 690 current journals and has a rich book collection. There are over 463,000 journal articles, 2,100 books, over 2,261 microfilms, and thousands of technical reports. There is also a photocopying facility available within the premises through an external vendor or payment basis.
Further, IIT Delhi alumni can also access the central library on the renewal of membership from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. The faculty members and employees can also take the membership.

Corporate Membership: Corporate houses can also take membership at IIT Delhi Central Library. An annual payment of INR 15,000 has to be made for the same. In addition, the corporate members can borrow only a maximum of two books for 14 days .

sections.heading: IIT Delhi Sports Facilities
text: For holistic development among the students, IIT Delhi has ample sports facilities, including lush green playgrounds, walking/running tracks, sports fields (for athletics, cricket, hockey, and football), etc. It has a racetrack of 400 m. The sports infrastructure of IIT Delhi offers a healthy and competitive environment to the students for their physical growth. IIT Delhi sports facilities have both indoor and outdoor games, such as a cricket ground, tennis court, etc.

Located near the Gulmohar guest house, IIT Delhi also has a Student Activity Center (SAC) where students can enjoy table tennis, squash, snooker, etc. It also has an Olympic-sized swimming pool and a separate exercise room for men and women. text: The IITD campus is situated in the Hauz Khas area of South Delhi. Being in the prime location of the capital, there are plenty of places to explore for students. On weekends, students can go out and enjoy the beauty of Qutub Minar and Lotus Temple . A simple Google search will also recommend good places to eat around the places. South Delhi is filled with a lot of good cafés. IIT Delhi campus is also near to various other educational institutes, including JNU , IIFT , and more.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The IIT Delhi Library System comprises of a Central Library and departmental libraries. The Library has subscribed to 690 current journals and a rich collection of books on science and technology including chemistry, mathematics, physics, chemical engineering, civil engineering, computer science, electrical and electronics engineering, textile engineering, biochemical and biomedical engineering, humanities and social sciences. The library houses a collection of 1,94,471+ books,  bound volumes of journals is around 1,03,942+,standards are 26,923+,microfilms are 2,261+, theses are in no.of 4,322+, technical reports are around 13,430+. It has also incorporated video cassettes, CDs and online electronic journals.The Library provides photocopying facility within the premises of the Library through an external vendor on payment basis.Also facilitates internet service.

facilities.name: Cafeteria
facilities.description: IIT Delhi has cafeteria near the academic buildings, a South Indian food court (Southy) in boys hostel area. There are many shops like Amul, Lipton, Nescafe and Cafe Coffee Day in institute area. Some hostels like Kumaon, Zanskar, Aravali, Girnar and Karakoram have a tea halt and there’s a Lipton right outside Vindhyachal and a Mother Dairy behind Nilgiri and in front of Kumaon.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: IIT, Delhi has a total number of 14 hostel; 11 for boys and 3 for girls. The boys’ hostels are Nilgiri, Karakoram, Aravali, Jwalamukhi,Satpura, Zanskar, Kumaon, Vindyachal, Shivalik, Girnar and Udaigir. Kailiash and Himadri Hostels are for girls. Each hostel in the institute is self-contained with amenities such as a reading room, an indoor games room, a lounge and a dining hall with mess.All rooms have been provided with Internet facilities.Xeroxing facilities and STD/ISD/PCO facilities are available in all the Hostels.

highlights.summary:
Established in 1958, Indian Institute of Technology Bombay is also known as IIT Bombay or IIT Mumbai. IIT Bombay has been declared a 'Deemed University' and is autonomous. IITB is the first public college to have laid its foundation stone with assistance from UNESCO. The institute has also been declared an Institute of National Importance by the Parliament of India in 1961. IIT Bombay has been conferred the status of Institute of Eminence by the Ministry of Human Resources and Development in July 2018.
IIT Bombay offers degree and dual degree courses at UG, PG and PhD levels across Engineering, Science, and Management streams. The flagship courses at IITB include BTech, MTech, and MBA. IIT Bombay has recently launched 2 professional certificate programmes, namely, Professional Certificate in Software Development and Professional Certificate in Cybersecurity. Further, the institute also offers interdisciplinary programmes and short-term and distance learning courses.
The institute has 17 academic departments, 30+ centers, and 3 schools to offer more than 80 courses. IIT Bombay also facilitates various research programmes in domains such as science and technology such as , Aerospace Engineering, Biosciences and Bioengineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Machine Intelligence and Data Science, Energy Science and Engineering, etc. Admissions to the institute are accepted through national-level tests conducted by various authorities, such as JEE Advanced, GATE, etc.
IIT Bombay is ranked 3 under the 'Overall' and 'Engineering' categories by the NIRF Rankings 2025. It is also ranked #129 in the World University category by the QS Rankings 2026. IITB faculty is highly qualified, dedicated, and experienced and hold prestigious awards such as, the Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar and Padma honours. In addition to this, IIT Mumbai has several notable alumni including Parag Agrawal (Twitter CEO), Kailasavadivoo Sivan (ISRO Chairman), Nandan Nilekani (Non-Executive Chairman, Infosys), Bhavish Aggarwal (Co-founder, Ola Cabs), and Vipul Goyal (Indian Comedian).
