reviews.review_title: My college campus is very nice.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 80-85 percent of students are placed in our college every year. The highest package from our college is approximately 1.5 crores. Google, Microsoft, Adobe, Oracle, and Bajaj are some of the major recruiting companies. There are a total of 163 companies for placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Our college has the famous James Thomson building, which is famous across the country. The Wi-Fi is very good. Wi-Fi is available in hostels and classrooms. Hostels are better, but three students live in a single room.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. Their teaching style is nice, but some teachers are not good, and their voice does not reach the back of the class. Semester exams are very difficult and not easy to pass. They are similar to previous year papers, and students cannot score well by studying only one night before.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college because it is the only option I have. Events and fests are conducted every few months.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied. Placements are very good, which makes this a perfect Tier 1 college.

detailed_review.Placements: Honestly, 95 percent of students get placed in our department. The highest package is 1.20 crores per annum, and the lowest package is 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Deloitte, Jio, and many others. All students get internships in the 2nd year. Top roles are HR, product management, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are excellent, with single rooms available. Classrooms are five-star and fully air-conditioned. The library is impressive, with all types of books available. The food in the mess is very good, fresh, and hygienic. All types of sports are also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and understanding. They provide 24-hour support. Teachers are of high quality and have master’s degrees in their subjects. The course curriculum makes students industry-ready, and companies are impressed by our college students. Semester exams are very hard. You have to be consistent in your studies to score well.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My journey and experience at IITR.

detailed_review.Placements: In our CSE batch, around 90% of students get placed. Coming to packages, the highest package is at the crore level, the average package is 15 LPA, and the lowest package is 8 LPA. Top companies include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, quant companies, etc. The roles offered are SDE, data science, ML engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For our department/course, we have fast Wi-Fi, modern labs, smart classrooms, and rich central libraries. Hostel facilities are decent enough with 24/7 internet. Even the mess food is good and decent. Medical centres are always available. Coming to the sports section, it is excellent and well-maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching staff is highly qualified, helpful, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is concept-oriented and very practical. The curriculum is relevant and industry-oriented. Semester exams are tough, but grading is very fair. The pass percentage is around 98% with regular attendance and effort.
detailed_review.Other: I chose computer science because I had a strong interest in coding and problem-solving. My best parts are strong fundamentals and projects. IIT Roorkee has vibrant fests, good connectivity, a green campus, scholarships, and active clubs.

reviews.review_title: Overall really good absolutely dissatisfied from mess and faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: This time IIT Roorkee is having one of its worst placement seasons. 100 students are placed in the current placement season from mechanical branch. The highest package offered is 51LPA the lowest package offered is 10LPA and the average package offered is 21LPA. The top recruiting companies are Amazon and Oracle. The positions offered are software development management and supply chain. 50 students got internships and mostly people got off campus. The PIC cell has failed to bring the much needed core companies like Jaguar and even negotiate proper offers or request more vacancies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course structure is very good but it still needs improvement as most of the courses are either related to out of industry knowledge or are completely backward structured. More courses like data structures or a course providing interview knowledge regarding data structures questions being asked in the interview. Classrooms have highly functional Wi-Fi AC and heaters. The library is excellent. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is the worst with a rating of 1 out of 5 stars. The medical facilities sports and games are excellent as there are experienced doctors and coaches to help us in our endeavor.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here are no doubt extremely knowledgeable and highly qualified but they are not that helpful. Most of them do not explain the doubts properly and they also expect that no one will copy the assignments and also submit on time. The course curriculum is slightly relevant it needs to improve vastly as it fails to make the students industry ready and thus many students have to prepare online to crack interviews and even company exams. The semester exams are really difficult and the grading is relevant. There is no pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: II purely got this branch due to my JEE Advanced Rank. Electrical or electronics are always my first preference but even though the mechanical branch is really good and I will say it exposes you to the world of robotics advanced printing technology and also enabled me to build an underwater vehicle. I  wish my course to have more subjects evolving around computer Science or data structure and algorithms as it becomes really difficult for people who are aiming for non core jobs. Fest events campus and connectivity are excellent.

reviews.review_title: Excellent but dissatisfied with faculty and course structure.

detailed_review.Placements: This time IIT Roorkee is having the worst placement season with only 47 companies coming for this placement/internship season. 100 students are placed from the mechanical branch. The highest package offered is 51 LPA the average package offered is 19 LPA and the lowest package offered is 6.6LPA. Top recruiting company is Amazon and it came for various posts. Top roles offered are management and software development. 40 people got on campus internships and others went for off campus internships. This is not a good result as the PIC is failing to bring more core companies and negotiate better offers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our department has many facilities including smart classrooms and laboratories. Classrooms are good they have all the facilities but laboratories are still developing. There are some outdated methods that are still being used considering them to be basic experiments. Some of them are really outdated. There is a central library which is very good well maintained. Hostels are good they have many facilities including Wi-Fi gyms canteens and sports rooms. The main problem is the mess it offers really bad quality and taste of food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are experienced qualified knowledgeable and helpful. Some faculty members are really rude towards the students and some faculty members also do favoritism towards a particular community of students. They are trying to make it relevant they introduce some new courses like AI/ML and Data Science but they are still unable to deliver quality content about the course. The professor with little knowledge about the course is assigned to teach the course instead of assigning a good faculty. It does not make students industry ready. They are very hard and the grading system is relatively so we do not have a pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: ]I got the course by JEE Advanced Rank although I will have gone for a higher branch if I am eligible. Mechanical branch is good if one is really interested in understanding the dynamics and the core functionality of the secondary sector of the country. Personally the best thing about the course is that I get to work with 3D printers and CNC machines. The course should cater more to be industry specific for contemporary times rather than teaching the old stuff that is no longer used in industries. Events fest campus crowd extracurricular activities are 1000 on 10.

reviews.review_title: Excellent infrastructure, but dissatisfied with placements and internships.

detailed_review.Placements: This year IIT Roorkee has the worst placement season with only 47 companies coming to the college. The placement cell is an absolute mess. They are not working properly, have little communication with branch DPRs, and limited interaction with company HRs for any further vacancies or offers that might be available if they negotiate. 45 students get internships from my course batch. The highest package is 10 lakhs for a 6 months internship, and the lowest is Rs. 25,000 for two months. Top recruiting and most internships go to Amazon. Top roles so far are management and software development.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course is a complete 4 out of 5. Classrooms are amazing with excellent seating, AC, and heaters in winters. The practical labs cater to job-ready skills that mechanical engineers require, such as CAD modeling and sessions on 3D printing. Hostels are 3.5 out of 5 because the management is good, but the rooms could be more modern. The Wi-Fi system and balconies score 5 out of 5. The canteen and mess food are good, both 3.5 out of 5. Medical facilities and sports are excellent, 5 out of 5.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is too vast, and some subjects are outdated, like manufacturing technology. The majority of the portion is related to old-style casting and holding methods, while newer methods like CNC machines and 3D printers are taught briefly, even though it is an advanced course. I would score faculty members 2 out of 5 because of some good professors. The professors are excellent at their craft, but they should listen to the students’ needs more. Exams are tough, but from a teacher’s point of view, they are excellent. The exact pass percentage varies from subject to subject, but on average, it is around 95%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose my course mainly because I get it according to my JEE Advanced rank and IIT Roorkee is among the top 7 colleges of India. I am also fascinated by the mountain life. Mechanical is a very good branch with average packages of placement going up to 25 LPA. More efforts are needed to update the syllabus so that students are more industry efficient. The campus, people, fests, surroundings, campus life, and extracurricular activities are 1000 out of 10. I do not have any scholarships but, my friend receives around Rs. 67,000 per sem. Connectivity is awesome too.

reviews.review_title: Sometimes, prioritize college over the desire.

detailed_review.Placements: In the core branches, placements are a bit low, no specific companies are visiting the college for branch oriented courses. Students get job opportunities in different domains, in which they get average package of 5 to 7LPA, and the highest goes to 10 to 15LPA. PSUs like ONGC, BARC, and IOL are recruiting. They hire for the manager role and the system engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Departmental infrastructure is average, not like the whole campus, with a limited lab for the core branches. Wi-Fi enabled departments and classrooms are, on average, not equipped with many facilities, like comfortable seating. Libraries are there, which are accessible all the time. Hostel facilities are just okay, it depends on which hostel you are living in. Canteen and mess food have average taste. Sports facilities are there where you can explore all games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of my department are okay, they have proper knowledge and skills regarding their courses, which is very helpful for the students to clear. They teach from the very basic to the advanced level. The course is not helpful for getting industry ready. Semester exams are easy to moderate, with a level 90% of the students pass.
detailed_review.Other: Events and extracurricular activities of this college are best when you really enjoy them, the campus crowd provides a versatile behavior and mindset.

reviews.review_title: A short review of IIT Roorkee and its earth science department.

detailed_review.Placements: It has good placement and internship opportunities for higher branches. For core, you have to maintain 8+ CGPA atleast as it plays a major factor. The highest package for our branch is around 25 LPA, and the lowest is around 12 LPA. Top recruiters are ONGC, Schlumberger, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Department facilities are decent with well-equipped labs, and all the instruments work properly. Classrooms are also mostly tidy. Regarding the hostel, for me it's been 3 years now on the campus so I have experience living in 3 hostels. I think the best one is Jawahar by far in terms of mess, canteen, and extracurricular activities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are pretty helpful and friendly in nature. They are pretty qualified and knowledgeable as well. Doubt-solving sessions are also conducted. The course curriculum is relevant but mostly depends on student's focus and interest whether he or she is industry-ready or not.
detailed_review.Other: Found this very unique course and wanted to explore more of it. I wish that we had more job opportunities in the core industry.

reviews.review_title: IIT Roorkee - The IIT of your dreams.

detailed_review.Placements: 85% is the placement percentage. 1.5 crores per annum is the highest package. Top recruiting companies are Jaguar, DE Shaw, Microsoft, Intuit, BCG, Google, Amazon, Mastercard, Sprinkle, Zepto, JP Morgan, BNY Mellon, and many more. Top roles offered are quant roles, SDE roles, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The whole campus is Wi-Fi equipped. The library and other academic facilities are state-of-the-art. Some hostels are better than others and are good, others are okayish. Mess food is so bad, but breakfast is awesome and nutritional. Sports facilities and gym are top-notch.
detailed_review.Faculty: Course Curriculum is relevant for the most part, and it does make students industry-ready, though more practical knowledge is needed. Teachers are very knowledgeable, but some professors don't interact that much, which is the case in every college, still, overall, good professors. Semester exams are average to above average here. The pass grade for a course is 4.
detailed_review.Other: Electrical Engineering is a very versatile course in terms of placements, most technical and non-technical companies allow you to sit in their tests, and you can target core companies. Betterment is needed in the mess and hostels, but it's still not that bad. Fests are amazing here, and the campus life is just too much fun.

reviews.review_title: I am satisfied with the campus and faculty. The core placements are not satisfactory.

detailed_review.Placements: About 60% of students got placed in 2024 with an average package of 20 LPA. The highest package is 36 LPA, and the lowest package is 12 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Schlumberger, OIL, etc. About 50% of students got internship opportunities. Most of them got a data analyst intern or a product analyst intern position in various companies. Many students are placed in non-core roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good. There is Wi-Fi on the whole campus. Labs are well-maintained with all the modern equipment. The condition of classrooms of our department is a little bit deteriorated. The mess food is good, and the canteen food is reliable. There are good facilities for sports. Medical facilities are the best, and we can consult a doctor at any time.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and knowledgeable. Their teaching quality is top-notch. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry-ready. If we want to do further studies, then it is one of the best courses. Semester exams are easy to pass. Almost all students pass exams.

reviews.review_title: World-class infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 90% of students were placed in our course. The highest package offered in our course was 32 LPA. The lowest package was 8 LPA. The average package was 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Siemens, Bharat Biotech, etc. Almost all students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were of a premium class. Wi-Fi-enabled campus. Modern design library with huge books. The laboratory was also equipped with all the updated instruments and machines. The hostel was also very nice. Multiple sports complexes are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their respective domains. The teaching quality of our faculty members was extremely good. The course curriculum was relevant. It makes students industry-ready. The semester examination was at a moderate level.

reviews.review_title: Review of Roorkee IIT for the Post Graduate Diploma in Hydrology course.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college has the best placements. The highest package offered in the college ranges from 3-8 LPA. Many companies provide internships in college. The one condition for participating in placements is that it requires 60% marks in all semesters.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college's infrastructure quality is very good. The college canteen food is also good, very tasty, and hygienic.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very intelligent and very helpful to students. They provide more knowledge of multiple sources. This course is practical, so teachers are different for it and not the same as theoretical subjects. This course is a total of 2 years in duration. There are 2 semester exams, and they are very difficult.
detailed_review.Other: Every year, the sports committee organises sports and games tournaments like kabaddi, cricket, football, tug of war, etc. It also organises cultural events.

reviews.review_title: IIT Roorkee College in M.Tech course admission information.

detailed_review.Placements: In this college, placement facilities were very good. Big companies were interested to the college, and provided 4 LPA to 9 LPA salary. TCS, Accenture, Wipro, Infotech, Infosys, etc., companies were involved.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: High-quality infrastructure was available, and many facilities were provided to students. There were facilities like classroom, labs, Wi-Fi router, bathroom, hostel, canteen, etc. In this college, every year sports and games facilities were organised for many students but it was charged for participating in events.
detailed_review.Faculty: In this college, teachers were very intelligent. High degree education completed like Ph.D, M.Tech, etc. These types of courses were completed with teachers and professors present. This course was total 4 years course duration and 8 semester exam. There was one semester exam and 900 to 1100 marks of exam paper conducted by the college.

reviews.review_title: It is the best college with a gate to Himalayas.

detailed_review.Placements: 100% of students got placements (2022 batch). The lowest package is 7 LPA, and the highest package is 60 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Myntra, Microsoft, Jaguar, EXL, Licious, etc. 55% of students get Internships. Roles like SDE, data analytics, and mechanical engineering are offered here. They come to recruit for almost all roles from teaching to acting to finance to product. If we name it, then they take it. There are very supportive seniors to help us crack interviews.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available on the whole campus. Classrooms are full of AC. The central library has a sitting capacity for more than 1,000 students. The hostel is there with a mess. Food is good, and a lot of variety is available. There is a canteen open 24 hours. Sports complex is also open for 24 hours.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and very interested in research. The quality of teaching is okay. The course curriculum is not highly relevant. Exams are full of difficulty and not so difficult to make us depressed. Relatively marking is there to help students. If a student fails, then they get a chance for a re-exam without any sort of issues. The best part of the exam is that it gets over in 2-3 days, and does not stretch to 1 month like other colleges, so students get ample time for extracurricular activities.
detailed_review.Other: Two big events are organised, one is a technical fest named Cognizance, and the other is a cultural fest named Thomson. It is India's 2nd largest fest after IIT Bombay's Mood Indigo. There are different groups like Himalyan explore club, dramatics, dancing, IIT Roorkee Motors, sports, and Knox for all-terrain vehicles.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Academics, campus, and placements - IITR ECE Review.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement rate for ECE is approximately 90%, with around 90% of students getting placed every year. The highest is more than 60 LPA, the lowest is 6-7 LPA, and the average is 17-18 LPA. Top recruiters are Texas, Intel, JP Morgan, Google, Oracle, and Cisco. Roles offered range from data science, software development, hardware design, VLSI, product management, to quant research.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: More than 10 hostels are there. We also have a coed hostel (married). Every hostel has its mess, stationery shops, gyms, study rooms, cyber rooms, fruit corners, and a tailor. Speak of any facility, we have it. The hospital has 24/7 facilities. The central library is open 24/7 around exam time and is fully air-conditioned. Food is fair and healthy; there are plenty of canteens available 24/7. Our college encourages sports and games and conducts intra/inter-bhawan sports events and many more.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, with most holding PhDs and conducting active research. They are helpful and very approachable. The curriculum is a bit tough, but can be cracked easily if you are a regular student. It’s very relevant. Exams are moderately difficult and focus more on conceptual questions. The pass percentage is very high at our institute.
detailed_review.Other: I don’t think I need to talk about IIT Roorkee’s events, fests, and campus crowd; everybody knows about its cultural fest THOMSO and tech fest CONGNIZANCE. These are the absolute highlights. I chose my course because I am deeply passionate about learning core ECE and hardware.

reviews.review_title: IIT Roorkee is heaven for me.

detailed_review.Placements: In our college and also in my course, almost 70% of students get placed. In my course, the highest package is 50 LPA, and the lowest is 8 LPA. The average package is 16 LPA. Quantbox, Graviton, and Google are the top recruiters. The top roles are analyst and senior development engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Each hostel room has a Wi-Fi connection. You can access Wi-Fi throughout the whole campus. Our department has multiple labs and a microscope worth 2.0 crores. Each hostel is good, and the messy food is also recommendable. Each hostel has a night and day canteen, which helps students get things at any time. Each hostel has its own sports ground and common areas like study rooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are very good. They are highly qualified as well as interactive. Our course is very relevant, and its relevance is increasing because of the upcoming merger of biotech and AI. The future is moving towards sustainable development and a healthier lifestyle, so the relevance of our degree is rapidly increasing.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I have an interest in Biology and Genetics. In our course, more practical knowledge would be a better way of teaching. Our college has two main fests, a cultural fest named Thomso and a technical fest named Cognizance, held in October and March, respectively. Multiple clubs and societies run by students help you build a career in your passion area.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied because of the best faculty members and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Nearly 85% of students get placed in our course. The highest package is nearly 1 crore per annum. The lowest package is nearly 10 LPA and the average package is 40 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are Google, Microsoft, and IBM. Nearly 95% of students got internships at Google, Microsoft, IBM, and Bank of America. The top roles offered are software engineer, mobile app developer, and cybersecurity specialist.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college provides free high-speed Wi-Fi, highly equipped labs, high infrastructure in the classroom with more capacity, and a huge library with books related to all branches and with an online book learning facility. The food is good mainly North Indian. The mess and canteen food will be good and even there will be a fruit stall, day canteen, night canteen, gym, TV room and study hall in every hostel. Medical facilities are 24x7 and even in an emergency, there is an ambulance. There are many sectors for sports with flexible timings.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are knowledgeable and qualified. The teaching quality is good. The course curriculum is very relevant, very useful in the future, and even interesting. There will be tutorials for 20-30 students to explain doubts regarding the lectures by PhD students. Semester exams are a bit difficult and the pass percentage is 90%.
detailed_review.Other: It is one of the oldest IITs. We will get better scholarships every year. Fests organised are great like Thomson, and E-summit.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Students will experience a very interesting life here with good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: I am not sure about other branches but in our computer science branch this year, 105 out of 110 students got placed on campus. The highest package ranges from 1.5 or 2 crores per annum. The average package is 35 LPA and the lowest package is 16 LPA. Major companies like Microsoft, Google, and all others have offered placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no doubt about Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library. I think our Wi-Fi is the fastest Wi-Fi in all IITs. When it comes to food I am from South India so it is somewhat difficult to have hostel food but we have pretty good canteens. Students of North India will not have any problem I think.
detailed_review.Faculty: First of all, it is IIT and it is the top among the top 6 IITs, so I don't know about curriculum and courses. Professors are there to help us any time. They are ready at any time to clarify our doubts. They don't even hesitate how many we ask and we can do projects under their guidance.
detailed_review.Other: Events are fabulous. I chose IIT because it has nice placements with packages.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The campus looks so beautiful. The placements and infrastructure are really great.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90% of the students will definitely get placed, as we are all from a Computer Science background, and that too from a NIRF 5 college. All that matters here is CGPA, if it is 8.5 and above, then we can apply to any on-campus companies related to software and prepare according for the selection. Some of the well-known companies coming to our campus are Google, Microsoft, and Dream11. But note that a company gives the same CTC to all the students once placed there, apart from independent of their talent. For example, Google gives 19- 20 LPA and Microsoft gives 50 LPA as CTC.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are single, double, and triple rooms allotted, and I got a single room, which is very spacious. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Also, for each hostel, there are 2 canteens, 1 study room with AC, a gym, and a play area too. The classrooms are well built and there are projectors, televisions, AC, and room heaters, so that students can focus well. The same works for the library, too. The labs are also well-equipped, and any damage will be repaired as soon as possible.
detailed_review.Faculty: There won't be any pass percentage, as most of the exams will be relatively graded. The teachers really have a great knowledge, but most of the time we can't understand their teaching, and we need to study on our own. I feel it happens in every top college, but the materials and resources they provide are good. Recently, some changes were made in our curriculum, which I personally did not like, as some less useful courses have been added and more useful courses have been removed.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Nice infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 90 students out of 120 were placed for the 2025 placement session in ECE at IITR. Many got placed in core ECE roles and software roles, and some even cracked quant positions. The average package offered is around 23 LPA-25 LPA. Internships aren't that fortunate. Around 60-65 students got internships on campus, with an average stipend of around Rs. 60,000 - Rs. 70,000.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms (particularly APJ Abdul Kalam LHC) are top-class. Hostels are a bit old but manageable, with a 24/7 canteen, but an average mess. Wi-Fi speed is good enough for any task be it gaming or studying, but improvements could be made.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty consists of highly qualified professors, many of them those who have dedicated more than half of their lives to a subject. The revised course curriculum seems cool, removing redundant subjects including compulsory management electives.

faqs.question: What is the JEE Advanced cut off for B.Tech in CSE at IIT Roorkee?
faqs.answer: IIT Roorkee BTech cutoff 2024 has been released across multiple specialisations. Based on the Round 5 seat allotment, the BTech cutoff scores ranged between 481 and, 7286 for the General AII India category students. Among all the BTech specialisations, BTech in CSE is the most competitive specialisation. The Last Round for Computer Science and Engineering is 481 for the General AI category. Furthermore, according to IIT Roorkee OBC AI category cutoff 2024, the Last Round closing rank for Computer Science and Engineering is 236 . In addition, the cutoff varied from 236 to 3549 in the OBC category. For more information, click here .

faqs.question: How much rank is required for IIT Roorkee CSE?
faqs.answer: Opening and Closing rank depends on the category and quota of candidates. For general category under All India, opening rank was 396 and closing rank was 412. Cut off are differant when it comes to other categories or female candidates and even domicile of home state. In All India, opening and closing rank for female candidates was 164 and 1165. Admission to B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering in IIT Roorkee - Indian Institute of Technology is based on the scores obtained in the entrance exam JEE Advanced. Applicants are advised to confirm what category are they applying while checking for cut offs.

faqs.question: What is the fees of BTech strcuture in IIT Roorkee?
faqs.answer: IIT Roorkee BTech fee is INR 8 lakh.  Apart from this, students are required to pay the JEE Main application fee which is INR 625 (for boys) and INR 325 (for girls). For JEE Advanced, the application fee ranges from INR 1,400 to INR 2,800 for different category students.

faqs.question: Which IIT Roorkee branches remain open till the last counselling round for admission?
faqs.answer: For students belonging to the General AI quota, most of the BTech branches remained open till the last round for admission at IIT Roorkee. The cutoffs of different branches vary across rounds and categories. Some of the BTech branches, such as CSE, ECE, Civil, and Mechanical , etc., reflected a rise in the last round, closing ranks as compared to initial rounds, indicating IIT Roorkee seats remained vacant till the last round for BTech admission. Whether the branch will remain open till the last round or not depends on the availability of seats allocated for each category. In the meantime, candidates can check out the round-wise cutoff details for a few BTech branches of IIT Roorkee for the students belonging to the General AI quota.

faqs.question: Does IIT Roorkee accept IIT JAM score for M.Sc admission?
faqs.answer: Yes, IIT Roorkee accepts IIT JAM scores for admission to MSc courses offered. Considering IIT Roorkee JAM 2024 Cutoff, the courses offered were MSc in Physics, MSc in Chemistry, MSc in Applied Geology, MSc in Mathematics and Economics. For the General All India category candidates, the last round Cutoff ranks ranged between 52 and 232 .

faqs.question: I got 200 rank in IIT JAM for Mathematics. Can I get admission in IIT Roorkee in the EWS category?
faqs.answer: IIT Roorkee accepts IIT JAM scores for admission to the MSc course. Analysing the IIT JAM cutoff, MSc in Economics was turned out to be the most competitive specialisations when compared it with the other four specialisations. For Mathematics, the Round 1 and the Last Round closing ranks were 247 and 272 , respectively for the Economically Weaker Section category candidates for the All India Quota. So, considering the 2023 cutoff ranks, yes a candidate can get into IIT Roorkee with 200 rank in IIT JAM for MSc in Mathematics.

faqs.question: Do I need to give any entrance exam for admission to BSc at IIT Roorkee?
faqs.answer: Yes, in order to take admission in IIT Roorkee BSc courses, candidates must first qualify JEE Main. Students who qualify JEE Main are then required to register and appear for JEE Advanced. This exam is conducted by one of the IITs every year by rotation under the supervision of a Joint Admission Board, which comprises of representatives from all the IITs. IIT Roorkee makes the selection based on candidate’s rank according to the merit in JEE Main+ JEE Advanced.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for BSc at IIT Roorkee?
faqs.answer: In order to be eligible to apply for BSc at IIT Roorkee , candidate must have completed Class 12 with a minimum of 75%. Moreover, interested students must qualify JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced exam. Admissions to IIT Roorkee BSc courses will be made based on merit in JEE Main+ JEE advanced and seat availability intake of IIT Roorkee.

faqs.question: What is the fees for BSc courses at IIT Roorkee?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fees for BSc courses at IIT ranges between INR 8 Lacs to INR 10 Lacs for course duration of four-five years, as per the official website/sanctioning body. It is, however, subject to changes and hence, is indicative. Apart from this tuition fees, the college also charges students for few more components mentioned below.

faqs.question: What is the admission process to get into BSc at IIT Roorkee?
faqs.answer: In order to get into BSc at IIT Roorkee candidate must have passed Class 12 with a minimum of 75%. Further, the candidate is required to qualify JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced. IIT Roorkee admits students based on merit in JEE Main+JEE Advanced. Once the JEE Advanced results are out, students must register at the JoSAA counselling portal. Further counselling and seat allocation is done through this particular portal. Upon allocation of seat, candidates must pay partial fees on the JoSAA portal itself. After that, students will be required to report to the allocated institute in the stipulated time frame. Students will be successfully admitted upon payment of the remaining fees.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in IIT Roorkee MBA?
faqs.answer: To be eligible for MBA programme offered at IIT Roorkee, candidates need to possess a graduation degree/ professional qualification in any stream from a UGC-recognised university with a minimum of 60% aggregate (55% for SC/ ST/ PwD candidates). data.title: IIT Roorkee Placement Report 2025
summary: As per the media reports, overall 742 offers were made out of which 222 were PPOs during IIT Roorkee placements 2025 (Phase 1). Further, 163 companies visited the campus during placements 2025. sections.heading: Introduction
text: The Institute has over three campuses namely a 365-acre campus at Roorkee, a 25-acre campus at Saharanpur, and a 10-acre campus of Greater Noida Extension Centre at Greater Noida. IIT Roorkee has 8,000+ students, hostels , clubs, sports facilities, guest houses, 10 boys' hostels, three girls' hostels, one coed hostel, and six married couples' hostels. The institute has UG, PG, Alaknanda clubs, and various other facilities for the students. IIT Roorkee's library has a collection of more than 3.20 lakh documents, Online databases, CD-ROMs, standards, audio-video material, specifications, theses, reports, etc
Check out more on IIT Roorkee Infrastructure:

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: IIT Roorkee library has a rich collection of more than 3,20,000 documents, CD-ROMs, Online databases, audio-video material, standards, specifications, theses, reports etc. It also has access to more than 8000 electronic journals.

facilities.name: Cafeteria
facilities.description: IIT Roorkee has many cafeterias. Apart from the all-night canteens, which are present in each hostel, there are 3 major cafes on campus, namely Nescafe, Alpahar and the University Canteen.These cafeterias provide quality food at reasonable prices.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: IIT Roorkee has 10 boys' hostels, 3 girls' hostels and 6 hostels for married candidates. All the hostels have basic amenities like cyber cafe, gym, Wi-Fi, water purifiers, common room, recreation room, mess, TV, laundry services, security and surveillance system etc.

data.description: All the faculty members at IIT Roorkee are PhD holders and have vast experience. The faculty-student ratio is about 1:3 at IIT Roorkee which is among the best in the country.

paragraphs: IIT Roorkee provides financial assistance to students by offering them scholarship schemes like Inspire She Scheme and various other schemes. Economically weaker students can avail of the tuition fee waiver benefit. Students having a strong academic background can also benefit from the IIT Roorkee scholarships. Check the list of IIT Roorkee scholarships mentioned below:
Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (MCM)
- IIT Roorkee awards this scholarship to the students who are meritorious but have financial constraints
- MCM scholarship is offered to 25% of undergraduate students
- Students admitted in MSc second year can also apply for it
Convocation Awards/ Scholarship
- IITR distributes these awards and scholarships during the convocation ceremony to the graduating students
- There are two set criteria for these awards:
Type A1: Based on Academic Performance
Type A2 Based on Academic Performance and other various activities.
Non-Convocation Awards/ Scholarship
- These are given to current students of various classes
- Awarded on the basis of the following criteria:
Type A1: Based on academic performance
Type A2: Based on various other achievements

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Hyderabad College.

detailed_review.Placements: Honestly, the campus placements here are fantastic. If you have skills, it's pretty straightforward to get placed with a decent package. We're talking about a 100% placement rate because more than enough companies are coming to our campus. It's not unusual for a student to end up with two job offers. The highest and the lowest packages vary by branch, but I'd say the top package can reach up to 50 LPA, while the lowest sits around 15 LPA-16 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In spite of the college's overall infrastructure being just alright, the campus-wide Wi-Fi, well-used labs, comfortable classrooms, and extensive library become a great source of satisfaction. The vast array of textbooks and other materials available on campus removes the necessity for students to buy many of the resources from outside. Students can also avail themselves of transportation and on-campus housing facilities in case they do not have their own vehicles. The mess is clean, and if we talk about the food menu, it is quite good, but if more items of students' choice are introduced, it will surely be beneficial.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty here always excel, but they do their job well. First year teaching was very similar to high school, which made the change quite easy. The yearly tests are not too hard. The college also recognized academic successes and took special care to award the highest achievers.

reviews.review_title: Campus Life at IIT Hyderabad.

detailed_review.Placements: 70% were placed in my college last year. The highest package is  30 LPA. All students got an internship in our branch. It is one of the best branches at IIT Hyderabad. You can also prepare for tech. The course of our branches is well prepared and organised.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our course is also very nice. Our department consists of a building in which most of the rooms belong to labs. In every room, you will get free Wi-Fi. The canteen will serve at least five items per day, and the taste is also very nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching is excellent, and they have mostly done their Ph.D. in IIT. Professors at IIT Hyderabad are highly knowledgeable and always helpful. They clear the doubts of the students at any time in the class. And the exams are above average in terms of difficulty.

reviews.review_title: My review about this college.

detailed_review.Placements: We could learn a lot during internships. If it were an industrial, field internship, we could really learn how companies work, how it was different from academics, etc. Placements were pretty much good compared to all new IITs. The average package was around 10 LPA - 12 LPA. The highest salary was 40 LPA, and the lowest salary was 4 LPA. There were many companies visiting the campus thus providing enough opportunities for placements. Nearly every student could get an internship opportunity if they applied to appropriate firms. The stipend depends on how you work at the firm.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities were world-class, and every student would love to get such world-class facilities. Buildings were seven-storeyed hostels. All kinds of sports grounds and well-furnished. A multipurpose gym was well-built. Music and recreation rooms were well built. Huge stages and open stands were ultimate open places. Course curriculum was very simple in our college. Our college followed fractal academics which help students to easily cope up with their studies while doing other activities. So it helped every student. Even if you were weak at some point, this exams were so easy. It provided wireless networking electives, machine learning, and databases.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members had been excellent in molding the students in various streams of specialisations. They had been trained from old IITs so that being a new IIT we were not missing that experience and expertise from the professors and faculty members. They had been really good job teaching with their experience. For 2 years, there were 4 semesters. All the exams also had lab exams as part of end-semester exams. Lab activities included, programming, coding, machine learning, digital signal processing, operation systems, embedded systems, micro processors, etc.

reviews.review_title: Awesome infrastructure and faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: The course I chose, engineering physics is more research-oriented. This year, only 5 out of 25 students got placed. But I am sure only 10-15 applied for placements as most are inclined to research. Internships are offered by multiple types of companies like software companies but also other ones like LIGO. Some people did internships in universities in Germany too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is excellent, spacious, and has charming architecture. There are single rooms for 2nd years and above. The food in the mess is good too with lots of variety even if it tends to get boring after a while. The library is also known as the Knowledge Research Center. It is very big with lots of books and e-resources. Labs are equipped with the best possible and updated equipment. The Wi-Fi is super fast here, in the full campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are helpful, especially when you want to do projects and learn more things under their tutelage. The course curriculum is pretty updated and gives a lot of time for individual learning. The resources for the courses are many. Exams usually depend on the professors, as their grading scheme. The syllabus is the deciding factor for the CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: I was always interested in Physics so I chose this course. The course has a lot of room for exploring all the different areas of Physics. Events and fests here are many and awesome. They are lots of fun and something that people shouldn't miss. There are many clubs here to meet people passionate about the same topics as you, to learn something that has always interested you, to meet like minded people and do projects with them. About scholarships, general students below 500 AIR and girls below 1000 AIR are exempt from tuition feels.

admission.overview_text: IIT Hyderabad Admission 2025 includes UG, PG, professional, and doctoral programmes in Engineering, Design, Sciences, and Liberal Arts. Admissions to IIT Hyderabad are primarily entrance-based. BTech applicants must clear JEE Main and JEE Advanced, followed by JoSAA counselling. BDes requires UCEED, MTech requires GATE, and MDes requires CEED scores. Selection to PG and PhD programmes may also involve departmental screening and interviews. Direct admission is offered to eligible IIT graduates in select PG programmes.

For general category under All India, opening rank was 604 and closing rank was 674. Cut off are differant when it comes to other categories or female candidates and even domicile of home state. In All India, opening and closing rank for female candidates was 128 and 1300. Admission to B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering in IIT Hyderabad - Indian Institute of Technology is based on the scores obtained in the entrance exam JEE Advanced. Applicants are advised to confirm what category are they applying while checking for cut offs.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for M.Tech at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: Students requiring M.Tech in IIT Hyderabad will be required to have an existing degree in BE/BTech or its equivalent as well as a valid and current GATE score. It is also applicable by final-year students. Additional requirements may exist at particular departments. Minimum qualifying marks are based upon specialisation and Category.

faqs.question: How can I apply for M.Tech admission at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: The candidates are required to apply through the portal-CCMT and register through the GOAPS portal to GATE. There might be some departments of IIT Hyderabad also, which might consider direct applications of sponsored, part-time or non-GATE candidates. The process of the application is online.

faqs.question: Is a GATE score mandatory for M.Tech at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: Yes, the entry in most M.Tech programs at the IIT Hyderabad requires a valid score in GATE. But the institute can give exceptions of candidates not selected in GATE but can be eligible based on special categories such as sponsored seats or working professionals in the internal evaluation process.

faqs.question: What is the closing rank for MSc in Physics at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: IIT Hyderabad JAM cutoff 2025 was released for admission to various PG courses. The cutoff was released for different categories belonging to the All India quota. For admission to MSc in Physics, the cutoff in respect to the General All India category candidates was closed at 310 . For the OBC AI category candidates, the cutoff for the same course was closed at 701 . For SC AI category candidates, the cutoff was closed at 1546 .

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for BDes at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: To apply to BDes in IIT Hyderabad the students must have cleared Class 12 in any discipline with qualified marks and must appear in UCEED. The admission is made based on the UCEED rank. There are also an attempt and age restriction according to UCEED instructions.

faqs.question: What entrance exam is required for BDes at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: BDes is offered by IIT Hyderabad which is now conducted using the Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design (UCEED). The test focuses on the aspects of design aptitude, creativity, logical thinking ability, and visual perception ability. The obtained rank is used in counselling and seat allocation.

faqs.question: Is there an interview for B.Des admission at IIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: No, IIT Hyderabad does not have a dedicated interview round in case of BDes admission. The process of selection is exclusively made on the UCEED rank and centralized seat allocation. To confirm the admission then candidates are supposed to meet eligibility criteria and pass through the processes of counselling.

data.title: IIT Hyderabad Placement Report 2025
summary: The overall highest package offered during IIT Hyderabad placements 2025 was INR 128 LPA . IIT Hyderabad average package recorded in 2025 was INR 33.96 LPA . 389 students registered , and 374 students were placed during the placement drive 2025. More than 710 offers were made out of which 53 were international offers . The highest stipend received was INR 19 lakh and the average was INR 80,000.

As per, IIT Hyderabad BTech placements 2024, INR 90 LPA was the highest package and average salary was INR 22.5 LPA. Additionally, the highest package for MSc and MTech placements in 2024 was INR 58 LPA . In total, 521 offers were made, including 43 international offers and 320 companies visited the campus for the 2024 placements. The placement percentage for UG and PG courses stood at 70.99% and 69.74% , respectively. Out of 800, 493 students were successfully placed marking the placement rates for for BTech, MTech, and PhD in 2024 at 86.67% , 76.47% , and 100% , respectively.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Hyderabad provides modern amenities with state-of-the-art infrastructure to its students. The institute is spread over 576 acres of land and offers various facilities to the students, such as a canteen, transportation, library, auditorium, and other facilities. The college also has a badminton court, basketball court, cricket and football ground, among others. In addition to this, the college also has separate hostels for boys and girls. Read further to gain deep insights into the infrastructure facilities of IIT Hyderabad :

sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Campus Highlights
text: IIT Hyderabad is one of the top-tier institutes in the country in terms of academic excellence, as well as infrastructure facilities. The institute has well-maintained classrooms, laboratories, a library and an auditorium. Since it is a fully residential institute, hostel facility is provided to boys and girls. There are well-structured facilities for sports as well as other recreational activities. Have a look at the table below to know about a few details of the campus:

tables.IIT Hyderabad Campus Highlights: High Performance Computing Centre, Library, Specialised Labs, Hostels, High-speed internet, and more

sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Academic and Research Facilities
text: IIT Hyderabad is known for its academic excellence, the reason for which, apart from the excellent faculty and ranking, includes the well-structured academic and research infrastructure. The institute has laboratories with the latest technology and equipment. It consists of a world-class library , apart from an expanding campus that includes a hospital and AI-powered driverless buses for transportation. There is a research park that indicates the emphasis on innovation and development. One of the aims of the institute is to offer holistic development for education, research and entrepreneurship.
Classroom:

sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: IIT Hyderabad is a residential campus, having modern hostel blocks under the care of the Council of Wardens and the Hostel Office. There are separate hostel blocks for boys and girls. There are 23 hostel blocks (17 for boys and 5 for girls). Most students get individual rooms with a cot, study table, cupboard, and radiant cooling system. Kalpana Chawla, Ramanuja, Vivekananda, and SN Bose blocks have double‑sharing rooms, while the Kapila block is a dual-sharing block for Non‑Regular Students.

Each hostel has a dining hall that fulfils the food needs of the students and a cafeteria for tea, snacks, etc. There are vending machines serving snacks present in the campus. The hostel has a pantry area for storage and cleaning purposes. A pharmacy is present for the medical needs of the students. Bank service and ATM services are smooth. A recreation centre is being created at the hostels for students to play indoor games. There are outdoor sports facilities and a gym to encourage physical fitness among students. There is a Tinker's Lab, a Dance Room and a TV room for recreational purposes. Elevators and CCTV cameras are installed for comfort and security.

sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Library
text: IIT Hyderabad has a library named Knowledge Resource Centre, which offers digital and traditional resources of learning. The library is open 24/7 , has electronic resources and comprehensive services.

The library is well-stocked with more than 20,000 books and 10,000 periodicals . The reference books as well as regular books are open for circulation. IITH also has an internal repository of scholarly publications made by its faculty and students.

sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Sports Facilities
text: IIT Hyderabad offer different sports facilities to promote holistic development and sportsmanship among students. The institute offers both indoor and outdoor facilities. There is a modern sports complex with cricket grounds, football fields, hockey fields, tennis courts, etc. The indoor sports facilities at the institute include a gymnasium, badminton courts, squash and table tennis.

highlights.summary:
IIT Guwahati was established by the Government of India in 1994. It is the sixth IIT established. It has been ranked 8 under the 'Engineering' category and 11 under the Overall category by the NIRF Ranking 2025. In addition to this, the institute has also been ranked 6th under the 'Engineering (Govt.)' category by India Today in 2024. Talking about the international rankings, IIT Guwahati has been ranked 334th in the 'World University' category by the QS World University Rankings 2026. The US News ranking 2023 has ranked the institute 25th under the 'University (Overall)' category.
Located on the banks of the river Brahmaputra in Guwahati, Assam, the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is home to the first research park in North East India. It holds the status of an Institute of Importance like other IITs. The Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati IIT Guwahati has signed MoUs with numerous national and international institutions across the globe to promote student and faculty exchange programmes and bring in more opportunities for international internships, joint conferences, and workshops. It has 5 academic centers and 5 extramural centers. Candidates can check the highlights of IIT Guwahati in the table provided below:

college_info_program.intro:
IIT Guwahati flagship courses are BTech and MTech. The institute offers 4-year BTech and BDes across various specialisations. Both BTech and BDes courses are for 8 semesters. At the PG level, IIT Guwahati courses include a 2-year MTech across 9 departments, a 2-year MDes, a 2-year MS (by Research), and a 2-year MA course. All the PG courses are for 4 semesters. IIT Guwahati Assam, offers PhD courses across 11 departments, 6 centres, and two joint PhD courses. Also, the institute offers dual degrees such as MTech+ PhD in Computer Science & Engineering and MS (Engineering) + PhD in Electronics and Electrical Engineering.
