reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The best college of my life.

detailed_review.Placements: For now, I have not seen any campus placements, but I know from seniors that the average package is 33 LPA for the DSAI batch, and the maximum is 96 LPA, where the median is 25 LPA. Top companies include JP Morgan, Samsung, Microsoft, and many more MNCs. Most people are placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everything is good, but the buildings of hostels are too old for new students, so you have to wait for new hostels. Meanwhile, everything is available, like Wi-Fi with good speed. All sports facilities, including cricket, tennis, football, and many more.
detailed_review.Faculty: It has an advanced syllabus, including AI. Teachers teach every topic in a very exciting way. The syllabus is updated every year. As industry demands grow, our syllabus is also not steady with old topics. Teachers are well-qualified and experts in their domains.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
reviews.review_title: The review of IIT Guwahati BS degree.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Guwahati's first-ever BS in Data Science & AI batch got 91% placements with offers from big names like Google, Microsoft, and Warner Bros Discovery. Students also went for higher education/studies (e.g., Carnegie Mellon University, United States of America).
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Guwahati's infrastructure is a bit far away from bigger IITs. But still great enough compared to many colleges and universities in India as IITs are the biggest and most prestigious chain of Indian colleges. It has modern classrooms, AC-enabled labs, and other facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty, curriculum, and exams are among the best in most of the colleges in India. Many of the professors have PhDs and master's degrees in their respective fields, and the curriculum is up to date according to the generation and needs of companies and brands.

reviews.review_title: Great experience overall, with supportive teachers and a lively campus.

detailed_review.Placements: Out of around 93 civil students who registered, about two thirds 66% landed a job. Placements are decent but not 100%. The highest package is 65LPA this is an outlier, usually non core. The lowest package is around 6LPA. The average package is around 18 to19LPA. Big tech & non core companies like Google, Microsoft, Qualcomm, Texas Instruments, etc., and core & infra side such as Larsen & Toubro L&T, Tata Projects, Adani Group, Afcons, NBCC, and HPCL/ONGC., visit the campus. Many civil students actually take non core jobs in tech, finance, and consulting, but core recruiters do come. IITG students together got 230 PPOs pre placement offers from internships. Typical internship companies are Google, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, L&T, Tata Projects, Schlumberger, Adani, TVS, HPCL, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In civil engineering, we have all the labs and classrooms we need, with Wi-Fi and a great library to study from. I live in the Siang hostel. The rooms are decent with LAN and Wi-Fi, and the mess food is okay, with the canteen for variety when we get bored. The campus has a 24/7 medical center, so health is not a worry, and sports facilities are really good. Grounds, courts, gym, and even a swimming pool are available. Overall, its a pretty comfortable place to live and study.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the professors in civil are really qualified and quite helpful if you reach out, though, like anywhere, some classes feel more engaging than others. The curriculum itself is solid and covers the basics well, but to be honest, if you really want to feel industry ready, you need to back it up with internships or extra skills outside the classroom. Semester exams are usually on the tougher, concept based side, but they are not impossible. If you study regularly, you can manage fine, and almost everyone passes, probably around 90% or more.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Civil Engineering because I want to become an IES officer in the future. The best part of the course is that it gives a good foundation through labs and projects. I feel could be improved is adding more industry oriented training. Campus life is lively with big fests like Alcheringa and Techniche, a friendly crowd, and a beautiful location by the Brahmapur. The hostels, sports facilities, scholarships, and extracurricular activities make student life comfortable and balanced.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT University, Guwahati.

detailed_review.Placements: We are IIT students, so definitely each one got a placement. So many M.Tech students have joined the CSE course. Highest package is about 2.4 crore, and lowest package is 35 Lacs. So many top MNC companies came to our college, they are Google, Microsoft, Flipkart, Amazon, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In IIT, the best infrastructure is placed. We have labs for every department and for every course. We have all AC classrooms and a well-stocked library. We have Wi-Fi available here. We have so many canteens here, and a medical hospital is available. We also have sports for any year students.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have the best faculty here, and they are very friendly with us. They teach classes very nicely, and the explanation is super. We have weekly 3 to 4 events. Seniors conduct the events. We also join these events and participate. Our dean conducts exams very strictly.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT Guwahati - A great college .

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 85-90 percent students from my college got into one or more companies. Many big companies like IBM, Google, Amazon visits for the campus placement as it is an IIT. So we got benefit for being an IITian. The average package bagged by students in M.Teach was around 15LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The building and infrastructure of our college hostel is very great. Also the mess is great we get variety of food through out the week. The hostel is very NEET and clean also there is separate hostel for girls and boys and each hostel have security guards .
detailed_review.Faculty: The professor in our college were highly professional and knowledgeable. They helps a lot not only in our college exams but during the placement season. They possess high practical experience in the field of computer Science and engineering. I am very satisfied with the faculty here.
detailed_review.Other: As It is an IIT you will surely get benefitted from the name of college. Also there is a lot of on campus placement opportunities .

reviews.review_title: IIT Guwahati is an awesome college.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Guwahati campus is very large. Since I am a Ph.D. scholar, the research facilities in this college are very good.  Around 80-85% of students get placed in our course. The highest salary package in our college is 57 LPA, the average salary package is 11 LPA, and the lowest salary package is 6 LPA. Companies like Aditya Birla, Tata, and PhonePe recruit students from our course. Every student gets an internship in the 2nd or 3rd year through hard work.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities available in our hostel include Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. Fully air-conditioned classrooms are available in our college. A central library is also available on our campus, and books can be issued by students. The quality of food in the mess is average. There are three canteens on our campus, and the fast food is good. We have a small ground to play different sports like volleyball, football, and cricket.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are well-qualified, helpful, and knowledgeable. All of them are PhD holders. The course curriculum is relevant to industry needs. Besides, one has to prepare themselves too. Each semester has 2 exams, mid-term and end-term. One needs to have at least 35% in order to pass the course.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a nice place with good vibes and makes memories to always be remembered.

detailed_review.Placements: Definitely more than 90% of students get placed every year, and the rest students opt for higher studies or choose other career paths. In the CSE, students rarely opt for other non-tech profiles, and students majorly focus on SDE, quantitative, developer, etc., roles. Few students go for embedded roles as well. The average package offered is more than 30 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We do not have restricted internet. LAN points are present in every hostel room. The campus's main buildings have centralised Wi-Fi known as IITG-Connect, and we can log in through our ID and ERP password. Internet speed is mediocre. Each hostel has an AC library and gym of its own. There is a big central library and a gym for the whole campus. Classroom infrastructure is way beyond what we will see in other tier 2 colleges. There are canteens in every hostel. There are 10 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are genuinely always helpful, and we just need to approach them well. They are mostly always open to help. Courses are surely relevant after the renewal of the syllabus, and more relevance will be achieved by this year. Making industry-ready is something the students also must focus on and gather their skills to stand out to the public.
detailed_review.Other: There's a fest for every board and every genre. The biggest and the best cultural fest, named Alcheringa is organised in January to February. Then comes Techniche, the tech fest during September. Our college also organises a sports fest named Spirit and a welfare fest named Prayatna.

reviews.review_title: Beautiful college.

detailed_review.Placements: A very reputable institute of India in all dimensions, including placement. The placement was very good. The highest package offered was 20 LPA. The average package in our course was around 8 LPA. Around 80% of students received placement offers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. It is one of the most beautiful institutions in India. Wi-Fi campus and library were present. A hostel with a family was available in this IIT. Food quality in the canteen and mess was also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors were helpful, qualified, knowledgeable, and well-experienced in their respective domains of study. Teaching quality of our faculty members was extremely good. The course curriculum was relevant. The semester examinations were quite tough.

reviews.review_title: The Best IIT in India with good packages and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed in IIT Guwahati was 98% of our batch. In our course, more than 90% got placed. The highest package offered was 39 LPA and the lowest was 10 to 15 LPA. Recruiting companies included Tata Chemical, BAFS, Apollo, and other top companies. Students internships in companies with stipends. Roles offered in the course were process engineering, analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure were very good. Each branch had different building blocks, including separate libraries, labs, and classrooms. Our course provided all resources and facilities, including materials, lab facilities, and library facilities. Hostel food was not very good. The canteen food was good but costly. Medical facilities were available for all.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were like friends. They supported us academically and in gaining industry experience. The teaching quality was very good. Teachers were well qualified with Masters and Ph.D. They had good knowledge. The course curriculum was relevant to the industry. Semester exams were hard to pass. The pass percentage was 83%.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with college and campus.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Guwahati is well known for good placements. Almost 90% of students are placed in our Ph.D. Chemistry course. The highest package offered is 39 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 12 LPA. Recruiting companies of our course are Dhrma, Asian Paints, Cipla, and many other companies. Nearly 80% of students got internships with stipends. Roles offered such as research analyst, associate manager, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities available in our course are like we have well-equipped with all materials and resources. Infrastructure is very strong and beautiful. Libraries are more. The college facilities are very helpful. The quality of food available in the canteen is very good and very tasty.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-trained under top universities and have more knowledge. They have many years of experience. The teaching quality is very good. Course curriculum is relevant to chemistry. It makes students ready for the industry. The semester exams are hard to pass. Pass percentage is 75%.

reviews.review_title: The best college to take admission in 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: 93% of students who were in my course got placed. The highest package was 2.30 crores per annum. The lowest was 16 LPA. The average package was around 31 LPA. Top recruiting companies included Google, Microsoft, Facebook, IBM, etc. The roles offered to students were at the level closer to CEO and managers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We had everything in our hostel including cupboards, indoor games, indoor courts, gym, and Wi-Fi at a very high speed. The quality of food depends on the mess you prefer, so the quality was based on the mess similarly. We had luxury rooms in the first year where we could make new connections. Also, college campus was very beautiful with natural beauty.
detailed_review.Faculty: The core opportunities provided by this course were good. The course curriculum was very relevant, and the teachers were highly qualified, helpful, easily approachable, skilled, and knowledgeable too. The teaching quality was very good and easy for students to understand. Semester exams were hard according to the standards of IITS with a high pass percentage of around 94%-95%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing Engineering
reviews.review_title: It's not just a college but second home.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage based on 2024 data is around 64.% It is a decent percentage as many of the students opt for further studies and other streams other than campus placements. SDE is the top role and is more beneficial for CSE and MNC students. Other branch students can have core placements too as per their interests.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is college Wi-Fi overall campus except hostels. There is Wi-Fi in each room inside the hostels. The network quality is really good. Medical facilities are very good and are available 24 hours including ambulance facility. There are courts for every sport and well-maintained by the gymkhana.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and always open to any kind of issues. The frequency of exams is manageable. The difficulty of exam is dependent on the course instructor. Some are really strict but mostly are good. They connect real-life problems with the subject which makes students focus more.
detailed_review.Other: I opted for this course as I was interested in maths in my 12th grade. The college is really good and the course too. Fests and events are next level. Everyone is friendly in their own way.

reviews.review_title: The campus is peaceful serene and beautiful.

detailed_review.Placements: From 3rd year the students become eligible for campus placements. The college also allows them to sit in placements even after passing out. The average package that our college offers is around 3.6 LPA while the highest one can reach up to 16-18 LPA it is based on the student's merit and performance. Many renowned companies visit and offer career opportunities to students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus life may just be the best part of IIT Guwahati be it the general championship or Alcheringa the college truly comes alive multiple times a semester. There is a club for everything and if you find an interest that does not have a club then you can just grab your friends and make one.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty-to-student ratio is proper as it should be in a college. I personally like Debraj Roy sir since he is very fun-loving and at the same time explains Maths as if it might be the easiest subject in our course. I can't recall any of the faculty members whom I might not like. There are 4 internal exams CA1, CA2, CA3, & CA4, and a semester exam at the end (IT A Makaut Affiliated College).

reviews.review_title: IITG Civil: Great for core careers, need self-learning for industry skills.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are decent here. Particularly in civil engineering, more than 70% of students got placed. The highest package is 69 LPA whereas the lowest package is 6 LPA offered in the core sector by L&T company. In the core sector, L&T offers packages to a lot of students but you can also apply for tech/product sector jobs. Top recruiters are Google, Microsoft, Flipkart, etc. Very few students got on-campus internships from my course, mostly in tech or product sector. Around 20% of students got on-campus internships. Some got into big companies like Adobe and BCG. Top roles offered are software developer, machine learning expert, data analyst, data scientist, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is amazing when it comes to administrative buildings, academic buildings, libraries, and food courts. Hostels are not so good, most of the hostels are too old. Talking about the mess, food is decent. Canteen food is also so good. Our campus is largest and it has facilities for almost all the sports including cricket, basketball ground, kho-kho, tennis, volleyball, and a gym also. Some of the hostels also have private gym and there is a central gym too. All classrooms are accommodated with air-conditioners, and it has a good Wi-Fi connection. There is Wi-Fi available in all the academic/administrative areas and also in library and labs.
detailed_review.Faculty: The civil engineering program at IIT Guwahati has strong faculty with PhDs from top institutes, though teaching quality varies. Some professors explain concepts well while others expect more self-study. The curriculum covers all core subjects thoroughly but feels slightly outdated for industry needs, so students often learn modern software and practical skills through internships or online courses. Exams are challenging but manageable, with most students passing easily. Scoring above 8 CGPA requires consistent effort since grading follows a relative curve. Overall, it's a good choice if you want a solid technical foundation.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I wanted a solid technical base that could open doors to government sectors. The annual fests Alcheringa for cultural events and Techniche for tech are always highlights. There are plenty of clubs for music, robotics, and startups if you want the campus itself is beautiful but a bit cut off from the city, though buses and auto make it manageable. It is near the Brahmapur River so it has nice view. Scholarships help many students, both merit-based and need-based. I'd briefly say that SC and ST category has 0 tuition fees. Annual income <1lakh -0 tuition feels and annual income between 1-5 lakhs have 33% tuition fees

reviews.review_title: It is one of the finest campuses. It has satisfactory placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements of last year were above average since many companies had a recession. Still, 70% of students get placed. The same goes for internships. About 30-35% of students got internships. The highest package offered was 56 LPA. BPCL hired 6 students last year with an average package of 20 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very impressive. Wi-Fi works in the academic blocks but is not that good in hostels. The hostels offer the best mess food and the quality is also getting better day by day. Many sports clubs are active on the campus and the facilities are also quite good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of our department are mostly chill and give good grades irrespective of our attendance. Some teachers are strict in case of attendance but do not fail anybody for having less attendance. Courses are very interesting and the labs too. We can pass exams with good grades if we attend classes daily.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The best B. Teach college in all IIT.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 85% of students got placed. The highest package is 1 crore, and the average salary is 25 LPA in my course. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Uber, JPMC, and Google. About 20% of students got internships, and they got it in Amazon, Uber, and JPMC. The top roles offered are software development and consultant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities are really good. The infrastructure is amazing. It has a big campus with a playground and different buildings for academics and administration. The hostel is quite good. We have a mess which provides 3 times meals then there is a gym. Canteens are available 24 hours. There is a separate hospital for the college people on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified. They have studied at IITs and foreign universities. The course is relevant for engineering and someone interested in Chemistry. The semester exams are difficult and competitive. The pass percentage is a minimum of 40%. They are also very well qualified. The exam structure is made so that there is not too much weightage on the end-semester. The marks are distributed well throughout the semester, and the grading is a little bad for a few courses.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I had an interest in Chemistry. My JEE rank allowed this branch in the top 7 IITs. I think more labs can be introduced to understand the course better. We have one cultural and one technical fest called Alcheringa and Techniche respectively.

reviews.review_title: It is a nice institute because of its excellent placements.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Guwahati is well known for the best placement. I love IIT because of its placement percentage of up to 100%. I am a passout student. The highest package offered in our course is 67 LPA and the lowest package offered is 8-10 LPA. The recruiting companies are Biocon, Cipla, Sun Pharma, Dr. Reddy's, and many others. The internship opportunities in our course are 92%. The roles, such as research intern and other posts, are offered. I am proud to be an IITian.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities at IIT are top-notch, and we get all the facilities. High-speed Wi-Fi facilities in classrooms and on campus are there. Labs with well-equipped systems, and they provide all materials. Library with all books and research papers. Hostel facilities are good. We get good food in mess, all different types of food daily. The taste is also good. The canteen is also good and provides the best food, but it is much more costly. Sports facilities are provided, and we can play all types of games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful in teaching and qualified with the highest degree and Ph.D. The teaching quality is good. The course curriculum is relevant to Chemistry. Teachers provide a practical experience with the lab and make students ready for industry. The semester exams are hard to pass, but if you study hard, you can score good marks.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Science and Technology
reviews.review_title: Professors are not that good.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed is about 78%. The lowest package is about 7-8 LPA, while the highest is 3 Cr. Google, Amazon, and many more chemistry-related companies are among the top recruiters. Most of students get internships, and they intern at the same companies listed above.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are many good facilities available here, like there is good Wi-Fi facility the entire campus, well-maintained labs, some classrooms that are good while others feel dead, a very large and nice library, and an environment that is very good for study.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are not that helpful, instead, teaching assistants TAs are helpful, but sometimes the TAs can be rude. They are qualified, but we don't know on what basis. The semester exams in almost all IITs are kind tough, as it is their hierarchy to make it tough.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Science and Technology
reviews.review_title: The college has great infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: A total of 81.4% of students got placed from my course, which means 35 out of 43 got placed. The highest salary is 85 LPA, the lowest is 5 LPA, and the average is 17.5 LPA. Top recruiting company is Hilabs. 7-8 students got on-campus internships mainly in Axella Advisory, Google, Microsoft etc., for each role like PM, Finance, SDE, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities provided in our hostel are the best compared to other colleges. Wi-Fi service is available everywhere on campus. AC services in classrooms are quite good. Library is very good and calm. Hostel Facilities are quite decent and our hostel food is also the best. Mess Food in IIT Guwahati is compared based on OPI forms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and knowledgeable. They taught up to the mark but some faculty members are not good, not helpful very angry nature. Our course curriculum is very easy and interesting and very adaptable to every student one can easily get good grades with minimum efforts. However, exams for other branches is quite tough and competitive for our branch.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it's easy to manage. Anyone with basic knowledge and learning ability can get good grades in exams, so we can do more extracurricular activities to enhance our overall college experience. Overall fest, events, and campus crowd is quite decent.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Amazing institute because of excellent placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Students are eligible for placements in their final year of B.Tech/M.Tech. There are around 120 software companies who visit the campus every year for recruitment. These also contain the top-tech companies such as Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Oracle, etc. The top offers made were Microsoft, Oracle, Paytm, VMware, Walmart, Goldman Sachs, Adobe, SAP, and Intel. The average CTC is 24.89 LPA, and the average base package is 15.06 LPA (in-hand salary without stock). The highest CTC is 43.36 LPA. The lowest CTC is 12 LPA and the lowest base package is 9.5 LPA seen every year. This year also there is 96% of placements for M.Tech, CSE which continues from the last 4-5 years.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Every hostel provides single rooms to each student (boy) (I don't know about girls hostel) with each room having fast internet access via ethernet cable. The food provided is average and eatable. Most students have a heavy breakfast (which has a good menu and is generally good). Every hostel has its canteen and juice center. It also has indoor games (table tennis, carrom, pool, and foosball) with a small gym, TV room, music room, reading room and a stationary. Overall, hostels are new and have good facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members to students ratio can be told 1:10. Also, for every 3 students there is 1 faculty advisory. Faculty members and students relationship is very nice. There are many faculty members I like because of their kind nature. Course curriculum is extremely relevant and industry-oriented. Exams are conducted in 4 phase. Quiz 1, mid-sem, quiz 2, and end-sem.

data.title: IIT Guwahati Placement Report 2025
summary: The highest package offered during IIT Guwahati placements has dropped from INR 2.05 LPA in 2024 to INR 1.25 LPA in 2025. The placement percentage of registered male and female students remained the same in 2025, which stood at 62% . Earlier, the percentage of registered male students placed in 2024 was 70%, whereas for females it was 68%. The overall placement rate for 2025 stood at 62% , which is slightly lower than the previous year (71%).

The top recruiting sectors include IT/Software (45.3% offers), Core sector (17.1%), Finance, Consulting , etc. Earlier, 102 students received packages of INR 50 LPA in 2024. A total of 229 PPOs were offered to the batch 2024. Core and Tech were the top recruiting sectors. Out of 1,584 registered students, 1,124 were placed in 2024.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Guwahati is located on the north bank of the Brahmaputra River and is spread across an area of 700 acres. The infrastructure of the college is very strong and includes an academic complex, well-equipped labs, a library, a sports complex with various facilities, and much more. The institute also offers hostel facilities with a canteen and recreational spaces. The institute offers adequate and well-maintained infrastructure where students can learn and grow. Apart from the goodwill, highly competent faculty and academic excellence, the infrastructure of the institute is also the reason that students feel confident and secure, which helps them later in their careers.

sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Campus Highlights
text: IIT Guwahati is one of the top institutions in India for engineering and other courses. The well-maintained infrastructure of the institute helps the students in many aspects of their college life. For instance, the classrooms are well-maintained and are equipped with all the modern amenities. There are various departments, all of which have the latest labs with all the modern equipment required. The institute also offers hostel facilities for boys and girls separately. These hostels offer a homely and comfortable environment to the students. To know more details about the infrastructure facilities offered by IIT Guwahati, read further:

sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Academic and Research Facilities
text: IIT Guwahati provides the best academic facilities to promote academic excellence. The classrooms are well-ventilated, spacious and are equipped with modern audio-visual aids. The institute has a Central Instruments Facility (CIF) that houses 26 advanced instruments for chemical/material analysis, which are used by 11 academic departments and 38 external institutes.

The CSE department has 7 labs - Robotics, Speech, IDS, ISEA, VLSI, Aakash, RTDLS and 24*7 UG/PG research scholar labs. The department also has high-availability server farms, high-end computer clusters, and robust networking.

School of Rural and Agro Technology has specialised labs - Agro-Eco, Food and Bio Process, Water and Sanitation, Microbiology and shared wet labs- all equipped with instruments such as gas chromatographs, HPLC, fibre analysers, etc.

The institute has CNT (Centre for Nanotechnology) , which has around 37 crore funding, comprising 25 advanced labs, including clean rooms. The institute has a supercomputer- PARAM Kamrupa , which is one of the fastest supercomputers in northeast India, supporting advanced simulation and AI-driven research. The institute has a Research Park, which offers Industry Collaboration.

sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Library
text: The central library of IIT Guwahati is named Lakshminath Bezbarao Central Library . The name is given in honour of an Assamese literary figure. It is housed in a four-storey building with around 7500 square feet of floor area. All the in-house facilities of the library are fully computerised, and wifi is available throughout the building for seamless access to electronic resources.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around IIT Guwahati
text: IIT Guwahati offers a serene environment with the Brahmaputra River on one side and hills on the other. There are many beautiful places to visit near the campus. Meanwhile, the campus of the college itself is a beautiful setting. In a short distance, there are picturesque attractions such as Umananda Island , Saraighat Bridge Area , and the town of Amingaon , which can be visited to know about the local life of North Guwahati. At a bit further distance, the places to be visited include Kamakhya Temple , Assam State Museum , Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary and many beautiful attractions.

After doing a BTech in Civil Engineering, students will gain the ability to implement infrastructure development by using various sustainable technologies and materials.
NIT Trichy's MTech programme is a two-year postgraduate programme given in 23 specialisations. Some of the specialisations in which MTech is taught are Geotechnical Engineering, Thermal Power Engineering, VLSI Systems, and others. NIT Trichy is ranked 9th under the Engineering category. detailed_review.Placements: 95% of students are placed in my course in my college. The highest package is 80 LPA offered in my course, the average package is 30 LPA offered in my course, and the lowest package is 10 LPA offered in my course. 90% of students got internships from my course in my college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is provided and very useful for networking. In labs, AC and projectors are provided. Classrooms are good, and AC and projectors are provided for display. The library is good and provides AC and projectors. Hostel is good, with quality food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very good in teaching. They approach students in a friendly manner. They are very knowledgeable, and teaching is good. In the semester, we have two mid exams and a final exam. The pass percentage of exams is 40%, we need to get 40% marks in the final exam only to pass the entire semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Amazing college with decent facilities. But the climate is very hot and there is language barrier.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of placements in our course is really nice, it is more than (94)%. Nvidia, Texas Instruments, Qualcomm, Micron, Synapse, Google, Amazon, Oracle, TCS, Wipro, Bajaj, etc. (These are mixed companies for electronics, software, and electrical). Chip designer, electro manager, developed (to be honest, I don't know much about the role they offer). The highest and lowest salary is average.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities are not up to the mark. There are equipments in our lab, but very less in number, and that too sometimes does not work properly. We don't even have the basic facilities like water purifier, it's very hard for us to fill our water bottles from different hostels. We have good computer lab and library, but we don't have Wi-Fi in library. The quality is really nice, they provide amul butter, kellogg's corn flakes, fresh bread, and fruits (It varies from mess to mess, but overall quality is good). But North-Indians may not like the taste initially.
detailed_review.Faculty: EEE is the toughest branch. The curriculum is very vast and is not updated. We have to study many outdated things which are of no use. It's really very hard to manage the course with clubs and fest teams. Many times we have to select one of them. But, we have the advantage of having many options for placements as we have a very vast curriculum.  I like the exam pattern, like CT1, CT2, at end-semester. I would say all the things depend on the proof.
detailed_review.Other: I selected the course because I like the electronics domain so much. We have a very good bond with our classmates as our course is very tough so, we are forced to do all assignments and projects together only. It should be updated, and the extra things should be removed to relax the students.

reviews.review_title: Good environment and peaceful campus.

detailed_review.Placements: 80% of students have placed in by the placement cell. 24 LPA is the highest and 2.5 LPA is the lowest salary offered. Top companies are recruiting. 100% students got internship from the course. There are good placement available.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
It's a good environment to stay in, and it's full of facilities available. 
The library is filled with all types of journals, and e-books are also available in the library. 
Classrooms are neat, and good seating facilities are available on the campus. 
There are all types of sports and training available.
detailed_review.Faculty:
The teachers are helpful in giving quality teaching, and they help students grow. Their knowledge is awesome, their explanation are good and neat. 
The course is curriculum-related, and it makes students industry-ready. 
Some difficulties are the semester exams.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely wonderful campus life and alumni association, which will help you in a lot of ways.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 75-80% of the students of the passing-out batch from my course got placed, the highest package is 33 LPA, while the averageis 10.3 LPA and the lowest is 6 LPA, almost everyone in the batch got good internships. The top roles are offered in software.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is pretty old but well-maintained. There is Wi-Fi facility in the hostel 24/7. The classrooms are well maintained. There is also a library with 1L+ books. Hostels are old too but well maintained. The mess food is decent. You will be able to see canteens and other shops near your hostel itself.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty members are friendly, while some may seem a little strict. But every faculty member is well qualified. The curriculum is pretty much the same as all first years. There will be two cycle tests and one end-semester examination when we talk about exams and tests.
detailed_review.Other: The campus life here is great. There are a lot of clubs and fests which will help in your overall development and shape you as a better person. Name any common sport, and that will be here with proper courts and equipment.

reviews.review_title: It is a fine college if you take higher branches like ECE, CS, EEE, mechanical, and chemical.

detailed_review.Placements: 45% of the students are placed, and rest go for higher studies. The lowest package is around 5 LPA - 6 LPA. The highest salary is around 20 LPA CTC. 45% of the students got internships and all. Students usually go for IT sector. They do not choose core because the CGPA needed for core is high.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are above average. Wi-Fi is installed in every room, now no problem with Wi-Fi. Quality of the hostel is good. Mess food is also good. Here they emphasize sports and extracurricular activities also. They also organise events, guest lectures, and workshops.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are very helpful. This course makes students industry-ready. The difficulty of semester exams depends on the faculty members. Some put easy paper some put very tough depending upon faculty members. Some teachers really help to grow but some do not care.

reviews.review_title: A student in the 1st year joined 1 month ago.

detailed_review.Placements: I don't have much information about placements, but I see some students in NCC, and a much larger number of seniors are getting placed. Seniors are getting almost 12 LPA-13 LPA of average package. 80% of students got placed, and for the rest, I see many students interested in sports and NCC.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is excellent. Each room has a new and separate Wi-Fi, I mean personal Wi-Fi for each room, with a speed of 300- 400 Mbps. Labs are good, a huge building dedicated to labs only. The classroom doesn't have AC, but it has enough lighting and fans. Food is usual. Sports are encouraged. Teams are selected in induction.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are too cooperative. I saw a PDF of the NIRF ranking, and almost every professor is a Ph.D. scholar. I think the course curriculum is industry-relevant. Currently, they are showing different types of civil construction that have been made and why it is important.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about this course is that you are always relevant and needed. No matter how developed we become, a civil engineer is still needed.

reviews.review_title: A geniune feedback on NIRF 9.

detailed_review.Placements: The mechanical engineering department is one of the oldest and most recognized departments not only in NITT but also in the country. It offers decent placement figures, such as the highest package is 35 LPA, the average package is 12.5 LPA, and the lowest package is 5 LPA. Placement percentage is 93%. Most of the students get recruited in companies such as Caterpillar, L&T, DRDO, NTPC, BHEL, Texas Instruments, Oracle, Samsung, Google, TATA, Mahindra, etc. The roles that they get are Design, Management, Consultancy, and mostly Core Engineering.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are decent but not up to the mark if we consider the feels. It has all the necessary facilities like Wi-Fi, TV, Water Coolers, Geysers, Washing Machines etc. There are 5 messes to choose from second year onwards and food in each mess depends upon caterer. Most of the food served is good just the thing lagging is the cleanliness of the mess and punctuality.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors here are masters of their field and have a vast knowledge of the work they do. Many are very helpful and supportive, so you can approach them anytime during working hours. The course curriculum followed is now as per NEP 2020, which started from the 2024 batch, and it contains a lot of flexibility for students to choose the subjects they like. The exams are a bit tough, but are manageable with 3 days of study before the exam.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course due to my passion for automobile engineering and wanted to explore my career in this field. NITT provides an excellent opportunity to develop the required knowledge in every field due to its diverse club culture. There is a club for everything, whether it's robotics or ATV building. The crowd here is very competitive, and everyone actively participates in campus activities, guest, and Sports. You can get many scholarship opportunities here at NITT.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The things at last, I want to say that my institute is worth coming here.

detailed_review.Placements: As I am in the CSE department of my institute, the placements are nearly complete. The highest package is of around one crore and twenty Lacs, the average package is around twenty-four Lacs, and the lowest package is around six Lacs. If you want funds, they will also be provided.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If I start telling about the facilities provided to us, this would go nicely as they provide personal cleanliness in the bathroom, and also provide a clean restroom. They also provide wi-fi facilities too and if you'd like to know about the mess food, it would go better as the years passed.
detailed_review.Faculty: The knowledge of teachers is too good. Some teachers have a Tamil accent in their English, so as a North Indian, I found it a little bit confusing, but I got used to it after some time. The level of the test paper is so good that if you attend class, you can score good.
detailed_review.Other: I would also like to share some things about the club and association. You have to be so active if you want to join any club or sports team and study well.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: The above review covers all aspects of NIT Trichy, how it is good, and the points where it lacks.

detailed_review.Placements: At NIT Trichy, the placement rate is very good. Almost everyone who appears for placements gets placed, with a placement percentage of around 85–90%. Last year, the highest package offered was approximately 65 LPA, while the lowest was 4.5 LPA. Companies that visit the college include Microsoft, Google, Qualcomm, Nvidia, and many more. For the MME branch, top recruiting company is Tata Steel. In the third year, many students secure internships, with almost 70%–80% obtaining internships in the companies mentioned above.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for my course, MME, are adequate but could be improved. For example, in some areas, we need more machines or additional lab technicians to conduct our labs, but these are not available, so we have to wait for our turn. Otherwise, it would have been much better. As for the hostel, it currently has all the basic facilities such as electricity, clean water, and high-speed Wi-Fi in every room. The quality of food in the mess is satisfactory.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here at NIT Trichy are like teachers of any other college like they come read PPT and go but some of them are good. They come to teach with all the feel and answer all the doubts of the students. The curriculum is not really relevant as it is all old and outdated, it does not really make students industry-ready. We have to study for internships and placements by ourselves only. The semester exams are medium difficult, if we start studying a week before exam then it's okay to score good marks.
detailed_review.Other: I am really not interested in the MME course I took, I chose this course just because of the college and its placement statistics. The best thing about this course is really the peer group I am interacting with. Most of them are ambitious about their goals in life and want to achieve something from this college, which motivates me to work hard too. The syllabus of this course could have been better, more practical, and industry-oriented, then it would have been more beneficial for those who want to work in the core sector. Pragyan, Festember, Sportsfete, and Nittfest are some of the fests.

reviews.review_title: BEST #9 NIRF ranking among all NITs.

detailed_review.Placements:
79.8 percent of students were placed in civil engineering at NIT Trichy.
The highest package is 35 LPA. 
Average package 13 LPA.
The lowest package is 4.5 LPA.
50 percent of students get an internship.
A management role is offered.
Google, Goldman Sachs, Samsung, Flipkart, Amazon, VMart, Dream 11, Godrez recruit.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Library 24/7 access. Octagon for coding purposes, computer lab.
Hostel with every room having personal Wi-Fi access.
Medical hospitals are freely available on campus. 
All categories of sports are available.
Mess is awesome. 4 times, food is provided.
Memu is awesome, all varieties are covered.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Teachers are well-qualified graduates from an IIT or an overseas university. All the courses at NIT Trichy are worth it, making the students ready for placement, and all are industry-demanding courses.
If you study in classes and follow professor blindly, then you will top the semester exam.
detailed_review.Other: I am interested in civil engineering. It's my choice. This branch has an open door in PSU GATE, IT sector, non-core jobs, and UPSC government jobs. Pragyan is a fest.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: My college is best for hostel life and campus is good -My honest review

detailed_review.Placements: For admission to NIT Trichy, the percentage required is around 99% to get into the B.Tech course, but category students pursuing B.Tech below 99 can also study in NIT Trichy, the highest package is 50 LPA, the lowest is 10 LPA, and the average is 20 LPA. For internships, percentage does not matter much, a good CGPA is important. With a good CGPA, big companies like Amazon, Flipkart, and HCL visit our college. Many roles are offered to B.Tech students. The ECE course requires hard work and a straightforward focus on studies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In my college campus, hostels and mess facilities are available. The college faculty are good and have the best experience in the teaching line. Labs, library, and sports facilities are available in college. Medical facilities are also available and are very good because the doctors have MBBS degrees.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty are good, and the teaching methods are also good. There are many types of curriculum, and the teaching quality is good, i don’t know much about the problems that come during semester exam preparation because I am a first-year student, my classes are held 2 or 3 days a week. My hostel life is good, and the library is very useful for studying.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because in my college, placement and teaching quality are good. In the future, I think I will improve my new skills and communication skills. All types of activities are conducted, such as fests, campus crowd events, and extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_title: Academics are really good. Placement-wise, it's also good.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from production department. For my department, median salary is 12.6 LPA, the highest is 38 LPA, and average is 14.91 LPA. Some of them get an internship in FAANG companies. Placement percentage is about 90% with the highest in core branches. In starting, you will feel a big language barrier.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is really great. AC and Wi-Fi are available in library. It has full Wi-Fi in the hostel. There are 2,3 seater rooms. Motor vehicles are not allowed for students. Hostel is too clean and well-maintained. Professors are all well-qualified.
detailed_review.Faculty: Almost all faculty members have done Ph.D. from IITs and foreign reputed universities. But a great language barrier in starting, although they speak in English. But their accent is much similar to Tamil. On campus, no problem at all but outside college, everyone speaks Tamil, not even English, and forget about Hindi.

reviews.review_title: A good start to my career.

detailed_review.Placements: Basically, they had a principle, like passing out, students are invited to college, to help them in preparing for the placement grounds, along with the MNC trainers. HCL Technologies Ltd, LTI Mindtree Ltd, and Persistent Systems are usual recruiters of ours, with some more companies added on every year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Students must adhere to the norms of the institution without any questioning. Institution had a strong foundation of knowledge, resources, and features. It's one of the top-ranked institutions in Trichy with effective classrooms. Maintains the students' data more confidentially.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members conduct daily assessments on a few of the selected topics, which makes us familiar with the subjects and makes us feel free from fear. Faculty members' works are recognised by providing them with an excellence award annually. All the faculty members in our college are specialized in their specializations.

reviews.review_title: Review of NITT.

detailed_review.Placements: As I am studying in 1st year, I haven't talked with our super seniors completely, but I asked once, and they told me that placements in our college in the last year were terrible compared to other years. The highest is 32 LPA, the lowest is 7 LPA, and the average is 10 LPA. Top recruiters of our college are TCS, Wipro, Capgemini, Cognizant, and Axiom OI. I have no idea.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have no Wi-Fi, in addition, we have jammers to block the network. Labs are well-designed and maintained properly. Classrooms are good with projectors, including a clean board, and also have nice air flow through windows. It is very comfortable. The library is also good with books. They got more books than any college after Githam.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful to us and they have nice qualifications and are very friendly when teaching us, and they also help us in lab practicals very well. Our course curriculum is fully relevant, and it does help in keeping students industry-ready. Exams are tough, but you could pass if you study well. I don't know about the pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course out of pure passion for being a chip designer, and the best thing about our course is the course itself. If the faculty of the 1st year goes easy on us in labs, then it would be a great help for us to improve. Events are indeed well-maintained, and I love the annual day.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a dream come true. College facilities are far better than my imagination.

detailed_review.Placements: In Electrical and Electronics Engineering and Electronics and Communication Engineering, the placement rate is above 95%, which is a decent figure. All the above information provided by me is from past trends. The highest package is 48 LPA, and the lowest package is 7 LPA. The average package is 18 LPA. Top recruiting companies in the electronics domain are Texas Instruments, Synopsis, and Nvidia. In the electrical domain, companies like Bajaj and various PSUs hire students. In the last year, 6-7 students got internships in the electronics domain. In the software domains, about 15-16 students got internships. In the electrical course, about 9-10 students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All facilities are good. It feels like a home away from home. Classrooms are well-equipped with fans, lights, and projectors. Food available in the mess is eatable. It provides a large variety of breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner. We get food four times a day.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and are ready to help us. The course curriculum is relevant. It makes students ready for the industry. Labs also try to give real industry experience to students. Semester exams are moderate. If students are sincere, then they can easily pass with good grades. E grade is the passing grade.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: My review of NIT Trichy - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of students got placed in the course. The highest package was 88 LPA. The lowest salary was around 7 LPA. Microsoft, Nokia, Qualcomm, etc., were the top recruiters. Internships were low because of the backlog of students. 35% of students got internships. Top role offered was manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: New hostels and academic buildings were very good, but not average, compared to the old hostels and buildings. It had good medical facilities because there was a free dispensary on the campus. Mess food was so good for the North students and below average for the South people. Campus life was good. For sports, there was a huge place. The only thing was that there was no swimming pool.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers in my college were Ph.D. holders and knowledgeable. They lack the skill to explain to students easily. Teaching methodology was very much and on labs writing work was too much especially for the electrical department compared to other departments in our college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Instrumentation and Control Engineering
reviews.review_title: Everything is excellent, but there are more students from Tamil Nadu.

detailed_review.Placements: There are 90% placements in my branch, and it is a better option than non-circuital branches. We can also go for software jobs and core jobs. But there are some lecturers who don't listen to our demands at all, but everything is fine with our college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are a little old, but they're good. Hostel allotment is also very good, and we can also interact with seniors easily, and it's very fun. Bathrooms are common for everyone, and per room, there are 3 people, and after the 2nd year, we have 2 people per room.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is very good.
detailed_review.Other: It's an 850-acre campus, so it's sufficient to enjoy ourselves.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Construction Technology and Management
reviews.review_title: My review of this college.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Trichy offers one of the best placements. Placements are 100% guaranteed. Job opportunities are also good. Around 2,000 people get admission every year, and obviously, according to 100% placements, 2,000 people get selected in top companies, except for our marks and all that system. It is good for placements. Few companies like ISRO, BEL ITI, Halosoft, Jasmine, Microsoft, Nvidia, Goldman Sachs, DE Shaw and Co., Cisco Systems, etc., visit the college for campus placements. In my branch, the highest package is 20 LPA. The average package is around 6 LPA. This is the main shortcoming of this institute.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel and mess facilities are top-class. There are both North Indian and South Indian messes. The Kerala mess is the best of all. There are about 15 men's hostels and 4 women's hostels on the campus. Single-seater and two-seater rooms are available for students as per availability. There is a sports complex inside the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have got one of the best faculty members with a lot of experience and excellent teaching skills. Every department has its own HOD which always strive for the sustainable development of the institution. I would suggest students make their own efforts and let the faculty members just guide them. The is a common thing in every college in our country. We only have exams in the first year, and they are not too frequent. We have 2 cycle tests and one final exam each semester, which is not too much pressure in the second year, and we didn't have any exams, but constant project reviews at regular intervals. It is well-planned, and the exam structure has been planned by taking the all-around growth of students. It is one of the prestigious institutions in India and an institution of national importance. The course curriculum is in line with students' development.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: NITT is very good and worth joining.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 100% of students get placed in CSE. About 70% of students get an internship in software and management. Companies like Google, Goldman Sachs, and P&G come for placements and internships and offer packages ranging from 10 LPA to 40 LPA. The average package is 25+ LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NIT Trichy offers state-of-the-art facilities and infrastructure like high-speed Wi-Fi in hostels, washing machines in hostels, advanced and well-equipped labs for all departments, and very big and useful libraries. Also, there are different sports facilities and everything is very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are decent but highly qualified and experienced. The teaching is both theoretical and practical depending on the course. But curriculum is the same as every other top-tier college in India. Colleges are medium difficulty but almost everyone passes.
detailed_review.Other: Pan India level fests and performances at NITT. Scholarships are provided for EWS students and other students who require them.

college_info.college_name: NIT Trichy Course Admissions 2025: Dates, Application, Eligibility & Selection

admission.title: NIT Trichy Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: The course admission of National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli (NIT Trichy) is largely entrance-based. NIT Trichy admission is also provided to undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral courses on fields such as Technology, Architecture, Management, and Science as well as Arts among others. The institute has some of the popular courses, which include BTech, MTech, MSc, MBA, MA, MS (by Research) and PhD. NIT Trichy admission to different courses is done through national level entrance exams, including JEE Main, CAT, GATE, etc. The following article can be read by interested students who might want to know everything about the requirements and process of NIT Trichy.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to BTech at NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: No, NIT Trichy does not provide direct admission for BTech. NIT Trichy BTech admission is entrance-based. The institute accepts admission to the BTech course through a valid score of JEE Main. Every aspirant needs to qualify for the exam in order to get admission. Selected candidates further need to take part in JoSAA counselling as well. There is no other procedure for admission.

faqs.question: Is there any entrance exam for NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: NIT Trichy does not conduct any in-house entrance test. It grant admission to the courses on the basis of merit in national-level examinations. The accepted entrance examinations are JEE Main,  GATE,  IIT JAM,  CAT, and NIMCET. Only the candidates with a valid score in the accepted exams as per the applied course are admitted.

faqs.question: How can I join NIT, Trichy after Class 12th?
faqs.answer: Interested students have to give the JEE Main exam in order to get admission in any one of the NITs available. JEE Main is a computer-based test conducted at the national-level entrance examination. Students can find the table below for eligibility in order to take admission in NIT Trichy: Popular Courses Eligibility & Selection Criteria Class 12 with PCM/ PBM UG or PG degree with minimum 60% aggregate UG degree with minimum 60% aggregate Pass with UG or PG degree UG degree with minimum 60% aggregate

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for MSc at NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: Candidates willing for admission to MSc at NIT Trichy must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria for the course in the first place. Students who want to get admission to MSc at NIT Trichy must graduate with a minimum 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA (for SC/ ST/PwD, a minimum 55% aggregate or 6.0 CGPA is required) in the respective subjects. The relevant documents also have to be presented as a proof of eligibility for verification purposes.

faqs.question: Which is better NIT Warangal or NIT Trichy for BTech?
faqs.answer: Both NIT Warangal and NIT Trichy are considered good for BTech course. When we compare both the colleges in terms of academics and placements, NIT Warangal outscores in terms of the average and the highest package. The highest package in NIT Warangal placements 2024 was INR 88 LPA . When we compare both the Institutes in terms of NIRF ranking 2024, NIT Trichy ranks 9 . On the other hand, NIT Warangal secured 21st spot in the NIRF ranking 2024 in the Engineering category.

faqs.question: Is JEE Main required for NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: National Institute of Technology Trichy or NIT Trichy admission 2025 is primarily entrance-based. The selection for admission to various courses is based on national-level entrance exams, such as JEE Main, GATE, etc. Final seat allocation is done through counselling sessions such as CCMT, CCMN and others. JEE Main is required for some selected courses at NIT Trichy like BTech but not for all courses. Hence, candidates can apply for admission to various courses except for BTech and B.Arch without JEE Mains at NIT Trichy.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in NIT Trichy for BTech?
faqs.answer: For admission in a BTech course at NITT, candidates shall have a valid score of JEE Main. Candidates with a score equal to or more than the cutoff marks further becomes eligible for participation in the JoSAA counselling round. If the seats are left vacant after this round, then those are filled through the CSAB counselling. Candidates who pass Class 12 in Science stream wtih PCM/ PBM subjects are eligible to apply for this course.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff for BTech in Electronics & Communication at NIT Trichy for other than general categories?
faqs.answer: The last year 2022 cutoff ranks for BTech in Electronics and Communication Engineering at NIT Trichy - National Institute of Technology other than General category are - 6680 for OBC,  15514 for SC,  205 for ST,  614 for EWS and 75 for PWD. While the admissions are based on the scores/rank obtained in JEE exam, the last cut offs also change a lot depending on All India quota or Home State. It also varies if the applicant is a female.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for M.Tech at NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: To get admission to M.Tech at NIT Trichy, candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria. Aspirants need to be graduated with minimum 60% aggregate with BE/BTech from a recognised University. Admission is conducted based a valid GATE score. The applicant further must submit the documents at the time of form filling and admission procedure as a proof of eligibility.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to M.Tech at NIT Trichy without GATE?
faqs.answer: No, there is not provision of direct admission to M.Tech at NIT Trichy. Aspirants must appear and qualify for GATE exam with a valid score. Other than this, candidates must pass graduation with minimum 60% aggregate in order to apply for this course. The final seat allocation is done through CCMT Counselling process. All these steps are mandatory to get admission to NIT Trichy M.Tech course.

faqs.question: What is the seat total seat intake for M.Tech at NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: NIT Trichy M.Tech course is offered for a duration of two years across 23 specialisations. The total seat intake for all these specialisations is 658. Candidates can secure their seat for M.Tech via GATE + CCMT Counselling process. Find below the seat bifurcation of top M.Tech specialisations offered at NIT Trichy: Click here for the complete seat details for NIT Trichy M.Tech course.

faqs.question: Is it expensive to study MBA at NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: The institute and hostel fees for the Open, Open-EWS, OBC-NCL, and EWS category is INR 4.35 Lacs (approximately). In addition, the institute and hostel fee for SC/ST category candidates is INR 3 Lacs (approximately. This fee is as per NIT Trichy MBA 2023 brochure. The tuition fee for a two-year MBA course at NIT Trichy is INR 1.4 Lacs as per unofficial sources.

faqs.question: Is MBA available in NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: Yes, NIT Trichy offers a two-year MBA course via the Department of Management Studies. The DoMS-NIT Trichy is funded by the Ministry of HRD. Eligible candidates can visit the official website of NIT Trichy (nitt.edu) and fill an online application form along with submitting the relevant documents to apply. summary: As of 2024, the NIT Trichy placements have recorded over 1300 students who got successfully placed from various courses. The overall placement rate was 85% . Moroever, the annual report 2024, mentioned that MSc students were offered packages upto INR 27 LPA in 2024. The final reports are yet to be out, once released it will be updated here.

Additionally, as per the NIRF reports in 2023, the median package for BTech stood at INR 15.76 LPA . The median packages for MTech and MBA were INR 10 LPA and INR 8.70 LPA , respectively. The median packages of MArch and BArch courses were INR 6 LPA and INR 4.8 LPA . In total 226 companies visited for the hiring process. Meanwhile, in 2022, the highest package offered during the NIT Trichy placements stood at INR 40 LPA. In total 81 students got placed and 43 companies visited the campus for recruitment. The placement rate stood at 94% in 2024.

One can observe that within the category of 'Engineering' , the institute's ranking has steadiness when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, NIT Trichy's rank is #9 , the same as last year's rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking. The institute has displayed a decreasing trend in the 'Management' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. text: NIT Trichy provides undergraduate and postgraduate students with all the needed facilities. National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli is well-equipped with a modern library, classrooms, hostels, and computer labs, among others. Some of the other campus facilities include:
Check out more on NIT Trichy Infrastructure in the below videos:

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description:
The Institute has a modern Central Library with more than two and half lakhs of documents consisting of Technical books, reports, standards, CD-ROMS, audio visual educational cassettes and volumes of journals.

Library has subscription to 164 periodicals (print) plus 7000+ e-Journals and 7000+ e-books besides a holding of 17690 back volumes of journals and also having 1,26,982 numbers of books. The library also contains 16,750 books in the Book Bank scheme

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: There are 18 boys' and 5 girls' hostels. Together they accommodate 5320 undergraduate and postgraduate students.Each hostel was provided with a television, two DOT telephones, intercom(s), aquaguard, water cooler and kit for indoor games and outdoor games. The Hostel office consisting of Hostel Manager, one Senior Superintendent and supporting staff looks after the day-to-day operations.

facilities.name: Gym
facilities.description:
Fitness Center has a wooden flooring house having exercise machines such as multi-station gym, tread mill, stairs, air walker, rowing machine, Exercycle, etc.
Gym has separate timings for men and women.

data.description: National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli has an experienced faculty. National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli faculty are diploma, PhD, and degree holders. Trichy NIT faculty have worked as professors, lecturers, and teachers. NIT Trichy also arranges guest lectures and student and faculty exchange programmes.
