IIT BHU Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: Review of Indian Institute of Technology, BHU, Varanasi.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70 percent of students get placed in the final year. The highest package offered is 54 LPA, and the lowest package offered in my college is 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Microsoft, Google, Nvidia, Goldman Sachs, Tata Motors, and Amazon hire students. Around 50 to 60 percent of students get internships before their final year. Both core and non-core jobs are offered in our college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities available are old, but everything needed is provided to us. Wi-Fi facilities are absolutely good. Classrooms are okay. The library is an absolute part of our college, and it has all types of book collections needed for a student. The hostel rooms are too cozy and small. The food is not that good in taste, but the quality is good enough.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers who teach us are very knowledgeable and friendly. They help us in our internships and academics. The course curriculum is relevant. Courses are very helpful and make us ready in all ways for our jobs and internships. The difficulty level of semester exams is very high. The pass percentage is around 80 percent.

reviews.review_title: The best college for placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 60-70 percent of students are placed in this course. Almost everyone chooses non-core jobs over core jobs due to the very low placement package in core jobs. The highest package is 51 LPA, and the average is around 18 LPA. The companies Indian Oil Corporation, BASF, ONGC, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not very modern. The Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. The classrooms, library, and labs are very calm without any disturbance. The hostels and mess are very neat. The college has a hospital. For sports, we have several grounds and a student activity centre.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very well educated and helpful. They make us think beyond the syllabus for deep understanding. This course is about process control and instrumentation, chemical relations, etc. This course is so much industry-related. The exams are a bit tough.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the good faculty members and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: About 90 percent of the students in my course (mechanical branch) are placed. The highest package is 3.4 crore per annum. The lowest package is 8 LPA. The average package is 10 LPA. About 80 percent of students get internships in college. Top recruiting companies are HPCL and ISRO.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has very good Wi-Fi. It has clean and well-equipped labs. There are very good, nice, and clean classrooms. The quality of the food is not that satisfying but somewhat okay. They mostly cook potatoes. The library is very good. Medical and sports facilities are average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers and professors are very helpful, highly qualified, and highly knowledgeable. Exams are very difficult and simple if we study from the beginning. They are hard if we neglect them. The pass percentage highly depends on the subject professor.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with placements, but the infrastructure is not good. They are working on improving it.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are quite good here, of course, as it is the Indian Institute of Technology. Especially in Computer Science and Engineering, the placement rate is even better. Out of 109 students, 96 are placed last year. The highest package is 90 LPA, and the average package in Computer Science and Engineering is 35 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel infrastructure is not very good as it is an old college. I do not like the mess food much, but it is fine. Since I am from the South, I find the food too sweet for my taste.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are knowledgeable, but a few cannot explain the subjects well to students. The course curriculum is good and relevant. Semester exams are very hard here, especially for Mechanical courses. The pass percentage for other courses is good. For Mechanical courses, it is only around half, I guess. A few faculty members are quite good and friendly, but some only teach for the salary. They come, teach, and leave.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of IIT BHU mechanical engineering M.Tech B.Tech.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Bhu (Varanasi) had 70 to 80 percent placements and the average package was around 10 to 12LPA. The highest package was 25 to 30LPA and the lowest Package was not so low its 5 to 6LPA. The top recruiters were like TATA Steel Maruti and L&T. 60 to 65 percent of the students get internships in companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The IIT BHU mechanical engineering M.Tech had the best classrooms labs and a well managed library. It also had Wi-Fi but it does not have a consistent connection by the way. Hostels were decent newer ones were better and hygienic but older ones were also good enough and hygienic.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty at IIT BHU mechanical engineering M.Teach were very qualified and experienced in their respective fields and they were well experienced and professional. Many have PHDs in their respective field. The curriculum was also very good and up to date. Semester exams were moderately hard.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Pharmaceutical Engineering and Technology
reviews.review_title: Review of IIT BHU Pharmaceutical Engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 65-75% of students get placed. Around 18-20 LPA is the highest package, the average package is 8-9 LPA, and the lowest package is 4-5 LPA. Top recruiters are from very great and big firms, I think so the culture at companies is very good and well maintained, companies like Cipla, Dr Reddy's, Sun Pharma, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As you know, IIT is one of the biggest institutions in the world, and to be specific, IIT BHU is very old and well settled in this field, so it takes care of students and knows the problems of students with this much experience. The hostels are very clean, the lecture halls have AC, and the hostels have Wi-Fi, and it's high-speed.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty at IIT BHU is very qualified, as it's one of the biggest academic institutions in the world. Most of the teachers/professors have PhDs in their respective fields. The curriculum is also very up to date, and it is aligned with the needs of fields and companies.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Pharmaceutics Engineering and Technology
reviews.review_title: Review of Indian Institute of Technology, BHU, Varanasi.

detailed_review.Placements: The college is well-known for its placements, right after the spiritual atmosphere of Varanasi. Students usually get internships in their third year, and placement season starts in the 7th semester for B.Teach and the 9th semester for IDD students. This year, the highest package offered was 1.68 CPA, and more than 100 companies visited for both core and non-core roles. The average package stayed around 23-24 LPA. Over 80% of students got placed, which is a big positive considering the current recession.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has pretty good infrastructure and decent amenities. The on-campus housing is actually comfortable and managed well, so many students prefer staying there. The food service is okay, too, not anything special, but it does the job. Overall campus experience was good and nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: Honesty, the faculty here is amazing. Every teacher really knows their subject and teaches with interest. They are approachable and always ready to help. Their teaching style makes it easier to understand the concepts. The curriculum is updated, and the exam papers are balanced not too tough, not too easy.

reviews.review_title: It is the best college with good campus life and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the Electronics department, and the highest package is around 1.2 CPA, while the average package offered is 27 LPA. Many top companies visit here for recruitment and check every skill that is useful for their company development. There is a placement cell here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has good sports facilities and big grounds for every game. There are many games like badminton, basketball, cricket, boxing, and many others. There is a sports fest, namely Spardha. Every year, many colleges come and compete, making the campus joyful. Good labs are there for students’ experiments and deep learning.
detailed_review.Faculty: The exams here are tough. 75 percent attendance is compulsory and very good for lectures. This course makes the student well-prepared for the core programme and has very good labs for students’ experiments and deep learning.
detailed_review.Other: Good college with the best sports facilities and greenery.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Decent infrastructure and well-experienced faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: About 65 percent of the students will get placements in our course. The average package is 8 LPA, and the top recruiting companies are Tata Motors, Bajaj, etc. While coming to the interns, the core companies were low compared to the non-core, so the interns were pretty difficult. Top roles like design engineer and production engineer will be achieved.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi facilities are good. The teaching quality is good. While coming to labs and equipment, it is perfect. The library and classrooms are good too, but the spacing is small compared to the total students. The hostels are a bit old, and the food is decent, too.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and they are well-experienced, so that you can take advice from them. They are well qualified. This course makes the students industry-ready. While coming to the semester exams, there are decent and sometimes difficult, but if we understand the concepts, then we can easily survive.
detailed_review.Other: The events, fests, and other extracurricular activities were good. We can learn so many things, like communication skills and gaining confidence, etc.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: One of the best engineering colleges.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage based on 2025 data is around 64%. It is a decent percentage, as many of the students opt for further studies and other streams, other than campus placements. SDE is the top role and is more beneficial for CSE and MNC students. Other branch students can have core placements too, as per their interests.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We do not have restricted internet. LAN points are present in every hostel room. The campus's main buildings have centralized Wi-Fi known as IITG-Connect, and we can log in through our ID and ERP password. Internet speed is mediocre. Each hostel has an AC library and gym of its own. There is a big central library and a gym for the whole campus. Classroom infrastructure is way beyond what we will see in other Tier 2 colleges. There are canteens in every hostel. There are 10 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are helpful, very qualified in their specialties, and knowledgeable in every aspect. There is a slight language barrier between teachers, professors, and faculty members due to different accents. The course curriculum is very relevant, and all data is shared at the start of the tenure.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Mining Engineering
reviews.review_title: Improved placements in 2025 at IIT BHU.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% of students got placed from my course with the highest package of 51 LPA offered by Microsoft. The lowest package is 7 LPA-8 LPA and the average package is 16 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Amazon, Flipkart, Cars24, Google, Goldman Sachs, De Shaw, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our department is well-equipped with different facilities like Wi-Fi, computer labs, AC in every classroom, and smartboards attached. The mess food is fairly good with varieties in the menu. Talking about hostels, some new hostels are decent with good infrastructure and facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly qualified and supportive. The teaching quality is commendable, with a good balance between theoretical concepts and practical applications. Semester exams are moderately challenging, focusing on both understanding and application of concepts.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Material Sciences and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Fully satisfied with what it provides, good infrastructure and facilites.

detailed_review.Placements: 13 out of 15 (87%) students were placed from the batch 2024-2025 in our course where the average package was 18 LPA-19 LPA given that not a lot of them were for core (in material science) positions because core companies like Applied Materials Inc. and Loham are offering upto 30 LPA offers. The highest package was 46 LPA in Meesho for the SDE role and the lowest was around 12 LPA. Some of the companies that came were Walmart, Citi Bank, Jarvis (business analyst role), Meesho, and Loham. 2 students got internships out of 15 and off-campus because companies came for circuital branches.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our material science department has complete high-speed Wi-Fi connectivity all over the same in the lecture halls. Department has AC-furnished rooms but not lecture halls as of now. Also, material science department has some world-class quality instruments for research so research-oriented students can surely come. My hostel (Satish Dhawan) reading rooms are equipped with AC and good food quality in a mess with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food options. Canteens are open from 3:00 PM up to 4:30 AM. 3 large common rooms with TV, chess, and seating are available. Every room has Wi-Fi and ethernet.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, and many research papers published, M.Sc.  PhDs from foreign universities medallists. Teaching quality is exactly like how science must be taught with examples with creativity, and very interactive in the class with all students. Course curriculum is also industry-relevant and keeps on adapting every year. Exams are as difficult as expected and sometimes stand out with questions such as trying to make a question utilizing all the knowledge learned through the course applied to a real-world problem, but the grading is relatively depend on the people around you.
detailed_review.Other: Clubs are good like every society you name it, astronomy club, business club, robotics club, COPS (Club of Programs), SNTC (science and technology council), quant club, football, and student alumni interaction cell. The only IIT in India that recorded a positive growth in placements such as good training and placement cell which provide classes for hard DSA topics and guidance. Fee remission is there if family income is below 5 LPA and many scholarships keep coming throughout the year. Spardha India's biggest sports fest and Kashiyatra and Technex, FMC Week are conducted.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college provides very satisfying services and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of placed students in our course is about 70%. The top recruiting companies are Mahindra, TCS, and Suzuki Motors. Many students got internships in several reputed companies that visited our college. The highest package is 10 LPA, the average package is 6 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is very clean and surrounded by greenery everywhere, which gives fresh air. A well-stocked library is present in a huge area. Wi-Fi facilities are available for everyone on the campus. The hostel rooms are very nice and comfortable. The quality of food is hygienic.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very experienced and qualified. The teaching quality is very satisfying. All the college staff and faculty members are of a very polite nature and helpful. Our course is curriculum-relevant, and it makes the students industry-ready. The semester exams are not difficult.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering
reviews.review_title: The best thing about IIT Varanasi is Varanasi and good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college has 80–85% placement records, which are among the best in the IITs. Last year, we had 23 students in Metallurgy IDD, and 18 of them got placed, and 2 went for higher studies. So, if you want to get placed, you will definitely. Last year, for Metallurgy, 5 students got placed in core companies like Jindal Steel.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The PC Ray Hostel that we got in the first year is the best among hostels in IITs. The rooms are spacious, the corridors are big, and it is equipped with all facilities like LAN, Wi-Fi, washing machines (most IITs don't have), vending machines, etc. The food is okayish, but the canteens are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very qualified, but students don't actually understand the teaching in class, and most of them study on YouTube. Especially in metallurgy and mechanical, professors don't give good grades here, so academics are a little on the tough side.
detailed_review.Other: Well, fests are just good. Like this year, Kashiyatra and Technex were held together in just a week, and there was a lot of mismanagement. Day 3 also got canceled, but overall, it is really good. If you want to enjoy, you can enjoy.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of its sports and games.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2024 average package of my branch was around 24 LPA - 25 LPA The highest package is 1.68 crore per annum. Around 83% of students got placed. 352 companies visited the campus. Companies like Qualcomm, Uber, Goldman Sachs, and Google are among the top recruiters.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of our college is quite old. But is very good according to me. Wi-Fi is available at good speed on our campus. In library, all facilities are available like Wi-Fi, AC, silence, etc. Our hostel is also good. One room shared with 3 persons with 3 beds, 3 tables, 3 chairs. Mess food according to me is average and canteen is also good. Medical facilities are also available. You can play most of the sports and games in our college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very helpful, qualified, knowledgeable, and experienced. They have their own style of teaching which is very good. This curriculum is relevant. Semester exams are not that much hard but some papers like mathematics and engineering are quite hard.
detailed_review.Other: Actually I don't have too much idea about the branch. I chose this course on the recommendation of my brother. But now I think this course is actually best for me according to my interests.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Mining Engineering
reviews.review_title: A complete and exhaustive review of IITBHU.

detailed_review.Placements: Every year, close to 60-70% of students get placed in my course, with the remaining either going for government exams or securing a job through GATE so 90-95% of people have their future sorted. The highest package for this year is 51 LPA by Microsoft. Almost all companies like Thoughtspot, Pace Stock Broking, Flipkart, and Meesho opened up for mining IDD. The internship number is a bit low. Around 15-20% of students receive on-campus internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are a bit old, although most of the facilities are provided, but a lot of them are not working, so they are a bit on the bad side. We have Wi-Fi and many things in all places. Labs, classrooms, and a library are fully equipped. The hostel mess is decent. Other facilities like sports and games are decent, with IIT (BHU), having a brand new students activity center.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified and have great knowledge. A lot of them do not know how to teach so that is an issue since most of the students prepare for non-core roles. Thus the quality of teaching is not a very big issue. The course curriculum is on the easier side. My mining department is very easy and rarely does anyone fail any exam in the mining department. There is a very famous in our department that it requires a greater amount of effort to fail then to top the exam.
detailed_review.Other: I was allotted this course on my rank and thus did not have an option to choose. The best thing about my course is the ease of the course, and the department is also very elite. In terms of improvement, better facilities and classrooms can be provided, but that is also being improved with air-conditioned classrooms and smart digital boards. Extracurricular activities are great at IITBHU. Fests and events are some of the best in north India. Connectivity is also decent.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the college and facilities but not with the infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90% of students get placed. The highest package was approximately 90 LPA. The average package was approximately 34 LPA. Most of them get placed in core companies and some of them choose tech companies. Top recruiters are Samsung and Qualcomm. Nividea takes less number of students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my department is good. The past is that it is the nearest department. Hostels have CCTV cameras, a water cooler, ending machines, and a canteen. The quality of the food is good. We have a study room in the hostel. There is a common room on each floor in which we play table tennis.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified. Most of them did their Ph.Ds. from IITs or other reputed colleges in other countries. The first-year curriculum is a slight mixture of all subjects and makes students industry-ready by other means. Semester exams are not difficult.
detailed_review.Other: The batch size is approximately 150 of which 15 are branch changes.

reviews.review_title: Old infrastructure, good placements in 2024, faculty members are top-notch, and a lot of crowd here.

detailed_review.Placements: About 74 to 75% of students got placed in the previous year. The highest was around 1 CPA. The lowest would be 7 LPA. The average lies around 19 to 20 LPA. Reliance is the top recruiter for the core sector. About 30% of students get internships basically in the no- core sector, especially in Microsoft. SDE-related jobs are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are quite good. The infrastructure is old but not very bad. We used to think about that before entering the college. Wi-Fi is also working properly but a few labs are not that much efficient that we accept from an IIT. The library is good. Our hostel is new so facilities are good but there is not very much extra space. The food quality is not very good but not very bad. The canteen is okay. Medical facilities are also up to the mark. There are plenty of opportunities related to sports and games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are top-notch. There is no doubt about it. They are very knowledgeable. The curriculum is quite old. It is not that much relevant. It doesn't make students industry-ready. Semester exams are not very hard but not easy. Almost 95%+ of students passed.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it is the best combination of branch and college. In our course, we get a lot of time so we learn so many new things to make it in such a way that it blends today's needs such as AI and all that stuff. Events, fests, and the campus crowd are the best here.

reviews.review_title: IIT BHU review by Deepanshu Ranjan.

detailed_review.Placements: 85-90% of students are placed. The highest package is 2.2 crores per annum. The average package is 22 LPA, and the lowest package is 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Adobe, Oracle, Google, Microsoft, Schlumberger, L&T, Tata Steel, etc. Internship depends on the branch you are in. Circuital branches have 60-70% internship offers. Top roles offered are SDE, business analyst, product manager, and consultant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are built new for the first and second-year students and are very great and remarkable. Hostel facilities include free Wi-Fi, LAN network, study tables, cupboards, and tube lights. Meal quality is good and is given a 3-time meal with good varieties. It provides 3 times chicken in a week and 4 times eggs in the breakfast. Registration process is quite easy and is done at the same time as admission and is very affordable.
detailed_review.Faculty: The ratio between teachers and students is 1:30 i.e., approximately 30 students are taught or educated by each professor. Faculty members to students ratio is very good. Professors are quite approachable and very helpful. They are all very passionate and outstanding in their fields. They work on different projects and also provide students with opportunities to assist them. Semester exams are quite difficult as they involve high-level problems that need hard work and consistency.
detailed_review.Other: I chose IIT BHU because it offers very good placements and has a high NIRF ranking. It provides higher exposure in sports as it has a swimming pool, boxing arena, lawn tennis, and squash. It also provides interaction with great personalities as they invite speakers to the college. The college organises outstanding fests for the students to enjoy. The improvement that needs imparting education should be mostly through building projects and assisting professors in their projects. The fests are very fantastic and grand. Scholarships are provided by different companies or alumni based on merit basis.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied because of faculty members and good placements in 2024.

detailed_review.Placements: 65% of students are placed in the first placement season this year in my mechanical engineering bachelor of technology course. The highest salary is 54 LPA. The minimum salary is 7 LPA. The average package offered in mechanical engineering course is 20 LPA. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and Goldman Sachs are among the top recruiters. About 20% of students from the mechanical engineering department at IIT BHU in Varanasi get internships at companies like Google, Tata, and Adobe. The top roles offered include data analyst, finance, and SDE.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a very small room which you have to share with two more students. There is no AC or cooler in your room. Only AC is in your common room which is too small and already being filled with students. Dogs and cats move in the corridors. Foods are of average quality in mess and canteen.  Medical facilities are quite good as I have experienced. Sports and games facilities are also good. There is a good Wi-Fi network in hostels, classrooms, and library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. There is 50-50 percentage of teachers who have good teaching quality and those who have poor teaching quality. This course curriculum is relevant. Difficult level cannot be described as it is relatively new. If you want to get a good CPI, you have to study. There is a good passing percentage of students in my course.

admission.title: IIT BHU Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: IIT BHU Varanasi Admission 2025 is currently ongoing and is primarily entrance-based. The candidates are selected through national-level tests conducted by various authorities. Popular as IIT Varanasi (BHU), the Indian Institute of Technology Varanasi offers a range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral courses in Engineering, Science, and Humanities. It runs under the Banaras Hindu University . It offers degree programmes like BTech, BTech-MTech (Dual Degree), BArch, BPharma, MTech, MPharma, MSc, and PhD. IIT Varanasi application form 2025 for all these courses can be filed by visiting the official website of the respective national/ state-level exams. However, PG applicants also need to register on the official admission portal of IIT Varanasi (BHU). Admission to all the courses is based on the scores obtained by the candidates in the respective entrance exams. IIT Varanasi (BHU) has developed an online international summer school on industrial CFD and FEM, a one-month job-oriented training programme .

faqs.question: What are the essential qualifications for admission to BTech course at IIT BHU?
faqs.answer: IIT Varanasi BTech admission is based on JEE Main and JEE Advanced. Students qualify Class 12 from the recognised board with 75% marks for general category and 65% marks for SC/ ST. PwD candidates.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for BTech admission at IIT (BHU)?
faqs.answer: In order to get admission into BTech programme of IIT (BHU), a candidate should have passed Class12 with a minimum of 75 percent in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. They have to as well pass the JEE Main and JEE Advanced exams. Selection and JoSAA counselling is done by JEE Advanced rank. Counselling is only an option to those who meet all the criteria.

faqs.question: Does IIT BHU offer BTech integrated courses?
faqs.answer: IIT BHU does provide combined programmes of BTech and M.Tech in many specialisation. These programmes enable the students to pursue both their undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in a combined format. The admission requirements to such integrated courses frequently have a minimum of 75% board examination marks (or equivalent) in Class 12 (or equivalent) besides other conditions.

faqs.question: What rank is required for SC category to get core BTech branches at IIT BHU?
faqs.answer: For the SC category students under the AI quota, the JEE Advanced cutoff ranks varied between 283 and 2261 for core branches, including CSE, Civil, Chemical, etc. For the core branches, mostly the cutoffs are on the higher side for admission. Candidates seeking admission to core branches must target securing a cutoff rank of up to 2000 to improve their chances of admission at IIT BHU. faqs.question: Can I do MTech at IIT BHU without GATE?
faqs.answer: As part of the admission procedure, the prospective candidates must also take a Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE). However, BTech qualified in IITs with an overall CGPA of 8.00 or above in 10 point scale are exempted with regard to the GATE and are directly eligible to the process. It is also worth mentioning that the minimum eligibility requirements are as well mandatory to the candidates who would like to join IIT BHU MTech programme in 2025.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission to the M.Tech programme at IIT BHU?
faqs.answer: To be eligible for the M.Tech programme at IIT BHU the aspiring candidates need to have a minimum of 60% in BTech. Aspirants with a score equal to or more than the cutoff also have to go through a counselling round. Once selected, aspirants have to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: Located within a 1300-acre campus of BHU, IIT (BHU) Varanasi has huge buildings that showcase exemplary Indo-Gothic architecture dating back to the first half of the 20th century. IIT BHU offers several amenities to cater to the academic and research needs of the students. IIT BHU offers separate accommodations to boys and girls. Scroll down to know more about the IIT BHU infrastructure.

Library, Cafeteria,Badminton court,Volleyball court, Wi-Fi LAN Internet facility,Hostel, Sports Complex, Gym, Garden etc.

sections.heading: IIT BHU Hostel
text: IIT BHU has 16 hostels, out of which some are dedicated to honouring illustrious Indian mathematicians and scientists. It is situated in the Principal Colony of the IIT(BHU) Campus and can house 51 students in twenty rooms. At IIT Varanasi, the newest boys' dormitory, Dhaulagiri-2, was opened in May 2022. The dormitory has a total of 402 rooms spanning across seven floors and equipped with six elevators, which can accommodate over 1200 people. One of the largest hostels at BHU, the residence boasts two large mess halls that can accommodate all the students. The hostel rooms are equipped with a mess room, basketball court, and a playground. Dhaulagiri-2 Hostel is the most recent addition to the male hostels, inaugurated in May 2022 at IIT (BHU) Varanasi.

sections.heading: IIT BHU Library
text: IIT BHU library consists of the Shreenivas Deshpande Library and five departmental libraries, which assist in teaching, research, and extension programs of the institute. The students and the faculty members are allowed to use the library upon taking the membership. The library of IIT BHU offers various facilities to the users, like a collaboration learning space, a Document delivery service, a Remote Access facility, an e-library, a Modern reading room, etc., and programs/workshops for the faculty and research scholars. IIT BHU library has more than 139,871 volumes of books, journals, theses, reports, standards, and pamphlets. The library is home to an excellent print collection. The library's operating hours are from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM, including weekends, and it extends its opening hours into late night during mid-semester and semester exams.

highlights.summary:
BITS Pilani was established in 1964 and it is a private deemed university. It is located in Pilani, Rajasthan. BITS has three campuses located in Goa, Dubai and Hyderabad. It is accredited with 'A' Grade by NAAC and also recognised by UGC. BITS Pilani Rajasthan is ranked 11 by the NIRF 2025 Ranking under the 'Engineering' category. BITS Pilani is also ranked 2 under the category of Pharmacy by NIRF Ranking 2025. Internationally, BITS Pilani has been ranked 668 by the QS World University Rankings 2026.
BITS Pilani in India offers Undergraduate, Postgraduate and Diploma courses in streams namely Pharmacy, Management, Engineering, and other streams. BTech, MBA and MTech from BITS Pilani are the popular programmes. The institute appoints well-trained and expert faculty members with years of experience.
BITS Pilani admissions are based on BITSAT exam. It is an in-house entrance exam to enrol for admission. Candidates looking for course admission in Birla Institute of Science and Technology Pilani must register for the exam at the official website. The highest and average packages offered to the MBA BA students during BITS Pilani placements 2025 were INR 26 LPA and INR 16.57 LPA. The major highlights of BITS Pilani in India are tabulated below:

BITS Pilani Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: It provides freedom to explore personal interests.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements of BITS Hyderabad are very good at around 91% and throughout the years, it has also seen a constant rise. Overall Average CTC for BITS Hyderabad is around 20LPA. Top recruiters include Atlassian, Dell, Google, Microsoft, Deloitte, Oracle, Adobe, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels at BITS are clean and spacious. Each hostel also includes common rooms with indoor games like air hockey and table tennis, and outside courts for badminton and volleyball. Mess food is a well-balanced meal and made in hygienic places. The medical centre is open 24/7, and also ambulances come to the hostel gate in case of emergency. Courts and other playing facilities are well-maintained for every sport.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. Students can visit their chambers at given hours for one-to-one doubt clearing as well as in either lectures or tutorial sessions. Semester exams can be a bit stressful because of the good competition, but students also help each other alongside the faculty.
detailed_review.Other: To counter the stress due to exams, we have many fests in college. ATMOS and Pearl are the main fests that happen every year.

reviews.review_title: Worth the high fees due to ROI, but after entering, hard work is expected to excel.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage placement is high, due to the brand name as well as quality of students. More than 80% of batch was planned with highly reputed companies with high packages in fields of tech, finance, and core came to hire, eg, Google, BlackRock, Nvidia, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Entire campus is Wi-Fi covered, and classrooms are well maintained with blocks assigned to departments like mechanical, CS, and electrical. Library is also pretty big, with a capacity of 600+, and it has a great interior, and provides a peaceful vibe for studying. Quality of hostel and mess is also good, food taste is decent with a different menu.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers, especially in my department, are very helpful, supportive, interactive, and open to doubts all the time. All are Ph.D. holders from reputable institutions and have great knowledge of the subject. Curriculum is also up to the mark, exams are an integral part of evaluation, combined with continuous evaluation. Pass percentage is high.

reviews.review_title: The college has good infrastructure, environment, facilities, and placement prospects.

detailed_review.Placements: The better part is that over 80% of students find placements. The lowest salary would be around 8 LPA, while the highest could exceed 40 LPA, with the average being 12 LPA. Top recruiters include Mercedes, L&T, and BHEL from the mechanical stream, and students can also choose to pursue non-teaching roles, which many do. As mentioned above, the top roles include analyst, management, and R&D.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Ethernet connectivity is available in hostel rooms and the library (1 Gbps speed), with Wi-Fi throughout the hostel and academic block, and in the library (100 Mbps). The food can be considered fair, with the menu undergoing slight changes every two months. For the mechanical department, we have dedicated labs, workshops, and sandbox areas.
detailed_review.Faculty: The pass percentage should be well over 90%. Exams can be considered difficult and hectic, especially the midterms. Teachers are very knowledgeable, and I believe what we are taught is largely relevant to the industry. The course doesn't feel outdated, and students have benefited from industry training through internship programs, preparing them to be industry-ready, in my opinion.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of BITS Pilani K K Birla, Goa Campus.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 80% of students got placed. A lot of companies recruit students, including Microsoft, Google, Rubric, Dell, Deloitte, Oracle, Adobe, Nestle, etc. Top roles include software developer, analyst, app developer, product management, etc. The median package is 17 LPA. Core branches like electrical have an average salary of 18 LPA - 20 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facility is very good. The academic block is beautiful, consisting of 4 lecture theatres and a lot of classrooms. Some labs are also present. A big canteen includes a kitchen and a Nescafe shop. There is also a big auditorium in the basement. There is a football and cricket ground with floodlights. Other sports facilities are also available. Hostels of the new block are very good with fully furnished rooms and 2 common washrooms on each floor. The campus is beautiful and green.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified. They have doctorates and master's degrees in several fields. The exams are conducted every month (quizzes, mid-semester, and final exams). Labs are conducted weekly and have evaluative components also. Semester exams are very tough and the average is very low. The pass percentage varies but is usually 25% of the total marks of the subject.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are huge with the budget varying from 1 crore - 1.5 crore. Weaves is the largest fest with various artists coming from across the world.

reviews.review_title: The overall experience with college is really good and I will definitely recommend it to others.

detailed_review.Placements: I am still pursuing my degree which is WILP B.Sc. in computer and designing programs from BITS, and it has really a great experience till now. As for the package and everything the students get a very good and satisfactory package. Top recruitment companies in BUTS are Accenture, Cognizant, EY, HSBC, Yes Bank, and KPMG. The highest package offered to CS IT students at BITS is 60 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: BITS is a fully residential campus with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including well-equipped laboratories, modern classrooms, a gymnasium, a swimming pool, various sports grounds, and campus-wide internet connectivity. The labs and classrooms are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is really cooperative. They are highly qualified with a large majority holding PhD and are known for their strong industry experience. They have diverse teaching methodologies and focus on keeping the curriculum updated with current industry requirements.
detailed_review.Other: If you are looking for the best college around you then BITS is definitely a good choice.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Ups and downs of BITS through some unknown insights.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, according to the current data, almost 98.57% of students got placed even with the current recession era. The highest salary package offered is 84 LPA. The average salary package offered is 18.34 LPA, and the lowest salary package is not mentioned to us. Top recruiting companies like Google, Amazon, and Nvidia visit the college for placements. The internship is compulsory in our college, and our college itself provides us with it through a scheme called practice school.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi facility in our hostel is not good. The land cables work better than the Wi-Fi. Classrooms are neat and tidy. Hostels are clean, but there is a dumping ground near, which sometimes ends with a bad odour. The mess food is better than most of the colleges, and the canteen is affordable. Sports facilities are quite good and almost every sports facility is available. We all get medical insurance.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are quite helpful. They set up a Chembur consultation hour which helps us to get a one-on-one interaction with them. The course curriculum is based on Massachusetts University as it is one of the leading universities of the world. Questions are logically based instead of rote learning. Exams are quite difficult, which makes us more competitive.
detailed_review.Other: BITS is a recognised institute all over the country, just in comparison with the IIT. I chose this course because of the exposure I would get in this college. The best thing is the alumni network and the helpful seniors. I feel the fee is quite high, and if BITS can be made a little bit more affordable then it would be better. It regularly organises fests like technical fests and cultural fests which are quite large-scale and fun, Almost hundreds of other college members come to our campus in fests. We get a scholarship both on merit and merit-based.

reviews.review_title: Worth it to take admission here.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90% of the students are placed through the campus recruitment process. The top recruiting company from my course is many product-based companies. The highest package from my course is 1 CR. The lowest package is 7 LPA, and the average package is 15 LPA. Almost 60% of the students got internships from our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of this college are awesome. Wi-Fi is available throughout the college campus, classrooms, library, and labs. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is top-notch. Medical facilities are also available 24/7, and sports and games are also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, the teachers are helpful and knowledgeable; they also help those students who are not able to grasp the concepts they are taught in the classroom. Teaching quality is top-notch. The course designed by BITS Pilani is relevant and industry-ready. The semester exams are good if you understand the concepts clearly.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I am keenly interested in software systems. The best thing about my course is we can learn along with the course. The only thing about my course that needs to be improved is the scheduled classes. Events, fests, and the campus are of the best quality, no doubt.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: One of the best engineering colleges in India.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements were amazing. The minimum package for my batch was 12 lakhs rupees, which was given to a student in the Chemical branch. The highest package this year was 40 lakhs rupees, which was given to a Computer Science student. Top companies were JP Morgan and Texas Instruments.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course and hostel are absolutely amazing, other than one big downside, which is the food. The food is horrendous, and you eat it just for the sake of staying alive. The paid canteens are good, but the mess is bad. All classrooms are air-conditioned, with Wi-Fi throughout the campus. The library has a wide range of books to cover every genre. Sports and games are widely encouraged, and there are multiple football grounds, as well as a gym and badminton/tennis courts.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is excellent. All of them are professors who have decades of experience and are really warm and welcoming toward new students. The exams are pretty difficult because BITS works on a relative grading score, i.e., your marks are compared with others', and then you are given a ranking rather than having a fixed-point system where if you get a certain number of marks, you will be given a certain grade. The pass percentage is very high, around 80-90%.

reviews.review_title: BITS Pilani - It's Magic.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good. The average CTC was around 17 LPA (including all branches). Companies like Google, Microsoft, Adobe, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Intel, Nvidia, AMD, Samsung, Nutanix, etc., do recruit here. The practice school makes placements better and helps students become industry-ready.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have great infrastructure at BITS Goa. The Goa campus is really beautiful, full of greenery, and Goa itself is also a very beautiful state. The campus is very clean, with almost no littering on the roads. Spread over 180 acres, it’s smaller than Pilani and Hyderabad, but you still have to walk a lot. Generally, first-year students are given double-occupancy rooms. Each room is equipped with a separate bed, table, chair, fan, windows, almirah, and whiteboards. Each hostel has a common room, a place where you can relax in AC, watch TV, play table tennis, chess, carrom, or foosball. Recently, washing machines have also been installed in each hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members here at the Goa campus are extremely qualified. Classes are full of demonstrations. There is no compulsion to attend classes, but it is recommended to attend them, especially if you are a dualite. CGPA matters in almost every aspect, whether it’s getting a dual, practice school, scholarship, etc. When it comes to the curriculum, first-year courses may not be that relevant, but in the end, they will surely help you in one way or another.
detailed_review.Other: The college is great, and people are great. And yes, BITS Pilani—it's magic.

reviews.review_title: Best academics as well as fest culture with good placements.

detailed_review.Placements:
This year the highest package for CSE was 62 LPA, with an average around 30 LPA.
Also, companies like Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Goldman Sachs recruit every year.
Mercedes recruits every year. 
But for core branches, the ROI (return on investment) is not that great.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
We have washing machines.
Clean bathrooms with hot water facilities 24x7, with proper purified drinking water. 
The mess provides very good quality food. The draw back being you have to follow same mess time table (weekly) for a month or two but overall experience being awesome.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Highly qualified teachers are there. 
Relatively tougher academics but the teachers do make efforts in the lectures to show all the demonstrations. Maybe the first-year courses offered are not so relevant but the further courses offered are relevant. 
Also having a good academic culture.
detailed_review.Other:
Engineering in bits pilani should be one of the best experience anyone can have as a student; it offers you. 
A very strong academic background, confidence, overall exposure and lots of fun festivals as well.

reviews.review_title: An Overview: Birla Institute of Technology and Science Pilani, KK Birla Goa campus

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, about 92% of students were placed, even though there was a recession in the market. The average package for my course is around 25LPA. Top recruiting companies were Oracle, Google, Amazon,... Most of the students got internship opportunities from all ranges of companies, ranging from Google to TCS. It all depends on CGPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in my department are top-class .  The quality of food is mostly good, but then if you choose a mess, it is comparatively better than a d mess. So, as the college gives us the option to choose the one we want, we can choose the best mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers were helpful and they are well qualified and knowledgeable; their teaching quality was pretty good. The first-year curriculum is a bit boring and seems irrelevant because they make you study most of the subjects starting from CS to Biology. I would prefer it being more specific for each course starting from the first year. Semester exams are pretty difficult.

reviews.review_title: Our college provides a vibrant life for students and very good career opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: In the 2023 batch, around 92% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered was 65 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 24 LPA. In CS, top recruiting companies are Amazon, Microsoft, Oracle, and Deloitte. Internships are purely based on the CGPA obtained and students receive the stipend after it. These internships are paid but we receive more stipends than we paid for in the first place so it is worth it.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very good. As it is a private college, they collect a good amount of fees to maintain hostels. Wi-Fi is provided to every student with a limit of 10 GB per day. LAN is provided in every room. Classrooms have air conditioners. They are good. The mess is good. The menu keeps changing frequently. Sports facilities are very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our faculty members are helpful. They solve doubts properly. They explain all concepts in detail and give tips on how to study and perform well in exams. They provide many life lessons to balance fun and academics. The course is very relevant and industry-compatible. The semester exams are easy to pass. Almost every student passes exams without much difficulty if they attend the classes.
detailed_review.Other: The crowd is very good as everyone is here because of merit. There is no management quota and reservations. The crowd is not diluted as all are deserving candidates. For economically weaker students, there are scholarships based on academic performance in our college. The campus is well-connected with an airport, railway stations, and the main city. We have many buses and autos. The cars for airports are easily accessible.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied by its performance in placements, good campus life, and personality development!

detailed_review.Placements: According to recent statistics, the placement scenario is quite impressive. Most of the students in the passing-out batch got a pre-placement offer during their Practice School 2. About % of students have been placed. The top recruiting companies for the ongoing year were Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Visa, Adobe, and Cisco. The highest package was around 60 Lacs while the lowest package was around 8 Lacs. The median package was about 30 Lacs. Our college offers internships in the 2nd and 3rd years which are called Practice School 1 and 2 respectively. Every student gets exposure to work and opportunities to do projects through these internships. Top roles offered in CSE were SDE, Software Engineer, Data Scientist, and full-stack developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are pretty good and well-maintained. BITS Wi-Fi also works efficiently. Classrooms are spacious and air-conditioned. The library is a very nice place to study at during summers as hostel rooms essentially do not have air-conditioning. Food in the mess is vegetarian with non-veg available on Sundays.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors at BITS are well qualified and knowledgeable, most of them known to be doing or have done research work in their field. Students can also consult with them or ask doubts at their chambers. The course curriculum is relevant and updated. These courses make students industry-ready. Semester exams are very competitive due to the relatively grading system.

reviews.review_title: A really good place to develop your personality as a whole.

detailed_review.Placements: My course is M.Sc. Chemistry and the course major students go into non-tech and consulting roles and a few go into research and Ph.D. in Chemistry. Placement packages range from 10 to 50 LPA and the average package is 18 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Jio, Deloitte, PWC, JP Morgan and KPMG. In SI, around 250 students from a batch of 1100 got internships. In my course, the top roles (if you proceed to go for core) offered are that of Chemical researcher, Synthesis and Lab specials.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms are well furnished having fully functional AC, efficient lighting and seating places. Labs in the first year are somewhat renovated but the research labs are very advanced and innovative. Wi-Fi works good, just some productive services like Netflix and WhatsApp video calls are banned. The Library is very spacious and has separate places and tables for studying and books. It also has a relaxing space to sit and has facilities like coffee, tea and snacks from vending machines which can be consumed in the sitting area only, otherwise fine is imposed.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors here are very qualified and have a diverse teaching methodology. They teach the whole syllabus in a systematic manner and follow the course handouts given initially. Sometimes the classes can be a bit difficult to understand due to increased level of difficulty and then people start getting bored and skipping classes. The semester exams are on the tougher side always and you have to think deeply or memorize in order to solve them. It's not a piece of cake anymore.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Chemistry as I have an interest in the subject since JEE time and wanted to learn and explore it in this college. The best things here include faculty members having expertise and great research experience in their respective fields and we get to learn a lot through them. The things which could be improved are the quiz and assessment timings and adding practices to maintain attendance in the classes. This college is the best place if you want to have a huge exposure to an intellectual peer group, all possible extra curriculars ranging from singing to drama to dance to managing events are provided here. All of them are adequately active and contribute and collaborate together for the functioning of fests. The connectivity is very good in the campus, all the places are within a 10 minutes walk and surroundings have a plethora of greenery and trees.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering
reviews.review_title: About moderate good placement season in 2023.

detailed_review.Placements: Currently, the placement scenarios are not revealed, but top companies like Microsoft, Sprinklr, JPMC, Nomura, etc., offer multiple roles such as SDE, consultant, and analyst. Banks like Deutsche Bank recruit financial analysts. While the lowest salary goes to 6 LPA, and the highest to 50 LPA, you can expect an average of 15 LPA. I secured an internship at MultiGraphics Group from my branch, and many students get such kind of internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, classroom labs, and library are of high standards, probably among the best compared to other institutions in our country. The quality of food is decent and manageable. Facilities such as sports and medical services are also very good and comfortable.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are qualified and knowledgeable, and the teaching quality is really good. The coursework is really relevant according to the market standards, making the students industry-ready. However, the exams are very difficult, with a pass percentage of only 20% of the total course.
detailed_review.Other: All the events are absolutely good.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with placements and teachers, a really good building and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good with approximately 96 percent of the students getting placed. Google, Microsoft, and Amazon like big companies come to recruit in the placements drive. There is PS provided which is unpaid. After second year, PS is provided to all the students which is very beneficial.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is very big having a lot of greenery. Wi-Fi is available all the time. There is a library and classrooms as well. There are many facilities like sports, games and medical facilities. Overall, it is a great college. There is a canteen in the campus and the food is really yummy.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very good, helpful and knowledgeable. Their teaching quality is great, it makes the students industry ready. There are certain subjects which are difficult, you need to study them well to gain good CGPA which really matters a lot. The course is really good in our college.
detailed_review.Other: Due to the increasing demand of this course, I chose CSE. Top fest are organized. There are scholarships provided for the students. The college had a good crowd and the campus is full of trees.

reviews.review_title: Amazing infrastructure, but placements are not that good because of the recession.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 60% of students were placed. The highest package was 60 LPA. The average can be around 10 LPA. Amazon was a top recruiting company. 80–90% of students get internships, and many of them get jobs at top companies like Google, Amazon, etc. Full stack developer, data scientist, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is amazing. The first-year hostels are very good and have good Wi-Fi. The library is also there, which is open until 2 a.m. Mess food is better than expected—not bad at all. There is a student activity center where all sports are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and have very in-depth knowledge of the subjects they are teaching. It is very relevant. Semester exams are difficult, and the competition is also very high. For the first year, everyone gets to study the same subjects, but from the next year on, subjects change.
detailed_review.Other: I had an interest in computer science, so I joined it. Campus life is amazing, and festivals are also very good.

reviews.review_title: Good campus with high vibes, but worthy of it.

detailed_review.Placements: The students placed it on my computer. The science branch is very high compared to all other branches of our campus, and we also get a good number of internships every year. The top companies that come for placements for our branch students are Google and Microsoft; they take around 3 students every year, and the packages offered by them are really good. We also get internship chances in those companies because the roles offered by them are backed-developed or software-developed. The highest package is 60 LPA, and the lowest is around 10 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the course, the availability of Wi-Fi and WLAN services, and the maintenance of the library, classroom, and auditorium are up to mark. The management takes a good interest in maintaining them, but coming to the hostel, the only thing that disappoints many students is that there is no AC in the rooms, and the AC in the common rooms is being installed this year itself. All other facilities in the hostel, like drinking water, Wi-Fi, etc., are very good and perfect for students' comfort.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers on our campus are equally educated when compared to any other top IIT or NIT faculty. All the lectures and tutorial instructors hold a Ph.D. degree, and they are good and friendly with the students and available every time to clear their doubts and help them in their academics. They also allow students in their fourth year to do research projects under their supervision, and the semester exams are not that difficult, and the pass percentage would be 4.5 CGPA, and the student can get a pass percentage very easily.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about my course is the placements are high when compared with all other courses of this campus and there is nothing that needs to improve in my course, but I need the frequency of the tests conducted should be reduced a little bit and coming to the events and fests they are many numbers of events and fests conducted every year and the food stalls, DJ nights, proshows, and many more are done during this time, and scholarships are also provided to the students every year to help them financially. There are two types of merit and merit cum need scholarships provided, and the connectivity is also good. We can SEE a cab or 5 buses are there every day from campus to the city but cab charges more since it's outskirts of the city.

reviews.review_title: BITS Hyderabad is magic.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of placements received by the students is almost around 80 percent, with the highest package offered being 60 LPA, an average package of 15 LPA, and an opening package of 10 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Intel, Qualcomm, and Google. The roles offered in my course are software development, and almost 100 percent of students got internships at our college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course is perfect for all students, and it's easy for any type of student to undertake. The campus is fully set up with Wi-Fi routers everywhere, and classrooms are equipped with good Wi-Fi and projectors for students' learning processes. The library is very huge and contains a large number of books. The hostels on the campus are very peaceful and have all the facilities for the students' betterment.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are highly qualified and have good teaching skills; they have graduated; almost everyone holds a Ph.D. from IIT, NIT, or BITS; they interact in a kind and friendly way with students; and they are available to them anytime when they need guidance or help in their academics. The course curriculum is good and comfortable, with a limited number of exams and easy-to-score marks, and the pass percentage is 4.5 CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: The course I choose is CSE, and this is the better option that I have after completing my 12th standard. I would suggest removing the class-existing tests that we have from our course curriculum, and the frequency of exams is better now. If it were reduced a little bit, the best course curriculum scholarships are provided highly in our college; there are 40, 80, and 100 percent scholarships based on your performance in the college, and the connectivity with the city is very low, and extracurricular activities are really great and encouraged by the management.

reviews.review_title: BITS Hyderabad: A campus with good campus life and flexibilities.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from chemical branch according to the information that I have, around 80 percent of students are placed and the average package offered was around 10 Lacs per annum. When it comes to recruiting companies, there are many like Divi Laboratory, Dr Reddy laboratory, Cipla, etc. Coming to the internships, not only our branch but every branch students gets good internships; almost everyone gets internship and the highest role offered is manager of production department in Cipla.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The complete infrastructure of the college is simply awesome: classrooms, library and auditoriums. Everything is well designed and maintained by the college management, and coming to the hostels, they will be inside the campus itself which is also well maintained by the college management itself and they have all the facilities that a student needs to live.
detailed_review.Faculty: The lecturers here are very friendly and highly educated; they often interact with the students and help them in their studies. The quality of education taught by them is good and the course curriculum is well designed and makes students comfortable to study without any trouble and they can almost become industry-ready. Coming to the semester exams, they are not that difficult and a student can comfortably score a minimum of 6 CGPA without any preparation and the pass percentage is 4.5 CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: The course I chose was easier. The best part is that there is no need to work hard compared to other courses and the reason why I chose this was that this is the best college I got compared to other options I had after completing my 12th class, attending events and participating in extracurricular activities. facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: Library has room for up to 8,000 students, offers 738 open access study places and 246 open-access IT work stations.  As well as the books and periodicals you expect, it is home to computing facilities for students.The library is searchable via the library catalogue.  But it is not only our library you will have access to – as a BITS Pilani student you can use a network of other libraries via our membership.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: The Institute is fully residential and hostel accommodation is provided to all students. There are eleven hostels for boys and one hostel complex for girls. The hostel rooms are fully furnished. Common room facilities with Cable TV and telephone are available in each hostel. Internet connectivity has been provided in all hostel rooms. Solar water heating systems are provided in all the hostels. There is a common kitchen cum mess unit for every set of two boys hostels. Girls hostel, however, has a separate mess of its own, situated within the boundary of the hostel. It is mandatory for the students staying in the hostel to have their food in the hostel messes. The messes attached to hostels are fully managed by the students.

highlights.summary:
IIT Indore or IITI, was established in 2009 and was founded by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The college is an institute of national importance. Located in Simrol, Indore, MP, IIT Indore is one of the eight new IITs initiated by Government of India. IITI is a Public Technical Institute and has secured the 12th rank in the NIRF 2025 Rankings under the 'Engineering' category, and #27 under the 'Overall' category. Further, IIT Indore is ranked #556 in the 'World University' category by the QS Rankings 2026.
IIT Indore has signed several MoUs at the national and international levels. The MoUs at the national level are signed with organisations such as ICAR, IIT Bhilai,CIAE, AIIMS Bhopal, NHAI, IIIT Allahabad etc. MOUs at the International level are signed with the National Taiwan University, ICAT, CNU, UoA, etc.
IIT Indore offers full-time BTech, MTech, MS, and PhD programmes in various streams such as CS, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Space Sciences, Biotech, and others. Other IITI courses include a BTech + MTech dual degree programme in a range of specialisations for students to choose from. IIT Indore admissions are merit based with the college accepting scores of national-level entrance exams such as JEE Advanced. Furthermore, IIT Indore admission process involves JoSAA counselling to grant admissions to students.
According to the latest placement report available on the official website of the institute BTech batch, 89.76% of the students got placed. Furthermore, the highest and average package offered during IIT Indore BTech placements 2023 stood at INR 68 LPA and INR 25.45 LPA, respectively.
