reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Indore - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Roles offered are software engineer, software developer, tester, mechanical engineer, civil engineer, and many core jobs. Top recruiting companies for our course are Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Capgemini, Accenture, IBM, Wipro, etc. More than 90% of students get placed here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available everywhere on campus, in hostels as well as classrooms. The library is fully equipped with a vast collection of books, and a system is also provided. Medical facilities are available here. A dietitian, physician, and gynaecologist are also present here.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty here are advanced because it is an IIT. Here, PhD students are very helpful to freshers and graduates. Semester exams are generally very strict here. The course curriculum is very relevant and future-based. Teaching quality is flawless. It is the best recommended college.
detailed_review.Other: It has every club, like sports clubs, dance clubs, fashion clubs, and NSS clubs. It is the best decision to join IIT.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Space Sciences and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college has good infrastructure and facilities with the most professional lecturers.

detailed_review.Placements: We are the first batch in our course. We are offered roles such as propulsion systems manager, satellite data analyst, etc., of positions given to us by the space companies. We are also offered government jobs under DRDO and ISRO, which are central government jobs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are perfect. Food is the best here. Sports and games are amazing. Wi-Fi is not so good at our hostel. It is one of the drawbacks of my college. We have amazing labs at our college. We often visit KV to conduct our experiments.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are pretty tough. You need to be well prepared for the exams. I feel that the course curriculum feels more relevant from the 2nd year. I can't guarantee you that the college will make my batch of students industry-ready. Maybe we should opt for higher studies for better placements.
detailed_review.Other: Fluxus is the best event conducted in our college once a year. I wish we had more understanding and depth in our course.

reviews.review_title: College has a good environment. Placements, infrastructure, and facilities are good.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch is the first chemical engineering batch (2023-27) in IIT Indore, so now I passed 2nd year so companies will start to come in July for internships. Many companies come on campus for placements like Google, Microsoft, EXL, Deloitte, TVS, Bharat Petroleum, Analog Devices, HP, GAIL, and many more companies to see more companies. You can visit on training and placements cell of IIT Indore website.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are separate labs and equipment established according to the course requirements with proper Wi-Fi availability. There are good classrooms in size and proper wooden benches. There are separate hostels for 1st year and 2nd year with double sharing rooms and 3rd, 4th year live in the same hostel. Good Wi-Fi is available in hostel room, and every day clean every unit properly. Hostels are best.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. You can share your personal or academic issues with them they understand and are mostly professors have Ph.D. scholars from foreign universities. But they are newly joined but good teachers. Course curriculum is relevant because course is designed according to the requirements of the chemical engineering sector. Pass percentage is almost 100%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it matched with my JEE rank. Interesting thing is that chemical engineering is mostly physical and chemistry relations. Events are good. Campus has around 3000 students and is good. But campus is beautiful in the rainy season. The campus has excellent infrastructure.

reviews.review_title: This is the only IIT college where placement and infrastructure are both very good.

detailed_review.Placements: In IIT Indore, 95% of students got placed. In my electrical branch, more than 50% of students got placed with a 2-digit LPA package. The highest package was nearly 50 LPA from my branch last year. Top companies are Microsoft, Google, LinkedIn, Goldman Sachs, etc. For electrical and electronics, top companies are NVIDIA, AMD, Snapdragon, Qualcomm, etc. These companies give more than 30 LPA. More than 70% of students got internships from college, and after doing their internships, PPOs are also offered. Top roles we get include chip research, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of IIT Indore is one of the best in India. Hostel of this college looks like a hotel. There is a common room for every 5 students. Every student of this college gets single from the first year. Although from this year, first-year students have to share a single room with one partner due to an increase in branches in B.Tech. Everything is here when it comes to the facility.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are too helpful. In IIT Indore, all professors are well-qualified with an IIT degree. And they wrote many research papers which published in foreign universities like MIT, Oxford, etc. Course is not so relevant. In Civil, metallurgy branch has some subjects that are outdated. Due to many clubs where students personality enhances, students become industry-ready. Semester exams are difficult. 80% of students pass every semester.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I got into counselling. The best thing is in my course on embedded system thoughts, which the industry needs, and chip design companies are a basic requirement. I would say colleges have to improve internship facilities among core branches, students as electrical, civil, metallurgy, etc. There is a FLUXUS annual tech fest organized every year, which is the biggest fest in central India.

reviews.review_title: I'm satisfied with my college because of good education.

detailed_review.Placements: This is a first-time batch, so we don't know the placement statistics. No recruitment has been done in our college yet, so we can't tell you. Students have got internships in the USA, China, and many other off-campus locations. Research internships are mainly provided by professors.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are proper labs and smart boards which help in better education. Wi-Fi is available, classrooms are high-tech as an IIT. Slides are shared well enough. Hostel is double sharing and the quality is very good two proper beds. Sports facilities have improved.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is very well improved and they are passionate about their work. Course curriculum is industry-relevant. They showcase the top-quality curriculum of IITs. Semester exams are prepared as per students' level.

reviews.review_title: All about Masters at IIT Indore.

detailed_review.Placements: In M.Sc. Biotechnology, there are very few placements for students. The average is 4-6 LPA, which is very low according to IIT. Approximately 40-50% of students get placed in companies. Most students prefer Ph.D. due to the low amount offered by companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities are all very good. Each classroom and lab is air-conditioned. The hostel facility is very nice. The washrooms and rooms are clean. Campus life is very good. The mess provides good quality food. The sports complex has a badminton court, swimming pool, and gym facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very approachable. Their teaching style is good. All faculty members have ample knowledge in their field as well as in other fields. Exams are based on the portions taught in class. The exam level is moderate to difficult. There is relatively fair marking for results.
detailed_review.Other: The fest, sports, and other facilities are good. Everything is great except for placements. Practical knowledge is far better here.

reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 92 percent of students got placed. The highest is 60 LPA, the average is 25 LPA, and the lowest is around 8 LPA. Amazon, Oracle, Microsoft, BHEL, Cisco, and Accenture visited. We get internships during our third year. Almost 80 percent get internships. The above-mentioned companies take us as interns. Roles offered are mostly VLSI- and software-based.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi is a little bad. Other than that, all is good. There are double-sharing rooms; 3rd and 4th years get single-sharing rooms. The library is closed on holidays, but the self-study center is open 24/7. Food is not bad, but don't expect too much. You will live in a unit, 4 BHK. There are washrooms in each unit too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are good, but you have to do your own stuff. The course curriculum teaches a lot of relevant stuff. Semester exams are quite difficult, but as it is relative grading, you don't have to worry much. The pass percentage is very high. You get to go on industrial trips too.
detailed_review.Other: I wanted to get into a circuital branch. As this college is a top IIT, I thought this was better. There will be one or another event happening all the time.

reviews.review_title: The campus of IIT Indore .

detailed_review.Placements: We are the first batch of chemical engineering at IIT INDORE, so there are no placements right now as we are studying in 3rd semester of B.Tech course. We are trying to approach several internships in upcoming 5th semester. We are now focusing on internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are total five to six hostel at IIT INDORE campus which includes namely CVR, VSB DA, HJB etc. There are five practical building and Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. The quality of mess food is quite good and it has its own health center and sports complex.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers ( professors) are Ph.D. graduates and very knowledgeable. The teaching quality is very good. And all the teachers are very helpful. The course curriculum includes the core and electives courses. The semester exams are very difficult. The pass percentage is high.
detailed_review.Other: I had got this course because of my JEE Advanced rank but I am getting into it nowadays and bit interested in agricultural field as a chemical engineer.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A students honest review of IIT Indore by Raja Reddy. Mentioning the advantage of IIT.

detailed_review.Placements: As far as my seniors told me, students are eligible for placement in the 8th semester and internships in the 6th semester. Companies that visit every year are Google, Goldman Sachs, and Accenture. They offer roles in Software Development and also in Core Engineering. The highest offer made last year is 68LPA for the ADE profile, and the average package is about 26LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is great and is considered the best of all IITs, with modern infrastructure combined. It has buildings like hostels, mess, lecture halls, and an auditorium, all within walking distance of one another. A beautiful sports complex is under construction, and an Inter IIT event is going to happen this year.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very good and well experienced. You will always find lecturers available to help you with your studies. The classes and presentations by the lecturers are well structured and very helpful. Most lecturers are experienced and have worked in various colleges, mastering their disciplines. As for academics, it follows the modern academic structure provided by the government.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life has been amazing. Seniors are very helpful and respectful. The combination of academic life and sports will keep you fit and allow you to interact with many people, increasing your communication skills. The campus is beautiful, and you can truly enjoy your time here. Fests, including music and dance events, are organized, with famous singers often invited, and summits have been held for the past two years during my time here. I have chosen the CSE branch, and all the branches are good. There are also various clubs to encourage self growth and competition.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the overall quality of the college .

detailed_review.Placements: Less than 40% of students were being placed. The average package was 50,000. PW Coaching Center and many more approached our college for the job of teaching after a Masters. No one got the internship opportunity. The top role, or the only role we were offered, is the teaching role.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Full marks on infrastructure and facilities with high-class labs and classrooms are there. All the extra facilities provided are up to par. Hostels are clean and the hostel staff is really helpful. We do have good-quality food in canteens and mess. Do get regular mess food checked.
.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty do not give their best but do make efforts to provide us with a with a good education. We need a better education course system as most of the courses in our subject need a lot of time to be completed so we need to have a lot of time to grab the things. For that, we need a much more organised syllabus.

reviews.review_title: A well defined review of IIT Indore.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of the students enrolled got a good placement. The highest package was around 67 LPA, the lowest was around 6-7 LPA and the average is around 18–19 LPA for the entire B.Tech. Top recruiters included Oracle DeShaw, Nvidia, Google, Quadeye, Goldman Sachs, AMD, Texas Instruments, Salesforce, etc. Internships were also provided to a lot of students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are in top condition at IIT Indore. Labs are well maintained and funded as well. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, provided by the institute. Classrooms are equipped with digital screens and AC's are seated, which is also very comfortable.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers in my department are very helpful. They all have completed their education from top institutes and are also doing well in their fields of research. The curriculum adheres to standards and is somewhat relevant. Semester exams are a little difficult but a week before preparing can help in facing the exams.

reviews.review_title: IIT INDORE : Best Campus Life With Greater Opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost every year, 90% of students get placed, and from CSE branch, 100%. The highest package at my college is 68 LPA and going on. The lowest package is 8 lpa, and the average package, including all domains, is 20 lpa. All branch students get placement with a decent package. Top recruiting companies include Google, Nvidia, Amazon, Walmart, Bhel, PW, and many more. Almost 50–60% of students got internships for SDE roles in Google, Bhel, and PW. The roles are offered for SDE, technical roles, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are well-equipped labs in buildings with free Wi-Fi access, big LED screens, and modern teaching classrooms with good-quality sound speakers. The infrastructure of every building is modern and beautiful. The Wi-Fi service is available in every hostel, lab, classroom, and auditorium. The hostel facilities are good too. We will find two student occupancy rooms, four rooms, two toilets, two washrooms, one kitchen, one living room, one balcony, and two sets of very high-quality chairs. The room contains a study table, chair, and B.Ed. almirah (you have to buy your own mattress). The hostel common area contains one big LED TV, a table tennis kit, a carrom, a badminton court, and a free-to-use sports kit. There is one health center too for our good health, and the health center fee is included in our fee receipt. The mess food is very good and a better-cost return meal. There are many canteens, shops, and other shops that need our help. There is no need to go outside the campus. The sports facility is too good to stay healthy and strong. There are two football grounds, one cricket ground, two basketball courts, two volleyball courts, one swimming pool, and many table tennis courts. Many tournaments happen for your entertainment.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching staff is very helpful for our academic journey. The professors are highly educated and kind. The teaching quality is good and classrooms contain digital equipment like LED screens, speakers and comfortable chairs. The course curriculum is good enough to train us for future jobs, including many projects. The difficulty level of exams is very easy, but it is difficult to score high marks. Pass percentage depends on other student's marks too, so no absolute marking works here, only relative marking.
detailed_review.Other: The B.Tech course is designed well to make students skilled and ready for industry-level. We will be given many projects to improve our skills. There is central India's big teach fest, FLUXUS, celebrated in March. The campus contains 3,000 to 4,000 students. The campus is surrounded by high-level security. You will be easily allowed to go around the campus even at night for girls too. There are too many scholarships provided to you to make your life very good. The bank offers loans too; a Canara Bank branch is located here on campus.

reviews.review_title: The real truth of IIT Indore.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, almost every top college faced a dip in their placements. The placement rate for the Mechanical Engineering department is around 70%, which is very low compared to last year's placement rate of 88%, highest package is around 50 LPA, and the lowest is around 12 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Amazon, DE Shaw, PSUs, etc. Internship opportunities are good for CSE and EE branches, while those for other core branches are less. The top roles are SDE and other technical roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is the best here at IIT Indore because it's a 2nd-generation IIT, and the hostels are just awesome. Currently, students get double occupancy rooms in their first year, and they get single occupancy from their second year onward. Mess food is okay or leans more towards the good side; sometimes, one may miss Mumbai food and sports facilities are good here, with a cricket ground, football ground, badminton court, squash court, volleyball court, swimming pool, and a well-equipped gym.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors at IIT Indore are good, and most of the professors are Masters in their field from top foreign universities. The teaching method is a little old, but since 2023, courses are aligned with the new education policy, so you will be getting more practical knowledge and will be industry-ready. Semester exams are of moderate level; you get good marks if you study smartly. Passing criteria are different for different courses; sometimes it may be relative grading, and sometimes it may be absolute.
detailed_review.Other: There are numerous events held throughout the year, but some major ones are FLUXUS, the cultural and technical event, E-Summit, MUN, TEDx, and the sports event Lakshya. IIT Indore is going to host the Inter-IIT competition in 2024.

reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure and research facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 96.88 percent of students placed last year. The highest offer made last year was 45 LPA, and the average package is 25.70 LPA. The top recruiters are Accenture, Goldman Sachs, and Google. Almost 50 percent of students got internships. The recruiters are NVIDIA, Texas Instruments, and Google. The roles offered are SDE and design engineers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are fully digitalized classrooms. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus with 20 Mbps of speed. The labs are equipped with all the latest equipment, but many times some of them are faculty. The library is very good, with almost 45,000+ books and 3000+ e-journals.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very qualified, but many of them lack teaching skills, especially in the math faculty. Many times, students have to rely on YouTube to prepare for exams. The course structure is very relevant to current industry trends. The semester exams are tough. The passing percentage is relatively high.

reviews.review_title: IIT Indore is good and I'm satisfied with my college placements and really good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course last year, the average package was about 12–14 LPA. The highest package was 74 LPA and the lowest was 6 LPA, and in my course, 18 LPA was the average package. Companies like Flipkart, Google, Axela, etc. are recruiting. Roles like software engineer, data analyst, etc. were offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs and classrooms are more than expected, and the library is very good. Especially in my department, we had many labs and faculty members provided projects to the students. Hostel facilities are okay because the rooms are too small for two students. Hostel food is moderate. The menu is good but the taste is moderate and for medical facilities, we had a health center too where students would get free treatment. Sports facilities are also awesome but cricket grounds have not been made till now; it's been 4+ months.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very good and also helpful. The teaching quality was average. Course curriculum is not relevant because I don't think engineers need to study courses like bioscience and environment studies. More subjects, like economics and entrepreneurship, should be there. Semester exams are not too difficult but the course curriculum is very lengthy, as we had 10–12 course subjects. Pass percentage is about 4.5–5+.
detailed_review.Other: I'm interested in this course by my 7th or 8th grade. The best thing about my course is that it's a real-world-based course. Events, fests and campus crowd connectivity are very good. Reliance scholarships are also available at our college and more scholarships are also available. Central India's biggest fest was held at IIT Indore, which is called Fluxus. Also, we had almost every club regarding each department.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science
reviews.review_title: Why you should choose IIT Indore!

detailed_review.Placements: This year, in the 2024 passing batch, the placements were not that good. Nearly 65% of students from our branch got placed. The average package was 15 LPA, which is less compared to previous years. The lowest was 8-9 LPA, and the highest was 35 LPA. The top recruiters this year were Jio, ZS, Razorpay, Deloitte, and Walmart. The internship scenario is bad this year; only a few students from our branch got internships. The top roles offered were SDE, Analyst, Consultant, and core positions.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus and infrastructure are top-notch. Classrooms are well-equipped with ACs and other facilities. The Wi-Fi is not super fast, but you can easily handle all necessary tasks. Labs have all the equipment required in fully working condition, and lab assistants are there to help us get familiar with lab equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful and very well qualified; most of them hold degrees from prestigious institutions all over the world. They are more than happy if you want to join them for some work. Talking about the curriculum, it is challenging but could be managed if done wisely. Marks are well distributed among midsems, endsems, and quizzes, giving multiple scoring opportunities. The semester exams are tough but can be passed if prepared smartly.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good learning facilities.

detailed_review.Placements:
95 percent of our course will be placed. The highest is 60 LPA, and the average is 32 LPA. The least is 4 LPA. Most roles offered in my course were based on AI, ML, web development, or CP. 
I don't know the percentage of students, but most of the students will be getting internships at the end of their 3rd year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is 24-hour Wi-Fi for students and professors on campus, and the labs and library are the best. Every facility is given to its best level. Food would be average. Medical facilities are available to students. Sports and games are welcome by all.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are really qualified, and they teach in an appropriate way. Semester exams are the same as in every engineering college, which are moderate. The course curriculum makes every student ready in their own domain. Every branch has its own better way of learning.
detailed_review.Other: CSE is the core course in the present generation. I don't think there is something about this course that I wish to be better at. Our college's events and festivals provide ample opportunities for interaction and enjoyment of college life.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review about IIT INDORE.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70% of students were placed in our course. Not sure but 50 LPA is the highest package, and 12 LPA is the lowest package, and the average is 28 LPA. Companies like Flipkart, Google, TCS come for placement. 1.5 LPA internship in Google is the highest internship from our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Among all IIT's we have the best infrastructure. But food is not good. We have an 81-inch television in the waiting hall. Double occupancy was about too bad, but understanding was important between roommates. And the quality of facilities in our hostel is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers who are teaching here are very knowledgeable. Faculty all are from IIT's who did PhD's in IIT's. Semester exams in our college are very difficult with strict invigilation. The passing percentage is about 95%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science
reviews.review_title: Life in an IIT by an average student.

detailed_review.Placements: In our course, approximately 80% of the students got placed with an average CTC of 10 LPA. The highest package was around 18 Lacs per annum and average was around 10 LPA with the lowest package being around 5 to 6 LPA. Many PSUs and tech companies visit for recruitments. Students getting internship opportunities are less in this branch compared to the other branches.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is the soul of this college. The hostels are good and cleaned properly. The medical facilities along with the and sports facilities also good. Wi-Fi is provided across the campus. Classrooms and the library are equipped with modern day technology. Quality of food in the mess is sometimes moderate and sometimes good or average, but it is never bad. Sports facilities are still progressing but they are moderate.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are well educated as they all have done their Ph.Ds from IITs. They are a little old fashioned and are very strict. Course curriculum is relevant and makes the students industry ready. Semesters are a bit difficult and the students need to work hard. Many student get a back (fail) in the exams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Most people are classified as both core and non-core. The average package of the CSE branch is around 30 lakh per year. And that is the highest among all the average packages. There are also opportunities for internships at companies like Amazon.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is excellent over here. Everyone has access to Wi-Fi almost everywhere. The labs are very well equipped. There are 2 large seminar halls with smart boards two relatively small seminar halls with smart boards and many other classrooms. A great library is there.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful and very qualified to teach; after all, they are all professors. But the teacher-to-student ratio is very high. The course curriculum is not so difficult except for math, which is easy to pass. And the grading is relative.

admission.title: IIT Indore Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text:
Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Indore offers UG, PG, and Doctoral level courses, namely BTech , MTech , MSc, and PhD through three departments of the institute:

Admissions at IIT Indore are based on national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, JEE Advanced, GATE, IIT JAM, UGC NET, and CSIR NET. Candidates who meet the initial cutoff must appear counselling and personal interview rounds for final seat allocation.

Students may look below for a breakdown on the IIT Indore admission process for BTech course:

1. Appear for JEE Mains

Interested students must appear for the JEE Mains exam. Candidates can register on the official website of JEE Main via NTA. Students can check the past trend of IIT Indore BTech cutoff to get an idea about the score they must secured to get a seat.

2. Take JEE Advanced

The next step is to appear for the JEE Advanced exam . Admission to the BTech course offered at any IIT require students to clear both JEE Mains and Advanced . Students must secure a good rank in the exam.

3. Apply via JoSAA

Once the results are out, students need to register on the JoSAA portal through which seat allocation will be done. Students need to fill in their preferences of BTech branch.

4. Receive Admission Offer

Those who make it to the final list and receive the admission offer need to report for document verification . For seat confirmation, one must pay the specified fees within the stipulated time.

text: The Indian Institute of Technology Indore provides modern amenities with state-of-the-art infrastructure to its students. Some of the IIT Indore facilities include
Campus facilities: IITI has various campus facilities which include Cafe, Atm, Bank, laundary, salon, etc.
Hostel: IIT Indore has a hostel facility both for boys and girls. There are a total of 5 hostels inside the campus.

Health Care: ITT Indore provides health services to the institute community comprising of students, employees, their dependents and Institute Guests. The Health Centre offers Outpatient, Day care, Trauma and Emergency

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The library has a collection of over 29,000+ books, which includes, in addition to text books and reference books, a fine collection of books on literature and English language and a select collection of books on sports, biographies, and general interest titles. The magazines and newspaper section includes popular magazines and newspapers both in English and Hindi. The library provides its users access to more than 6000 e-journals through individual as well as fulltext database such as ACM digital libray, Elsevier Science Direct, Springer link, IEEE XPlore, JSTOR.

facilities.name: Cafeteria
facilities.description: The Institute has well maintained, spacious and hygienic dining halls both for Veg and Non. Veg food. Students are provided four meals a day: breakfast, lunch, evening snacks and dinner. Mess Menu is regularly updated and changed as per students' demand.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: Presently around 600 students are residing in the hostel of IIT Indore. The rooms are spacious and large and looks out to the nearby mountains, RO system installed in every room to provide safe water.  The hostel has wireless internet connectivity and many other recreational facilities.

data.description: IIT Indore has some of the top faculty across the nation. The institute has faculty members who gained their educational qualifications from the world's top institutes. The members have adequate experience in their respective fields. The faculty members at the institute are always keen on providing education in n engaging way.

highlights.summary:
NIT Rourkela, also National Institute of Technology is famous. This institution is funded by the GOI. The management of the university tackles by the Board of Governors of the National Institute of Technology (Rourkela) Society, and is registered through the Societies Act. NIT Rourkela is approved by NAAC with a grade A, located in Rourkela, Orissa. The National Institute of Technology Rourkela is accredited by the NBA and is ranked 78 in QS Southern Asia University Rankings 2025. Courses in NIT Rourkela include BTech and MBA as the flagship courses. NIT Rourkela is ranked 13 by NIRF 2025 under the Engineering category.
Courses in NIT Rourkela are offered at the UG, PG, Doctoral, PhD, and various other levels to students. These courses are offered across Engineering, Management, and various other streams. National Institute of Technology Rourkela course admissions are conducted on the basis of merit and entrance. NITRKL offers placement assistance to students. The university is visited by top companies such as Apple, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Wipro, Deloitte, and others.
National Institute of Technology Rourkela is to produce quality Engineers and Scientists at the Post-Graduate and Graduate levels in various branches of Science and Engineering. The university has a residential campus and offers accommodation to the faculty, staff, and several students through the NIT Rourkela guest house. The campus is equipped with all the necessary amenities for developing the social, personal, and academic skills of the student community. reviews.review_title: Good college, the best NIT in India.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement season starts from the end of the 6th semester and continues till the end of the 8th semester. Many of the students who get an on-campus internship offer get the pre-placement offer after their internships. Companies like Google, Texas Instruments, Oracle, Tata, Accenture, Fractal, PWC, ZS, etc. Come to our campus. The highest package is about 98 LPA, while the average is 12 LPA- 14 LPA across all the branches. More than 90 percent of the students sitting for the placements get placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a good central library in our college. All the classrooms in the lecture halls have a blackboard and a smart board along with a projector. There are 2 stadiums inside the campus, a gymnasium in every hostel, a swimming pool, basketball and tennis courts, and indoor sports in every hostel. There are over 50 clubs on campus for different things like coding, poetry, dramatics, etc. The hostel facility is okay. The boys' hostel is bigger than the girls' hostel. The food served is manageable.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty in our college is very well qualified. Most of them hold a Ph.D. from some prestigious universities abroad. We have 2 exams per semester. Midterms for 30 marks for each subject and end-terms for 50 marks. The remaining 20 marks out of 100 marks are internal and are given based on class performance and class tests. Each semester, we have 5 theory subjects and 3 practical labs. We have viva and practical exams for our practical subjects, and the professors also take regular class tests to assess our performance.

reviews.course: M.Tech. (Research) in Earth and Atmospheric Sciences
reviews.review_title: Very unique course and this is the best place.

detailed_review.Placements: We have organised a placement cell in our college. They shall assist us in all possible ways. Lots of emails and messages shall be sent to students to be prepared for the upcoming campus placements of various companies. Many companies provide internships to deserving candidates. L&T, IBM, TCS, Amazon, Flipkart, Deloitte, Practo, Microsoft, and various companies that provide internships with a stipend of at least Rs. 5000 per month.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is so elegant, so beautiful, just looking like a wow. Everything is there, for example, the gym, swimming pool, labs, Wi-Fi, hostel, and mess. Labs are well-equipped. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. There are many grounds for different sports. Hostels are very good. Food is outstanding.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is short and crisp. It depends on the branch that we opt for. Every semester, there is an internal followed by a main examination. Practical as well as theoretical to check the deep knowledge of students. Our faculty members are top-class faculty you can ever imagine. The way they teach is practically apart from a theoretical base. These make a student think of themselves as scientists, being multi-talented is much needed.

reviews.review_title: This is a very unique course; you will enjoy this college

detailed_review.Placements: Many companies come for engineering students. For post-graduate students, companies like Byjus, Aakash, and FIITJEE visit. Summer internships are compulsory for students in my college. I got a chance to do it at NCRA (TIFR Pune). Every year, 50 percent of students opt for placement and 25 percent are placed. Usually, a written round is followed by an interview for placement. Our college makes us practice for these in an online mode.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are well-equipped with instruments. All sorts of competitions happen, and workshops on robotics, AutoCAD, etc., also take place. The hostel rooms are small, and we have double-sharing rooms, as well as triple and single-sharing rooms. Hostel is compulsory for everyone. The library is accessible throughout the day. Other facilities include a medical store, hospital, swimming pool, gym, student activity center, data center, etc. We have a lot of fests all throughout the year.
detailed_review.Faculty: The courses here are well-structured and research-oriented. The faculty members are really good and helpful. Even the Ph.D. scholars interact with us frequently. Many students get placed in different companies from here. For engineering students, industrial visits occur very often. Examinations are regularly conducted under strict administration.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Come join this amazing college.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Rourkela guys are more benefited with placements. There are more than 300 companies offering jobs in our college. The main companies for the electronics branch are Texas Instruments, which offers about 35 LPA. The second most important company is Qualcomm, and it offers 28 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Coming to classroom facilities, there are two lecture halls. Every classroom has 2 air conditioners. Room is allotted to two people. There is a facility that you can select your roommate. In the hostel room, you will be given a table and a chair and two charging points. Coming to the mess, the food quality is good but bad in taste. Fee for room is 5000 per semester and 20000 for mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: NIT Rourkela has a 1:15 faculty-to-student ratio. For every department, one faculty advisor is appointed. After every semester, we need to give feedback on professors of the completed semester. We also need to give a review to the faculty advisor. As we know, in every college, electrical department professors are a bit strict; the same repeats in our college. In the curriculum, the electronics department has digital electronics, analog electronics, and so on. Up to 3rd semester, everyone will have mathematics, and the syllabus for every department is the same. In the first year, all departments have the same subjects.
detailed_review.Other: The part of the engineering college is the fests. In NIT Rourkela, there are mainly four fests: Innovision, technical fest, Virridhi, sports fest, Cosmo, cultural fest, Nitrutsav

reviews.review_title: Very good college, top NIT college.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement of my college is very good. The college offers an average package of 12-13 LPA and a median package of 11 LPA. The highest package of my college is 84 LPA. The placement percentage is about 90 percent, but this year, due to the recession, the percentage is quite low. The top tech companies visit my college, like Microsoft, Google, Amazon, and Barclays.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel infrastructure is good. There are many facilities like a gym, reading room, night and day canteen, book shop, badminton court, sports, everything. But the mess food is quite disappointing for me. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. There are many cafeterias, restaurants, and malls inside the campus. There are many grounds for different sports. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, and it is open 24 hours.
detailed_review.Faculty: Talking about the course, it is quite interesting. The exams are held every 2 months, one is a mid-semester exam, and the other is an end-of-semester exam. The faculty-to-student ratio is 10 students per faculty. The faculty members have vast experience in their field, and they are well educated and trained. You can easily go to their office and interact with them, or you can call or text them.

reviews.review_title: NIT Rourkela College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: In my M.Sc. Batch, everyone who applied got placed, but many students prefer to go for PhDs. A 2-month internship is mandatory, so all students get internships in companies or IITs. There are things to be considered before you take this course in college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our course gets a lot of support from the available facilities. We have a central library, Wi-Fi, and digital classrooms, which really help. The hostels are quite good, and the food, whether from the mess or the canteen, tastes nice. Plus, there is a multi-sports complex too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty, staff, and teachers play a very important role in helping students learn. They are not just helpful but very supportive, and they try their best to provide a good education. Their teaching style prepares students well for industry needs. Overall, the campus experience was good and nice.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely best college in Odisha.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are outstanding. 90% students are placed through the campus interview. Most students choose to be professors in colleges like any engineering colleges in Odisha or other states. Ambani is like Amazon Samsung Flipkart etc. Visited the campus during the campus interview. The average salary given was 6LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure are world class. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. This is the best engineering college in Odisha. Classroom setup having digital equipment like projectors and smartboards in the classes. Lab surfaces and having all the equipment used in industries. Library is good all types of books are available in the library. There are many grounds for sports like cricket ground volleyball court badminton court basketball court etc. Postal Sir good. Mostly there are two rooms and all types of facilities like seats and a geyser are available in the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teacher board is highly qualified and experienced. Most of the faculty members are from the IIT. Teachers taught us in very unique concepts like they cleared doubts through the discussions in the class. Two semesters per year are contracted by the college. Semester questions are sometimes hard and sometimes of a moderate level.

reviews.review_title: Shubham Anand Shiksha review.

detailed_review.Placements: Every year more than 90 percent of students got placed in top companies of India. My college offered to them was 12 LPA to 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies in India hired my college students. The percentage of students got internships from my course in companies like Amazon and Ola was more than 60 percent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities available in my department were so good. Infrastructure of college was average. But classroom and library were available for all students. Wi-Fi was not present in this college. The quality and facility in my hostel canteen were so superb. Sports and games were also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in my course were very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They had great teaching qualities. This course curriculum was relevant, and students were industry-ready. Semester exam in my course was little difficult to pass. But pass percentage was more than 90 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course to gain knowledge from my college. There was nothing to improve in my course. Scholarship was also available for all students.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely the best college with a tag as NITian, good placement and a bright future in every field.

detailed_review.Placements: Well, I'm from the mining department, and to be honest, among all NITs and IITs, NIT Rourkela offered the best facility and placement for mining engineering, due to the available mines in Odisha. 98% of our seniors got placed in various companies like Coal India, Hindustan Petroleum and other mining industries. Many also learn coding and finance to get a placement in the desired companies. The highest was 45 LPA, and the lowest was 5 LPA, with an average of 11 LPA. NIT Rourkela offered an outstanding base for mining engineering. Roles like mining designer, etc., are also offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Literally, you will get everything in the hostel, from free Wi-Fi to a gym, everything is available. Facilities like a central library, swimming pool, gym in both campus and hostel, computer labs, free Wi-Fi, an outstanding building with stunning classrooms, smart boards, and AC. Study room, TV room, dining room, game arena, TT court, badminton court, basketball court, hockey court, chess, and Uno, everything is easily accessible and for everyone to use. A temple, hospital, free checkup, sports complex, many canteens and a food court are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: As the 2nd best NIT, I can confirm that the curriculum, strict courses, and teachers are all qualified and help you to your best. Teachers also focus on the mental health of the students. Each students get assigned a faculty advisor for their helpful needs. The study here is so peaceful and really good. Although semester exams are too strict and hard, the attendance policy is 85% compulsory.
detailed_review.Other: Well, with my JEE marks, I was assigned this branch, though it was not my dream one, but still it's so good with a helpful senior, nice teacher and freedom in this course. I wish to learn more from my branch. The fests and events here are literally the best among all. The biggest fests of East India are organised by NIT Rourkela too. The campus is vibrant and beautiful. The crowd is organised and don't stand out a lot. You can get a lot of scholarships due to the big name of NIT Rourkela. Every facility, like tech, dance, music, design, and sports, is present.

reviews.review_title: Review of Electrical Engineering at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: About 80% students got placed. The highest package was 62.44 Lacs per annum, the lowest package was not available, while the average package was 14.10 Lacs per annum. Top recruiting companies are. Texas Instruments, Bharat Petroleum, JSW, ExxonMobil. Amazon, etc. Almost every eligible student received internship opportunities. Top roles offered are hardware engineers, analogue and digital design engineers and power system engineers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi available in the classroom, but we can access the internet using the LAN cable provided to us in our rooms. There are air-conditioned classrooms with smart boards, and the labs are equipped with decent equipment. There is a central library with over 60,000 books and access to digital resources. Hostels are safe and offer accommodation with amenities like a common room. The quality of food is decent. There are options for vegetarian and non-vegetarian people. They serve four times a day. There is a health centre on the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are highly qualified. Some of them are from top institutions like IITs. The teaching quality is good, and the teachers are quite knowledgeable and generally helpful. The curriculum is relevant, and it makes a student industry-ready. Thus, the mature exams are moderately difficult, with about 80 to 90% students passing each semester.

reviews.review_title: Review of mechanical engineering at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: About 85% of students got placed. The highest package is 10 LPA, the lowest package is 3.9 LPA, and the average package is 9.3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Tata Motors, Mahindra, and BHEL. Top roles offered include Hardware Engineer, Graduate Training Engineer, and roles related to Mechanical Engineering in the manufacturing sector.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi in the classrooms. We can access the internet using LAN cables provided in our rooms. Classrooms are air-conditioned and have smart boards. There is a large central library with over 60,000 books and access to digital resources. Hostels are safe and provide comfortable accommodation with amenities like common rooms. The food quality is decent. It has a large variety of options for vegetarians and non-vegetarians. A 24/7 medical facility is available at the nearest health center.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is well-qualified, mostly consisting of Ph.D. holders from top institutions. Teachers are knowledgeable and generally helpful. The teaching quality is good. The curriculum is not highly relevant, and the exams are moderately difficult, with a pass percentage around 80 to 90%.

reviews.review_title: Review of the Master of Science in Mathematics at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 60% of the students get placed. The highest package is 14.45 LPA, while the average package is 7.36 LPA, and the lowest package is 5.48 LPA. The majority of the students tend to pursue research careers. Almost all the students get internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are no Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. But we can access the internet using LAN cables provided in our rooms. Classrooms are air-conditioned and have smart boards. There is a large central library with over 60,000 books and access to digital resources. The hostels are safe. They provide comfortable accommodation with amenities like common rooms. The food is decent and hygienic. They offers a variety of options for both vegetarians and non-vegetarians. The Health Center is open all day, and access to doctors is available throughout the day.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well-equipped, mostly Ph.D. holders from top institutions like IITs. Teachers are knowledgeable and generally helpful. The curriculum is relevant, with high exposure to research and internships. The play is coordinated by Shabina. The exams are moderately difficult, with a pass percentage around 80-90%.

reviews.review_title: Review of Bachelor's of Technology in Chemical Engineering at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage for students in Chemical Engineering is more than 95%. The lowest package is 3.3 LPA, while the average package is 13.0 LPA. The top recruiting companies are ONGC, ExxonMobil, ITC, and Bharat Petroleum. About 90% of students get internships, mostly at IITs, BARC, and BPCL. The top roles offered are generally research roles in the chemical engineering domain.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi in the classrooms. But we can access the internet using LAN cables provided in our rooms. Classrooms are air-conditioned and have smart boards. The library is well-equipped with over 60,000 books. They are access to online digital resources and journals. The hostels are safe, with comfortable accommodation and amenities like common rooms and sports courts. The food is decent, with a variety of options for vegetarians and non-vegetarians. Medical facilities include a health center with 24/7 doctor availability and pharmacy services.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well-qualified, with some holding PhDs from IITs and others from international universities. The teaching quality is good. Teachers are knowledgeable and generally helpful. The course is not highly relevant. The semester exams are moderately difficult, with about 80-90% of students passing each semester.

reviews.review_title: Review of the Industrial Design course at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 60 to 70% of students got placed. The average package is about 13.98 LPA. The highest package at my college is 62.44 LPA for the whole college. Top recruiting companies are Mahindra, TCS, Wipro, and Rubrik. Intensive opportunities are few for industrial design. Top roles offered are product design, manufacturing design, and ergonomics.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi in the classrooms, but we can access the internet through LAN cables present in our rooms. Classrooms are air-conditioned and have smart boards. There is a large central library with over 60,000 books and access to digital resources. Hostels are average, offering comfortable accommodation. Food is decent, with options for both vegetarian and non-vegetarian people. A health center with 24X7 doctor is available, and pharmacy services are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well-equipped. Some of them have earned their Ph.D. from top institutions like IITs. Some are also from international universities. Teaching quality is good. Teachers are quite knowledgeable and generally helpful. The curriculum is not highly relevant. Semester exams are moderately difficult with a pass percentage of about 80 to 90%.

reviews.review_title: Review of Integrated M.Sc. Mathematics at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: About 50% of students got placed. The highest package is 14.45 LPA, the lowest is 5.5 LPA, and the average is 7.36 LPA. Top roles offered are analytics, research, and software development. Most students generally pursue higher studies. A total of 59 jobs are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: While Wi-Fi is not available in the classrooms, we have access to LAN cables in our rooms. There are well-equipped laboratories with all the necessary and latest equipment available. College has a large central library with over 60,000 books and access to digital resources and online journals. Campus has a modern auditorium and seminar hall. Hostels are decent with double occupancy. Mess food is decent and served four times a day. Medical facilities include a health center with 24X7 doctor availability and pharmacy services.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well qualified, mostly holding Ph.D. degrees from top institutions like IITs, and some are from international universities. Teachers are knowledgeable and generally helpful. Teaching quality is decent. The course is relevant. Semester exams are moderately difficult with a pass rate of around 80 to 90%.

reviews.review_title: Good campus life along with good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all students got placed by the end of the year. The highest package was in the software domain, and in core, Vedanta provided the highest package. Major recruiters are Tata Steel, Vedanta, JSW, Orica, Aditya Birla Group, IMFA, etc. The roles provided are mostly GET and MT.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the classrooms are fully digitalized, with all types of laboratories ranging from mechanics to software. All the classrooms have Wi-Fi. There is a central library which covers everything one is in need of. Hostel rooms are good, with bed, table, and chair. The quality of food in the mess is good. There is a dispensary where you can get health treatment.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the faculty members are highly qualified. They are very supportive and helpful throughout the entire B.Tech. Every batch is assigned a faculty advisor who guides us throughout. The course curriculum is beautifully designed, covering the syllabus of the GATE examination.

reviews.review_title: Review of Biotechnology and Medical Engineering at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: About 75% of the students got placed. The highest package was 15LPA. Lowest package was 3. LPA, an average packages was 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Deloitte and Wipro. In the southwest, Tata Consultancy Services, Aditya Birla Group, Reliance Industries, and many more. About 60% students got an internship. Most of them got internship at Reliance industries, Aditya Birla and research labs. Top roles offered are research associate bioinformatics, Bioprocess engineer and many more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classroom infrastructure is modern with comfortable seating. Having air ventilation and smart boards. The library has large number of books and extensive number of resources, and also access to online repositories. The college has a central research facility, which supports high-end analytical instruments and interdisciplinary access. Boys' hostels have double occupancy rooms. Each room is equipped with a bed, table, chair, LAN connection, fan, and adequate storage. Hostel provides four times meals a day, including veg and non-veg option. The Medical Center provides free medical care for students. There are regular doctoral visits and 24/7 ambulance facility.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most faculty members hold Ph.D. from prestigious universities like NIT's, IITs and some of them also got Ph.D. from international universities. Teachers are helpful, knowledgeable, and easily appreciable. The teaching is based on theoretical lectures. The curriculum covers biotechnology, medical engineering, molecular Biology, and many more. It does not make student a completely industry-ready one. Semester exams are moderate and almost eighty to ninety percent students pass.

reviews.review_title: College is good in terms of academics and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Your skills matter to get a job. Many companies visit, but they mostly prefer to hire from the higher branches. For the lower branch, there are only a few opportunities. It's not 100% always, but almost 80% get placed every year. In my course, VISA, Natwest, and Cisco are the top recruiters.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college and hostel is good. However, the facilities in some hostels, like CVR, are not so good. The food quality of some hostels is below average. Medical facilities are good. There are various kinds of sports facilities, and a new sports complex is also going to be inaugurated.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are really helpful and well-qualified. The course curriculum is relevant, which makes students ready for the industry and corporate environment. The attendance system is very strict. The semester exam is a turning point, as it decides your stay in college, but it's not that difficult.
detailed_review.Other: Events and fests are the best part of my campus life.

reviews.review_title: We have very vibrant and beautiful campus that you will definitely enjoy.

detailed_review.Placements: I don't know the placement percentage properly right now, but placements are decent. M. Many students got internships, mainly in the core branch and circuit branches. Mainly, you will find Amazon, Flipkart, and TCS- and Infosys-like companies hiring, and also some startups, which is very useful if you want to get experience and exposure to teaching, as PSUs have limited opportunities and working areas, which you will not get.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very good as far as I have explored, but the internet connection is very poor. Other than that, I don't think there are any issues you will face here, except the attendance rule. Medical facilities are good. 2 hospitals and one medical store are there. The food is good with a variety of options.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable, but in class, you may not get it sometimes, as the teachers' teaching skills are not very good; it's good, but you might have read it by yourself only. Most students study on their own at exam time. The rest of the time, they enjoy.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen biomedical engineering because, honestly, I didn't get ECE as per my rank, but since biomedical is interdisciplinary to the electrical branch, and also NIT Rourkela is a tier 1 college, the environment you will get here is amazing. You can learn engineering from anywhere (we also study from NPTEL, etc.). Personality can't be upgraded or built anywhere. Events, fests, and sports activities are held regularly, so there is no issue from that side. The only issue in NIT Rourkela is the connectivity issue; the internet connection is not good. You will get a network somewhere and not somewhere else.

reviews.review_title: Review of Civil Engineering Department at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: About 90% Students were placed in civil engineering. The highest package was 20 LPA, and the lowest package was 6,00,000 per annum. Average package was about 10,00,000 per annum. Top recruiting companies are Tata Projects, BPCL, TCS, and Larsen and Toubro. About 50% students secured intensive. And mostly got an internship at Tata. Some of the top roles offered are site engineer, project manager, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are advanced, well-equipped labs for all major civil engineering disciplines. The classrooms are spacious, air-conditioned, and have smart boards. The Central Library has a large collection of civil engineering books and access to journals and digital resources. There are double occupancy rooms available. Mess food is average. Colleges 24 into seven ambulance service. And a well-equipped campus health center.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most civil engineering faculty members are highly qualified. Some have done their Ph.D. at IITs or at International Universities. Faculty members are helpful and knowledgeable. The course is not relevant, and new specialities are not included, hence a lack in industry demands. The semester exams are moderate, and almost all the students pass.

admission.title: NIT Rourkela Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
National Institute of Technology (NIT) Rourkela admissions 2026 are entrance-based various courses. The institute offers various UG, PG and part-time courses. Some other popular courses offered by the Technology Institute are MTech, MBA, MSc, MCA, etc. Moreover, BTech is the flagship course of NIT Rourkela.

NIT Rourkela admissions to the offered programmes are either through entrance examinations (for example, JEE Main/ GATE/ IIT JAM) or based on merit. The NIT Rourkela application process is completed in online mode. Read on to know more about NIT Rourkela course admission 2026 :

faqs.question: What are the courses that NIT Rourkela offers?
faqs.answer: National Institute of Technology (NIT) Rourkela offers various undergraduate, postgraduate, Doctoral, Executive PhD and other courses to students. It has 20 departments under which these courses are offered. Moreover, BTech is the flagship course of NIT Rourkela. Some other popular courses offered by the university are MTech, M.A. and others.  Admission to the offered programmes at NIT Rourkela is either through entrance examinations (for example, JEE Mains/ GATE/ IIT JAM) or based on merit. Candidates must timely fill out the NIT Rourkela JEE Main application form. To predict the chances of admission through JEE Main, click here .

faqs.question: What is the minimum percentage required for BTech at NIT Rourkela?
faqs.answer: To get admission to BTech at NIT Rourkela, candidates must secure a minimum of 75% aggregate scores in the last qualfying exams of Class 12. Further, admission to B.Tech courses at National Institute of Technology, Rourkela is based on the JEE Main score. The centralised counselling process is managed and regulated by Joint Seat Allocation Authority JoSAA based on which the seat allotment is carried out. The seat allotment is based on the cutoff released by NIT Rourkela and a candidate's preference for courses and colleges. Further, the remaining vacant seats are filled through CSAB counselling.

faqs.question: What is the lowest rank to get into NIT Rourkela? I belong to the OBC category.
faqs.answer: The closing rank was 1011 for admission to the CSE course for the OBC AI category. The cutoff rank varies for different courses, specialisations, rounds, and categories. faqs.question: What is the fee for BTech offered at NIT Rourkela?
faqs.answer: NIT Rourkela BTech fee is INR 5 lakh. The total tuition fee for BTech + MTech courses is INR 6.3 lakh. It includes other components as well, such as hostel fees, admission fee, caution money and institute emergency fund. T his information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

faqs.question: How to apply for BTech at NIT Rourkela?
faqs.answer: NIT Rourkela BTech application process is completely online. For admission to BTech, students need to apply via JEE Main and appear for the exam. After qualifying the JEE Main entrance exam, students need to register for the JoSAA Counselling and submit the final score on the institute's official website. The process of application for JEE Main consists of three steps, i.e., registration, form filling & document upload followed by payment of application fees. faqs.question: Can I apply at NIT Rourkela for M.Tech without GATE score?
faqs.answer: No, admission to the M.Tech courses is only through GATE in NITs. There is no other provision for admission. Furthermore, after GATE, it is also crucial that the candidates with scores equal to or more than the cutoff take part in CCMT counselling. The final selection is based on merit in both selection rounds.

faqs.question: How to do M.Tech from NIT Rourkela?
faqs.answer: Candidates with a bachelor’s or an equivalent degree in an appropriate branch of Engineering of a minimum four-year duration are eligible to apply. Eligible students further need to take the GATE exam. Candidates are shortlisted based on their GATE score following which they are called for CCMT Counselling. Further, the seat allotment is done on the basis of merit in the national-level exam, counselling, and cutoff for NIT Rourkela.

faqs.question: What is NIT Rourkela M.Tech cutoff?
faqs.answer: NIT Rourkela M.Tech cutoff is based on GATE cutoff followed by GATE CCMT Counselling. For NIT Rourkela cutoff 2023, GATE CCMT was concluded with the release of Round 6. faqs.question: What is the NIT Rourkela M.Tech fee?
faqs.answer: NIT Rourkela total tuition fee for MTech is INR 1.4 lakh and for BTech + MTech is INR 6.30 lakh. This fee is calculated as per the data collected from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. Aspirants can visit the official website for more details around NIT Rourkela MTech fee.

faqs.question: How to get MSc in NIT Rourkela?
faqs.answer: For admission to an MSc course, aspirants must have taken the IIT JAM entrance test. Based on the NIT Rourkela cutoff, candidates are shortlisted on the basis of merit in IIT JAM and are called for CCMN Counselling. Furthermore, the final seat allotment is carried out based on the cumulative score in the entrance test and based on the counselling round.

faqs.question: What is the minimum eligibility requirement for MSc at NIT Rourkela?
faqs.answer: For NIT Rourkela MSc admission, candidates must hold a valid Bachelor’s degree from a recognised institute/ university with at least 55% aggregate (50% for SC/ ST/ PwD category candidates). The aspirants who have appeared for their graduation exams in 2023 are also eligible to take admission.

faqs.question: What is the selection process in NIT Rourkela for MSc course admission?
faqs.answer: Eligible candidates who submit the applications and secure a good score in IIT JAM are shortlisted for further admission rounds. A cutoff for IIT JAM Counselling is then announced, based on which candidates have to appear for counselling to secure a seat. During counselling, document verification is done and if all the documents are fine, then students are admitted.

faqs.question: What is the opening and closing rank for Integrated BSc + MSc in Physics at NIT Rourkela - National Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: The opening and closing rank depends on the category and quota of candidates. For the General category under All India, opening rank was 19155 and closing rank was 39174. Cut off are differant when it comes to other categories or female candidates and even domicile of home state. In All India, opening and closing rank for female candidates was 26823 and 74273. Admission to Integrated B.Sc. + M.Sc. in Physics in NIT Rourkela - National Institute of Technology is based on the scores obtained in the entrance exam JEE. Applicants are advised to confirm what category are they applying while checking for cut offs.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in NIT Rourkela for MBA?
faqs.answer: To get admission to MBA course at NIT Rourkel, the minimum eligibility is to get a Bachelor’s degree from a recognised university with at least 50% aggregate. Eligible students can further fill out the application form via online mode (nitrkl.ac.in). Candidates are shortlisted for this course based on the score in CAT/MAT/XAT/CMAT. Further, the shortlisted candidates are called for GDPI round. The selected candidates are offered seats through a common counselling process.

faqs.question: What is the cost of studying MBA at NIT Rourkela?
faqs.answer: The NIT Rourkela total tuition fee for an MBA is INR 4 lakh. The hostel charges are INR 20,000 and INR 17,500 has to be paid as a one-time fee. NITR one time fee includes admission fee, caution money, and institute emergency fund. T his information is taken from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. Students are requested to visit the official website to know more details around NIT Rourkela MBA fees.

faqs.question: Does NIT Rourkela offer MBA?
faqs.answer: Yes, a two-year MBA course is available at NIT Rourkela, which is taught by the School of Management. The total seat intake for this course is 75. Admission to an MBA at NIT Rourkela is through national-level exams such as CAT, MAT, CMAT and XAT. Selected students are further called for the Group Discussion and Personal Interview (GDPI) round. The total tuition fee for this course is INR 4 lakh for both the years.

faqs.question: Does NIT Rourkela accept CMAT score for MBA?
faqs.answer: Yes, aspirants can apply for MBA at NIT Rourkela can apply with a valid score of CMAT. The other accepted entrance exams are CAT/XAT/MAT. Candidates shall have the CMAT scorecard with them at the time of form filling and admission process. There is 40% weightage given to the entrance scores in the total selection process. Interested candidates can check out the CMAT 2024 registration process here.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The library has an invaluable resource with over 60,000 volumes, 1400 journals and periodicals, 700 CDs and video cassettes. The library also hosts a digital online library, providing access to over 1200 video courses online and a number of other journals and an online-wiki page hosted on the intranet for the benefit of the students. The online repository hosted by the library also hosts every paper, dissertation, and thesis published by the students and faculty not only making it one of the biggest online resources for both the students and the faculty but also making the publications available throughout the globe. Constitutes robust collections in both print and electronic resources in subjects ranging from engineering to basic sciences to humanities.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description:
There are nine halls of residence, seven for boys and two for the girls with an overall accommodation capacity of over 3000 boarders. The entire campus is connected by a state-of-the-art network with almost 4000 nodes. 
Every hall of residence boasts of a Badminton court and a Volleyball court for its borders.

highlights.summary:
SRM Institute of Science and Technology was formed in 1985. It is located in Kattankulathur, Chennai. In 2025, SRM IST was ranked 11th position under the 'University Category'. Under the 'Engineering' category, it was ranked 14, by NIRF 2025. SRM IST is a top-ranked institute that is part of the SRM Group of Institutions. Internationally, SRM Institute of Science and Technology is ranked 1001-1200 under the 'World University' category by the QS World University Rankings 2026.
SRM University has been approved with an 'A++ Grade' by the NAAC. The university has been accredited by Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, the Computing Accreditation Commission of ABET and NBA, etc. the university is also a member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU).
SRM Kattankulathur courses are given through its different affiliated colleges and constituting departments. The universoty gives UG, PG, PhD, diploma, and other courses to students across Management, Architecture, Engineering, Agriculture, and other streams. The university also offers distance education and online courses to students.
SRM University Kattankulathur is famous for its flagship MBA and BTech courses. Other SRM Institute Chennai courses include BSc, BBA, MSc, MTech, MBBS, etc. The admissions to most of the courses given at the university are based on entrance exam scores. SRM Chennai Kattankulathur admissions to the BTech programme are based on the SRMJEEE UG scores. The university also accepts several national-level entrance exams. Also, the admissions into the different Health Sciences UG, PG, and Post-PG courses is conducted on the basis of the SRMJEEH exam.
SRM University offers placement assistance to students. Over the years, SRMIST Kattankulathur has conducted more than 2,193 recruitment drives, with over 14,030 offers received, including 47+ global job offers. The highest package given during the SRM University Kattankulathur placements in 2025 stood at INR 65 LPA. SRM University Main Campus Kattankulathur has collaborated with more than 60 organisations and companies such as BITS Pilani, Goa, and Toyo University, Japan. SRM University Main Campus Kattankulathur offers different facilities such as a hostel, library, sports facilities, etc.

college_info_program.intro:
The most popular courses offered at SRM University are its BTech in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) and MBA programmes. The SRMIST BTech CSE programme is highly in-demand because of its excellent job prospects and high salaries. It is a versatile degree that can lead to a variety of career opportunities. The CSE graduates can find work as Software Engineers, Web Developers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, etc.
BTech graduates can also start their own businesses or work as freelancers. SRM Chennai Kattankulathur also offers the BTech programme in combination many other major degrees or specialisations, including Aerospace Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, etc. The university provides students with the opportunity to pursue the BTech programme in any of the majors along with a minor, specialisation or both.
Another particular popular course choice is the large collection of Health Science programs available among the SRM University Kattankulathur courses. These courses are offered in the UG, PG, and Post-PG streams and are available in plenty of specializations including Health Sciences, Nursing, Occupational Therapy, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, and Pubic Health.
