reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Vibrant college life at SRM.

detailed_review.Placements: 90 percent of the students got placed from the Computer Science course, where the top recruiting companies are Amazon, TCS, and Wipro. The top roles offered are full-stack development and software engineering. The highest annual package is 50 LPA, and the average is 5 LPA- 8 LPA, where the lowest can range from 3 LPA- 4 LPA. For an internship, many top companies come like Well and Fargo, Citibank, Natwest, and Fidelity.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In terms of infrastructure and facilities, it is very good. It has high-tech labs and a good Wi-Fi connection. It has a huge central library containing all kinds of books where students can go to study and read in their free time. The classrooms are equipped with CCTV, smart boards, and projectors, and all are in very good condition. The hostel rooms are very good, with nice furniture. The food is fine and has a variety, plus there are lots of canteen cafes plus the sports facilities are good too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are highly experienced and knowledgeable in their respective fields, and they are all very helpful. The course curriculum is relevant to modern technologies, and it makes the students industry-ready. The semester exams are moderate, and all questions are from the given course material only. The pass percentage is 99 percent.
detailed_review.Other: It is very costly, but the campus life is very vibrant. There are two major fests happening in a year, and lots of cultural events and road shows. Extracurricular activities are encouraged through various clubs, and students can join them according to their interests. The campus is very crowded, and it has a nice connection with the main city. Scholarships are given according to rank, merit, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It’s good, but it feels boring sometimes.

detailed_review.Placements: They have top companies. 80% of students are placed. The lowest is about 3 LPA, and the highest is 35 LPA. Placement training is very good. But many students choose higher studies, and many opt for an MBA depending on their career goals. Compared to last year, this year is better.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has good lab facilities and solid infrastructure. Canteens are available everywhere, but they have computer science labs in most of the buildings. However, the Wi-Fi is very bad. There are certain criteria that students must follow. Overall, it's excellent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are easy if you follow the previous year's question papers. Faculty members are good. They follow the 21 regulations. It is also good. Most faculty members are Ph.D. graduates. The pass percentage is 50%. It makes students industry-ready. Internal marks are really important for students.
detailed_review.Other: They conduct many hackathons, which are really fun events.

reviews.review_title: Good placements, solid infrastructure, supportive faculty, and a relevant BCA data science course.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently in SRM IST doing BCA Data Science. Around 80 percent of students in my batch get placed. The highest package is about 8 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is around 4.5 LPA. Top recruiters include Infosys, TCS, Cognizant, Capgemini, and Wipro. About 70 percent of students got internships in companies like Zoho, Virtusa, and HCL. Common roles offered are junior software developer, data analyst, and data support roles. It's a good platform for learning and placements if you are proactive and work on projects and skills.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: SRM IST has good infrastructure for BCA Data Science. Classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated, labs are equipped with modern computers and software, and Wi-Fi is reliable across campus. The library has a decent collection of books and digital resources. Hostels are clean with basic amenities, and the mess food is average but edible while the canteen offers a variety of snacks. Medical facilities are available on campus, and sports and games facilities like basketball, cricket, and indoor games are decent giving students a good balance of academics and extracurricular activities. SRM has good infrastructure, labs, and faculty.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers at SRM IST are generally helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Most are approachable and clarify doubts effectively. The teaching quality is decent though learning depends a lot on the student's effort. The BCA Data Science curriculum is relevant covering programming, data analytics, and the basics of machine learning which helps students gain foundational skills for the industry. Semester exams are moderately challenging, testing both practical and theoretical knowledge. Pass percentages are usually high. Around 85-90 percent but scoring well requires consistent study and attention to assignments and projects.
detailed_review.Other: I am in the BCA Data Science course at SRM IST. I chose this course because I love programming and data analytics, and wanted a career in IT and Data Science. The best things about the course are the practical labs, relevant curriculum, and exposure to coding and analytics projects. I wish there were more industry-oriented workshops and advanced machine learning sessions. The campus has a lively crowd, good connectivity, green surroundings and hosts events and fests regularly. Scholarships and extracurricular activities are available making it a balanced place for learning and overall growth.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great CSE and good placement, good faculty and good future, good labs and great outcome.

detailed_review.Placements: Recently, the highest package is 65 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Top companies are Amazon, Microsoft, PayPal, Deloitte, and many. 60 to 70 percent of students get placed in companies like Amazon, PayPal, Dell, and TCS. The roles are Full Stack development, Data analyst, and Cloud engineering.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: CSE has high-speed Wi-Fi and multiple modern computer labs. Smart AC classrooms and a well-equipped, big library and digital courses like IEEE, Springer, NPTEL. Hostels are clean with Wi-Fi, AC and non-AC options, laundry and good security. Mess food is average, and there is an excellent medical facility 24/7.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is good. Most faculty help with lab doubts and projects. Curriculum is updated and industry-relevant. Includes DSA, DSBS, OS, etc. Exams are moderately difficult. The pass percentage is very high.
detailed_review.Other: I chose it because I am interested in computers and coding. It offers a strong career option. I wish the course had even more specific sessions and updated more industry tools. The campus has big fests like Aarush and Milan. A diverse crowd and good connectivity.

reviews.review_title: Good placements in 2025, really good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 88.5% of students got placed from my course. The highest package is 52 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. Companies recruited are TCS, Cognizant, Infosys, and many more. Internship percentage is around 80% in companies like Dr. Reddy's, Avigen, and Manna Biotech. Research scientist, biomedical engineer, bioinformatics analyst, bioprocess engineer, and quality control officer are roles offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available 24X7. The classrooms and labs have very good infrastructure. College has a very big library, which is a real value for money. The facilities in the hostel are a bit for me, but the food is very good. Medical and sports facilities are great.
detailed_review.Faculty: The quality of the teachers is very good. Faculty members are very knowledgeable, kind, and helpful all the time. The course curriculum makes the student industry-ready, and it's relevant too. Semester exams are a bit difficult, and the pass percentage is around 60%.
detailed_review.Other: Events, fest, campus crowd, connectivity, campus surroundings, scholarship, extracurricular activities, etc., are conducted. They are very good at SRM.

reviews.review_title: It is a good college for BDS and a hospital.

detailed_review.Placements: For a dental college, there are zero placements, but the engineering campus has abundant placements, so the question is not valid for a dental college. The internship is a mandatory procedure to do a compulsory rotation internship within the college after 4 years of study to obtain your degree Certificate. You have the option of doing your internship at any other college (dental) by breaking the bond with the college after payment, and after the internship completion, you can obtain your degree certificate.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The surroundings of the college are pretty great, it has everything in its locality. There is a gym, restaurant, hotels, turf, Game Centre, cafes and a lot of exploring options around the college. I stayed in the hostel for 3 years. They only have a very limited number of AC rooms. And you cannot get a single room. The food quality is terrible. There are many departments like the pharmacology department, pathology department, biochemistry department, microbiology depth, moral pathology department, Endodontics depth, prosthodontics department, orthodontics department.
detailed_review.Faculty: It's a good course only, they provide lots of research projects for the development of the students, and they also give quality teaching. This course is perfect for people who pursue a medical. Speaking of staff, most of them are good, and some of them are very bad. sections.heading: Introduction
text: SRM Institute of Science and Technology Chennai campus area is 250 acres . It provides variety of facilities, state-of-the-art labs, Wi-Fi, a knowledge centre, libraries, 4,000 capacity AC auditorium, more than 100 online smart classrooms, boys and girls hostels with multiple premium facilities, and others. The campus of SRM Chennai is green, clean, and energy-efficient. It considers solar energy as one of the major sources of power for the campus. There are other endless facilities of convenience offered at the campus of SRM Chennai such as cafeterias, prayer halls, ATMs, bookstores, dining options, gym, and others. The students are engaged with community radios, student clubs, cultural events, fitness centres, and prayer halls.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The university library is fully air conditioned 15 storey building comprises a rich collection of books covering various branches of Engineering and Technology, Medical and Health Sciences and Science and Humanities. The library has stocked 140518 volumes of books consisting of 61289 titles. The collection also includes 1550 handbooks & 200 encyclopedias. Back volume is about 4105.  8235 above project thesis. 781 standards which include BIS, ISA & IEEE. Around 5938 books CDs, 2710 journal CDs, 25 encyclopedia on CDs, 20 self learning tutorials, 850 video programs are available in the library.Cumulative database of nearly 2.52 lakh records covering the period from 1990 - 1999 are available. The library building is fully air-conditioned and automated. Photocopy facility is available in the library.

facilities.name: Cafeteria
facilities.description: University has 16 canteens and food courts which serves a variety starts from fast food to full-fedged cafeterias spread throughout the campus.Beside this a 24 hour café is also available for the hostellers.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: SRM University has 14 blocks for boys and 7 blocks for girls. All the hostels have hi speed Wi-Fi connectivity and are provided with solar water have heating systems, mineral water supply, water cooler in each floor, generator power supply.Students are offered with healthy and sumptuous food options at highly subsidized rates and can choose to have North Indian or South Indian menu in the dining halls that are co-located. the hostels also offer a multi-cuisine dining facility providing Thai, Chinese and continental food for the benefit of our international students,.Rooms with single cot ,study table & chair, cupboard & common mirror are available. Most hostels have common washrooms, a few blocks are available with attached bath and AC rooms too. Facilities such as gym, prayer halls, games, sports and cultural activities has been facilitated. 3 International hostels with modernized kitchen,library,drinking water, water heater, telephone,power supply, medical care, recreation,stationery shop, laundry point, gym, playground, indoor games, banking facility, a/c dining hall, a/c study hall and one off campus international hostel is also available.

data.description: SRM University Kattankulathur has reputed faculty with over 2,000 members . These include teaching and non-teaching staff. International faculty also visit the campus regularly. This provides students with a wide range of perspectives, and creates a vibrant environment. Most of the teaching staff is qualified and hold PhDs.

highlights.summary:
IIT Dhanbad is also recognised as the Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines Dhanbad) by the masses. As the name of this institute reflects, it provides engineering and technology courses. The institute offers several UG and PG courses. The facts that one should know before selecting this course are mentioned in the pointers below
History: The institute was formed in 1926. It is one of the third institutes that was converted into an IIT.
Courses: The academics of this institute are well recognised and famous. Some of the prominent courses that are in demand and offered by the IIT Dhanbad are MBA, BTech, M.Tech, M.Sc., etc. The course is offered through 18 departments.
Ranking: IIT Dhanbad has been ranked 20th in the QS WUR Ranking By Subject, and it is ranked 100th in Southern Asia and 381st in Asia by QS World Ranking 2025. The institute also ranked 15th by NIRF in 2025 for Engineering. Thus, IIT Dhanbad's ranking is famous all over. Ongoing, the institute has been ranked at number 35 in the overall category by the NIRF 2025 and at the rank 48 among the top Management institutes in India by NIRF 2025.
Research: The institute focuses on strong research in the field of mining, earth sciences, and engineering.
Placements: In this academic year, IIT Dhanbad placements for 2025 are still ongoing. As of now, 1,389 students have participated in the recruitment drive. A total of 237 PPOs have been offered to students up till now, out of which 211 have been accepted. The median and the average package recorded during IIT Dhanbad placements 2025 were INR 17.56 LPA and INR 13.38 LPA, respectively.
Admission: Admission to the courses of IIT Dhanbad is completely dependent on the entrance. The institute accepts different entrance exams for the courses; some of the exams are CAT, JEE Main, JEE Advanced, GATE, and others. For IIT Dhanbad admission, complete the eligibility requirements too.
Infrastructure: The facilities include sports, a gym, labs, an auditorium, hospital facilities, and a lot more. Additionally, the institute provides hostel facilities for both boys and girls. International Collaborations: IITISM Dhanbad has signed various MoUs (Lols) with different universities across the globe.
International Collaboration: The top international collaborations are the Institute of Geonics, Boise State University, National United University Mioli, Taiwan, Oakland University, Ecole Centrale de Nantes, and others.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The campus has a classic environment, well-trained faculty, and good placements every year.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 84 percent of students get placed. The highest package offered is 58 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 15 LPA. The average package offered is 24 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Google, Amazon, Flipkart, Tata, Microsoft, etc., hire students. Around 60-70 percent of students get internships in companies like Google, Amazon, Microsoft, etc. Roles like data analyst, operating system, ML engineers, and information security-related engineers are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All facilities are good in terms of academics, like labs, Wi-Fi, classrooms, and branchwise departments. The campus environment is very nice, with lots of trees. It has a pollution-free campus, as most vehicles run on electricity. Hostels are also nice. We get both good non-vegetarian and vegetarian food. Sports and games are excellent here. All required courts are available here. We also have a student activity centre where we play indoor games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-trained. Their tactics in designing exam papers are really awesome. Teaching is also good. They use the digital projector for displaying slides. They also use the smart board to explain. They will also update the course based on time and current situation to make students ready to face the competition in the industrial world with updated skills, somehow we learn them at least by clubs. The pass percentage is about 90-95 percent.
detailed_review.Other: In view of the present and future situation and the job market, in society, software engineers occupy major roles in development, so I chose the Computer Science and Engineering course. I think that some skills should not be taught through clubs, but should be a mandatory skill to learn by everyone through the curriculum. It is better to implement this in the present curriculum (presentation and communication skills). Events, fests and extracurricular activities organised are also good here as they are governed by students and funded by the campus and other local companies.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Honest review of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 85 to 90 percent of students get placed almost every year. The highest package is 59 LPA, and the average is 24 LPA. Recruiting companies include Google, Zomato, and Blinkit. 50 out of 140 students got internships last year at companies such as Cisco, Google, and Microsoft. Roles offered include web developer, data scientist, app developer, software engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Campus Wi‑Fi is available free of cost and for unlimited use. Labs are equipped with computers, although some systems are old. Classrooms are air-conditioned and very spacious. The best thing about our college is its 7‑storey library containing thousands of books, with ample sitting areas and a cafeteria. Hostels are small. The mess/food is the greatest downside. Currently, our sports grounds are under renovation, so sports aren’t active lately.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, with all being Ph.D. holders. Some have advanced qualifications. Teaching quality is satisfactory. The course curriculum makes students industry‑ready. Semester exams are not very difficult, and most students get around 95%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it is Computer Science from an IIT, which is the best thing about it. I think they could reduce some theory classes and replace them with practical or lab classes. There are three major events/fests organised at our IIT, not including sports fests and sports meets.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A brief overview of college life at IIT Dhanbad.

detailed_review.Placements: Top companies include Google, Microsoft, Samsung, Uber, and many more that come for internships and placements. The average package for our course is 28–30 LPA. The highest package is nearly 80 LPA. Top roles like Software Engineer are offered. Overall, 75% of students get placed in our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are many hostels on campus for student accommodation. Each hostel provides all basic necessities like 24/7 cold/hot water, Wi-Fi, sports facilities, and a canteen. Hostel food is also nice and hygienic. Labs have advanced computer facilities with Wi-Fi. Classrooms are air-conditioned. We have one of the largest libraries in Asia.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are highly qualified and experienced. Professors are assigned as mentors to guide students. There are courses that give us experience in different working fields. The difficulty of exams generally varies with the professor. Some exams can be much more difficult than expected.
detailed_review.Other: Our college is the first IIT to provide a no-attendance policy. Students get enough time to build skills and can join various clubs. Various events and fests also occur here.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great college with top faculty, strong labs, good facilities, and excellent placements.

detailed_review.Placements: As I know, out of 137 students in CSE, 122 are placed, and the average LPA was 27.5. The highest was 65 LPA, and the lowest was 6 LPA. Top companies like Microsoft, Google, and Amazon, along with other top companies, are coming for recruitment. Top roles like SD and other roles were offered at my college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As I was studying at IIT, the food quality was good, but as I was from the South, I did suffer; mostly people from the South will suffer. Wi-Fi is 24/7 available in the hostel, college, and library. Classrooms have digital boards and are provided with projectors, and everything is facilitated with air conditioning.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and knowledgeable. As I was studying CSE, the course was a little bit hard to study for the semester, as the exam papers tend to be difficult. When it comes to the pass percentage, almost everyone will pass. It's hard to score the highest marks in a semester, but it's okay to pass the semester.
detailed_review.Other: I’m doing CSE at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, from the 2024-2028 batch. I chose this course because I enjoy teaching and wanted strong career opportunities. The peer group, coding culture, and project exposure are the best parts. A few subjects could be more updated, and the workload can get heavy at times. Campus life is lively with fests like Srijan and Concetto, good connectivity, and plenty of clubs and activities, so overall the experience is positive.

reviews.review_title: Great opportunities, mixed hostel vibes, but worth it for the IIT tag.

detailed_review.Placements: I graduated from the Environmental Engineering batch of 2K21-25, and honestly, placements are pretty solid. Around 85-90% of students in my course got placed. The highest package was 45 LPA, while the average was around 15-18 LPA, depending on the branch. Top recruiters included big names like Google, Microsoft, Schlumberger, Tata Steel, and ONGC. Roles varied from Software Developer, Data Analyst, Mining Engineer, to Petroleum Engineer, so there is something for everyone. The placement cell is quite supportive. Many students convert their internships into PPOs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I am part of the 2K21-25 batch, and overall, the infrastructure is decent. Classrooms are well-maintained, Wi-Fi is available but patchy at times, and labs have the necessary equipment, though some need upgrades. The library is huge. Hostel life was manageable. Rooms were okay, but not luxurious. Mess food is hit or miss. Some days are edible, some days are emotional damage. The canteen has better options, and the sports facilities are actually good. Medical facilities are available, but basic. Overall, the infrastructure is good, and it's the IIT guys.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty profs are super helpful and know their stuff. Teaching quality varies, but if you show interest, most teachers respond well. The curriculum is mostly relevant, especially for core subjects. It does help in placements and internships. Exams are conducted on time. The pass percentage is decent. If you study regularly, you're good. No last-minute surprises, but, some papers are tricky. Overall, the academic vibe is serious but not suffocating.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Environmental Engineering because I am genuinely interested in the field, and IIT ISM has a strong reputation for it. Things that could improve are faster curriculum updates. Events like Srijan and Concetto are major highlights. The crowd is competitive but friendly. There's a good mix of extracurriculars, from coding clubs to dance groups. Scholarships are available for eligible students, and the surroundings are peaceful, though not super urban.

reviews.review_title: Decent college, but with some fundamental problems.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements have always been decent at IITISM Dhanbad. The good part about IIT Dhanbad is that even the supposedly "lower' branches also score decent packages like petroleum engineering, mining. Environmental engineering. Petroleum engineering, in particular, has had a decent history of placement since all major oil and petro companies like ONGC come here to recruit. Recently, even bigger companies are taking an interest in recruiting from IITISM, which promises a hopeful placement journey for the future.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our mechanical department is the richest in the entire college. We have a lot of machines and lab equipment. We have the Institute Research Hub (iRh) and the innovation centre i2H and NVCTI. They have world-class infrastructure. However, I have only given three stars for the infrastructure, which is because of the hostel. The food is okay, we get paneer and non-veg 3 times a week, and the taste is okay. The internet speed is only 50 Mbps most of the time, and the rooms are small and don't even have two desks, although two people live in one room.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers, almost all of them, are very well qualified with their post-graduation studies done from abroad or top institutions. Now, the helpfulness of the teacher tends to be a hit or a miss, but I have found that the odds of you getting a bad teacher are low-ish, at least for the first year, when we have common courses. The course is relevant, but you will still need to do things on your own to make sure you are not missing out on skills that the industry requires. The academics are a bit on the tougher side.
detailed_review.Other: I took this college since it is near my home and I can often come to meet my family. Mechanical engineering is a decent branch that gives you the option to appear for the IES exam down the road. The hostel rooms need a change. We were allotted Jasper hostel, and the worst problem I face is that there's only one desk space, so if you're using the desk, your roommate has to study on their bed. This year's final year also has double sharing, which is very sad because you'll never get personal space in your uni life here.

reviews.review_title: Extremely happy seeing my dream of becoming an IITan come true.

detailed_review.Placements: The data on the placements here is good compared to the other 2 IITs. Many of our seniors are placed in foreign countries this year, and some also got high packages in India. Placement in the Mechanical department is expected to become low this year, as everywhere.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel is good. We are getting several facilities with computer labs, a Library, and Many lecture halls for studying. The full campus is Wi-Fi covered, and internet LAN cables are also available everywhere.  Inside the hostel, on every floor, a common room is also available for playing games, watching TV, and relaxing.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors here are very good in terms of teaching and providing study material. They are also highly qualified in their subjects and very humble and kind in nature. They are always ready to help and solve doubts. They also help during exam sessions by taking practice question classes.
detailed_review.Other: There is always something happening in college that helps us to get involved and feel a social presence for it.

reviews.review_title: This is the best university in Dhanbad.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Dhanbad offers the best placement opportunities for students, this university has high placement rates. The highest package of this university is 70 LPA, and the lowest package is 50 LPA. Many companies like TCS, HCL, and Microsoft visit this university every year for placements. At least 70% is required for placement purposes.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this course is very good for the students. There are many facilities available in this university, like all-time Wi-Fi. There is a big library present in this university where students learn together. There is a big hostel with a calm and clean environment for the students. The food quality is also very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of this university is good for the students. They support students in every situation. The teaching quality is also very good. The course curriculum provided by this college is relevant for the students, which makes the students industry-ready. Many exams are organized in this university so they perform well in their sessional examinations.
detailed_review.Other: There are many fests and events organized in IIT Dhanbad for the students. This university also provides scholarship facilities for the students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: This is the best college in Jharkhand.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2025, IIT Dhanbad saw an overall placement rate of 76.36% for the 2024-25 academic year, with 70% placed and the highest package of 60 LPA and an average package of 13 LPA. The placement scenario varies by department, with Computer Science and Engineering achieving an 86.50% placement rate and Petroleum Engineering achieving a high of 93.33%. Major recruiters include Google, Microsoft, and Tata.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Dhanbad has a large 444.98-acre campus with a fully automated, extensive library, spacious smart board-equipped classrooms, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Student amenities include 24/7 healthcare, sports facilities like a swimming pool and gymnasium, and the student canteen offers spacious twin-sharing rooms with high-speed internet. This university is very good in all its facilities. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers of this university are helpful and Ph.D.-qualified, and they teach students in a very effective manner. They make hard concepts very easy. The course curriculum provided by this college is relevant to students, making them industry-ready. This university organizes numerous exams on campus, enabling students to perform well in the final examination. There is a 60% passing criterion.
detailed_review.Other: There are many fests and events organized at this university. This university also provides scholarships for weak students so they can easily pursue their studies. There are many extracurricular activities organized at this college, like a sports fest, which is organized every year to build the aura of IIT Dhanbad students.

reviews.review_title: Best IIT for opting for core fields.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement of my branch is best among others because this college is mainly known for Mining of petroleum and Metallurgy as well as material engineering. Almost 90% students are placed every year with an average package of 12 LPA that goes to 34 LPA. Companies that come for this branch are mostly PSUs like Bharat Petroleum, ONGC, Indian Oil, and many more. Internships are offered to 80% students. They hire for a System Engineer and a manager role.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my branch is average, not good like other IITs. Basic classrooms without a projector, Wi-Fi enabled campus, but with low speed. The library of this college is very big and has a large number of books. Hostel facilities are average, the canteen and mess food are not good in taste, but you can manage it. Medical and sports facilities are good, and students get opportunities to show their talent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are very well qualified and knowledgeable, as it should be in IITs. Every faculty is supporting students where they need guidance. Curriculum are much relevant to modern technology, and the application of theories is well executed in labs. Semester exams are not easy if you do not study from the start. Those who prepare earlier get passes easily. The numbers would be 90%.

reviews.review_title: My honest review about my college.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements used to be top-notch 2-3 years back. But with the increase of seats and slowdown in the mining sector, the job opportunities were not as good as before. Many reputed companies like KPMG, TATA Steel, PWC, Tata Consultant Engineers, Tega Industries, and Aditya Birla recruited through this branch. The maximum pay is 10 LPA, with an average around 4.5  LPA. I got selected for RINL Visakhapatnam for an internship. It was a non-stipend internship. Tata Steel also came for internships, and they eventually offered PPOs to some of the selected ones.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are 6 hostels for males and 2 for females. All the hostels are good, but I love Diamond Hostel because of the heritage it has. The rooms are spacious, and you need to share the room with one person. The hostel fees are included in your semester registration. The course curriculum is pretty good. It is well-structured and helps the students in getting a better understanding of the entire field.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course is basically about mineral processing techniques and the engineering involved in those processes. It is under the Fuel and Mineral Engineering department, which has good lab and research facilities. The faculty members are very qualified in the past, but since the last 2 years, some good professors have left, creating a void.

reviews.review_title: My honest review of my college.

detailed_review.Placements: Being an IIT, the college has a full potential for placements. There is a nice exposure to MBA students for working in the core companies. There are many companies to work with. I did my summer internship at Turtle, India, and my winter internship at Coal India Limited. Both online with the HR course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are 6 hostels for males and 2 for females. All hostels are good but I love Diamond Hostel because of the heritage it has. Rooms are spacious and we need to share the room with one person. The hostel fee is included in our semester registration.
detailed_review.Faculty: It is a semester-based university. There is a credit-based education system, and it has a maximum of 10 credits. There are 75 marks for exams and the rest 25 marks are based on classroom performance, attendance, etc. Faculty members were very qualified in the past, but in the last 2 years, some good professors have left creating a void. The course is good but the focus is more on the theoretical aspects rather than practical. We have to take on our own initiative if we want to do something new and convenience the department once. If they are convinced, they will stand behind us to give their full support. The course curriculum is a bit outdated but professors bring lots of new topics for discussion. Pedagogy is also a bit outdated considering the fact that lots of other MBA institutes have innovative styles of teaching. Some courses are offered on a specific campus.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Electronics Engineering (Communication & Signal Processing) (SP)
reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Dhanbad (ISM) - Indian Institute of Technology (ISM).

detailed_review.Placements: Usually, placements begin during starting of December. There are lots of companies that come for placements. Highly paid companies like Citibank, Barclays, Google, Microsoft, and Amazon are on the list. They will be coming at the beginning to filter out the cream layer. There are companies like ICICI, Wipro, TCS, and Infosys, which come at the end to recruit students in bulk. There are core companies like Tejas Network, Sterlite, Tata Motors, etc visit our college to recruit the core students. The average package is between 8 LPA to 12 LPA, and the highest package offer is about 60 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course curriculum is very exhaustive, and students are always in the midst of things. Recently, our curriculum was reviewed, and my juniors have a completely new curriculum and courses. All the important and relevant courses are covered in this institute. The facilities in the hostel were good. We are provided with many activities there. There was a big TV room, table tennis, computer room, fine arts room, badminton court, and basketball court in each hostel. The mess food quality was good, and hygiene was well maintained by the college; that's the main thing I like about the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified. Everyone has done a Ph.D. and is doing a lot of national and international projects in their respective fields. They are also well-experienced in their fields and give their best to bring the best out of the students. They have also written many research papers and published them in top-class journals. Most of the lecturers also have industry experience. Exams are being conducted with ease and dedication. Labs are well structured and well maintained by the end of the day, and one feels relaxed.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Dhanbad (ISM) - Indian Institute of Technology (ISM).

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 80% of students are placed. The average package is around 15 LPA - 20 LPA. The highest would be around 1.2 crores. Top recruiters include companies like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and many more. 25% of students got internships from my course. Mostly in core companies, and every kind of role is offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is built everywhere on campus. LAN is also provided. Classes are not as big as expected, but good, mess is just fine, as expected, not that good. Various canteens are there in every hostel. Vending machines are also installed. Medical facilities are good. Facilities are also really good for studying. Library is really big.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and very knowledgeable. Teaching depends on the teacher though, some teach really great, some don't. That's the crux of every college to be honest. Curriculum is relevant as it's an IIT. Exams are fine.
detailed_review.Other: I didn't choose this course, I got it through counseling. It's good though, really interesting.

reviews.review_title: IIT ISM Dhanbad College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: A high percentage of placements are available in my course. The lowest and highest packages from top companies range from 3 LPA to 16 LPA. Top recruiting companies are interested in this course. The percentage of internships in this course is 80% in top companies like Wipro and Railways.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has the best infrastructure compared to other colleges in the city. Wi-Fi is available all around the campus. Our classrooms are very clean. The library has good books. We have clean washrooms. The hostel does not have good facilities. The food is the worst. Sports are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is very qualified but not helpful. They do not provide the required knowledge to the students. The curriculum contains very old technologies, and the semester exams are not difficult. The situation is such that teachers do not cover the right portions and include different topics in the exams. The checking is not thorough, leading to difficulties for students during exams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good placements in 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: As of the 2024–25 placement season, the B.Tech Electronics and Communication Engineering program at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad achieved a placement rate of approximately 68.18%. This indicates that about two-thirds of ECE students secured job offers during this cycle. The highest package offered is 51 LPA, the average package is 20 LPA, and the lowest package is 7 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Texas Instruments, Qualcomm, Samsung R&D, Intel, Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Flipkart, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities provided for the ECE department are a VLSI lab, a SAP lab, a communication lab, a fiber optic lab, and a metamaterial lab. The central library is open every day, with good air-conditioned facilities for studying. Wi-Fi is available 24/7 throughout the campus. Different kinds of sports are played on campus, such as cricket, football, basketball, hockey, tennis, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are highly qualified and have doctorates. They have knowledge, and their way of teaching is very good and easily understandable. The course curriculum is very good and makes students industry-ready. The semester exams do not feel so difficult, as the faculty's teaching is good enough to pass. The pass percentage is about 97%.
detailed_review.Other: Different kinds of fests are conducted in our college, like Srijan, the cultural fest, Parakram, the sports fest, Kanan, Concetto, etc. Students from different colleges are invited to participate in the fests conducted by our college. I chose this course because I am interested in developing both hardware and software knowledge.

reviews.review_title: A glimpse of my life at IIT Dhanbad (ISM).

detailed_review.Placements: Placement states are quite good in our college and in my course also which is 76.92% of 48 students which is quite good. The highest package offered for my course is 38 LPA and the lowest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 13 LPA, which is decent. Top recruiting companies are Reliance, Sun Petrochemicals, Chevron, etc. Internships are decent but it is hard to get an internship in my field, but some got in non-core. The top roles offered are process engineer, project engineer, product engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Since it is an old college which is completing its centenary in 2026, some old hostels are average but others are very good. Our college library is the world's second-largest technical library. It has 24-hour Wi-Fi and classrooms are quite good. Labs are conducted in a very strict way. All basic needs are available in our college. Ground, medical center and canteen all are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very friendly and teach us well. Their teaching style is a bit different as compared with others. About 14 weeks are allotted for a semester, which is enough to complete the syllabus and study. Some exams are very tough and some are a bit easy according to professors. The pass percentage is almost 90%.
detailed_review.Other: I love civil engineering, so I have opted for this course. There is a scholarship for merit students, i.e., MCM which offers Rs. 10,000 for a student. There are three major fests that happen in a year namely Concetto (tech fest), Srijan (cultural fest), and Parakram (sports fest). Some minor fests namely Turbulence, Khanan, etc., are also organised. The college life is quite good in my college.

reviews.review_title: My college, in my opinion.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70% of students are placed every year in my college. The highest package is about 20 LPA, and the lowest is about 6 LPA on campus. About 80% of students get internship opportunities, and they work very hard for them, acquiring good knowledge from this.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are quite good in my college, it is a tier 1 college in India. Hostels are quite poor, but students live peacefully here. Wi-Fi facility is also available, and students acquire good knowledge. The medical facilities are also available, which is good. You can go for it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very good in my college. They are very supportive and help us both mentally and socially. The course curriculum also supports building a good future for engineers, but the semester exams are difficult. You can study throughout the year for good marks.
detailed_review.Other: I personally chose this college because of my interest. It is a reputed college in India and one of the top ones. It holds 2-3 annual fests, and we enjoy them along with our studies.

reviews.review_title: Good placement, satisfying faculty, good infrastructure, and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, around 80% of students are placed and it will surely reach above 85 as in past years this percentage used to be around 100. In my course, the highest package offered is 42 lakhs and the lowest is 8 lacs. Top recruiting companies are SLB, Exxon Mobile, Meesho, etc. During internship season around 50% of students got internships in companies like Cairn, SLB, Microsoft, and many more. The top roles mostly offered are in core petroleum like reservoir engineer and production engineer but if you are willing to be a software engineer then some people get placed in good companies like Microsoft.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Girls' hostels have big rooms and fast-speed Wi-Fi available in the hostel. You will get good quality food, fast-speed Wi-Fi available on the whole campus, best library. I am is known for the biggest teaching library in Asia, it is where I have spent my maximum time, in interactive classrooms. Professors solve doubts immediately you can ask them in between really good. The quality of education is provided. The food is good. Medical, sports, and games facilities are available in our college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors teaching this course are among the best. They are helpful and qualified, and the curriculum is highly relevant to the industry, particularly for petroleum studies. Semester exams are at a moderate level, allowing students to easily balance their studies with extracurricular activities. The pass percentage is 98%, so it's very rare for someone to fail.

reviews.review_title: Decent academics, good placements, & vibrant college life. At the end college with a strong culture.

detailed_review.Placements: My branch is EE, and about 85% of students are placed, with the highest package is 36 LPA, and the average is 16 LPA. Also, about 30% to 45% of pre-final year students get internships. Companies like Google, Microsoft, De-Shaw, JSW, Reliance, TATA, Accenture, and many software companies come for placements as well as internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Recently, we got a new hostel, Aquamarine, which has 13 floors with all kinds of facilities, including Wi-Fi, a common room for indoor sports, washing machines, etc. Hostels provide good basic facilities for B.Tech students with double-sharing rooms. The mess food is not good. Medical facilities are good, as we have a Health Centre with about 5-8 doctors on day shifts. Classrooms are equipped with smart boards, projectors, etc., and ACs be installed soon. Sports facilities are also very good, like in every IIT.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are well-qualified and have a good understanding of the core subjects. Some professors are very helpful and approachable, but there are many whose teaching quality is not good or who are not good at delivering what they know. But they are full of knowledge if we ask them one-on-one questions.
detailed_review.Other: I choose IITISM Dhanbad as it has solid academics, decent placements, and the IIT tag. The course offers good facilities and structured learning. Fests like Srijan and Concetto add vibrancy and the student crowd is great, focused, and friendly. The campus is peaceful and has active clubs.

highlights.summary:
Vellore Institute of Technology Vellore was established in 1984 in Vellore, Tamil Nadu and is a private research university. It is recognised as an Institution of Eminence and the No.1 private university for innovation recognised by Government of India. VIT Vellore is UGC recognised with NAAC A++ accredititation.
VIT Institute Vellore is ranked 22nd in the 'Asian University Rankings - Southern Asia' and 173rd in the 'Asian University Rankings' of the QS World Rankings 2024. It has been ranked 14th under the Universities category by NIRF 2025. QS World University Rankings 2026 has ranked it at 691. The university offers Engineering, Management, Commerce, Science, Computer Applications, etc courses at UG, PG, and PhD levels. Popular courses are BTech, BBA, BCom, BCA, BSc, MTech, MSc, MBA, and more.
VIT Vellore has three major campuses located in Bhopal, Chennai, and Amaravati. These are run and managed by the VIT Group of Institutes. It also has the VIT Online Learning Institute, which offers online courses to students. The VIT Vellore India campus has separate boys and girls hostels, state-of-the-art classrooms and laboratories, library and resource center, recreational facilities, an auditorium, etc. Major highlights of Vellore Institute of Technology Tamil Nadu are as below:

reviews.review_title: Very satisfied with the facilities they provide, and the teachers are teaching very well.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 80 percent of students are placed in my course. The highest package is Rs. 1,50,000, the average is Rs. 1,00,000, and the lowest is Rs. 75,000. The top recruiting companies for my course are Nestled, Biocon, and Himalaya. Many students got internships in the Biocon company, even abroad. The top roles are research and development.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi in the hostel, and the infrastructure is very good in VIT. The library is the best. Hostel facilities are so good, and the food is served very neatly. We have an ambulance for emergencies. We have badminton in our hostel. The hostel is very good, and the hygiene is very good. They have laundry also.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Their teaching quality is very good. The course curriculum is so relevant, and they make the students industry-ready. The semester exam is somewhat tough, but the final exam sem is much tougher than the internals. The pass percentage is 60%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this out of personal interest. The best thing is that there are many lab works. The timing of the class could be reduced. There are many events, and they keep the students engaged very well.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Bioinformatics)
reviews.review_title: VIT - Vellore, Tamil Nadu review.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement cell is there on our campus for handling all the placement interviews and aptitude training workshops. The highest package is 1 Crore per annum, and the lowest is 30 LPA. And the average package is 50 LPA. Top recruiting companies are like Apple, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Goldman Sachs, etc. About 80-90% of the students get a chance of an internship, and most of them are aware of the real-life problems, so they meet the requirements of the company and get enrolled in the company.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are well furnished, and all necessary equipment like an almirah, wardrobe, table, bed, and chair are there. Classrooms are also loaded with the facilities that are required, and they keep us available as soon as possible. Food quality is impressive as they give both veg and non-veg options on the menu. Games and sports are there in bulk, most of the international player comes from this college only.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very supportive and helpful. They help in every circumstance of life. Also, the course curriculum is well and good as compared to other private institutions. Semester exams are a little more difficult but easy to crack. About 70-80% students get more than 9.5 CGPA. And a rest above 8 CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is very engaging, and we generally have to go through the workshop every day with the industry experts. My experience in this college is awesome, and I want other students to study here as the college offers an overseas study medium for students who pursue a master's degree. The campus crowd is full of engineers and innovators. Fest is held generally in the month of December, at the end of our semester.

reviews.review_title: Infrastructure and campus life are good.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a fresher; I don't know much, but I will tell you what I know. 50% get placements mostly in tech-based companies like Infosys and all, and we should have a minimum 8.5 CGPA. The package ranges from 3.5 LPA to 26 LPA. We get mostly UI/UX design or automobile design jobs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. I took the H Block hostel apartment type; it is costly but very spacious. Wi-Fi is good, and the food is also good. We have a health center within VIT with a medical shop, and we have a basketball court, badminton court, and all to play. The mess is also neat.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are experienced and teach well. They are friendly, and we are literally like friends with them. The course curriculum has completely changed this year. It is hands-on and drawing, so it's like skill development. I am still in my 1st semester as of now. The assessments were neither hard nor easy, just average, and I don't know the pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: I love designing and drawing. It is my favorite, and I love it here. There are events and fests, and campus life is great.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Vellore Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage to get placement was 90 percent. The highest package offered was 56LPA and the average package offered was 8LPA. The top companies recruiting like Google Amazon Flipkart Infosys Wipro etc. The percentage of internship was 80 percent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College infrastructure was very beautiful. All blocks had good infrastructure. College only provides Wi-Fi. Labs were very helpful. In library there were all these types of books. Hostel rooms were good and also hygiene food. In total five canteens were there. Good medical and sports facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality was good. Almost all teachers were very experienced and very knowledgeable. Teachers help students face any kind of doubts. Teaching quality was good. The course was relevant. Semester exams were moderate. The percentage passing the semester was 85 percent.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science)
reviews.review_title: Vit Vellore course review.

Companies like TCS, Wipro, and more. There are good placements if you have reached a certain criteria like completing the credit and internship.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the lab and classes is good. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel. In library it is available. The hostel facilities are good and the food is also good. If you're interested in sports, there is a chance you can play, and they give first preference to health in the hostel.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Bioinformatics)
reviews.review_title: Good placements, good ROI of CAT 1, 2, and strict rules.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement percentage is very high, above 99%. The highest package offered is 1 crore per annum, with a average of 9.9LPA. The lowest packages are 3.3 to 4LPA. Big companies like Google, Microsoft, Deloitte, Apple, etc visit the campus. Top roles offered in my course are software engineer, data analyst, data scientist, hr, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very good in my college. Library with many books. Wi-Fi is decent, but only in the library and hostels. There are AC and non AC rooms available, and the room you get depends on your CGPA or your roommate CGPA. Food is sometimes good, sometimes not, depending upon what mess you take. We have a volleyball, gym, a tennis table, table tennis, a basketball, a swimming pool, and a big ground for football and cricket.
detailed_review.Faculty: There are 4 main exams conducted. CAT 1, CAT 2, lab fat and fat. Fat is the final exam. CAT 1 and CAT 2 are monthly, and the lab fat is the final exam for lab courses. CAT 2 is open book but the questions are hard. Again, some faculty members are very good, some are not. It really depends upon which faculty you take. There is a FFCS system using which you can decide which faculty to take and which slots in a day to take and customize your timetable.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I was interested in computer Science and engineering, and was fond of computers since childhood.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Well maintained campus and great environment to learn and grow.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package offered this year was around 1 crore per annum and the lowest package offered 5LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Wipro, TCS, Infosys, and many other tech based companies in India and abroad. 70% of students with a CGPA of 9 or above and good coding skills get internships. Mostly students land roles in the technical side itself as they develop.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Computer Science department is one of the largest in VIT and hence has been provided with the best facilities, such as well equipped classrooms with smart boards and internet connection. The rooms are large and spacious. The library here is not only big but also has a wide range of books available on every topic necessary. They even have self serving kiosks, which can give us an idea of where the book is present. The hostel is well equipped, and they have good Wi-Fi, good food, AC, and non AC rooms. Canteens and sporting areas are available as well.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified but can be hard to understand at times. They are very knowledgeable and can be really helpful. Course curriculum is relevant to industry standards, and the semester exams are mid-level. The pass percentage in our batch is pretty high, with at 85% to 90% of the class passing.
detailed_review.Other: It is an overall experience, it gives you great exposure, and shows you a new community of people who share the same interests as you. I chose this course out of my interest in technology since childhood. They could improve the faculty a bit more. Events and fests organized are wonderful. There are technical fests and plenty of hackathons and events for everyone.

reviews.review_title: VIT University: A place that you cannot miss in your lifetime.

detailed_review.Placements: The basic eligibility for sitting in the placement is to have a minimum CGPA of 7, and you have to have a score above 65% in your 10th and 12th grades. The highest package is 16 LPA, and the average is around 4-6 LPA. Top recruiters include Deloitte, Empower, NielsenIQ, and many other top MNCs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the classrooms are air-conditioned and smart classrooms, with projectors and speakers, and arch classrooms with rolling chairs. Every room is equipped with Wi-Fi facilities. All the hostel rooms are highly maintained, and AC and non-AC rooms are available. All the rooms in the hostel have Wi-Fi connectivity. You have different types of mess options like veg, non-veg, and special.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the teachers at VIT are Ph.D. scholars and also professional industry personnel. All the faculty are very supportive of the career and friendly. The curriculum is up to date and approved by UGC. All the current skills the industry expects are provided to the students from time to time. The college conducts 3 main exams per semester, and the exams are moderate to difficult. Teachers will equip us to attend the exams and achieve very good marks.
detailed_review.Other: As starting a career in business administration is related to doing an MBA, and an MBA will cost around 15-20 lakhs, spending less on a BBA will be a very good option. A university like VIT has a brand value and face value. The college life in VIT is very vibrant, and there are many cultural fests happening frequently on the campus.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Bioinformatics)
reviews.review_title: Vellore Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: In VIT Vellore, in our course, which has a high demand, more members are interested in joining this course. I got placed in Techmojo with an 11 LPA. The highest package of our course is 88 LPA, and the lowest is 9 LPA. More than 85% members are placed in our course, top recruiting companies are Zomoto, Phone Pay, Google, and Amazon.

Every floor contains a speed Wi-Fi network, and classrooms are clean and neat, with well-maintained food in hostel that is healthy and of good taste.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our faculty members are highly talented and have good teaching skills. They are student-friendly, explanations are good, and all teachers are qualified and knowledgeable. This course curriculum is relevant, and it makes the students industry-ready. Semesters are tough to get good marks in.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College facilities need to be improved due to the overflow of college crowd.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 75-80% of the students are placed in my particular course in the previous year. The highest package is around 85 to 90 LPA, and the average is honestly about 8.9 LPA. The lowest package was between 3.5 to 3.9 LPA, which includes many service IT companies such as TCS, HCL, Wipro, Infosys, Capgemini, Cognizant, etc. Around 62-65% of the students got internships from many major companies like TCS, HCL, and Infosys. The roles offered are data analyst, software developer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure need to be improved, while the hostel rooms and the food in the mess are quite bad. They have to increase the quality of food, and the facilities are also not up to the mark compared to the high fees they are charging us.
detailed_review.Faculty: In most cases, there is little use of the teachers. The teachers are knowledgeable and qualified, and their teaching is also good. The course curriculum is a bit clumsy and might be confusing for freshers to adapt to these conditions. The semester exams are pretty decent, the papers are set based on the students so that they can answer at least 4-5 questions.
detailed_review.Other: I had a bit of interest in the fields of IT and software, so that’s why I chose this course. The course curriculum needs to be improved much better. The college organizes fests and events on a regular basis. The campus road is a big problem because the intake is growing each year, which is a bit concerning. They also offer many scholarships which might be useful.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is the best and most lovely college for education.

detailed_review.Placements: The Tata group will hire a higher number of people, and 99% of students got placed in my course. The internship opportunities will be provided by external companies. I don't know all the companies, but major ones like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Flipkart, and Mahindra will be visiting, and prominent companies can be seen at our college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities are very good, and the infrastructure is amazing. Wi-Fi will be available only in hostels for 18 hours. Labs are good, and the library is the biggest attraction of my college. The food is good, and you can expect good facilities overall. There is a hospital on campus, but it is quite expensive.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching quality is okay, but you have to study more. The pass percentage depends on the faculty. There is an option to choose your faculty. The semester exams are divided into three parts: CAT 1, CAT 2, and final. CAT 1 and 2 are like midterms, while the final is like the semester exam.
detailed_review.Other: This course is the best and most trending. It will be useful in the future. It has already improved significantly. Events are not bad, but once a year, the biggest fest takes place, which is awesome.

reviews.review_title: It is absolutely the best university in India with a QS ranking of 21 (Southern Asia).

detailed_review.Placements: Placements for students in the agriculture department are comparatively less. The highest package is 5 LPA. Internship offers provided by our department are very useful as all of us did internships in national institutes, fertilizer companies, startups, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities on the Vellore campus are extraordinary. It provides Wi-Fi, multiple mess facilities, a 24-hour ambulance facility, and a hospital inside the campus. Students are encouraged and trained to participate in national and international sports and competitions.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-experienced and are from various states. VIT has an open-book test too which helps students to score marks before their final test. VIT provides a student with an abroad program where students can complete their one semester in any university abroad.
detailed_review.Other: VIT offers courses and programs and has ICAR accreditation too. Agriculture is one best options to choose from because they cultivate various crops. It also has a livestock, poultry unit, mushroom unit, botanical garden, and vermicompost unit where classes happen in fields and in the unit.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied beacuse of infrastructure is good, placement is avg.

detailed_review.Placements: Our claims to have 100% placements but I think this time about 90% have been placed. The highest package is 24 LPA and the lowest is 8 LPA. Nvidea and Seimens are the top companies for our course. For the internship, I don't have much idea. HR and management are the top roles offered in my course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for your course/department are very good. Wi-Fi quality is decent about 2 Mbps speed. Classrooms are good which is non-AC. The library is excellent but crowded. Food quality is good. They have a night mess. Medical facilities are also good. For sports, they have all types of facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful. All teachers are well-qualified. Some teachers graduated from IITs, so there is no doubt about the teachers. Course curriculum is well and good, well-structured, and it makes students industry-ready. On a scale of 1 to 10, I would rate 7 as the difficulty level of the semester exam. Pass percentage is 50%.
detailed_review.Other: I aimed to choose CS but I got ECE but that is also fine. According to me, they should improve their teaching style. Events and fest are good. They provide scholarships and they also conduct extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with faculty members and infrastructure. Good placements in 2023.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently doing my 3rd year in integrated M.Tech in software engineering at VIT. Since we are still in 3rd year, our batch hasn't gone through the placement experience yet. But I can provide the details of our seniors. Approximately 80 to 90% of students got placed. The highest package is 40 LPA - 50 LPA. The average package is 8 LPA - 10 LPA, and the lowest salary is 4 LPA - 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Amazon, PayPal, Zoho, Microsoft, TCS, Infosys, and Wipro. 80% of students got internships from our course. Top roles offered are full-stack developer, data analyst, business analyst, and software development engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has a massive library and all academic-related books can be seen there. Classrooms have a capacity of 70 students per room. Campus size is that I heard a part of Vellore is VIT that is huge. Labs, seminar hall, auditorium, conference hall, everything is there and each is of its kind. Medical emergency center is also there with an ambulance and doctors for every block. Securities are there every 50 meters. My institute has many hostel blocks and mess quality is very good. Being a day scholar, I do not have experience with hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are from all around the world. Many Ph.D. students have also become faculty members here. Teaching method varies based on faculty like blackboard, PPTs, group discussion, seminars for students, etc. Our campus may have an approximately 15:1 teacher-student ratio. Faculty members are very much approachable and many faculty members maintain a friendly bond with students, helping a lot with projects and academic-related work. They conduct regular tests and quizzes to enhance student knowledge.
detailed_review.Other: I opted for VIT because of its good industry network, diverse pool of students, and creative curriculum. The flexible credit system and practical knowledge make it stand apart from the rest of the institutes. VIT's dynamic campus life and international exposure through international partnerships make it a good option for our future engineers.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The real experience at VIT Vellore.

detailed_review.Placements: When it comes to placements at VIT Vellore for the 2024-2025 academic year, the highest placement recorded is 1.2 crore. But, not everyone will get a 1 crore package. If you maintain a CGPA of more than 9 and have perfect skills, you can easily expect a decent package. Overall, placements are good, but VIT is overcrowded, and you have to survive on your own in the crowd.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: VIT Vellore has basically having of seven academic blocks with cool infrastructure. PRP, which is one of the academic blocks, is the largest academic block in India. The VIT Vellore hostels offer four types of accommodations AC, Non-AC, Deluxe, and Apartment, and the fee are charged according to the hostel you chose.
detailed_review.Faculty: VIT Vellore provides FFCS Fully Flexible Credit System, where you can select your own class timetable and faculty members. VIT Vellore has basically two schedules one is morning theory theory classes are in the morning, and labs are in the evening, and the second is evening theory theory classes are in the evening, and labs are also in the evening. Students can select according to their wish.
detailed_review.Other: The only thing I regret about VIT is that it is very overcrowded. Remain all aspects, VIT is very good the management of both academics and residential is very good. There are two major fests at VIT GRAVITAS a technical fest and RIVERA a cultural fest. Both are conducted over the course of one week. Many sub-events and hackathons are registered under the main events.

reviews.review_title: I love the college life they provide me with, amazing placements, and entertaining campus facilities

detailed_review.Placements: Around 78% of passed-out students who opted for placements were all placed at excellent companies with great packages. The highest package offered by our college is 1.5 crore, while the lowest stands at 20,000. Most students begin their internships starting in their second year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Each department has its academic building with specialized equipment and labs, all are embedded with campus Wi-Fi. In between all the scenic blocks. We have a medical clinic as well to aid the students with any clinical help needed. We also have canteens and cafeterias in walking distance from the academic blocks.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers and professors are qualified. They are very knowledgeable and available full-time for any queries as such. They give detailed lectures and make sure to make students understand it in depth. They provide us with the necessary materials for preparations as well.
detailed_review.Other: I chose biotechnology as it is one of the growing sectors with wider job opportunities and openings. It gives both hands-on knowledge and work experience.

reviews.review_title: It's good, you will have to put in effort to stand out. Competition is hard and you are not alone.

detailed_review.Placements: In the B. Des, Industrial Design at VIT Vellore, I can't really say what the placements are because there are hardly any. Honesty, it depends on your portfolio and is gradually improving as the course gains more visibility. If you approach a company and have a good portfolio. You can get a 10 LPA - 12 LPA starting package.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are fine. But as there are around more than 40,000 people living in hostels, it's too crowded. Though the facilities are good. Again, because of the traffic (crowd) Wi-Fi is mostly bad in hostels. Labs and classes are well-equipped. We have a lovely library. It won't really bother you. It's good than most of the other college hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are overall very nice. Except for this one professor who is taking 2 of the subjects in my first year, design thinking and methodology, and materials and processes, respectively. Other than that, all the subjects are actually good and helpful. The software, you will have to learn on your own. No college is going to sit and teach you step by step.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about this course is that I get to explore. I am doing this because I wanted to do this, no one forced me and I love this basically. Next is crowd, it is bad and very crowded. But if you can adjust to it, good for you. Also, there are only 2 fests per year, Gravitas (in September) and Riviera (January around).

reviews.review_title: Overall, it is an excellent college for greater opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students that get placements is about 50%. The highest package is 1.2 crore per annum. The percentage of students who got internships is quite decent, and about 80%. The course in this college is good, so most of them get placed in top-rated companies within their course duration.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite nice. Hostel facilities are luxurious. Almost all kinds of sports are available at any time. Students have a nice campus life for 4 years. People find it memorable in this isolated place. The library is peaceful for reference materials.
detailed_review.Faculty: The number of faculty members available is quite high, but students find it difficult to find a suitable one. It depends on the mentality of the student's academic preference. Teachers would help their students at any time. Students feel helpful with this.
detailed_review.Other: The campus is hugely crowded. Events happening here are actually engaging. Students enjoy their free time at almost every spot inside the campus.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: "VIT Vellore - A premier destination for engineering aspirants.''

detailed_review.Placements: On this campus, nearly 75% of students will be placed. Last year the highest package is 80,00,000 and the least is 3,00,000. There are many top companies will visited this campus. This is the top most private university. There is also internships opportunity for the students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is very beautiful and the campus is very large. There are many facilities on the campus like Wi-Fi, a library, AC labs, many shops, etc. The hostel facilities are also really good and there is hot water and a 24-hour Wi-Fi facility also.
detailed_review.Faculty: There are top most senior and experienced teachers. They are very friendly with students. The course curriculum is also well-designed and there are a total of 162 credits are there. Sem exams also moderate difficult papers. The pass percentage in sem is 40 overall is 50.
detailed_review.Other: The campus is very crowded with so many students. I had chosen CSE core by discussing it with my parents some teachers and with my well-wishers. There is a cultural event that is happening in February River and there are many clubs on the campus.

reviews.course: B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)
reviews.review_title: VIT is a place to learn and a chance to grow.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, 10,027 students are placed as per the official website. Those with proper skills and knowledge get placed. Around 632 companies come, which include Consulting, Data Analytics, Automobile, Core, and other companies. Among them, top recruiting companies include Microsoft, Amazon, Cisco, Intel, and Deloitte. There are 3,337 Super Dream offers and 2,862 Dream offers. The university offers rigorous and efficient training for campus placements. The highest CTC offered is around 1 Cr.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for my department is excellent. We have fully air-conditioned labs, classrooms with SMART boards, well-equipped computer labs with the latest configurations, and Wi-Fi all across the campus. The library is huge with digital access to journals, and study areas are well maintained. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms, 24/7 security, and the food quality in the mess varies from decent to good along with multiple cuisine canteens. Medical facilities are available on campus with an emergency ambulance service. Sports facilities include cricket grounds, football fields, a swimming pool, a gym, basketball courts, and a multisport court.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is designed to be industry-relevant and highly reliable in the future. All courses have access to high-quality labs that promote practical learning along with theoretical learning. Faculty members are mostly well-versed in their subjects except for a few, and most of them are willing to help beyond class. Students are prepared with not only technical skills but also with foreign languages, non-core subjects, and soft skills, which are highly relevant and helpful. Semester exams are mostly moderate and can be cracked with a decent amount of preparation.
detailed_review.Other: The surge of game-changing action involving AI in almost every field leads me to pursue my current course at VIT. I am surprised by the number of technical workshops covering multiple domains and fields being hosted every day by clubs and chapters. Riviera and Gravitas are the main fests of our college; other than these, many events and fests are also organized. The campus is very huge, and all academic and hostel blocks are big enough to accommodate students sufficiently. The crowd is very high. This college also provides multiple opportunities to participate in extracurricular activities of many kinds.

faqs.question: Is MBA available at VIT Vellore?
