sections.heading: Introduction
text: VIT Vellore is one of the prestigious institution in India that aim to provide quality higher education on par with international standards. It persistently seeks and adopts innovative methods to improve the quality of higher education on a consistent basis. The campus has a cosmopolitan atmosphere with students from all corners of the globe. Experienced and learned teachers are strongly encouraged to nurture the students. The global standards set at VIT in the field of teaching and research spur us on in our relentless pursuit of excellence.

Spread across a vast area of 372 acres, VIT Campus is a state-of-the-art infrastructure for both students and faculty. VIT Vellore campus has fully furnished and well-equipped labs. Moreover, the campus is fortified with plenty of features that support events, an auditorium, plus open spaces, outdoor stages and more. A notable feature of VIT is the well-planned and comprehensive premises provided for both students and faculty. Seven academic blocks in VIT are extremely specialised in their particular field. The layout has been excellently planned to make the optimum utilisation of the 372-acre campus. Read on to learn more about the VIT Vellore campus, hostel, student life, and more.

sections.heading: VIT Vellore Infrastructure Highlights
text: A striking feature of VIT is the well-planned and comprehensive premises provided for both students and faculty. There are seven academic blocks in VIT which are extremely specialised in their particular field, namely- MB , GDN , CDMM , SMV , CBMR , TT , SJT and GANDHI BLOCK . The layout has been excellently planned to make the maximum utilisation of the 372-acre campus. The idea behind these separate blocks is to make every block equipped with the necessary amenities whilst providing the perfect atmosphere for both studies and research.

VIT Vellore is a home away from home; the hostels of VIT are designed to provide comfortable and safe living. The campus has 24 hostels , out of which 18 blocks are designated for boys and the rest are for girls. The block in total caters to over 22,000 residents every year.

paragraphs: Each year, Vellore Institute of Technology offers scholarships in the form of tuition waivers and freeships. While merit scholarships are awarded to class toppers, economically challenged students are provided need-based financial assistance. Furthermore, NRI and foreign students are given scholarships upon presenting meritorious records. Students from rural backgrounds who secure top ranks in VITEEE at the district level (in Tamil Nadu only) are given free education.

Students who wish to pursue MTech are also given scholarships, given that they score well in the GATE exam. In addition, scholarships are given to students who excel in sports and games. Financial assistance is also provided to students who wish to do their project work in partner universities and institutions abroad, under the Semester Abroad Programme (SAP). In order to encourage the students to pursue active research, VIT also awards appropriate research associateships to meritorious and needy students.

NIT Surathkal Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: The course is very unique and offers good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, HSBC, Wells Fargo, Arcesium, L&T, Amazon, and ExxonMobil were among the firms that visited. IT/Software firms paid an average of 14 LPA, with the maximum compensation being about 50 LPA. Many PSUs paid approximately 16 LPA for core roles. The management was also very supportive in providing placement training.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In the hostel, all facilities were provided in the rooms. The rooms were spacious. First- and second-year students shared rooms with 2 or 3 people, and later they got single rooms. All types of sports like basketball, volleyball, cricket, badminton, swimming, and powerlifting were available. There were also many cultural and technical clubs, which won cups and prizes in competitions. The classrooms were spacious, with charging points and Wi-Fi connections throughout the campus. Classrooms had proper smart boards, and some even had ACs.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members were good. They were highly educated and experienced. They had all completed their post-graduation. The course content was fantastic. Faculty was highly adaptable to the changing environment and incredibly knowledgeable. Some of the work created by NITK academics was used in colleges throughout Karnataka and India. I found a plethora of practical topics here from the outset and learned a lot.

reviews.review_title: Good college, infrastructure, and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: From the 2nd semester, we are eligible to get internships, so along with many students, we can get PPO. The number of companies visited is all there on the NITK website, but placement is good. In my course, the highest package is 10 LPA, the lowest is 4.5 LPA, and the average is 5 LPA-6 LPA. In my course, around 85-90 percent of students get placed. I wanted a job in a pharmaceutical company.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are top-notch, and all facilities, like projectors and smart boards, are available. The library is good, and all types of books and magazines are available. Hostels are good. There are 2-seated and 3-seated rooms. There are different grounds for different sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty members have good qualifications, but some courses are not relevant to us, so it is very difficult to understand. So we are thinking that the faculty is not good. In my course, two faculty members are good. They always focus on good teaching with industry knowledge, others just come and teach Maths and go.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Surathkal - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: For B.Tech and MCA placements are good. MCA students get an average package of 10-12 LPA. Big companies like Amazon, Flipkart, Microsoft, Infosys, Samsung, and many more visit the campus. Around 250 companies come for MCA placements alone. Overall good placement experience here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels have facilities like Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. The classrooms are air-conditioned, and the central library is well-equipped for borrowing books. The mess food is average, but there are three canteens serving really tasty fast food. There is also a small sports field for volleyball, football, and cricket.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers have good experience and qualifications. They mainly support students preparing for placements. Many subjects focus on the financial sector, especially accounting and auditing. Overall, the staff is capable and usually delivers good results.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Surathkal College.

detailed_review.Placements: Roughly 85 percent of students got placed, with about 6% opted for masters programs. The highest salary package reached 64 LPA, while the lowest was 6 LPA. Big names like Amazon, AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Qualcomm, Nvidia, DE Shaw, Goldman Sachs, and Morgan Stanley were all on the list of recruiters.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Now, our course definitely benefits from some great facilities and infrastructure. The campus had a central library, Wi-Fi access, and digital classrooms, which was nice. The hostel accommodation was quite good, and the meals were pretty tasty, whether you were eating at the mess or the canteen. Don't forget the multi-sports complex!
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers here had solid experience and good qualifications. The ones who got the most support, definitely the students aiming for job placements. The subjects were mostly entered around the financial sector, especially in areas like accounting and auditing. Overall, the staff seems pretty capable and tends to achieve great results.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: National Institute of Technology, Suratkal

detailed_review.Placements: 95% of students are placed in my course in my college. The highest package is 80 LPA offered in my course, the average package is 30 LPA, offered in my course, and the lowest package is 10 LPA offered in my course. 90% of students got internships from my course in my college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is provided and very useful for networking. In labs, AC and projectors are provided. Classrooms are good, and AC and projectors are provided for display. The library is good and provides AC and projectors. Hostel is good, with quality food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very good in teaching. They approach students in a friendly manner. They are very knowledgeable, and teaching is good. In the semester, we have two mid exams and a final exam. The pass percentage of exams is 40%, we need to get 40% marks in the final exam only to pass the entire semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT Surathkal College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: Over 95% of our students land jobs after graduation from our college. This year, the highest salary package from my branch hit around 50 LPA, while the average for core electrical engineering was about 15 LPA. The big names doing the recruiting include Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Nvidia, Tata, TCS, Jio, and a whole bunch more. Its worth noting that nearly all students who applied for internships got one, but those who did not throw their hat in the bring brought the overall internship numbers down a bit.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi was available all across campus, and the hostels have LAN, too. The labs were fully stocked and really good. The library had over 200,000 books on just about every topic you can think of. I would have to say, when it comes to food, I would give it a 2 out of 5. The medical and sports facilities were pretty solid overall. The second year student hostels arena. It was the best, but the others were just fine. The food was decent, too.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers had solid qualifications and extensive teaching experience. Our course fits well within our environment. The semester exams were pretty tough, so getting a good grade requires some serious effort. So, overall, the faculty members were good and approachable.

reviews.review_title: NIT Surathkal College review.

detailed_review.Placements: In the mechanical engineering department, it was impressive. Over half, and sometimes even up to 80% of students, land jobs every year. Some of the big players that came looking for fresh talent include GAIL, HPCL, BPCL, BHEL, and MRPL, just to name a few. We had graduates snagging positions at dream companies like Reliance, Tata, Samsung, and Bajaj, too. Internships, companies like Caterpillar, JSW Steel, and Rather Energy were regulars around here. It was a great time to be part of this field.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus includes all the essential academic and research buildings, a central library, well equipped labs, and classrooms with Wi-Fi. Students could use residential facilities and dining halls. The hostel accommodation was generally seen as satisfactory. The food in the mess was just average. It was a health center with medical professionals available, in case someone got sick.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching staff was made up of qualified individuals with a solid grasp of their subjects. They get creative with their methods, which keeps students engaged. They often used storytelling and discussions to explain concepts. The curriculum was spot on, and students who were well versed in the material usually ace their exams.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely a good college in order to learn, with better infrastructure and good placements in 2026.

detailed_review.Placements: In civil engineering, we have 70% placed in different companies, and rest are for higher studies like M.Tech, MBA, M.Sc. Our college placement cell, CDC, has been doing great work for past 3-4 years. Highest package is 22 LPA, and the lowest is 4.5 LPA. Top recruiting company is BPCL. 30% of students got internships, and top roles are associate engineering and supply chain.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure in our college has been developing over last 4 years. We got new hostels this year, and last year they inaugurated a new lecture hall. Wi-Fi is pretty good, and labs are maintained and equipped with the latest machines. Classroom has good ventilation and proper spacing, with a smart board also. We also have 2 libraries, one of which is 24hrs open. Food quality in mess is normal, and canteen has good food also. We have a medical centre, also with all types of doctors available. We have many grounds in college for sports, such as indoor and outdoor as well.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable and qualified. Teaching quality is also modernized, like they teach on a smart board and also on a blackboard. For my branch of civil Engineering, the course curriculum is enough to be qualified as a civil engineer. Semester exams are of a moderate to hard level. Pass percentage is like 90%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the Civil Engineering course from JoSAA counseling through JEE main exam. Best things in civil engineering course are labs and practical training. Everything is fine with my course. Civil Engineering connection is with many other colleges, and they also conduct many events in college just to discuss and prepare necessary improvements for civil Engineering sector.

reviews.review_title: NIT Surathkal College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all of the students who signed up for our course got placed, except a few who wanted to go for higher studies. The highest package is 48 LPA, and the average is around 10 LPA. Moreover, around 80% of students received internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, with good facilities for sports and academics. LAN ports are available for connection to the public Ethernet, which is unlimited. Various events are well-organized on our campus, and different clubs provide different opportunities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified with great experience. The teaching quality is Excellent. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry ready. Semester exams are neither easy as well as not too difficult. The pass percentage is 50% of the class average marks.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Surathkal - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: All I want to say about placements is that mechanical students tend to get selected more into non-core, management, and other sectors than into core mechanical roles. So, yes, the placements look good on paper, but you need to realize there aren't many jobs available, and even if there are, they don't pay well.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are pretty decent. The first-year boys' hostel is basic, but after that, the second-year Shivalik hostel is basically a hotel. The third and fourth-year single rooms are excellent. I think you won't be disappointed with them. They are better than most government colleges, though they have some issues too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The college offers a basic engineering education. It's the same as every other college, with nothing new an old curriculum that's recycled repeatedly. The teachers try to teach, but their assistants (TAs) often outperform them in teaching quality. It's pretty standard. Like every other college, there's nothing particularly innovative.

reviews.review_title: Great campus life with good placement and private rooms, a place like heaven for engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements here are good. From 2019-2023, there was almost 99% placement in the IT department, and in 2024, about 91% students were placed in the IT department. The highest salary varies from 55 LPA-62 LPA, the average was about 24 LPA, and the median was about 21 LPA. Companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, Morgan Stanley, Dell, etc., are major recruiters. Most of the roles offered are developer. Around 30%-40% of students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are enough buildings for classrooms. Wi-Fi is available throughout campus through captive portal login. Two libraries with air conditioners are available. There are 3 grounds. Two sports complexes are too good. 12 boys' hostels and 5 girls' hostels are available. Mess food is decent. We get both vegetarian and non-vegetarian mess. 3-night canteens are available, which serve midnight. There is a food court too. We also get a private one. Campus has a good connection to road (NH66), which runs between the campus, splitting it in two. There are guest houses available. Overall, very good infrastructure.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are well-qualified. The teaching is not that good I would say. Curriculum is relevant to the existing trend, and also makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are decent, not too hard or easy. Pass percentage varies from 20% marks to 30% marks. There is a grading system in NIT Surathkal. Semester can be balanced with other activities.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course out of my interest in the IT field. The best thing is that it's a chill branch and provides all the CSE courses for a slightly lower cutoff. Placements are top-notch. Some professors don't take classes properly and don't give deserving marks. This could be improved. Incidentally, our cultural fest is India's second-biggest fest. Engineer is our technical fest. All the fest events are too good to experience. There are also other events. Many scholarships are provided by institutions as well as private organizations. Scope is given for extracurricular activities like dance, music, art, etc.

reviews.review_title: It is a awesome college.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students got placed in my college is approximately 97%. The highest package is 52 LPA, the lowest package is 6 LPA, and the average package is 15 LPA-18 LPA. The recruiting companies are too good, and they can achieve bigger and bigger choices.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Scenic & well-equipped A 295-acre beachside campus featuring private access, lush green zones, and world-class sports facilities including swimming pool, tennis courts, gyms, and stadium. Everything is good, having this kind of college is okay. Mess food is decent.
detailed_review.Faculty: NITK Surathkal is one of India's premier engineering institutions, particularly strong in core and technical branches due to its excellent faculty, research environment, natural campus, and placement success, if you're up for a slightly high. Faculty of AI isn't that good, most we have to do is self-study.
detailed_review.Other: There are no academic or cultural restrictions.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College has all the required things for students in all terms.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement is always above 90% among the eligible students. Top companies like Microsoft, Adobe, and Oracle. It depends on the student's choice and their exploration in getting internships and top roles in any company. Students' abilities can drive them to get internships from outside also.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is a little issue sometimes we get some suffering, but mostly we don't face it. It is not a big thing to be concerned about everywhere it's common. Everything is fine but sometimes there is an issue of food poisoning and all. We have good medical facilities and have an HCC inside the college open 24 hours.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and very friendly in teaching. Every course is useful for us and makes us better. Pass percentage is above 85%. Students abilities are tested in exams so it is important that every student has to be legit and cross that minimum mark. In many cases, malpractice is the reason for their failures so it's all the students' fault in this type of situation. But some lectures don't give marks though we are eligible sometimes it's really hard.
detailed_review.Other: CSE is always a great course for those who have an interest in coding and that driven me to choose this option. Better ways of teaching the basics more carefully. All the activities are good. But if the budget is more than I guess that you will be more productive and useful for us in all terms.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure with excellent sports facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 70% of the students got placed. The average package is 19 LPA while the highest is 52 LPA. For my course ECE, Qualcomm and Texas Instruments are major recruiters. Hardware engineer and analyst roles are offered. I am not very aware of the internships and all but placement wise it is good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We cannot use Wi-Fi in our hostel but we have LAN facility in our rooms. Hostel facilities are good while mess food is not that good. Sports facilities are amazing, especially cricket. We have cricket kit, nets, etc. There is a health care center within the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly knowledgeable and they teach well. Semester exams can be cleared by studying a night before the exam. As far as I heard from the seniors, the course is relevant and makes students industry-ready. Teachers are friendly and they are keen to share their knowledge.
detailed_review.Other: I heard from a lot of people that NITK is one of the top institutes, and ECE branch at NITK has good demand. Events will depend on the people you have selected in the student council selection. Government gives scholarships to people whose income is below 1 lakh.

reviews.review_title: Good faculty members and infrastructure, near to sea, and have beach also.

detailed_review.Placements: In my branch IT, more than 95% of students got placed. We have courses in every domain of IT sector, so students can choose which fits and is good for them.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have few decent hostels and few good hostels. It has very good classrooms and few very good labs, libraries with AC and non-AC rooms, large number of books, and sufficient timings. We have Wi-Fi all over the campus, even on ground also, and in rooms we have Wi-Fi LAN ports also. We have very good labs, high-speed internet everywhere.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have very good and experienced faculty members who are doing some research in their respective fields. They will be available most of the time physically, and we can contact them anytime by mail, etc. Exams are also in a very well-planned manner. Each year, we have very decent faculty members.
detailed_review.Other: We have 2 very big events, engineer and incident. Incident is the second-largest fest in South India. Those 2 will be around 3 and 4 days each.

reviews.review_title: It is best college for engineers.

detailed_review.Placements: Percentage of students placed is 30/43 (70) on campus, around 10 in GATE, and rest in further studies. Top recruiting companies are Vedanta, JSW, Chettinad Cement, Ramco Cement, and Aditya Birla Group. Top roles offered are graduate management trainee, analyst, and design engineer. The highest package is 36 LPA. The lowest package is 6 LPA. The average salary is 13 LPA. Internship is only 1, he is our class average student, and not a topper.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure wise NITK is best. It has good hostels. Nice way to live and enjoy student college life. Wi-Fi connectivity is also good and no issues. Moreover, library has nice way to read and makes it a decent learning environment. Quality of hostels and mess is upto the mark and not an issue at all. We all have to just slightly adjust to the taste of the food and not the quality. Good medical facilities are provided. Sports facilities are good. There is a great culture for students to live and enjoy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors in mining engineering are highly qualified and have more knowledge in practical terms. Thus they always welcome any kind of event conducting or organizing workshops. Course curriculum is slightly older version and thus needs to be modified. Luckily, the course curriculum is now modified by 2025. Semester exams are not that difficult, and a week before the exam is sufficient.
detailed_review.Other: NITK was my choice it was my go to college because I loved the place. I belong to the same place and I love the nature around and so it is upto my expectations. Best thing about my course is my friends, well to be precise the most suitable reason would be the home-like department and the professors who support me. Improvement is just that lab should be maintained a little more upto newer generation. Regarding the connectivity, crowd, campus, surroundings, scholarships, and extracurricular activities, I would just say that its awesome.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is the best way to live a life and life in NITK.

detailed_review.Placements: We have an electrical and electronics engineering branch in NITK which is one of the first branches in our institute. Around 80% of students get placed on campus every year and this year it is not an exception. The highest package is 44 LPA and the lowest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 18 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course include Texas Instruments, ARM, Bajaj, Sony, Samsung, Philips, etc. A majority of students get placed as embedded engineers, graduate engineers, and trainees. Around 30% of students got internships and are majorly in analyst roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure-wise, it is very good. We have sophisticated labs, a well-deserved learning environment, and classrooms with AC. Availability of Wi-Fi and classrooms are also present in it. The library is also in good condition with more books. Sports and games are also given good priority and thus are more entertaining.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly responsible, intellectually brilliant, and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is relevant and has no gist in it. Semester exams are difficult and require around a week of preparation for it. The pass percentage is 20%.
detailed_review.Other: I wanted to become an electrical engineer from early on and I got 10,000 rank in JEE so I took EEE in NITK. The best thing in the course is that we have more projects that are practically more related. Things which can improve about our course are that labs are way more hectic in a course having 5 to 6 credits. Events are way good. The campus crowd is also nicely populated. Extracurricular activities are always conducted here.

reviews.review_title: You will have a pretty good memories in 4 years. Placement in civil is not appreciable.

detailed_review.Placements: Our placement is yet to begin. As far as we know from our senior batch, the placement percentage of civil is one of the lowest of all the branches. Most roles offered are managerial ones. An average package of 8 LPA is offered, as far as I remember it properly.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Most of our civil department labs are good, especially the Hydraulics Laboratory. Our classroom is still old-fashioned. There are old, typical wooden benches. There have been new rooms, but we hardly get to have class in that one. Wi-Fi facilities have been removed recently in hostels, and we are using LAN connections. I have hardly accessed the library, so I can't comment more on that. But we have 2-3 libraries with good facilities and accommodation for students and teachers. Mess food is average in most cases. Medical facilities are good, and they operate fast in emergencies.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers are well-qualified. Some courses I feel like are outdated (like geology lab, drawing) unless you pursue a Ph.D. Some courses are relevant for the coming years. Curriculum doesn't make students industry-ready. Semester exams are good. The pass percentage is above 90% in most of the courses.
detailed_review.Other: I didn't choose this course rather, I got it by chance. The course should be changed a lot to make it even interesting and helpful towards the industry. Events and fests are very good. Extracurricular activities take place frequently. The campus surroundings are very good.

reviews.review_title: It has a world-class infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 100% of students get placed in our course. The package offered in our course ranges from 10-12 LPA mostly. The highest package is 32 LPA in our course. The top recruiting companies that visited our college are Larsen & Toubro, GMR Infrastructure, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely awesome. A Wi-Fi facility is present on the whole campus. A huge library is available in the college for studying. The quality of facilities available in the hostel is good like fresh drinking water, clean washrooms, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their own field of education. The teaching quality of our faculty members is extremely great. The course curriculum is relevant. Students become ready to work in real industry. Semester examinations are a little hard.

reviews.review_title: It is a good college for learning. The college has a low fee and a very passionate crowd.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed in the senior batch is around 80%. The top recruiting companies include Vedanta, JSW, and various government PSUs through the GATE exam. The roles offered are primarily as graduate engineer trainees (GET). They focus on managing mine operations. The highest package offered is 16 lakh per annum, the average package is 9 LPA and the lowest is 5 LPA. The internship offers you get in the mining sector are less than 10%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department is fully equipped with a Wi-Fi facility. There are 4 different labs for the mining core (ventilation lab, rock mechanics lab, and mine design laboratory). The food options are pretty mid so you have to compromise on it. The medical facilities and other sports facilities are present.
detailed_review.Faculty: The academic teachers are good and helpful. All are Ph.D. graduates from IITs. They are knowledgeable. Course curriculum is outdated for mining we had a meet this year the management has planned to change the syllabus in future batches. Semester exams are easy the pass percentage is around 90.
detailed_review.Other: I did not choose the course due to the brand value of NITK. I chose mining because the course should have present-day technology used in the mining sector. There are many events and engi are the main events. The college has good connectivity and can get a scholarship through SSP and NSP portals.

faqs.question: What is the admission procedure for the BTech programme at NIT Surathkal?
faqs.answer: Admission to the BTech programme at NITK Surathkal is done basis of JEE Main score and JoSAA Counselling. If the seats are left vacant after JoSAA counselling, then the seats are filled out through CSAB counselling. Apart from this, applicants must meet the minimum eligibility as well, which is at least 75% in Class 12 or an equivalent examination.

faqs.question: What is the opening and closing rank for BTech in Computational & Data Science at NIT Surathkal?

Applicants are advised to confirm what category are they applying while checking for cut offs.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for M.Tech course admission at NIT Surathkal?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission are required to apply for the GATE exam to pursue M.Tech from NIT Surathkal. The aspirants with a valid GATE score become eligible to take part in CCMT Counselling . Further, admission is granted based on scores in the national-level exam, counselling, and cutoff marks.

faqs.question: How to get into NIT Surathkal for MTech?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission shall apply for GATE through the COAPS portal and take the entrance exam. Candidates with a Bachelor’s or an equivalent degree in an appropriate branch of Engineering of a minimum four-year duration with 60% aggregate (55% for SC/ST/PwD) can apply. The students shortlisted based on GATE score are further required to appear for CCMT counselling following which the seat allotment is carried out.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for M.Tech course at NIT Surathkal?
faqs.answer: The eligibility criteria for MTech course at the NIT Surathkal is that candidate should have passed BTech with a minimum of 60% aggregate from a recognised university. Aspirant should have the degree and mark sheets (original/copies) at the time of form filling and admission confirmation. The selection process include GATE + CCMT Counselling .

faqs.question: Does NIT Surathkal have MBA?
faqs.answer: NIT Karnataka offers a two-year MBA course. The mode of education is full-time. Admission to the PG Management course is entrance-based. The total seat intake for the course is 64. Before filling out the admission form, candidates must ensure that they fulfil the eligibility criteria which is Graduation with 50% aggregate.

faqs.question: What is the total tuition fee for MBA programme at NIT Surathkal?

faqs.question: How to get seat in NIT Surathkal for MCA?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the MCA course must first check the eligibility criteria, which is BCA/BSc Hons/BSc degree. Eligible candidates can further apply by filling out the application online through the NITK website (nitk.ac.in). Admission to the course is further based on merit in NIMCET and academic records.

faqs.question: What is the duration of MCA in NIT Surathkal?
faqs.answer: The technology institute offers a three-year full-time MCA course. The three-year duration of the course is divided into six semesters of six months each. Admission to the PG course is entrance-based.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for NIT Surathkal MCA course?
faqs.answer: The aspirants with a BCA/BSc Hons/BSc with Mathematics and Statistics subjects with 60% aggregate (55% aggregate for reserved category) can take admission to the MCA course in NITK . Jadavpur University, also kown as JU, is a state-level public university of Kolkata, West Bengal formed in 1955. The university is approved by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), and is accredited with an 'A+' grade by the NAAC. Jadavpur University is also a member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU).
Jadavpur University Kolkata has been ranked in NIRF 2025 Rankings across multiple categories. It has been ranked 1, 9, and 18 in the 'State Public University', 'University', and 'Overall' categories, respectively. The university has 2 campuses, the Jadavpur campus sprawls over 56 acres, and the Salt Lake campus spawls over 26 acres.
Jadavpur University offers several UG, PG, PhD, certificate, and diploma courses across streams such as management, engineering, science, humanities, commerce, pharmacy, architecture, education, etc. Majority of the courses at Jadavpur University are accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA). reviews.review_title: Jadavpur University has a legacy of more than a century.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in the department are among the best in the state and region after IIT KGP. Usually, the average placement percentage for interested students stays above 85–90%, which is good considering this is a core department. The average package in recent years is around 7–11 LPA and varies greatly depending on peer quality. Core packages include most chemical engineering core companies like Vedanta, pharmaceutical companies, Exide, and others, along with PSUs and various other firms. On average, core packages are around 6–9 LPA. Some companies offer 12+ LPA, and PSU salaries are higher. Non-core packages are around 10–14 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department is well-equipped with all kinds of labs and necessary teaching resources. As I am not very familiar with the facilities offered by IITs and NITs, I would rate mine as 4/5. This department was the first in Asia and receives a lot of funds and grants from alumni and organizations. You will learn a lot if you join JU Chemical. About the hostels, UG1 hostels are well-maintained and good. Wi-Fi is available, and rooms are big enough for 2–3 people. As I am not a hosteller, this is all I can share.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are a mixed bag. Some are fantastic, some are okay, and some are not very good. They are all highly qualified in their fields, with degrees from IITs, foreign universities, and most are Ph.D. holders with published research work. The course curriculum is almost as good as that of the older IITs, and I can vouch for that. You will gain the required knowledge and industry exposure when you actually work in the field. Semester exams can be rated as moderately difficult to difficult in some cases, which is very subjective.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this because it was my best option for my rank (GMR-1379, General) and because I was flexible about the course, it does not bother me. I am genuinely interested in learning chemical engineering. About the fests and campus life, it is probably one of the best in the region and certainly in the state. The culture is very vibrant, and many events take place regularly around the campus. As long as you keep working hard, you can enjoy life here, land a good job, and get into quality research according to your calibre. JU is a very good university.

reviews.review_title: Review of J.D Birla Institute (JDBI).

detailed_review.Placements: I’m just a fresher in my college, so I really don’t know about the placements, but I’ve heard the placements are pretty good and the internship process is very detailed. It’s made compulsory for us to have an internship in the third year of college, and it’s a part of the course itself.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have good classrooms, a canteen, labs, a library, and even the college is undergoing renovation, providing us with greater facilities and a more comfortable infrastructure. We have AC classrooms and comfortable seating arrangements. The canteen food is good, and the library has a vast range of books with borrowing facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is really good in my college, with the detailed academic calendar being provided beforehand, and the faculty is really helpful with everything. What we need, what we want, and our issues are heard here. The semester exams are a mix of everything, being easy to difficult, making it a good exam for all types of students. The exam papers are exactly like what we’re prepared for.
detailed_review.Other:
I chose B.Com as a course and specifically in JDBI because it? S a well known college and it? S been ranked in a good position
I want to pursue a professional degree and B.Com course here in this college provides flexible timings being a morning batch making it very easy for students like us .

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College with the best return on investment.

detailed_review.Placements: The exact details for placement drive for 2025 batch are yet to be released. For 2024, the median and average were near 20 LPA, with almost every top company coming for on-campus placement. This year (2025), the placement drive has been immensely successful. Placement percentage is over 90%, with the highest package being as high as 1.4 crore offered by Rubrik. Top companies like Google, Oracle, Sprinklr, and DE Shaw offered full-time roles. Many banking companies like Wells Fargo, ICICI Bank, and Deutsche also visit the campus for full-time roles. On-campus internship drive also takes place.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Being a state university, the institute is heavily underfunded. As a result, the infrastructure is not upto the mark in comparison to IITs and NITs. Though a good amount of research does take place. Hostel specifically is not of great quality, but that is justified by its ultra-cheap rent of Rs 30 per month.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well qualified. Some of them have multiple PhDs. Teaching quality is fair enough, though it varies from teacher to teacher. The course curriculum is restructured starting from the 2025-2029 batch to meet the industry standards and make it relevant. The questions in semester exams are easier in comparison to IITs, but are much lengthier. Exams are of 100 marks with a time limit of 3 hours.
detailed_review.Other: Events are great and something or the other is always happening around on the campus with so many clubs and societies. Being a university, Arts and Science faculty students are also present thus diversifying the crowd.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall, a great college with the best return on investment, one can get with good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 90% of the students are placed this year. The highest package is 1.4 crores offered by Rubrik, and several other high packages are offered by companies like DE & Shaw and Google. Internships secured are also good, with a major percentage of the students being placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are well-maintained and have the necessary facilities for the course. From 2025 onwards, a new syllabus is being introduced which removes irrelevant courses in the first year that have been a part of the course for many years, replacing them with necessary subjects.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are highly qualified, with most of them having high research indices indicating their great knowledge. Most of them have completed their PhDs and postdocs from reputed colleges. The course's new curriculum is highly relevant and makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams are not an ordeal if one pays attention to the classes when they are being taught.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a very good college. It is the best state university in India.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are very good. Top companies come every year. The highest package offered is 1.5 LPA this year, and the median salary for CSE is near 20 LPA. Companies like Google and Frank come every year and hire like 3 to 4 students from our department.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department coordinated well with the students. There is Wi-Fi available. Library is one of the biggest in the whole West Bengal. The campus is very big, and has 6 canteens where food of every range is available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very helpful and highly qualified. There are exams occuring throughout the whole semester, so students won't face much difficulty in giving exams at the end. They get prepared after giving the class tests for each subject. The course curriculum is well-received by students.

reviews.review_title: The college has very good infrastructure and resources.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the 2022-2024 batch. 60% of students are placed, and the highest package is Rs. 50,000, and the lowest package is Rs. 10,000. Placements are mostly in the government and private teaching sectors. Around 50% of students get jobs from internships in schools and colleges. The top role offered by our course focuses on good teaching ability.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure of our department are very good. The whole department and campus have free Wi-Fi. Classrooms, library, and computer labs are also very modern. Hostel facilities are very good, with rooms for study, food services, and a canteen available. Every sports instrument is available, with a good playground.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our department has very good and helpful teachers. The teaching quality is very scientific. The curriculum is also very good because our curriculum is developed by our own department teacher. Semester exams are very easy, and the passing marks are only 35%.
detailed_review.Other: My Course is M.A. in Education, and it is the best department in the whole of West Bengal. It is a multidisciplinary course, which is why I chose it. Jadavpur University has a very good campus with a good environment, playground, and OAT. The placement percentage is very good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Food Technology and Biochemical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Jadavpur University food technology course summary and college life idea.

detailed_review.Placements: About 60% of students got placed in core companies. The highest package is 14 LPA, the lowest package is 2-3 LPA, and the average is about 5-6 LPA offered in our course. Amul, Winkies, and ITC are the top recruiting companies. A solid 80% students got internship opportunities every year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Free Wi-Fi is available on the whole campus. There are a total of 9 canteens, and each hostel has its own separate cooking area. Table tennis, cricket, and football are the most popular sports. The sports culture and fests are the most lovable part of Jadavpur University.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified. They are helpful. Exams are tough, and lab faculty members are above average. Minimum 60% marks are required for passing the semester. Each department has its own different set of subjects with different faculty members and a different environment.
detailed_review.Other: This course is good, especially for those candidates who like Biology. Biology and Chemistry are the main subjects in this course. Maths and Physics are not that applicable.

reviews.review_title: Good college with good faculty, placements, and affordable education.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good. In the previous year, placements were around 88%. The schedule is too hectic, but also very rewarding and good. I recommend students to take admission in the college. Top recruiting companies that hire students from our course are HSBC, HDFC Bank, etc., banking companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is good. Hostels are clean. The menu is good and cheap. It has clean labs, and toilets are provided. Medical facilities are also provided. The library is very big and good. Many books are present in the library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and helpful. Exams are also very practical and useful for placements. The course curriculum is supported in our college. Professors are very professional and helpful towards students, and good. Semester exams are very tough.

reviews.review_title: Awesome placements, top-notch faculty, and the college with the highest ROI.

detailed_review.Placements: 95-97% of students were placed this year. Top private construction and manufacturing companies like L&T, TCE, Reliance, Godrej, ExxonMobil, Airbus, AFCONS, etc., recruit from our department. PSUs like BPCL, IRCON, Bridge & Roof Co., and EIL recruit on campus directly. Coming to non-core, IT companies are very few that recruit from the civil department (like TCS). In fintech and consultancy roles, ICICI Bank, PwC, ZS, and Polestar recruit every year. The average salary is around 8 LPA, and the median is 7.5-8 LPA. This year (24-25), the highest package given by BPCL (PSU) is around 21 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are non-AC, and college infrastructure is decent. Labs are also decent; only the computer lab has AC. Wi-Fi is available throughout the whole campus. A large central library and a departmental library are available. Hostel is so-so, also about mess food. I live outside campus in a PG. I would say the hostel should not be preferred. There is a large playground on the campus, and also an ATMA SBI bank.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well qualified, having Masters and Ph.D. degrees from IITs, IISc, and foreign universities. The curriculum is well designed, equivalent to the GATE and UPSC ESE syllabus. Exams are very difficult to score; even the student with the highest CTC in placement also gets supplementary.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life I have experienced here is the best. There are organized fests like Sankranti (cultural) and Srijan (techno-management). I chose this college for its low fees and high ROI.

reviews.review_title: A college known for its flagship BBA course.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 70% of students who applied for placements got placed. The average package was around 5 LPA. Companies like Deloitte, Godrej, and EY were among the recruiters. Internships are mandatory for 6 weeks during the final semester. The college assists in getting students placed in their internships, however.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are spacious and equipped with smart boards. The library has a respectable selection of materials that can be accessed both online and offline. There is a canteen inside the building providing vegetarian food only. There are a few indoor games as well as a badminton court.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are great and highly knowledgeable. They will assist students with any issues at any time and are very approachable. The curriculum is relevant enough, and exams are of moderate difficulty, but that's a relatively vague term to use, to be honest. The pass percentage is around 80%.

reviews.review_title: Jadavpur University has got tier-1 rank by NAAC.

detailed_review.Placements: At least 95% of students got placed per year in a Bachelor of Engineering course. The highest package is 1.5 crore per year. The lowest package is 5 LPA. The average package is 10 LPA. Companies like Texas Instruments, Wells Fargo, Oracle, CESC, PwC, HSBC, ICICI Bank, etc., visit the college to recruit students every year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Every department has its own library and Wi-Fi. Each classroom is air-conditioned and contains a projector. Both boys' and girls' hostels (3 each) are available for students coming from far rural areas.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and qualified. Some professors belong to the top 2% of scientists in the world. Their teaching method is beyond raiseable. The course curriculum includes lab and workshop work which help a lot for working in the tech field in the future. Faculty members are very much dedicated to their teaching and care a lot for students.
detailed_review.Other: Only this university in West Bengal provides a bachelor of engineering degree with affordable fees and the highest placement offers, so I chose it. Course curriculum should be more accurate for higher studies entrance examinations like GATE qualifying. There are so many events like cultural (Sanskriti), tech (Srijan), film fest ( Chhayanat), etc.

reviews.review_title: An outstanding course for higher studies.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements generally don’t happen after a Bachelor’s degree. But after a Master’s, several companies come during the final semester. The average placement package lies in the range of 4–6 LPA. Generally, students are recruited into the R&D department. The highest package has even gone up to 12 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms and, most importantly, the labs are well-equipped. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. There is a huge collection of all types of books in both the central and departmental libraries. Hostels are also at their very best. The hostel charge is actually very nominal.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly qualified. They provide valuable insights into the subject in both theory and practical classes. The course structure is well-established and relevant for higher studies. Semester exams are easy to moderate, I would say. The passing percentage is quite high.

reviews.review_title: Amazing return on investment and value for money. Amazing campus life and very good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2025, the placement record was quite good for the chemical engineering department. The highest salary is 34 LPA this year. Above 90% of students who opted for placements got placed in varying fields, mostly in the core sector. And quite good placements in the IT as well as finance sectors. Overall, chemical engineering department is quite a chill department, where you do get the time to develop quite some other skills like coding and all. Also gives you exposure for higher studies abroad.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite good. Labs are maintained. Wi-Fi works quite well. Classrooms are quite clean. Library here is one of the best places. There are 4 canteens with reasonable rates for food present. Sports and games are quite encouraged too.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are quite helpful, friendly, and highly qualified. They teach the curriculum quite well, and the curriculum is quite relevant for the higher studies exams like GATE and all. The exams are moderate to hard, but nothing out of the curriculum, so studying well can secure you good marks.
detailed_review.Other: Our college is quite the value for money, as the return on investment is amazing. Paying almost 10,000 for the whole 4 years, and passing out with a 10 LPA job is quite worth it. Not to mention the amazing and fun campus life at the college. It's quite fun.

reviews.review_title: My pleasurable experience at Jadavpur, 2021-2025.

detailed_review.Placements: In our batch of 44 students, 15 people appear for placements, and to date, 11 of them have get jobs 73%. The highest package offered is around 14 LPA by PwC, and the average package is around 3-6 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Cipla, Zifo, Alteus, Medline, GSK, etc. We have mandatory internships for every student at companies like Cipla, Sun Pharma, Glenmark, etc. The top roles offered include R&D Associate, QA, QC Officer, Assistant Sales Manager, and Product Management, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: My department has Wi-Fi, labs with a specific setup for each student, classrooms with projectors, and a library with AC. Hostels also have high-speed Wi-Fi, and the quality of food is good both in the hostel and in the university canteen. The university has a health center, a separate sports board, and a game room.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are very humble and knowledgeable. They hold Ph.D. degrees, and some of them have post-doctoral qualifications as well. They teach awesome. The course is industry-focused and also makes students to be clinic-ready. The semester exams are not so difficult, and it is possible to pass with good marks if studied well. The pass percentage is 98%.
detailed_review.Other: I find this course exciting as I have exposure to direct medicine development, formulation, and manufacturing. I wish there are more student-focused teachers than average. Jadavpur University is well known for its culturally rich environment, so events, fests, and crowd are awesome. JU also has a scholarship section dedicated to handling the scholarship applications of students.

reviews.review_title: All you need to know before joining Jadavpur University.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2024, about 90% of students got placed in Information Technology. The highest package was offered by Pixel Group of 1.4 crores per annum and the lowest was 3 LPA by TCS Ninja. The average package was 19.12 LPA and the median was 13 LPA (due to recession). Top recruiting companies were Google, Well Fargo, De Shaw, Salesforce, and BNY Mellon. About 20-30% of students get internships in companies like Salesforce, BNY Mellon, etc. Software development engineer role is the most common role offered, besides this assistant member of technical staff, offered by Salesforce.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the classrooms except 1st year have AC and projectors and have enough space to accommodate students. The infrastructure of our college is decent. We have campus Wi-Fi and high-quality laboratories. We have a central library that contains a lot of books and journals. On the Saltlake campus, we have all single-roomed hostels. There is a mess and a hostel canteen that serves North and South Indian food. Hostel seats are very less so maximum students ahead to stay in PG and flats. There is a hostel, Wi-Fi, volleyball, and badminton court inside the hostel. Hostel infrastructure is decent and has enough space.
detailed_review.Faculty: Maximum teachers are highly qualified in their fields and are very helpful. Their teaching quality is also good. They are highly concentrated in their research fields. Course curriculum is industry-relevant, almost every 5 years the course curriculum is changed and it had provided the college with great results. The semester exams are moderately difficult. The pass percentage is 32%.
detailed_review.Other: The placement of our university is very good. Moreover, there is a great scope for extracurricular activities. The fests are above average in our college. The night life is awesome here due to the excellent location of our college. There should be 6 months internship scope on our curriculum that is not present at the moment I am writing this review.

reviews.review_title: Review of Jadavpur University.

detailed_review.Placements: Packages offered for engineering students are top-notch, but for the B.A. students, packages are not quite sure. Internships are best. As far as I know, the highest package in our university is 10 crore per annum. At least 80% of students will get guaranteed internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For the infrastructure, I would rate 7 out of 10. We do have libraries and Wi-Fi. We even have digital libraries and separate departmental libraries.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are held semester-wise. It makes students ready for exams. After the new NEP policy, it has become tough for students to gain great marks but good enough. The highest pass percentage is 8 CGPA. I would recommend students join this university as it is the best at least in my state. Professors are good, but most of them teach in the vernacular, so it might be tough for non-Bengal students.
detailed_review.Other: Jadavpur University is basically free so students who cannot afford tuition can join this university. Fests are held for a month. We have a lot of fests and extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_title: Jadavpur University dream of every aspiring engineer.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement offers are quite good in our college. In my department, the placement percentage of students who opt for placement is 100%. The highest package offered in the last year was 26 LPA where as the average package for mechanical engineering was 8.5 LPA. In my course, our top recruiters are Caterpillar, Airbus, Tata Steel, Mahindra & Mahindra, PwC, Zs-Associate, etc. Internship opportunities are less as compared to the placement scenarios. The internship offers have come from Airbus, PwC, Tata Steel, and some others also.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is average. There is a central library which is good in terms of the availability of books and journals. The Wi-Fi is fine but labs are not as good as per the expectations. Hostel rooms are also average. In each room, there are three students. The quality of food in the mess is bad. Hostel facilities are not so good. However, medical facilities are provided by the university. The sports and games are given priority and there are clubs also for the different games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our faculty members are very qualified and knowledgeable. The relationship between teachers and students is quite good at the university. They teach in PPT mode most of the time, and are always available for help to the meritorious students. The course curriculum is also relevant if we talk about core engineering. The syllabus is very vast making the students industry-ready. Semester exams are moderate, and it is sometimes easy depending on the subjects.
detailed_review.Other: The mechanical engineering of Jadavpur University is quite good if you look at the other private colleges status (including CSE and IT branches also). The course is designed in such a way that the students can crack any competitive engineering exams like GATE, IES, etc. If there were some robotics subjects included it would be more better. The fests are very good and campus life is enjoyable. For different curricular activities there are many clubs also.

reviews.review_title: I am dissatisfied with the administration, especially the controller of the examinations office.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed ranges from 12% to 15% since the placement cell of the English Department, in terms of undergraduate courses, is defunct. Course packages are not specific due to the lack of placement opportunities. The top recruiting company for our course is TCS, in the Human Resources department. The top roles and the percentage of students who get assured internships are unclear due to the lack of information regarding the same.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Course facilities and infrastructure include an audio-visual room, internship opportunities under professors (with vague details available), and internship opportunities in the JU PRESS. Our departmental library has an incredible collection of literature across all spheres of English Literary studies. Hostel facilities are more or less abysmal. The quality of food available is borderline poor, as most canteens offer the same dishes every day, and sometimes the food is undercooked. Medical facilities are almost nonexistent, but facilities for disabled persons are being gradually built. Sports and games are mostly available to men.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors of the English Department are extremely accomplished individuals with a diverse array of knowledge in intersectional studies. They are helpful and considerate, although sometimes they tend to ignore major issues in the department. The course curriculum is relevant in terms of academia, especially for those who want to pursue Literature for higher studies. This course has a syllabus different from most college curriculums in India, as it focuses more on intersectionality than on the objective evaluation of a text, which is the rising trend of new criticism across all spheres of academia. Semester exams are extremely difficult, and the pass percentage is 35%.
detailed_review.Other: I choose this course because the department is one of the best in the world, and the outlook they have collectively adopted towards literature is unmatched and eternal. Improvement in the course could include better placement opportunities. There are huge events in JU, ranging from cultural events to literary fests to debate competitions. JU tends to excel in most. The campus environment and crowd are very laid-back in a way. The administration is slow in their work and maintenance of university grounds, but the campus environment is charged with freedom and its risks.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Instrumentation and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: A good college that provides good placement andand has value for money.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90% of the students get placed every year. The highest package is  40 LPA - 50 LPA, whereas the average package lies between 15 LPA every year. Companies like Amazon, Schrodinger, Nvidia, and Texas Instruments visit for campus placements. Almost all the good students get internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, and the college has highly specialized labs with all the required instruments in excellent condition. The college has a central library where all the necessary books for the courses are available. The hostel accommodation is good, providing a single room for each student and ensuring their health by offering fresh and healthy food.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching faculty is highly qualified and helps the students in every aspect. The curriculum is excellent in this course, since it provides all the subjects to make a student industry ready which further helps the students in getting good opportunities in their placement drive. The semester exams are held in a very organised way, where everything comes from what is taught during the class. Only 40% is required to pass a semester exam.
detailed_review.Other: I choose this course because it provides very good opportunities in future. The curriculum in this course is purely excellent along with the faculty. The college is itself an assets since it stands out for its placements and value for money than any other colleges.

admission.title: Jadavpur University Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: Jadavpur University admissions are both merit and entrance-based. The university considers scores in WBJEE, CAT, MAT, etc. for admission to specific courses. Jadavpur University offers programmes at UG, PG and doctoral levels in various streams such as Arts, Science, Engineering, Commerce, etc. The university offers admission to programmes such as B.Ed, BA, BBA, etc. based on the qualifying exam scores of the candidates.BTech is one of the top courses of Jadavpur University, admission to which is based on WBJEE scores of the aspirants.  Interested candidates can fill out the application form online for the preferred course.

faqs.question: Is Jadavpur University under CUET?
faqs.answer: There is no official notification from Jadavpur University, which indicates that the admission will be accepting CUET. However, candidates with a CUET score are still eligible to apply. Candidates just need to ensure that they fulfill the required course-specific eligibility requirements. For complete details about the Jadavpur University courses, Click Here .

faqs.question: What is Jadavpur University fees for the BTech programme?
faqs.answer: The total course fee of this university multiple components such as the tuition fee, admission fee, library fee, security deposit, etc. Jadavpur University BTech tuition fee range between INR 9,600 and INR 1.21 lakh . Additionally, the hostel fee ranges between INR 900 and INR 1,200 . Some amount of the total fee has to be paid for seat confirmation. It must be noted that the given fee is taken from the official website/sanctioning body. It is still subject to change and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: What is the required qualification for BTech at Jadavpur University?
faqs.answer: For Jadavpur University BTech admission, candidate should have passed Class 12 from a recognised board with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics as compulsory subjects. Candidate should have passed the qualifying examination with at least 60% aggregate. The required aggregate for SC/ST/OBC/PwD is 45% aggregate. Moreover, the age limit for the aspirants of BE programme is 17 years. Applications of the students who meet this criteria are accepted for admission. Candidates shall also ensure that they keep the academic documents handy during form filling and admission confirmation.

faqs.question: What is the last date for Jadavpur University BTech admission 2023?
faqs.answer: BE (5-year) courses 2023 for working professionals provisional merit list had to be published on Sep 5 and Physical verification–cum- Provisional Admission for selected candidates was scheduled on Sep 8 and Sep 9 . Moreover, the classes for BE/BTech (5-year) for WP shall commence from Sep 18 . For complete details about Jadavpur University BTech course, admission schedule, Click Here .

faqs.question: How many seats are there in Jadavpur University for BTech?
faqs.answer: The total number of seats available for BTech courses in Jadavpur University is 51. Candidates are admitted to the Technology programme in accordance with the seat intake. For information regarding seat reservation, candidates are advised to get in touch with the university admission office. Further, the seat intake for each of the BTech course is mentioned below: BTech Specialisation Seat Intake Instrumentation & Electronics Engineering 22 Food Technology & Biochemical Engineering 31 Furthermore, apart from this, the total seat intake for all the BE/BTech (full-time/online) courses is 1314. This seat count is as per an unofficial source and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: What documents are required for Jadavpur University BSc admission?
faqs.answer: A set of documents have to provided during Jadavpur University application and admission process. These documents are required for verification purposes. Listed below are some of the important documents required during application/admission procedure:

faqs.question: How much is the fee for Jadavpur University BSc course?
faqs.answer: The total BSc course fee is cumulative of various fee components such as the admission fee, enrolment fee, tuition fee, security deposit, etc. Jadavpur University BSc course tuition fee ranges between INR 1.51 lakh - INR 4.13 lakh . This fee range includes BSc tuition fees at some of the affiliated colleges as well. It must be noted that the mentioned fee is taken from the official website/sanctioning body. Hence, the actual amount may vary.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission in BSc at Jadavpur University?
faqs.answer: Candidats seeking admission to BSc course in Jadavpur University must have passed Class 12 from any recognised Board in Science with Chemistry, Mathematics, and Physics. In addition, aspirant should have passed the qualifying exam with at least 75% aggregate (67.5% for OBC-A/OBC-B,  56.25% for SC/ST/PD/Sports category, and 40% for PD candidates). The aspirants must also hold the mark sheets (Original/photocopy).

faqs.question: Can I do MTech from Jadavpur University without GATE?
faqs.answer: Jadavpur University admit candidates to ME andM.Techcourses on the basis of merit in GATE exam only. It does not accept score of any other examination. Hence, it is necessary that the applicants have a valid score of this national-level examination. Furthermore, the candidates seeking admission can contact the university admission office to confirm whether direct admission is offered to this PG-level programme.

faqs.question: In which specialisations does Jadavpur University offer ME?
faqs.answer: Jadavpur University offers MTech courses covering 12 specialisations, including CSE, Civil, Control Systems, Electrical, Software, Printing & Graphical Communication, Chemical, Mechanical, Automobile and Power, among others. These are two-year programmes divided into four semesters. For the ME courses, admission is also through GATE. The aspirants must check out the eligibility conditions before applying to the course.

faqs.question: How is Jadavpur University for MTech?
faqs.answer: Jadavpur University offers a two-year full-timeM.Techcourse at the postgraduate level. Jadavpur is a good option to pursue an M.Techcourse, as the University has been ranked 12 in the Engineering category by the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) in its 2024 rankings. Talking about Jadavpur University's  placements 2022 for Engineering students, the highest package offered was INR 1.8 crore per. The median package given to M.Techplaced candidates stood at INR 9.10 LPA and the placement percentage achieved was 71%.

faqs.question: When do admissions for the M.Tech course start at Jadavpur University?
faqs.answer: Jadavpur University accepts M.Tech course admission applications in online mode. It may accept applications in offline mode as well. As per the past years’ data, Jadavpur University generally starts the online registration process in April and May of the admission year. Candidates seeking admission to the Jadavpur University M.Tech course must visit the official website of the University to apply online. sections.heading: Introduction
text: Jadavpur University is a state university located in Bengal. It is extremely keen on the betterment of the infrastructure to promote a more conducive academic environment. The campus has hostels, a guest house, a library, a daycare centre, a health centre, JU Employees’ Coop Credit Society Limited and a Computer Aided Design Lab (CAD). The university keeps on working on improving the infrastructure and the major improvements are being done during the 2008-2013 period. Read further to know more about Jadavpur University Infrastructure:

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Campus Highlights 2024
text: Jadavpur University is not only known for its academic excellence but also for its excellent infrastructure facilities. The university is spread across 56 acres of land in West Bengal. The university is well-equipped with all the latest infrastructure facilities, yet it keeps on expanding and improving to provide a comfortable environment to the students. The university has comfortable and spacious classrooms, labs with the latest technologies, a library with a knowledge hub with digital library as well, day care, health care and other such facilities.
Campus Building:

tables.Jadavpur University Campus Highlights: Hostel, Guest House, Library, Day Care Centre, Health Centre

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Hostel & Residential Facilities
text: Jadavpur University has 13 hostels, out of which 4 are for girls and 9 are for boys. In these 16 hostels, there is a provision for accommodating over 1600 students. To increase and improve hostel infrastructure, the university is making efforts for the extension of the existing buildings and the construction of new buildings. The hostel has a mess that is conducted by the students' mess committee under the guidance of the Superintendent of the respective hostel. The main hostel complex is situated outside the hostel. The hostel premises' private canteen is supervised by the Students' committee.
Auditorium:

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Hostel Fee
text: Jadavpur University offers affordable hostel accommodation to its students. The students are required to collect a form from the Information Office and submit it to the Office of the Dean of Students. The payment of two meals provided differs from hostel to hostel.

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Hostel Life
text: Jadavpur University offers a safe, comfortable and friendly atmosphere at its hostel premises. The hostels have free wifi for speedy internet and 24*7 security with CCTV surveillance for added safety. Rooms are kept clean and spacious, with 2-3 students sharing a room. Single rooms are available at the Salt Lake Campus Hostel. The university tries its best to ensure that students are living safely and comfortably at the hostel premises.

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Academic and Research Facilities
text: Jadavpur University places a lot of focus on research. The university allocates over 35% of the total yearly budget to research. The research is conducted as per global standards. The university allocates 15 lakhs INR of its funds every year to support research activities by students. Twenty-two out of the university’s thirty-six departments have been recognised by, and have been receiving funds from, national and international agencies, primarily because of their research output.

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Library
text: Jadavpur University has a Central Library, which is a three-storeyed building on the campus. Although the shelf space and working space of the library is 36,000 sq. ft.,(approx), it is being extended by the new construction of annex building 5,500 sq. ft. (approx.). The library has 7 reading rooms, carrels, and an alcove for bound volumes of journals providing sitting accommodation for 700 readers. There is one more library at Salt Lake, the space of which is 6,500 sq. ft. (approx.).

The University also has a Digital Library, which has The Digital Library possess a Learning Resource Centre (LRC) and a reading room. The Digital Library Management Software Dspace, developed by MIT, USA and Hewlett Packard has been installed in the library. It is open-source software and has been customized to suit our requirements. DSpace accepts all forms of digital materials including text, images, video and audio files.

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Sports Facilities
text: Jadavpur University pays adequate attention to the sports facilities so that students can possess the significant development and promotion of sports culture within the university. The university believes in the idea of "Sports for All", as sports are considered the fundamental right of all which seems to preserve the integrity of sports in the university. The sports board encourages sporting activities as an imperative part of the university community that can generate a feeling of national pride and identity.

Every year about 200-250 students of the university participate in the inter-university sports competition. Such participating events are Aquatics (Swimming & Diving), Rowing, Chess, American Football, Karate, Grappling, Kick Boxing, Football, Volleyball, Basketball, Cricket, Tennis, Table Tennis, Air Rifle Shooting, Squash Rackets, Kho-Kho, Kabadi, Badminton, Ball Badminton, Athletics, Taekwondo, Weight & Powerlifting, Gymnastics, Yoga, Handball, Netball, Wrestling, Archery, Judo etc.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the Jadavpur University Campus
text: Jadavpur University is surrounded by Parks and nature, historical and cultural sites and other attractions. In their free time, if students wish to explore parks and nature, they can explore Rabindra Sarobar Lake, Science City, and Benu Bana Chaya Lake. A few historical and cultural sites that could be explored are St. Paul Cathedral, Tagore House, Howrah Bridge and Victoria Memoria. A few other places that could be explored are Jadavpur Lenin's Statue, Graffiti warehouse, and Nuner Bheri Picnic sport.
