facilities.name: Library
facilities.description:
Jadavpur university library system comprises the Central Library, Salt Lake Campus Library, 36 departmental libraries, and also the libraries attached with schools and centres for studies.
The University Central Library is housed in a three-storied building on the campus. Its shelf space and working space total 36,000 sq.ft. and is being extended via a newly constructed annex building. This will add another 5,500 sq.ft. Seven reading rooms, carrels, and an alcove for bound volumes of journals provide sitting accommodation for 700 readers. There is a separate library on the second campus at Salt Lake. The space of the Salt Lake campus Library is 6,800 sq.ft.

The Central Library is home to over 6,46,296 volumes of books on record (including the Salt lake Campus Library and those loaned to departmental libraries), 80,700 bound volumes of journals, 13,000 theses and dissertations, and 37,000 items of non-book materials such as reports pamphlets, maps and micro-forms. 

The library subscribes to about 633 print and 2,794 online journals. The university also has access to an additional 9,082 online journals through the INFLIBNET and the INDEST consortia. In total, the university library provides access to around 12,530 Journals.The library subscribes to 30 databases which include Scopus, Econlit etc. and also about 10,057 E-books.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a really good college with great campus life and good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80 percent of total registered students get placed in the Metallurgical and Materials Engineering branch. The highest package is 51 LPA, the average is around 15 LPA, and the lowest is 10 LPA. Top companies are Google, Microsoft, and Facebook. Around 60 percent of students get internships. The top roles are software engineer and consultant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are top-notch for Metallurgical and Materials Engineering at IIT Patna. There are almost all labs for every subject. The infrastructure for lectures and tutorials are top-notch. Hostel infrastructure is very clean and top-notch, and the mess is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very qualified. All of them have studied at very good universities all over the world. They are very knowledgeable. Teaching quality is also very good. This course is relevant. It makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are of a good level. The pass percentage is 98 percent.

reviews.review_title: Comparing IIT Patna with other IITs.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement here is not that good if you compare it with other reputed colleges, even though it comes with the IIT tag, it does not fulfill it. I can say placements are just good, but not top-notch. Students get internships here, but the number is low.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is good if I compare it with other colleges, many IITs have average or just the worst hostel, but here the infrastructure is good, the buildings are new. Mess is also good, but not that good, you can't expect so much from them. Some lifts are not working all the time in hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good here, not that strict but not so much lenient. Some give free attendance, but some are so strict that they do not even allow attendance after 5 minutes in the class. Faculty members are well-established in their field. Everybody is from IITs, and they have researched a lot.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are also good here if we compare to other 2nd-gen IITs.

reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Data Analytics
reviews.review_title: A day as IIT Patna B.Sc. student.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 60-70 percent of students are placed. Average salary is 7 LPA. The highest salary is 15 LPA. The B.Sc. program includes a mandatory summer industry project for the fourth semester. Top roles offered are software development engineer, data analyst, and data scientist.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As we have campus immersion every 6 months for 10-15 days, we have the best facilities, hostel, mess, complete access to library, classrooms, gymkhana, and everything. We have a daily workshop in our college in which a teacher comes to guide us for our future.
detailed_review.Faculty: All subject teachers are well qualified and have appropriate knowledge. They guide us to upgrade our skills. The course is also easy and makes us capable of competing in the industry. We have a marking system based on assessment, quizzes, and end semester exams.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about the course is that it is hybrid as we can get extra skills and college work consecutively. One thing that I want to improve in my course is that the final year is completely offline classes so that students can get extra knowledge and social exposure.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My review of the IIT Patna.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement for the first batch of scores happens in 2026, so clearly mentioning some record about the placement is a big challenge. Right now, they have created a WhatsApp group for career and placement for hybrid students, where they constantly give a link.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In the friendships structure, it is good for other IITs. It has 516 students and a big campus, but BS students cannot get hostel facilities. If you want hostel facilities, you can contact the IIT administration, who can allot you a hostel with all facilities like a gym and a khana.
detailed_review.Faculty: IIT Patna is located on its permanent campus, Beta. It has well-developed infection for both academic pursuits and student residential life, the institutional lecture hall and editorial building, each department has a BS student with a very high per month 14000 speed Wi-Fi, water purified and regular.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My college looks like heaven.

detailed_review.Placements: Good placement record, the highest placement offer is 60 lakh above. Approximately 99% students got placed in multiple companies like Amazon, Flipkart, Microsoft, etc. Every company gives us a good infrastructure and environment when we join, and then we will learn more about the work.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Patna College's infrastructure is amazing, it looks like heaven. They have a big library, a big auditorium, and a garden area of 250 acres. The college looks like an angel. I love it, I like it, everything is amazing. Hostel infrastructure is good, mind-blowing, they have girls' and boys' separate hostel rooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very good at behaviour. In terms of looks, their dressing sense is too good. Every faculty member has a polite nature. They always teach us in a good way, they always guide us, they have much more knowledge, they become so polite, they always clear our doubts.

reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Data Analytics
reviews.review_title: College is very good with the IIT tag.

detailed_review.Placements: Currently, I am in the 2nd semester, but as per the seniors' advice, the placement cell is not so good here. Only a few students from the very first batch got internships, and also at a very low package. I do not have the correct data on how many students get placed, but it is not too many.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very good. Hostels are also good and well-maintained. The mess food is above average and not so good. We would not feel bad on campus because there are so many sports to play, indoors or outdoors, and of course, I must say that it's not enough.
detailed_review.Faculty: The subjects taught here are very good. However, the way they teach is a little boring and not very good. If they bring experienced faculty members, then it will have a greater impact, but now they bring new faculty members, who I think have just completed their course.

reviews.review_title: I am very satisfied with the infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: About 75% of the students were placed in our course. The highest package was 15 lacs, the average package was 7 lacs, and the lowest package was 4.5 lacs. The top recruiters were TCS, Mahindra, etc. About 40% of the students also got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities available for our course are very good. The classrooms and labs are modified and well-maintained. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is average. The hostel rooms are comfortable and clean. Multiple sports and medical facilities are available in our college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable and experienced. They are not helpful enough, and they become angry if doubts are asked repeatedly. The teaching quality is average. Our course is curriculum-relevant, and many activities happen every month. The semester exams are quite difficult.

reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Data Analytics
reviews.review_title: Campus is clean and peaceful. Faculty members are helpful. Placement ratio is too good.

detailed_review.Placements: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Patna has a strong and consistently improving placement record, attracting a wide range of companies and offering competitive salary packages. The placement data varies by programs (B.Tech, M.Tech, B.Sc., M.Sc).
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Patna is located on its permanent campus in Bihta. It has a well-developed infrastructure for both academic pursuits and student residential life. The institute has a central lecture hall and a tutorial building. Each department has well-equipped and fully functioning research and teaching laboratories.
detailed_review.Faculty: IIT Patna has highly qualified and experienced faculty members. A significant number of professors have Ph.D. The course curriculum is regularly updated to meet industry demands. Exams are challenging, as is expected from an IIT. They are designed to test students in depth.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: I'm absolutely satisfied because of the faculty and good placements in 2024.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed in this course is about 33%. The students of this course got the highest package of 25 LPA and the lowest package of 9 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Intel, Texas Instruments, Qualcomm, Samsung, Wipro, Cisco, Nvidia, Siemens, and AMD. Government organizations like DRDO, ISRO, BHEL, and BEL also actively recruit ECE graduates. 70% of students got an internship in these companies. Top roles offered are electronics design engineer, embedded systems engineer, VLSI design engineer, telecom network engineer, and various positions in research and development, software analysis, and networking.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is well-planned and developed. The whole campus is covered with Wi-Fi, and the classrooms have smart boards. The labs are updated with the latest technology, computers, and have an Apple lab. The food available in the mess and canteen is freshly prepared and delivered with proper packaging. The campus also has medical facilities and organizes an annual sports meet.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are supportive and qualified. The teaching quality is also good. The course curriculum is also relevant and makes the students ready to work in companies and industries. The semester exams are easy to pass, and the pass percentage is 40% in each subject.
detailed_review.Other: I joined this course because I want to develop my technical, programming, and soft skills. This course will improve my electrical and communication abilities. The campus organizes events such as freshers', farewell, and other cultural events. The students are also sponsored with a scholarship according to their marks in the 12th standard.

reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Data Analytics
reviews.review_title: Placements check, coding check, no physics, no chemistry. Just maths for the first semester.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently studying a BS course in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity. It is my first year. The classes have not started yet, but I've attended the orientation. They'd also invited the first-year and second-year students to tell about their experience. Placements are good, of course, because it's IIT.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I'd better not say because I've not visited it yet, but according to my friends who study there, they said it's not that good because it's a government college, so I can say it is average. The hostel facilities need some improvement; we are both invited to all the fests and extracurricular activities.
detailed_review.Faculty: 75% attendance is compulsory. The difficulty level is like the other B. Teaching courses requires dedication and interest in coding and stuff. Weekly quizzes and assignments are taken regularly. I would not suggest you take any tough course like B.Teach or something with it. Be it a standalone course, it will show you results.
detailed_review.Other: The fests are amazing. Every year, there are at least 1 or 2 fests. Every 6 months, 15 to 20 days of campus immersion take place. We can also participate in all the sports and activities.

reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Data Analytics
reviews.review_title: About IIT Patna BS/B.Sc in computer science department.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Patna launched the B.Sc. (Hons). In computer science and data analytics (CSDA) recently, so it's a relatively new course. The first batch graduated in 2024, which means full-fledged placement data is still limited. However, based on student reviews and the institute's overall placement performance, the outlook is very positive. CSDA course is supported by IIT Patna's central placement cell, which is the same team handling B.Tech CSE placements. The eligibility for campus placements begins after the sixth semester. According to students from the first batch, about 80-96% of eligible students received placements or internships. IIT Patna has placement cell for B.Sc. students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good as other IITs. It has 516 acres and a big campus but BS students can't get hostel facilities. If you want hostel facility, you can contact IIT administration, they can allot you a hostel with all facilities like gymkhana, mess, and sports. But hostel fee for BS students is very high 14000/- month. It has speed of Wi-Fi, water purifiers, and regular cleaning.
detailed_review.Faculty: IIT Patna's faculty members are very helpful. They will support you and give placement and internship trips. College life at IIT Patna as a B.Sc. CSDA student is a unique mixture of academic rigour, opportunities, and personal growth. The course is relatively new.
detailed_review.Other: Our campus is not too much crowded but campus life is good like other IITs.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Material Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Decent faculty, good labs, and helpful placement support.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the M.Tech batch of IIT Patna. Around 80% of students were placed. The highest package is 18 LPA, the lowest is 5 LPA, and the average was 9 LPA. Companies like Amazon, TCS, and Wipro came. About 85% got internships in DRDO, ISRO, and startups. Roles like developer and research assistant are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Patna has good infrastructure. The department has fast Wi-Fi, modern labs, AC classrooms, and a big library with many books. Hostel rooms are fine, but sometimes not properly clean. Mess food is average, and canteen food is a little better. A medical room is available for health issues. Sports ground and indoor games are also present. The campus is neat and peaceful.
detailed_review.Faculty: IIT Patna has good Wi-Fi, a big library, smart classrooms, and the lab is also nice. Hostel rooms are okay, but sometimes cleaning is not proper. Mess food is not very tasty, canteen food is better. A medical room is there for small help. Sports ground and games are also available. It's quite good.
detailed_review.Other: I took this course because I like research and teaching. The best thing is the good lab and project work. Some subjects can be more updated. The campus has events, fests, and tech fests also. The crowd is good, and the campus is clean. Scholarships are given to many. Sports and club activities are also there. Connectivity by bus and train is okay.

reviews.review_title: Good campus, supportive faculty, and decent placements.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the PGDM Finance batch of 2025-27. Approximately 85% of students got placed. The highest package was 14 LPA, the lowest was 4.2 LPA, and the average was 7.5 LPA. Top recruiters included Deloitte, EY, and HDFC Bank. For internships, 90% of students got placed in ICICI, Kotak, and Deloitte. Roles included Analyst and Associate.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college had good Wi-Fi and AC classrooms. The library was big and full of books. Labs were also available. Hostel rooms were okay, but sometimes not clean. Food in the mess was normal and not very tasty. Canteen food was a little better. Medical help was available. A sports ground was also available. Overall, it was quite good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were good and helpful. They knew the subject well. Teaching was also okay. Some teachers explained better. The course was useful and helped with jobs. The syllabus was slightly updated. Exams were not very hard. If students studied regularly, they easily passed. Almost 90% of students passed, which was good.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I wanted to go into the finance field. The best things were case studies, group work, and presentations. Some subjects could have been more practical. The college held fests, events, and sports. The crowd was nice. The campus was clean and had a good vibe. Wi-Fi and bus facilities were available. Scholarships were also given to some students.

reviews.review_title: IIT Patna- Emerging gem in Science.

detailed_review.Placements: There is 100% placement in the 2025 passout batch of M.Sc. The highest package is 9 LPA and the lowest is 6.5 LPA. Narayana Group, Infinity Learn, Physics Wallah, and Akash Group are recruiting companies. Not everyone is interested in an internship, and those interested got the internship, in JNCASR, IIT Gandhinagar, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Air-conditioned classrooms with installed projectors and Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs with chemical, IR, NMR, XRD, Rotavapour machines. The newly built grand Library is there with 24-hour open. Double occupancy rooms, room size is small for two people, the mess food is of good quality, free medical consultation and medicine are available in the campus health centre, well-equipped gymkhana is available. For sports, there are basketball, badminton, volleyball, tennis, cricket, football, and hockey courts.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty in JEE and NEET coaching is good. All faculty members are very reputable in their field. They teach with dedication. The Curriculum is up to date and will help you find some jobs and clear exams like CSIR NET and GATE. It is difficult to pass exams and you have to be focused throughout the semester. Almost 90% of students manage to pass.
detailed_review.Other: M.Sc. Chemistry is dynamic, you have immense possibilities after that, like job, government job, Ph.D., etc. Maybe some courses in a semester can be replaced with more industrially important courses. Popular events are Anweesha, Infinito, Celesta, and Nebulla. Merit cum means scholarship is available.

reviews.review_title: Quite satisfied because of the good infrastructure and faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: We can apply to work at ISRO with this course. The average package offered in this branch this year is 12 LPA. We can also get internships in this course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For the first year, 3 students stay in one room. But the hostel is very good. We have a water cooler, washing areas, and an outdoor badminton court at the back. Labs are clean, but we need to be careful while doing our assigned experiments. Mess serves pretty good food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very good and helpful in nature. We have to coordinate with them to secure good results and follow their piece of advice very carefully. Teachers are very qualified, with some having a PhD degree. Some have already studied at universities in the USA. The course is good. It is entirely research-oriented. There are a lot of headaches in studying Physics if we are not interested in it.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college is good for CSE and AI students.

detailed_review.Placements: Twenty-six third-year students joined Google as interns, and 5-6 third-year students joined Atlassian this year (2025). Overall, the placements are good this year, with the average B.Teach placement salary nearly 20 Lacs, and the CSE department's average is almost 25 Lakh
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All hostels at IIT Patna are excellent, but the third- and fourth-year boys' hostels are old. Each hostel has its own mess, and the food quality is decent—neither very good nor bad. The first-year students' hostel has two badminton courts inside. Other sports grounds are roughly 1 km away from the hostel area.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are very helpful. All courses are relevant and it helps you to get placed in any industry ( according to your department). There is an absolute grading system so you have to score at least 40% marks in each exam (mid-semester, end-semester, lab exam).

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Patna - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of students get placed in my course. The highest package offered in my course is 55 LPA. Many top companies like Amazon, Samsung, Intel, Siemens, Cisco, Zomato, etc., visit the college to hire students. 60-70% of students got internship opportunities in some companies mentioned above. The top role offered is SDE.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. Facilities are provided. There are labs and classrooms with good facilities like Wi-Fi, AC, etc. Everything that should be in a hostel or in classrooms is available, like Wi-Fi and good rooms. The quality of the mess food is also good, and the same is for the canteen. It has its own hospital so every facility in the medical area is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and knowledgeable. Some of them are too good at teaching. The course curriculum is relevant or we can prefer to do research projects under professors. The difficulty level of exams is moderate. There are minimum grades for each subject to avoid failure like D is the minimum passing grade.
detailed_review.Other: Based on my rank and college preference, I chose this course. AI is introduced and hardware requirements are increased, which can be beneficial for the scope of this field. Annually, four fests are organised, i.e., cultural, freshers, sports, and tech fest. Income-based scholarship is provided.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My review of this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements at the institute are the perfect definition of it. Students generally become eligible for placement from the fourth semester. Around 300 recruiters participate, including top domestic as well as foreign companies. The average package for the M.Tech program is 16 LPA, and the highest package offered is 1 CPA. The top recruiters in the drive include Microsoft, Oracle, Goldman Sachs, ICICI, Tata, and HCL. Almost 100% of students get placed. I plan to work after my graduation.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel rooms are good in all aspects. 24-hour electricity is provided, and an emergency generator facility is available. The hostel is neat and clean. Sweepers come regularly to clean the dirty areas, and rooms are properly cleaned every weekend. The mess maintains good quality food.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are highly qualified, coming from both Indian and foreign universities. They have wide exposure to research and teaching experience. The associate professors and assistant professors have extensive teaching experience and teach us in a friendly manner. Students enjoy their teaching style. In the first year, everyone studies the same courses. Exams are semester-wise, where students have a few mandatory courses and some electives available within their department. One can also opt for courses of interest from different departments. For example, engineering students can choose management courses as their elective subjects. The course workload is heavy. So it prepares you for real-world work. Courses can be chosen from the 2nd semester, allowing you to select courses according to your preferences. There are minor exams, major exams, and many assignments.

reviews.review_title: A college with world-class facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Last year, 94.87% of students were placed. The highest offer made last year was 83 LPA, and the average package was 31.40 LPA. The top recruiters are Accenture, Goldman Sachs, Tata, Reliance, and Google. Almost 75% of students got internships. The recruiters are NVIDIA, Texas Instruments, and Google. The roles offered are SDE and design engineers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi is good and has a speed of around 10-12 Mbps. Other than that, all is good. There are double-sharing rooms; 3rd and 4th years get single-sharing rooms. The library is closed on holidays, but the self-study center is open 24/7. Food is not up to the mark, but good, don't expect too much. You will live in a 5 BHK unit. There are washrooms in each unit for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are very good and well-experienced, with high knowledge of their respective fields. You always find lecturers available to help you with your studies. The classes and presentations by the lecturers are well-structured and very helpful. Most lecturers are experienced and have worked in various colleges, mastering their disciplines. As for academics, it follows the modern academic structure provided by the government. The pass percent is around 95%.

reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Data Analytics
reviews.review_title: Very good and top college.

detailed_review.Placements: As we are the first batch of the BSE honors in computer science and data analytics, we don't have much information about placement support. I am in my third year. There is a very good internship placement support that we are getting from our college. They are offering internships in the domain of data science, artificial intelligence development, digital marketing, and many more. Companies like PNGDHL and many other start-ups like Roadbez and Nextute are also there.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our hostels are quite new and well-maintained with the option of single sharing double sharing and triple sharing each hostel has bed cabinet table, chair, and balcony for the students. There is a common washrooms and bathrooms available. Mess food is very good and hygienic and has a lot of options and the canteen also has a huge variety of options for medical facilities. We have Apollo clinic branch on our campus and there are many games like cricket, football, basketball, tennis, volleyball, and other options available on our campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and qualified and their teaching qualities are also quite good as they answer every doubt. This course is very relevant for the upcoming generation and the future of AI and data science fields. The semester exams are conducted offline and the semester exams are very tough for those who haven't gone through the lectures, but it's very easy for the students who are keeping a daily track of the lectures. The pass percentage is around 3.8 CGPA.

admission.title: IIT Patna Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text:
IIIT Patna admission 2025 is completely an online process. For admission to its flagship course, i.e., BTech, the institute accepts JEE Advanced scores followed by JoSAA Counselling. Students are also required to qualify JEE Main exam before appearing for JEE Advanced . In addition to its flagship course, IIT Patna offers BS, MSc, MTech and PhD courses to students at the UG, PG and doctoral levels. While admission to MTech and MSc is subject to GATE and IIT JAM, respectively, the admission process for BS is subject to a valid score in JEE Main, JEE Advanced, followed by JoSAA counselling.

1. Application: BTech aspirants in IIT Patna must apply in JEE main and then appear in JEE advanced. Admissions in the MSc and MTech must be through IIT JAM and GATE respectively. The other classes are to check the specific entrance test information in the official site.

2. Entrance Exams: JEE Main, then JEE Advanced, is needed to take admission in BTech and BS courses of IIT Patna. The candidates who take MSc should appear in the IIT JAM exam and those who take MTech should appear in the GATE exam. The entrance examinations vary depending on the course and thus, the candidates are asked to read the requirements.

3. Selection Rounds: In IIT Patna, admission to BTech can be done on the basis of JEE advanced marks and rank by taking part in JoSAA counselling. The process of admission to MSc is dependent on IIT JAM scores, and CCMN counselling, and the process of admission to MTech is dependant on GATE scores through COAP. Other programmes may involve merit lists or institution specific rounds.

4. Counselling and Admission Confirmation: Applicants of BTech are made to go through counselling in JoSAA, after which they receive a seat based on their rank and preference. MSc and MTech students go through CCMN and COAP counselling respectively in order to be given seat allocation. Finally, the successful candidates pay the fee of admission to get a seat at IIT Patna.

faqs.question: How can I join IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: BTech and BS courses completely based on JoSAA following an appearance by a candidate for JEE Main and JEE Advanced examination, however for other courses MSc and M.Tech based on GATE, IIT JAM through COAP and CCMN counselling and the seats under PhD course on appearance basis on admission test organized by institute itself. After the test is conducted, IIT Patna publishes a merit list containing the names of students selected for PhD.

faqs.answer: 1: Go to the official website 2: Click on 'Register' tab. 3: Add COAP registration ID, password and Captcha and Sign in. 4. Check the result .

faqs.question: What has been the trend for cut off in BTech in Chemical Engineering at IIT Patna in last few years?
faqs.answer: The cutoff trend for BTech at IIT Patna  has been increasing in the recent years. In 2021, the closing rank for BTech. under general category for all India quota was 11673. In 2022, it increased to 12874. Likewise, the cut off ranks have changed from 4549 to 4722 for OBC, 2500 to 2592 for SC, 2500 to 1195 for ST, 1674 to 2099 for EWS. This trend is likely to continue in the coming years, as the demand for engineering education in India continues to grow. Similar cut off trend can be seen for female candidates under all categories however the ranks are slightly different.

faqs.question: Can I study BTech at IIT Patna for free?
faqs.answer: No, there is no provision of a student studying free at IIT Patna as per the official website. However, IIT Patna provides a range of Merit-Cum-Means scholarships to meritorious and needy students. Any UG (BTech) student or MSc student can receive these scholarships. The criteria to receive is that the annual income of a student's parents/ guardian/ family from all sources in the preceding financial year must not be more than INR 4.50 lakh. Category-wise eligibility criteria and the way in which the scholarship is offered is as follows: A few more PG scholarships and UG scholarships offered by the PM are awarded to the students of IIT Patna.

faqs.question: Can I change my BTech branch after admission to IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: In general, students admitted to the particular branch of the undergraduate BTech course must continue studying that branch till completion. However, in special cases the institute may permit a student admitted through JEE to change their branch of study after the first two semesters. Such changes are permitted only for students who have completed all the common credits required in the first two semesters of their studies, in their first attempt, without having had to pass any course requirement in the summer term examination.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Patna campus has various facilities for its students and people who are part of the system. Spread over 501 acres, IIT Patna's infrastructure includes the following amenities, which help in the overall development of students:
For more information about IIT Patna check out the below videos:
list: Hostels:IIT Patna hostel facility for all students There is one boys’ hostel and one temporary girls’ hostel, with a total capacity to house 1,200 students. Hostels are equipped with a gym, TV room, mess, food joints, and table tennis facilities.

Medical Unit:Thehealthcare facility at the IIT Patna campus is run with the help of Ruban Memorial Hospital. A pharmacist and an assistant are available on a full-time basis; moreover, the medical unit is well equipped to cater to the basic medical needs in case of emergency.

Sophisticated Analytical Instrument Facility (SAIF):Sponsored by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, SAIF was established to provide analytical and data collection facilities to the scientific community using different sophisticated analytical equipment.
Sports Complex:IIT Patna campus has sports facilities like a badminton court, basketball court, cricket ground, football ground, and a volleyball court.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: IIIT Patna digital library is equipped with modern technology of library automation system with Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) and self check-in and shelf check-out (Drop Box) system using RFID technology. The library provides e-resources (e-books, e-journal, e-databases and Turnitin) facility, newspapers, etc.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: IIT Patna currently has one boys' hostel and one temporary girls' hostel in the campus. It also has necessary arrangements for married research scholars. Presently over 1200 students are residing in the hostels. Regular bus services have been provided from the hostels. The hostel also has a Wi-Fi facility along with gymnasium, TV room and table tennis.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of good placements and faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: Mostly, 80 percent of the students in Anna University Chennai got placements in good companies. The highest package is around 30 LPA to 40 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA to 5 LPA. The top recruiting companies for my course are TCS, Wipro, Accenture, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Anna University Chennai is good, and laboratories and libraries are available. They provide separate hostels for both boys and girls with free Wi-Fi. Hostel food is not bad. Average in taste. They give importance to sports as well as studies.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers at Anna University Chennai are well-experienced and qualified. They are always being friendly with students. They teach us lessons crystal clear and always clear the student's doubt regarding lessons without any concern. They conduct an examination every month.

reviews.review_title: I like hostel life more as college is strict.

detailed_review.Placements: The students from 3rd semester were eligible for placements. Companies like Toyota, EY, Micromax, Accenture, KPMG, Delliote, etc., will come to hire the freshers. The highest package offered was around 20 LPA, and the lowest package was around 4 LPA. The percentage of students getting placed was 70-80%. My plans after degree were to work for 5 years in an MNC.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our campus was good enough to accommodate 2500 students including two colleges as we had two colleges under the same campus. Blocks were different but common facilities were shared be it library, canteens, sports ground, or the perpetual seminar halls. We had plenty at our campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty student ratio was around 1:15. Faculty members were so supportive of the students, and they would always respond to students immediately. All faculty members were good like Charitra ma'am, Jasmine ma'am, Ranjitha ma'am, Santhosh sir, etc. All the faculty members were the best. There was no faculty whom we didn't like. There will be semester exam after 3 months in the semester. In a semester, there will be 2 internals, 2 small tests which will be considered as assignment, and 1 project for every subject. The courses were good and connected to the industry.
detailed_review.Other: Our events like the tech fest Henosis also held there.

reviews.review_title: The pride in sharing the greatness of Asia's oldest college.

detailed_review.Placements: In our course last year, around 81% of students got placed. The remaining students opt for higher studies abroad. So the remaining students do not apply for placements. The students are being given an enormous number of opportunities for placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It is the best infrastructure available among the government colleges. The standards and the fees that we pay are very different. Though the fee is low. The infrastructure is very good. The greenery of the trees within the campus gives a good feeling to stay.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very much helpful and have a great experience in research as well as in the curriculum. The curriculum is very relevant to the needs of the industry. Semester exams are very easy to crack which makes me give four stars rather than five.

reviews.review_title: My college is a 10 for those who prefer exposure rather than infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: 50% of students got placed in IT companies and manufacturing companies, mechanical sectors as well. Remaining students focused on building their own company, and some of them are getting into higher studies. The highest package known to me was 18LPA, and the lowest is 4.5 LPA. Companies like TATA, Hyundai, Mahindra, CATERPILLAR, etc. Roles offered are mechanical, automobile, manufacturing, management, data analytics, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everything is available, but the maintenance is poor. Wi-Fi is available, but it lags sometimes. Medical facilities are good enough, and the food is also good. But there is no proper maintenance of restrooms and infrastructure. The canteen still doesn't have Epay, but it is still in development. Cleanliness is at its worst on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are helpful, joyful, and qualified. Teaching is still like the old school. No advanced methods. It is relevant to what the industry needs, but still holds. 75% is the pass percentage, approximately. The semester exams are difficult but manageable.
detailed_review.Other: This course integrated Mechanics, Management, and Data Analytics, so I ended up here. The building is worse and can be cleaned, painted, or renovated. Events, fests, etc., are excellent. There are several scholarships that one does not need to worry about.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college with nice campus and social life.

detailed_review.Placements: 26 LPA is the highest package and 5.6 LPA is the lowest, and 6 LPA is the average. Associate engineer is the position offered. Caterpillar recruits more freshers here 70% of students are placed/in internships. The exact numbers are not known off-campus students are like 10.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus life is lot enjoyable. There are lot of space to spend time inside campus, like clubs. Architecture classes are quite good. You can have Wi-Fi access on laptops for free. A wide range of sports are available. Two canteens are available. Hostel and mess food is decent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified. Most of them are Ph.D. holders. Every 4 years once they change the syllabus and curriculum. It makes study more informative, but not more practical. Semester exam are sometimes easy and hard based on the selector. 45% is the passing percentage.
detailed_review.Other: Through Tamil Nadu Engineering admission counseling, I got this course. The course is quite tough. There was a choice filling where you could select professors of your choice. But it has been removed now Kurukshetra, the biggest tech fest and lots happening around college every now and then.

reviews.review_title: I highly recommend, it is good.

detailed_review.Placements: In the industrial department, most of students get placed, and some go for higher studies in top institutes, including IIM. Here, they encourage students to contribute to the entrepreneurship sector too. It all depends on our efforts; opportunities exist.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Free Wi-Fi is available for laptops, and the library is really good with sufficient books and infrastructure. Hostel infrastructure is good, but the taste of mess food is a con, especially lunch. It is really a good college for sports, PPL in ball badminton, hockey, and throw ball. Health facilities are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching style is based on real-life applications rather than marks, with interactive classes. The new curriculum makes it even better. Getting marks is easier, but knowledge depends on you. The question paper depends on the professor, and presentation matters. Class notes are key to marks.
detailed_review.Other: There are a lot of extracurricular activities where you can showcase your talent in science, dance, or whatever. You can learn a lot. Clubs guide for higher studies, UPSC, singing, dance, astronomy, robotics, etc. It is a wide exposure college.

reviews.review_title: My experience of M.Sc. electronic media at Anna University.

detailed_review.Placements: The average package is 7 LPA and the highest package is 36 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Cipla, TCS, Infosys, Siemens, Vodafone, Wipro, Flipkart, etc. Statistics show that around 90% of students are placed from this college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of Anna University is good. University is well-managed for students. Labs are advanced. Library has more than 1 lakhs books and journals and full campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Hostel is clean and well-managed. Mess has separate vegetarian and nonvegetarian food. So this is a better option for students who are vegetarian.
detailed_review.Faculty: According to students the teaching is very good. Almost 90% of teachers are Ph.D. scholars. All teachers are very friendly and fully experienced. The mentors are very supportive and available all the time to help. Exams are not too much easy and not too much difficult, so students are passed quite easily.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Quality education with strong placements and affordable fees.

detailed_review.Placements: This college offers 120 seats for Computer Science and Engineering. With quality teaching, it has a 90% placement rate. The average salary package offered ranges from 4 LPA to 10 LPA. All major IT companies recruit from this course, and 95% of students secure internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For my course, they provide good infrastructure with high-speed network in Wi-Fi and data. It provides well-organized labs and wonderful Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan library which has more than 40,000 books. The canteen provides food 3 times a day with good quality and good taste.
detailed_review.Faculty: Every teachers in this course are well qualified and with more than 7 years of experience. Their teaching is proven with the passing percentage. It makes industry-ready students like providing good communication skills and stage performances. Exams are easier in this college as the good teachers, and pass percentage is 93%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it has been a good platform during the quarantine time and good average package. It provides more technical skills like developing company projects, and all special events are conducted at appropriate time.

reviews.review_title: Anna University is well satisfied with placements and exploration.

detailed_review.Placements: High package - 33 L, the lowest package - 3 L, average package - 6 L. Anna University has a robust placement programme, attracting numerous companies across various sectors. Some of the companies are Apian, Microsoft, etc. Nowadays, the internship opportunities seem to decrease in count.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the students of the college are provided with Anna Wi-Fi. The speed of the Wi-Fi is quite enough for academics. There is a health centre inside the campus, which is open to all students, faculty members, etc. There is a huge library inside the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The exams will be very tough to clear. The pass percentage is 50 percent. The course curriculum is quite relevant to the industry. Most faculty members hold advanced degrees (Masters and Ph.D. from reputed institutions and from abroad). No complaint regarding teaching.
detailed_review.Other: There will be two events held in the even semester. One will be a teach event and the other will be a non-teach event. In the odd semester, there will be no events.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Anna University, Chennai in the year 2025 admission in M.Tech course information.

detailed_review.Placements: In this college, we get the best placement opportunities. Students must score an 8 CGPA to participate in campus placements. In this college, many companies come for internships. The salary package offered is around 4 LPA to 8 LPA. Our college has a partnership with tech companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This college provides the best facilities. They use high-quality infrastructure, products, and materials. This college provides facilities like classrooms, labs, benches, a library, fans, bathrooms, computers, etc. Facilities are available. This college has a canteen. Its food is very tasty and clean.
detailed_review.Faculty: This curriculum is relevant and very good. Our teachers are very good. They provide knowledge of the subject. This course is for 1 year. We have 2-semester exams. Exams are very difficult to clear and score marks.

reviews.review_title: Good exposure and campus.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% are placed and many go for higher studies. The lowest package is 3 Lacs and the highest is 21 Lacs. A student recently got into Apple as well. Most students get placed as Software Development. Students also get mass recruited at the end of the placement season. Companies like Fidelity, Visa, Citi Bank recruit students here often.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department has working labs and classrooms. There is a common library for all students within and outside the nearby campus. You cannot connect to data on your mobile within the department, but they will provide students with Wi-Fi that can be registered with your laptop. The quality of food is subpar in the international hostel. It is very repetitive. Housekeeping is prompt. The medical center closes by 5 pm, so in case of emergency, you have to visit Malar hospital nearby. Sports culture is very strong here.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified but lack the ability to teach. The course is slowly being revised and is somewhat relevant, making the students industry-ready through mandatory internship/summer projects. Semester exams are application-oriented. Pass percentage is 45% if you pass in internals.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course because I assumed it has good placement. There are many scholarships that are offered for different sections of society. The campus crowd is mostly Tamilians, with few foreign nationals, NRIs, and other state students. I wish the professors were more approachable.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Vibrant Campus Life at CEG.

detailed_review.Placements: Currently, I am in my third year as far as the placements and internships go our college is very esteemed. Very old college we have a greater army association and alumni connections so it will be very much easier to get connections outside the college through the alumni as far as college placement cell goes. We have many companies visiting yearly for our college for internships and placements and college has done a very good job at bringing those companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Even though our college is 200 years old, all the infrastructure is present and is very much available for students. But, we may not have a mobile network on the college campus. But there is Wi-Fi present all around the campus so it is very much helpful. Labs have very high facilities like the computers software required are very much pre-installed and ready to use. Hostels are affordable and manageable but still a bit of improvement is required.
detailed_review.Faculty: As far as curriculum goes, the curriculum is regulated every four years. It is changed based on industrial requirements and other changes. Faculty members are very friendly, approachable, and very experienced in various fields. Very diverse staff are present in the department and also the exams are conducted twice within the semester which are the internal assessment. Finally, we have an ancient semester totally accounting for the grades of the students.

reviews.course: M.E. in Power Electronics and Drives
reviews.review_title: The college is good, nothing negative as such.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of the students getting placed in our college is 95%, and the college does provide us with internship opportunities. Students also pursue internships on their own as well. The average package being offered was 10 Lacs rupees per annum.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and the infrastructure that is provided to us in our course is that we have access to Wi-Fi 24/7, labs, and also audio-video classrooms. The quality of the facilities that are provided to us in our hostel is really good, and the medical facilities are also really great.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers in our college are really very helpful. They have strong domain-related knowledge and also have good teaching skills. The course curriculum is also very relevant to the industry requirement, and the pass percentage of the college is 90%.

reviews.review_title: The best university with many facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Our university is well-known for good placements. Almost 93% of students were placed. The highest salary package offered in our course is 34 LPA, while the lowest salary package ranges from 5 LPA - 9 LPA. Recruiting companies include Wipro, Infosys, Amazon, Google, and others. More than 100 companies collaborated with the university. The percentage of students who got internships is 97%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College facilities were good at our university. The infrastructure is very attractive. Our course provides Wi-Fi and a library that has books on all fields. The food quality in the mess is good. The hostel facilities are also good. Many sports events were conducted.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very supportive, and the courses are to the point. They are helpful in teaching and have more than 20 years of experience. Teachers' knowledge was excellent. The course curriculum was relevant, covering everything from basics to advanced topics. They prepare us for the industry by providing hands-on experience. The semester exams are challenging, and the passing percentage is 93%.

reviews.course: (Discontinued Sep 2021) M.Tech. in Environmental Science and Technology
reviews.review_title: I like mostly college. College infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are very good in our colleges. Students got placed in reputed companies with good packages. Students from the 6th semester become eligible for placements. More than 400 companies visit for placements. The highest package is 56 LPA and the average is 5 LPA. Every year more than 90% of students get placed in companies and some do their startups.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The range and accessibility of books and journals available in the library yes it's available. The facilities and technological provisions within the classrooms. An overview of sports and extracurricular activities offered on campus yes they are offered.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty-student ratio may be 20:1. But they are all very helpful whenever there is a need. Data Science faculty members are all very good. They also take extra classes for those who have any queries and solve their queries. There are a total of 3 sessions of exams per semester and the level of difficulty is moderate. Almost 80% of students passed every exam.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: My Life Lessons at College of Engineering Guindy.

detailed_review.Placements: For IT, CSE, nearly everyone will get placed and their average salary is around 12 LPA, with the highest salary being around 36 LPA. For ECE, EEE department core companies will also come, but the salary is not lesser than IT. Their average is around 8 LPA. For civil, mech, and manufacturing, core companies will come and the average is around 7 LPA. Rare departments like printing, mining, some companies will come, some will get placed, and some will do higher studies. Even though they don't get placement, Anna University brand name and life experience will help them grow.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is not so good as private colleges. Ambience is good. Some classes don't have smart boards. Wi-Fi facilities are given only for laptops. Lab infrastructure is very good. Hostel facility is okay, but you have a very good life experience there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some faculty members teach extraordinarily. Some faculty members don't have subject knowledge, but this helps us to improve more through self-learning. Without self-learning, you can't get good grades. The question paper is set by any one of the staff members who are handling the subject. Exams are somewhat medium to difficult level. Seniors will guide you more for placement, etc. Seniors also conduct special classes for students.
detailed_review.Other: I chose ECE because we can go for both IT and core jobs. Some department staff are not teaching well, and it is tougher if you don't follow self-study. There are many clubs, and it is mandatory to be a part of NSS/YRC/NSO. I am a part of NSS, which is a personality improvement course. You will be able to speak confidently and efficiently. Many clubs are also there. Each club has its significant events. CEG Teach Forum conducts Vyuhaa for freshers and Kurukshetra, an international-level tech event. SAAS CEG conducts AGNI in the odd semester and Techofes in the even semester. Those cultural events are the best part of your life.

reviews.review_title: Review of B.Tech in information technology at Anna University.

detailed_review.Placements: We have higher placement chances in both the core and non-core companies. Our alumni's got placed in various roles such as finance, IT, consultant and so on. And also, they honestly respect and support our start-up ideas patiently without any jealousy. They had given their fullest support.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are 400 computers present in our college laboratories. As programmers were appointed to monitor the computer laboratories, they additionally took care of students while doing programs. Also, technical assistants were appointed in order to monitor machines and equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: During examinations, our teachers gave special attention to the students who scored below average marks and they arranged special coaching for them in their lacking subjects. Also, special rooms were allocated for the students who have medical issues like fever during exams.

reviews.review_title: Overall the best college for M.E in Solar energy.

detailed_review.Placements: Our university placement percentage varies from year to year. About 80-90% of students are placed in a special education. The salary range offered is between 10 LPA - 15 LPA. The salary range offered is between 7 LPA - 6 LPA. Minimum salary is between 4 LPA - 6 LPA. Recruitment for our study can vary from year to year. Some of the top recruitment agencies included Adani green , Waaree energies, Tata power Soler systems, Vikram solar, loom solar, Goldi solar etc. Approximate 70% of the students got internships. Top or startup companies offer internships for students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have everything in our college. Our college and hostel have 24/7 Wi-Fi access. Our classrooms are well equipped and well maintained. Our university has state-of-the-art labs. There are good books in the library. Our college has basic facilities and courts for various sports. We also have a canteen and meeting room.
detailed_review.Faculty: The instructors are highly experienced, offering excellent instruction and live coding in the classroom using projectors. The learning experience is excellent, with instructors solving questions in different ways and properly guiding students. The pass percentage is 86%.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a good engineering college.

detailed_review.Placements: Our university provides good placement opportunities. Students have to score above 7 SGPA in all the semesters to get good placements. Top recruiting companies are Bajaj Electricals, Syska, HP, etc. These companies select students based on their interviews. The average salary package offered in our course is 5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The overall environment of our college is very good. All people are very helpful. There are different types of clubs where like dance clubs, music drama, etc. You can join in these clubs. The infrastructure of our college is good. All facilities are available in our college. There is a huge library. It is always full-stocked. The hostel facilities are good. The food served in the mess is tasty. Canteen and grocery stores are available on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is well-designed and provides practical knowledge. Faculty members are average. Some of them are very good. Some are not good. They keep on criticising and de-motivating you. They make you feel bad about yourself. Some of them are very motivating. They help us learn new things. The teaching methodology is good. Exams are organised on time.
detailed_review.Other: All festivals are celebrated in our college. The seniors are very helpful.

reviews.review_title: Review of College of Engineering, Anna University.

detailed_review.Placements: Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Caterpillar, etc. These companies provided jobs to MCA students. In the previous year, the highest salary package offered by Microsoft to MCA students was 22 LPA. The average salary package offered is 4 LPA. Around 50-60% of MCA students got placed in top MNCs. The remaining 3% of students got internships. In the previous year, my friend Ashis got an internship in Mindtree during his 3rd semester. Top roles offered are software engineer trainee, application developer, analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are well-equipped labs and a central library in our college. The central library has more than 1,00,000 books. There is a separate library for each department. Smart classrooms are available in our college. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Hostels have separate vegetarian and non-vegetarian messes and amenities for normal and international students. There are 2 health centers which work 24X7 for any kind of emergencies.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching is very good. Almost 90% of staff members are Ph.D. scholars. Our DSA and network faculty members completed their Ph.D.s from France and London. The course curriculum is constructed based on the course and industrial knowledge. The semester exams for MCA are less complex compared to B.Tech and BE students. The pass percentage is based on the assessment, attendance, and semester exams.

highlights.summary:
National Institute of Technology Calicut is one of the top-ranked Architecture institutes in India. It was founded in 1961. It is one of the 31 institutions of National Importance. NIT Calicut has been ranked 2 under the 'Architecture and Planning' category and 21 under the 'Engineering' category by NIRF 2025. National Institute of Technology Calicut Campus has been ranked by several international organisations as well.
NIT Calicut has 15 Engineering departments. The courses offered in these department include BTech, MBA, MPlan, MS, BArch, MTech, and PhD. The BTech is one of the most famous courses of the institute. NIT Calicut admission to these courses is based on the entrance exams, such as JEE Main, GATE, CAT, IIT JAM, etc.
National Institute of Technology Calicut Campus covers an area of around 120 hectares. It is a residential campus with all amenities available on and around the campus. There are, at present, 13 hostels on the campus, out of which 10 are for boys and 3 for girls. Mess operated by outsourcing is given in all hostels.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: The infrastructure and environment are really good.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Calicut maintains a strong placement record. The placement percentages often exceed 80% for undergraduate programs (and nearly 100% in top branches like CSE). A wide range of top companies and multinational corporations (MNCs) visit the campus, including tech giants and core industry players. The highest package is around 42 LPA, and the median package is around 16 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NITC is a fully residential institution. The hostels are generally well-maintained, with good food and Wi-Fi connectivity. The campus is vast (around 300 acres), lush green, and offers a beautiful, eco-friendly environment. The food is great here. We have our own medical center here in NITC.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are highly qualified. Many hold Ph. D.s. They have extensive research experience, including patents. They are always noted as being supportive, approachable, and encouraging of critical thinking and innovative projects. The academics are generally described as structured, rigorous, and industry-relevant. The curriculum is regularly updated.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is vibrant. Major annual events like the technical festival TATHVA and the cultural festival RAGAM, which is known as one of the biggest in Kerala.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: College not only forces students to focus on marks also encourage in participation extracurricular.

detailed_review.Placements: Many students in our college are getting placed based on their merit and knowledge. Our college not only focuses on our sem exams they will also help us build our skills. Many top companies are coming to our college and hiring. The highest package in our branch is 42LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are decent in our college. Wi-Fi is also provided for first years and a laundry facility too. The food is acceptable to eat not that good and not that bad. The security in the hostels is not that violent they will be polite with us.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and they are highly qualified and knowledgeable and teaching quality is good. The curriculum is also relevant and it makes students industry ready. The semester exams are not that easy and not that hard. We can score good marks by studying one. Week before the exams.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest in semiconductors and electronics. We can do electronic related things and coding related things in this course. Our college also conducts regular workshops and hackathons.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really, it has good infrastructure and facilities available for the students.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement percentage is 35 percent, the highest Package is 26 LPA, the lowest Package is 3 LPA, and average Package is 6 LPA. In your college, you have a very close relationship with the internship, and seniors also guide about the interns, and if we have talent, you are max eligible for the internship.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: They provide good Wi-Fi facilities for the students. In the academics, they also give the most good health Wi-Fi in college, and they provide nutritional food in your hostels and mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: In your college, they provide good connections with students. It has a good curriculum provided by faculty related to the branch. Exams are also conducted in a very strict and disciplined manner, and the questions in the exams are useful for the students' further studies.
detailed_review.Other: Ee got the NRIF ranking of Architecture 2, and it is more famous for Architecture, and it has a good life for CSE, ECE, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: This college has a good academic and non-academic staff.

detailed_review.Placements: Students will get placed into the top companies as per their talent and merit. Many companies are hiring our college students. The highest package in the CSE department is 42 LPA. Many companies are hiring our college students because of students’ talent, knowledge, and what not.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are decent, and the night curfew time too, and the food is not that good. The hostel Wi-Fi is provided in the first-year hostel too, and laundry facility too. We have separate labs for electronics and programming, and the college also has a health centre where we get free doctor checkup and medicine.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable, and the teaching quality is good. The semester exams are also not that hard and not that easy. Course curriculum is also relevant and it makes students industry ready. The pass percentage is more than 85 percent.
detailed_review.Other: There are many events conducted in our college. Since I joined, this is the place we can study as well as participate in any extracurricular activities you want.

reviews.review_title: NIT Calicut is a heavenly college in god's own country.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement in the college is very good. The average package is 9 LPA. The college provides strong support throughout the placement season. However, students are highly advised to work very hard because the competition is tough.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The buildings and infrastructure are well maintained. It has regular maintenance and construction throughout the campus, making living here convenient and worth the money spent. Although the campus is very big. You might need a cycle for comfort.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty here is one of the best among any other institute in India. They are all Ph.D. holders from NIT, IIT, IISc, and even some from Ivy League schools. The semester exams are very hard and difficult to score a high GPA, so students must be very careful.
detailed_review.Other: The college curriculum is very hectic, so be prepared to face challenges. Above all, the placement is good but not well guided, so you have to perform and manage things on your own.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Calicut College.

detailed_review.Placements: Every year, more than 75 percent of students find their way into management companies, typically with packages over 8 LPA. A couple of our seniors recently landed some great offers, one hitting 36 LPA. Another senior got a package of 22 LPA in mechanical engineering, while others got 16 LPA and 12 LPA in mechanical and EEE courses, respectively. These were the packages from folks I know.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
When we talk about the college's infrastructure, it covers all the basics clean water supply, spacious science labs, an auditorium for cultural events, and a playground for sports. There was a well-stocked library and tidy classrooms. Students could also benefit from transportation and on-campus housing if they did not have their own rides. The mess was kept 
clean, and while the food was decent, I think adding a few more choices that students like would be a real bonus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty and staff really did a good job here. First-year classes felt quite a bit like high school, which honestly made the transition easier. The yearly tests were not too complicated. The college did a great job recognizing academic achievements, going out of its way to celebrate the top performers.

reviews.review_title: About good campus life and hostel facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% of students are placed. The highest package is around 18 LPA. The lowest package offered is around 4 LPA. Out of all the companies, around 40% of students are in core companies. Rest of the companies are sales and marketing related. Usually, 3rd year students get internship offers, and 4th year students get placements. Internship offer percentage is less, around 20%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are good with changing room allotments by year. In the first year, rooms are shared by 3 students (earlier 4). Second and third years stay in the Mega hostel with 2 students per room. In the final year, students can choose the campus hostels or the Mega hostel, with a single room provided. Wi-Fi or LAN is provided to all the hostels. Mess food is better than that in many colleges, with multiple mess options available. There is a health center outside the main campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Semester exams are moderately tough, and most of the grading system is relatively. Everyone has to get a minimum of 40% marks in order to pass. All teachers here are highly qualified. Most professors maintain good teaching quality, though a few lack in this aspect. The old curriculum was followed till 2024. But I think it is completely restructured now for 2024 admissions onwards, and may make the students industry-ready.
detailed_review.Other: I chose mechanical engineering as I was interested in cars. Even though its not much popular nowadays, it's still one of the core branches and its value will remain as it is for the rest of the time. During my study, the curriculum was not industry-ready. Many lack the awareness of the skills that are needed in the companies. But a lot of changes have been made in the curriculum for the upcoming batches, and I believe this will be beneficial for them. Ragam and Tathva are the 2 fests conducted annually.

reviews.review_title: NIT Calicut Engineering Physics.

detailed_review.Placements: This is primarily a research course. Most people go for a masters degree or a Ph.D. degree. A very few 3 to 4 students out of 39 opt for placements, and they also get placed. Engineering Physics is counted in the circuit branch along with CSE, EEE, and ECE. We are taught electives from the ECE and EEE branches, so we are placed in similar companies and job roles as them.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Mess is okay, not so good, and not so bad. Hostels for 1st year are a bit old. The 2nd year, we get new hostels which are way better than the 1st years. These new hostels are inaugurated 3 to 5 years ago. In first year hostels, there is a computer room, a visitor room, a common room which has TT table, Air hockey, Pool, Chess, Carrom, and a TV. We have a wedding machine installed on the ground floor, which has basic snacks and drinks. We have 3 washing machines also.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty are well qualified. All have done their Ph.D. from reputed indian institutes like IITs, IISc, IISER, and reputed foreign institutes as well. The material that they teach us is very good, and their teaching method is also good. In the first year, some courses are irrelevant for us, like Engineering graphics, mechanical workshop, etc. The curriculum after 1st year is very good. The main objective of this course is not to make students industry ready for companies, but to make students capable of getting offers from reputed institutes for Masters and Ph.D.
detailed_review.Other: If you want to build your career in research, but also want there to be more existing options, when I am not interested in research, then this is the best branch and college you should opt for. College culture is very good. We have workshops related to Physics every month, and there are events organized. The Cultural Fest Ragam is the biggest cultural fest of South India. Connectivity is a issue. You will not get Uber and Ola from airport to college. You need to opt for a local taxi that does not charge too much money.

reviews.review_title: The great campus and great placements in 2015.

detailed_review.Placements: Above 90% of the students have been placed, and the highest packages of 20 LPA and the lowest packages of 5 LPA. The top recruiting companies are the architecture companies. About 40% of students got internships in the field of architecture.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This is great infrastructure in the departments, which are very well maintained. Wi-Fi is less and the labs are very brilliant. The classes are five-star rated, the quality of the facility is not very nice, the food is very good, the canteen is brilliant, and sports and games are very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful, they are qualified, they have a Ph.D. from out of the country, and they make students industry-ready. It is very difficult to clear the exams, the papers are semester-wise, and stop at 20 credits per semester
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course to become an architect to design for companies. The best thing about this course is that there is a great scope for increasing demand for different designs of houses.

reviews.review_title: It gave me an exceptionally beautiful experience.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80% of the people got placed from my course. The highest package was 34 LPA, the lowest was 5 LPA, and the average was 8.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Oracle and Caterpillar. Very few, around 30% got the internship in companies like Oracle, TVS, Bajaj, etc. Top roles offered were like application developer, associate engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was excellent, I would say. The infrastructure of the hostels, etc., from outside would be conventional, but the facilities are top-notch. The Wi-Fi is provided, power laundry is available, and the issues, if any, raised are also taken care of by the management with utmost care.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are well-qualified and knowledgeable in their fields and put their maximum efforts to deliver high-quality teaching to the students. The course is relevant to the curriculum, and it does make students ready for the future industry they will be going to work in. The semester exams are moderate to hard level, and they are designed to test our skills. The pass percentage varies from faculty to faculty, but I would say 35-40 percent.

reviews.review_title: NIT Calicut College review.

detailed_review.Placements: When it comes to packages, the highest average is between 20 LPA and 25 LPA, while the lowest average is around 15 LPA. We got about 80% of students placed in our course, which is solid. The top recruiters, I think, are food industry giants and well-known names like Tata and Mahindra. They are handing out some top roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: One noteworthy positive characteristic of the university is the statement of the modern infrastructure being accompanied by extra resources. The public library not only has a wide range of books and novels but also has different academic journals. The canteen is big and offers a variety of dishes and drinks that are served in a customer-friendly place. Students appreciate living in the well-managed hostel where the food is not only satisfactory but also meets the basic quality standards.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are approachable and they take things step by step, therefore making the examples very simple and relatable for the students to understand. The exams are easy, and they mainly focus on conceptualizing the topic. The semester assessment is completely dependent on the high school curriculum and is easy in nature.

Just recently, some of our seniors scored impressive placements. One even got a whopping 36 LPA. Another senior from the mechanical course landed a package of 22 LPA, while others had seen offers around 16 LPA. It was pretty exciting to see how well everyone is doing.
