reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: National Institute of Technology

detailed_review.Placements: The student placement percentage for my course is 90%. The highest package for this year is ₹54 LPA, and the average package is ₹9 LPA. Top companies like Google, Microsoft, Tata, Amazon, Flipkart, etc., hire from our college. The percentage of students getting an internship is 85%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. All department infrastructure is very nice. Labs are very advanced. The college provides Wi-Fi 24 hours. Classrooms are good. The library has all kinds of books on coding subjects like Python and Java. The hostel and food are good, as well as the medical and sports facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very highly qualified. The teaching is very nice. Teachers help us with any kind of doubts we have. The course is relevant to the hardware field. The semester exams are a little bit tough. The passing percentage for the course this year is 75%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: About National Institute of Technology, Calicut.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost more than 70% of students got placed from my course in their senior years. The highest package is about 47 LPA and the lowest is 10 LPA. Goldman Sachs, Sprinklr, Salesforce, and Oracle are the top hiring companies for my course. About 40% of students got internships from our course in companies like Oracle, Goldman Sachs, Flipkart, Texas, and Sprinklr. Roles like embedded software, full-stack developer, and frontend developer are roles offered in my course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Room allotment is given like four per room in the first year, in further years, 2 per room, and one room for physically challenged students. Wi-Fi labs are available, and the classrooms and library are nice. Food is good and there is availability of vegetarian and non-vegetarian food for students, and multiple canteens in the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are highly qualified, with their degree from IITs, NITs, and most of them have finished a Ph.D. too. The curriculum is built perfectly so that students can learn a wide range of topics and become capable of being placed in different positions. The semester exams are a bit difficult than those at other colleges. The pass percentage is good, above 95%.
detailed_review.Other: The course in this college was popular among people, and they have to improve their standards, like being close to students, and extra-curricular activities and events are good in this college.

reviews.review_title: One of the best NITs in India.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement in our course was extremely awesome. The highest package offered in our course was nearly 48 LPA. The average package was around 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Larsen & Turbo, Reliance Construction, etc. Around 70% of students also got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Central library was present. Wi-Fi was enabled on campus. Labs were available with well-equipped instruments. The facilities available in the hostel were also good. Sports ground was available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors of our course were helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their respective domains. Teaching quality of our faculty members was good. Course curriculum was relevant. Semester examination was not easy. Around 90% of students passed.

reviews.review_title: Vibrant campus life of NITC.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Calicut offers decent placements. But the percentage of students getting internships is very low. The highest package is around 40 LPA, and the average package is around 10 LPA. CSE offers the highest placements for the students. Many top companies recruit students from NITC.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is pretty organised and beautiful. But the faculty members in the lab are pretty outdated. Most of the equipments gives wrong measurements. Hostel facilities are very good. Food in the mess is also pretty good. Hostel is worth the money.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members at NITC are well-experienced and educated. Most of them have industrial experience too. The course curriculum is updated every now and then so that students are learning up-to-date information which is very useful. In each semester, we have a lot of exams both practical and theoretical.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because this was what I could afford with my rank in JEE. The campus life at Nitc is top-notch. We don't have any restrictions on campus, and we have a lot of fests.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: An overview of NIT Calicut.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Calicut offers good placements. But recently the placements have gradually decreased. CSE offers the best placements followed by ECE and EEE. The average package is about lakhs, and the highest is 44 LPA this year. In CSE, almost hundred percent of students get placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NIT Calicut provides very neat hostels and infrastructure facilities. The food provided in the hostel is also good. They provide both Northern and Southern food. Sports facilities on the campus are average compared to other institutions. There is a healthcare center on campus for students and faculty members.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members at NITC are well-experienced and educated. Every teacher is highly qualified. The course curriculum is very well updated, and it changes at regular intervals of time. Semester exams are not that much difficult. You can score easily if you study properly.
detailed_review.Other: The campus life at NITC is so much better than at any other NIT. In South India, the largest cultural fest is happening in NIT namely Ragam and technical fest Tathva.

reviews.review_title: NIT Calicut has been ranked 25th in the NIRF ranking.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a UG student in chemical engineering pursuing from NIT Calicut. The report given from NIT Calicut is 87% of students got placed in our course. The highest package is 34.1 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA. The average salary offered by the chemical engineering course is 10.68 LPA according to the placement report.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are top quality at NIT Calicut. Wi-Fi is available everywhere throughout the campus. Classrooms and the library are assigned to studying. The quality of the food in the hostel is awesome. We get different types and varieties of foods from the hostel. The college has 3 canteens. The college supports every sport and game.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is relevant to the course in every way. In the first semester, we have 6 subjects and 1 practical lab. At the end of the course, 150 credits are required. Among the 150 credits, there are 64 credits for the core program,  and 22 credits are required for the institute core.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Microelectronics and VLSI Design
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Calicut - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements and job opportunities were also good. Many more well-known rebound companies visited the campus for job selection, offering attractive packages to the Nitans both in the country and abroad. My internship experience was fantastic; six of us completed a summer internship at CSIR-CRRI in Delhi. As we all know, the Central Road Research Institute of India is the premier research institute in India, providing numerous features, improved techniques from newly implemented systems, and innovative ideas to research scholars from top-class scientists.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course structure for my program was excellent and focused heavily on research. In the first year, we attended classes and studied various subjects similar to B. Tech, but in the second year, we only had lab work and projects, with the projects being of our personal choice, which I feel was a great step to promote research. For the M. Tech program, the apartments were spacious and well-maintained. Cleaning staff came every morning to clean the area. There were a total of seven messes, and anyone could choose their preferred food options.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty's quality was outstanding; they were incredibly helpful in guiding students at every step, whether in class or outside of it. They organized various skill development programs, such as seminars, presentations, and software applications. There was a lot of pressure in M. Tech compared to B. Tech, so the first year of M. Tech was quite hectic. However, in the second year, there were no classes, just project work, allowing students a bit more time to spend.

reviews.review_title: I am satisfied with facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 80% of students get placed. The highest package is around 47 LPA I guess, and the average package is 12 LPA. The lowest package is 7 LPA. The top recruiting company is BPCL. Almost 50% of students got internships from companies like Tata and Visakhapatnam Steel. The top role offered is GM.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college offers Wi-Fi, clean rooms, 24x7 water, security, and basic amenities for a comfortable stay. It has a well-equipped library. The campus has a hygienic canteen, nutritious food, a medical center, and sports facilities for fitness and overall well-being.
detailed_review.Faculty: Experienced faculty members ensure high teaching quality through interactive and practical learning methods. The course curriculum is industry-oriented, offering practical knowledge and skills for real-world applications. The pass percentage is 95%. The exam level is hard.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course out of my passion for civil engineering. A better curriculum with practical applications should be provided, which will be helpful. Events are good. We can connect and communicate with different people there. Scholarships are good, and extracurricular activities are interesting.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: The campus of the National Institute of Technology Calicut is located about 22 kilometres to the northeast of Calicut (Kozhikode) city. NIT Calicut covers an area of around 120 hectares . The campus is green, and the ambience is very enjoyable. It is a residential campus, with all amenities available on and around the campus. The students live in hostels on campus. There are, at present, 13 hostels on the campus, out of which 10 are for boys and 3 for girls. Messes operated by outsourcing are available in all hostels.
Check out more details in the below videos:

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The central library has the collection of over 1.55 lakhs of books, 193 national and international journals and other resources cater to the knowledge. The central library also houses the NALANDA Digital Library, which has over 4690 online journals, 2117 e-books, 31674 e-databases, 9994 conference proceedings and about 2132 ETDs/ CBTs, etc. NALANDA is one of the earliest digital libraries in the country.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: The institute has different hostels starting from 1st-year students to final year students and for international students also. All the hostels have Common room and Recreational center where newspapers, magazines, TV’s and indoor sports/games facilities are available.Free 24 hour internet and computational facilities are available in almost all hostels.

facilities.name: Shuttle Service
facilities.description: The institute provides transportation services for the campus community in the morning and evening shifts. The bus service also provides in the afternoon time from the east campus towards the hostel area.

data.description: NIT Calicut has a rich faculty community with technical and scientific expertise. The faculty members consist of PhD holders involved completely in teaching and research. Currently, at NIT Calicut, there are 312 faculty members, spread over the cadres of Professor (HAG), Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor. The faculty members are highly qualified and are very helpful to students, be it academic or any other.

highlights.summary:
Siksha O Anusandhan University, formerly known as SOA University is a private deemed university founded in 2007 and is located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. SOA University is accredited by the NBA (National Board of Accreditation), NABL (National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories), NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals), ICAR (Indian Council of Agriculture Research), ABET (Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology), and NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council) with an A++ grade. It is approved by the AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education), UGC (University Grants Commission) and SIRO (Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation). SOA University Bhubaneswar has been ranked the 15th best university in the country by the NIRF Ranking 2025.
SOA offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Engineering, Medical, Management, Pharmacy, Agriculture, Nursing, Law and Research Programs. Siksha O Anusandhan is a leading institute which focuses on preparing the future generation with quality teaching and innovative research. SOA University has top-class infrastructure and it has been ranked 3rd nationally for the Swachh Campus. SOA University placements are splendid where renowned companies such as Amazon, Dell, HP Inc, Deloitte, Hyundai and others. SOA University admission is based on merit and entrance exams. The university accepts various national-level entrance exam such as NEET, JEE Main, CAT, XAT, etc. It focuses on fostering the culture of academic excellence and embracing technologies. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: See in Odisha, and in terms of a private college, ITER is actually good and if you give.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, some of my seniors said Flipkart and some other companies hire with a nice package. 28 LPA and 32 LPA packages are offered. And the thing is, many companies are coming for hiring, like JP Morgan, TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, Capgemini, Flipkart, and Google. The ratio of this year was good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Nice building and hostel are well-maintained, both with AC and non-AC. Food is good, lunch, dinner, breakfast and snacks. All the rooms get cleaned daily. Staff are good, no disturbance. We have 2,3,4 sharing rooms and all the washrooms on all floors, and they are cleaned too.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are good, and they make everything easy to understand. All the teachers are well qualified with a Doctorate, and they are really cool and very good. Able to make us understand things as simply as we want. Overall, all staff and teachers are good.
detailed_review.Other: You may not get a high campus life like other colleges, but in the curriculum and in other aspects, this college is good.

reviews.review_title: My college experience and my opinion.

detailed_review.Placements: In our batch, out of 120 students, 90 to 95 are getting jobs. Most of the students are getting jobs in good companies like Accenture, Wipro, Zomato, TCS, Swiggy, etc. The highest package offered by Accenture is 9 LPA, and the lowest package offered by Wipro is 3 LPA. For our course, the college is not offering any internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college campus is too big. Inside the campus, they provide all kinds of facilities like a big central library, gym, food court, and both indoor and outdoor games. The college campus is a full Wi-Fi campus with smart classrooms. Hostels are inside the college and they provide a Wi-Fi facility inside the hostels. They provide typical North Indian food in the hostel, and the food quality is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers have good quality teaching skills, and some teachers help students related to placement. Those who are weak in communication and academic performance get guidance. The teachers prepare students before placement for all companies. The semester exams are not very difficult to pass; most regular students pass the semester exams.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course because I have an interest in technical courses. In my course, they teach the subjects that I am interested in.

reviews.review_title: Strong academics, but a few areas can be improved.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage is generally high because most students get absorbed into reputed hospitals. The highest package for neurosurgery specialists is usually very good. The lowest and average vary depending on whether the student chooses a private hospital, academic positions, or fellowships. Top recruiting options include multispecialty hospitals, medical colleges, and neurosurgery centers. A decent percentage of students also secure internships, observerships, or fellowships in renowned hospitals and institutes, which helps build strong clinical exposure. The top roles offered are Neurosurgery Specialist, Senior Resident, Consultant Neurosurgeon, and Fellowship Trainee in subspecialties.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are generally helpful, well-qualified, and knowledgeable in their subjects. Most of them explain concepts clearly. The teaching quality is overall good. The curriculum is relevant and covers important industry-oriented topics, which helps students become well-prepared for future opportunities. Semester exams are moderately difficult, but if you attend classes and study regularly, they are manageable. The pass percentage is decent, and most students clear the exams without major issues. So overall the academic experience is good.
detailed_review.Other: Strong academics and supportive faculty with good clinical exposure. Excellent facilities and hands-on training make it an overall good experience. Quality teaching and solid clinical opportunities in neurosurgery.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College is good. You can take admission and have a good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is good. If you are a good student doing amazing in academics with extracurricular knowledge and coding knowledge you will surely get a better placement. Our average placement is 5 to 6 LPA but in 2025 batch we got 10 to 12LPA. Many companies like Infosys Flipkart Amazon TCS etc. B.Tech CSE core is in much demand but if you can take AI ML it will be better. Last year 80 to 90 percent got placement.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Campus is a little big not that big do not expect that much. Classrooms are not that modern but always clean. Wi-Fi everywhere. Central library is good and it has many facilities. The key building is cafeteria which has 2 cafes 1 salon and a big restaurant and on the ground floor there are many stores like Maggi and more. Labs are clean not that messy and bad looking.
detailed_review.Faculty: Curriculum is good and has developed a modern syllabus. B.Tech in AI ML got Python and Java both languages. Students can get a great idea from this syllabus. Teaching is good but the number of faculty is not that good at teaching although every teacher has graduated from many great colleges.
detailed_review.Other: Do not expect any big fest. The best course to pick is in CSE core. I wish they did more fests events and concerts. Crowd is good as they have alternative time classes. You can get 20+ clubs or societies.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: SOA ITER overview.

detailed_review.Placements: Decent placements. Packages amount ranges between 4 LPA-45 LPA, with an average of around 7 LPA. Top recruiters include names like Amazon, Microsoft, TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Accenture, etc. Top roles offered are software engineer, data scientist, DevOps engineer, AI/ML engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is quite well-equipped with various facilities for both academics and beyond, such as sports and research purposes. The campus size is quite vast, and the academic buildings are very well-equipped with air conditioning and other required facilities for learning. The quality of the mess food is decent. Medical facilities are top-tier since there is a collaboration with SUM hospital.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very well qualified, eager to help, and the quality of teaching is very good. The course curriculum is relevant with cutting-edge courses available for AI and Data Science. The course makes the students industry-ready and beyond. The semesters are moderately difficult with a decent pass percentage.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My experience so far has been good for learning and growth.

detailed_review.Placements: From what I've seen with my seniors, the placement record is strong, and the university brings in a lot of well-known companies for recruitment every year. Placement cell is also quite active. Companies like TCS, Cognizant, etc., come here for the B.Tech course. To my knowledge, the highest package offered in B.Tech is 30-40 LPA, and the average is 8 -10 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is pretty good, the classrooms are well-maintained with ACs and digital boards, and the labs have all the equipment you need for assignments. The Wi-Fi is decent enough to get work done. Hostels are fine, pretty much what you'd expect. The mess food can be a bit boring, to be fair, but the canteens have great options, so it's not a big deal. There are also libraries and many sports grounds for various games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers I've had are mostly great, they actually know their stuff and are pretty helpful about helping you out if you're stuck on something. The syllabus feels up-to-date and prepares you for what companies are looking for. The Exams are challenging but fair, you can't pass by memorising everything. Basically, if you show up to class and study a bit, you'll do fine.
detailed_review.Other: I have taken B.Tech in the year 2024, so far it is good, there is so much more to explore. Campus is good with good students and facilities. They are helpful.

reviews.review_title: Good college in Odisha, ITER.

detailed_review.Placements: If someone is pursuing BCA, they become eligible for campus placements in their final year. For B.Tech students, eligibility starts from the 3rd year. The highest package is 4.5 LPA. Each year, over 2000 companies visit and offer comfortable packages to deserving candidates. Around 80-90% of students secure placements with decent salary packages. I plan to pursue MCA after completing my BCA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are really nice. The food is nice. Whenever I had any problems, I just filled out a form, and within 24 hours, the issue was fixed. Although the hostels are quite expensive compared to other colleges, they provide flexibility and comfort. The central library offers all kinds of books. Book lovers would really feel like they are in heaven there. Each classroom has projectors for digital education. Students involved in clubs and social groups may find it difficult to manage everything, but it is manageable if one tries.
detailed_review.Faculty: The quality of teachers and their knowledge is very important in the IT sector. To be honest, our college provides the best in class. The faculty-to-student ratio is quite impressive, as SOA has more than 500 faculty members. There are only two exams. They are mid-semester exams and end-of-semester exams. The mid-semester exams are usually tougher than the end-of-semester exams. Around 20% of students fail to clear each exam. The course curriculum is a little old, but it is being updated as of 2024.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Well-rounded experience with strong academics and vibrant campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Our B.Tech CSE batch of 2025 achieved nearly 80% placements. The highest package offered is 30 LPA, the lowest is 3.5 LPA, and the average range is 6.5 LPA - 8 LPA. Top recruiters include Microsoft, Amazon, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Deloitte, and Goldman Sachs. Around 70% of students secured internships with leading companies such as Microsoft, Amazon, Infosys, and Deloitte. Top roles offered are software development engineer, data analyst, cloud engineer, full-stack developer, and system engineer, with strong industry demand and excellent career opportunities for the batch.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our course offers well-equipped classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, modern labs, and access to a comprehensive library. Hostel provides clean rooms, 24X7 water and electricity, and basic furniture. The mess serves decent, hygienic food with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. A canteen offers snacks and beverages. Medical facilities are available on campus with a resident doctor and emergency support. There are also good sports facilities, including a gym, football ground, basketball court, and indoor games like table tennis. Overall, infrastructure supports both academic and personal development effectively.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well-qualified, helpful, and knowledgeable, with good teaching methods. The curriculum is relevant and includes practical elements that help students become industry-ready. Semester exams are of moderate difficulty which focus on conceptual understanding. With regular preparation, exams are manageable. The pass percentage is generally high, around 85%-90%.
detailed_review.Other: I pursued B.Tech in computer science (2022-2026) due to my interest in technology. The course offers good practical exposure through labs and projects. However, more industry tie-ups and internship opportunities would help. Campus has a vibrant crowd, regular fests, and active clubs. It's well-connected and located near essential amenities. Scholarships are available. Sports and extracurricular activities are well-supported.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: ITER Bhubaneswar has strong placements, good faculty members, and modern infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements:
The average placement percentage for top courses, especially B.Tech (CSE), stands at about 96% for the 2025 batch. For other branches like ECE, mechanical, and MCA, placement percentage typically ranges from 65% to 85%. The highest package is 46 LPA (offered to a CSE student in 2025). Average package is 5.75 LPA - 6 LPA for B.Tech (CSE), ECE, and mechanical programs, with an average between 4.8 LPA and 5.5 LPA. The lowest package is reported at 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are
IT/software TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Adobe, Amazon, Cognizant, Deloitte, core engineering at L&T, Tata Motors, Bosch, Intel, and Qualcomm, emerging sectors are healthtech startups and semiconductor design firms. Other notable recruiters include Highradius, Hexaware, Justpay, and IBS Software.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Campus has wide Wi-Fi and wired internet. Hostels have 24X7 Wi-Fi, but student access in academic buildings may be limited. It has spacious, air-conditioned rooms, equipped with smart boards, projectors, and comfortable seating for interactive learning. We have well-equipped labs with advanced instruments and regular upgrades, specialized department labs for hands-on learning and research. There are multistoried central and departmental libraries, with large collections of print and digital resources, journals, and e-library facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers at ITER have advanced degrees from IITs, IIITs, and other reputed institutions, making them experienced and well-qualified. Most faculty are approachable, supportive, and committed to student success, though some provide feedback notes on traditional methods and limited interaction due to large class sizes in technical branches. Teaching quality is described as good to excellent, with practical exposure through field visits, seminars, and interactive learning sessions.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements, modern infrastructure, supportive faculty members, and vibrant campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: For ITER Bhubaneswar CSE 2025 batch, around 96% students are placed. The highest package is 46 LPA, the average is 6 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA - 3 LPA. Top recruiters included Amazon, Google, Deloitte, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, Cognizant, and Tech Mahindra. Many students secured internships in 3rd year, with a stipend between Rs 8,000 and Rs 25,000 per month, though the exact percentage is not disclosed. Roles offered are mainly software engineer, data scientist, AI/ML engineer, and devOps/system engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: ITER Bhubaneswar's CSE department offers Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, advanced computer labs, project labs, and a digital library with books and journals. Hostels provide Wi-Fi, study space, and common rooms. Food in the mess is hygienic though average, while canteens serve better options. Medical facilities include a 24X7 health center with doctors and hospital tie-ups. Students also enjoy good sports infrastructure with grounds for cricket, football, basketball, badminton, athletics, and a gym, ensuring balanced academics and extracurricular activities.
detailed_review.Faculty: At ITER Bhubaneswar, faculty members are helpful, well-qualified, and knowledgeable, offering both theoretical and practical exposure. CSE curriculum is updated with industry-relevant subjects like AI, ML, data science, and cloud computing, supported by workshops and training that help students become industry-ready. Semester exams are of moderate difficulty, testing understanding rather than written learning. With regular preparation and attendance, most students clear easily. The pass percentage generally remains above 85-90%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose CSE at ITER Bhubaneswar for its strong placements and growing tech scope. The best parts are modern labs, an updated curriculum, and supportive faculty members. Improvements needed include more industry tie-ups and practical exposure. Campus is vibrant with technical/cultural fests, active clubs, and sports. It is located in Bhubaneswar. It has good connectivity and safe surroundings. Scholarships support meritorious students, and the diverse campus crowd ensures overall growth.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Strong placements with top recruiters, qualified and supportive faculty, and good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: About 90 percent of undergraduate engineering students are placed in the 2025 batch, with branch-wise placement rates ranging from 78.7 percent (electronics) to 95.3 percent (computer science). Data suggests a strong performance, but exact percentages are not consistently reported across all branches. Pre-final year students from computer science have an internship rate of up to 73.3 percent, while other branches generally trend between 10-55 percent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Engineering course and campus provide strong facilities, modern infrastructure, quality hostels, good food options, reliable medical amenities, and diverse sports opportunities, supporting both academics and student well-being. It has complete campus Wi-Fi coverage, including classrooms, labs, and hostels for seamless academic and personal use. All engineering departments have well-equipped labs with individual computers, modern equipment, air-conditioning, and specialized hardware/software to support practical learning.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in top engineering colleges are widely regarded as helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is praised for being rigorous, research-driven, and supportive of student learning. Course curriculum is aligned with modern industry requirements, including hands-on projects, internships, and exposure to emerging technologies, making graduates highly industry-ready.
detailed_review.Other: Engineering is chosen for its problem-solving nature, vast career prospects, and ability to create a positive impact. Best aspects are hands-on learning, innovation, job security, and team-driven skill development, while areas for improvement include curriculum modernization and easier access to global exposure and projects.

reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security)
reviews.review_title: It is a very good college. It is a top college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are very good. Placements are dependent on the performance in the interview. There are different companies like Wipro, TCS, Tech Mahindra, etc that have visited our college. Wipro is the top recruiter. The highest package offered is 2.8 LPA, and the lowest package offered is  1.7 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi all over the campus and CCTV security. There are 4 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels inside the campus. Labs are spacious and digitally updated. Classrooms are ventilated and air-conditioned. There are a cricket ground, a volleyball court, and a badminton court present.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good. They are highly educated and experienced. The course curriculum is good. It makes us ready for the industry. Faculty members use simple language, which is easy to understand. There are two semesters in a year, and each semester has two sessions, which are conducted by the college.

reviews.review_title: Review of SOA University - Siksha 'O' Anusandhan.

detailed_review.Placements: The college campus was good. A maximum of eligible students got placed in our college placement. The highest package in our batch was 16.4 LPA, and the average package was 3.5 LPA. Companies like TCS, Wipro, Media-mint, Zomato, etc., come to our college to hire students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college campus is so big because it provides B.Tech, M.Tech, BCA, MCA, and M.Sc. courses on one campus. All departments have separate blocks, and inside the campus, a food court, indoor games, and a gym are available for all students. The college campus is fully Wi-Fi-enabled, and all labs are available for practicals. Hostels are also inside the college. They provide good quality food and full Wi-Fi access inside the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our college faculty members were good and well-qualified. Their teaching quality was good, and they are fully cooperative with all students. They also provide placement training for all students and prepare them to be industry-ready. Semester exams are easy. Most regular students pass all semester exams.

reviews.review_title: Good faculty members and campus infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 12% of students got placed during the campus placement drive. There is a placement cell at the college. Some of the companies are Accenture, Verve Farmstay Pvt Ltd, Udyogini, Coromandel International Ltd, some SEED based companies, etc. The average package is 4 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are equipped with projectors. College has a good number of books and a peaceful library to study in. The quality of food and canteen is above average. They have good extracurricular activities. It conducts an annual competition between all the year students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are extremely helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. We experienced quality teaching during the 4-year course. The theory from classroom teaching and the practical experience gained during the field visits are all helpful to the students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Inter Soa College Review 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80-90% of students get placed in this college. The average package is around 5-6 LPA. Top recruiters include Amazon, Microsoft, TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Dell, and PwC. Around 60-70% of students get internships through the college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has air-conditioned classrooms with comfortable seats. It has a very good library with almost every book. I don’t live in the hostel, so I don’t know much about it. However, my friends tell me that the hostel food in the mess is average, while the college cafeteria has good food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Facilities in the college are very good. The staff are helpful and well-behaved. All teachers are highly qualified. Teachers, clear your doubts in the classroom or personally in your cabins if you are shy to ask in class. The college makes you industry-ready.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college as compared to all private institutes in Odisha. 80% average placement.

detailed_review.Placements: 80% of students are placed. The highest package Is 45 LPA, and the minimum is 3 LPA. This is good compared to all colleges in Odisha and good private college in Odisha among all private colleges, and it has a good environment..
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good in hostel life, not like best, but it is okay. This is a very good college, and here 12 boys' hostels and 4 girls' hostels are available. All hostels are good, the food is good, and the environment is the best. It is the best college in Odisha compared to all private colleges.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good. The curriculum is also good, and exams are very strict. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry-ready. It's not very difficult, it's easy. A normal student can achieve above 8 CGPA by reading studying two weeks before the exam.
detailed_review.Other: I thought this college was best for me as I cannot go outside of Odisha, and this is a very good college, as I had heard.

reviews.review_title: Good faculty, bad placements.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement in our college is very average, with around 60% of students getting placed every year. However, the packages are very low, around 2-3 LPA on average, with the highest being 6 LPA. The top recruiting company is Quickflex, and students usually get very few internship opportunities. Only about 8-9 students get internships every year, and even those are not in good places.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a library and an e-library, but they are only open until 5 PM. There are AC classrooms, and each contains a projector screen. The college building does not have Wi-Fi, but the hostel has 24/7 Wi-Fi available. However, when the power goes off, there is no generator, so nothing works. There is a canteen on the college campus that is open until 9-10 PM and delivers anytime to your hostel. The mess food is average. Some days they make good food, but other days it cannot be eaten. There are 24/7 medical facilities available at the college hospital, which is around 3 km away from the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are quite knowledgeable and helpful, not just with the curriculum but also if you have any personal problems. Most teachers are either retired professors from reputed colleges or those who have studied at NLUs. The curriculum is the same as that of many NLUs. I don't think it makes students industry-ready, as it is just book-based. The semester exams are moderate, and around 70% of students pass the examinations.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about this course is that you get practical knowledge about society. The fees are low, and you get decent facilities and faculty. Every year, a fest is organized where you can participate or just enjoy your time. It continues for 2 days. I wish they had better placements and a bigger college campus so that more activities could be held.

reviews.review_title: College is average. Placements are quite good, and hostel is also okay.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements were quite decent, not much higher or not much lower. The incharge of placement cell was supportive but first you have to make a good impression on them. So that you will be recognised and can get placed. This can be your boon as well as curse.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities were quite good. They charged Rs 95,000/- per year for the students who preferred AC and for non-AC students, the hostel fee was Rs 60,000/- per year. Hostel provided very good environment but the canteen food was not tasty. They should work on it and make tasty and more hygienic food.
detailed_review.Faculty: They provided us with a chance to grow. Teachers were well qualified. They had helping nature, and full of knowledge but there were some exceptions too. Some teachers were painted on the head. They just teach the 1st benchers and leave. They should take some proper responsibility for this. But the course makes us more motivated towards our future. The difficulties for semester exam were not that tough, it was average. If you study well, then you will surely score well.
detailed_review.Other: I preferred SOA National Institute of Law because the review was quite good. I also wanted to pursue law because of my own interest.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the infrastructure and location but have good faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: I have not seen many students to seat in the placement. They prefer to join any company from their internship, or they go for other options. Our college does not offer any internships to the students. They have to find an internship on their own, even they don't suggest any good companies either.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college campus is not near the main road so there is an issue with traveling. Infrastructure is good but there is no sports and games facility. Hostel food is really bad. Canteen food is also not good and does not have proper hygiene. We are not provided with Wi-Fi password, and the internet connectivity is slow. Classrooms are good, and all the rooms have AC.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our faculty members are very helpful but when it comes to teaching, some faculty members are not that good. Semester exams are not that difficult, and passing percentage is 40%. There are many class tests, group discussions, and presentations that help in public speaking and intellectual thinking.
detailed_review.Other: Our college needs to improve its crowd work, students generally do not interact with each other, and many of us do not know our seniors or juniors. Our college doesn't provide scholarships anymore.

reviews.review_title: Detailed review of IDS SOA, Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: We don't get placement options. But we get paid internships, then we can't further pursue higher studies or work in a hospital till we get enough experience to establish our own clinics. We can go to other seminars for good results.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Course is up to date with current medical standards, and hostel is very clean and provides basic necessities. There is a better study environment in hostel and also bare minimum disturbance. Food is also good. Mess is clean and every day room cleaning is also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are helpful and provide practical experience. They complete the curriculum thoroughly and are patient enough even with the slow students. They provide doubt clearing sessions even in their off hours. Course is all about dentistry.

faqs.question: What is the total fees of SOA BTech programme?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for the BTech programme at SOA University ranges between INR 5.1 Lakhs - INR 11 lakhs. This range of fees does not include the cost of the mess or the hostel fee. There is a range in the fee structure because the fee for each specialisation can be slightly different from the other. The BTech programme at SOA University is also provided as a three-year lateral entry programme and in this case, the candidates will not have to pay for the first year of the prgramme. The fee mentioned here is taken from unofficial sources and can be indicative.

faqs.question: How is admission determined for the BTech programme at SOA University?
faqs.answer: Entry into the BTech programme of SOA University is based on appraising the merit of the candidates either through the performance in the SOA Admission Test (SAAT) or through the JEE Main. A valid JEE Main score leads to exemption in taking the SAAT exam. To this end, the university will use a multi dimensional method of evaluation where the performance of an applicant in a national scale entry examination is taken along with union test on admission (which will be developed by the university) to make a proper and equitable evaluation of applicants seeking to pursue a BTech programme.

faqs.answer: For admissions to the BTech course at SOA University, the university accepts the scores of SAAT. Moreover, candidates can access and fill out the SAAT (Siksha 'O' Anusandhan Admission Test) application form from the official website of SOA University. At the admission protal of the univeristy, the application form of SAAT is available. Candidates can fill out the form with requried details. Note: candidates can appear for SAAT only once per programme.

Many got good out-of-campus placements, and many were placed in good colleges for higher studies. detailed_review.Infrastructure: To be fair, I consider infrastructure to be worth the money in college. We are getting good 24/7 Wi-Fi, classrooms with smart boards, personal desktops, and charging ports. Many say hostel food was not nice in Amrita, but for me, it's somewhat good compared to other colleges, I think. They may repeat the same menu across a week, but the quality of food is okay to eat. In the canteen, we can get non-veg, so it's also somewhat good, not perfect.

No semester importance, just projects and their reviews, making us hands-on with hardware and software to apply to real-world problems.

Out of 260+ students, around 180 are placed in top companies, while others get mass recruitment opportunities and wait for offers. The highest package is 24 LPA, the lowest is 3.5 LPA, and average is 6 LPA to 7 LPA. Top recruiters included Qualcomm, Texas Instruments, Intel, Cisco, TCS, and Infosys. About 60% secured internships at reputed firms like Qualcomm, Bosch, and TI. Roles offered range from VLSI and embedded engineer to software developer and network engineer, providing strong opportunities in both core and IT domains.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Electronics and communication department at Amrita Coimbatore has well-equipped labs, smart classrooms with Wi-Fi, and access to a vast library and digital resources. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms, study space, and 24X7 Wi-Fi. The mess provides nutritious food with both South and North Indian options, though taste can vary. Medical facilities include a dedicated health center with ambulance support. Campus has excellent sports infrastructure, including indoor and outdoor courts, gym facilities, and grounds for cricket and football, ensuring overall development. The environment is safe, disciplined, and supportive for both academics and personal growth.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members in the electronics and communication department at Amrita Coimbatore are highly qualified, approachable, and supportive, with many holding PhDs and industry exposure. The curriculum is regularly updated with electives, labs, and projects that align well with current industry needs, especially in VLSI, embedded systems, and communication. Teaching quality is good, with a focus on both fundamentals and practical learning. Semester exams are moderately difficult, designed to test understanding rather than written learning. The pass percentage is usually high (above 90%), as students receive sufficient guidance, assignments, and remedial sessions to ensure strong academic performance.
detailed_review.Other: I graduated in 2025 from the department of ECE. Events happen in my college but are mostly traditional.

Sometimes the faculty also helps with this. Our faculty members also offer dissertations, but they encourage students to apply outside the university.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our department is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi, AC, a water purifier, and a projector. To conduct experiments, all necessary facilities are available in our lab, including RT-PCR, qPCR, BSL-2, a cell culture room, and a Virus culture lab. Our university has a central library near my department, where you can issue any two books for 14 days. The central canteen has good quality food at a cheap rate, and many other shops are also there. In this course, you have to give two sessional exams, each worth 20 marks, and a final exam of 60 marks. 40 percent marks are needed in every exam to pass.
detailed_review.Other: The university and departments organize many events, but the best event is the annual university event. My department organized an international symposium last year. admission.title: Jamia Millia Islamia Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
JMI admission 2026 will be as per the score of the entrance exam. The university has made its prospectus available in March along with the admission schedule for courses with national-level and university-level entrance exams. JMI, New Delhi provides more than 220 courses both in regular and self-financed modes. The university also offers distance learning courses at UG, PG, and diploma levels.

JMI admissions 2026 are majorly on the basis of CUET and JMI entrance. Applicants who want to get a seat to one of the programmes have to take part in the process of admission through the steps provided below:

1. Eligibility:

Applicants have to go to the official website.

2. Apply Online:

Candidates must apply through the application form on the official website of the institute.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Jamia Millia Islamia?
faqs.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia admission to UG and PG courses is entrance exams based. The university accepts JMI entrance exam, CUET and JEE Main for admission. Further, to be eligible for admission, students also need to pass Class 12 with 50% for admission to UG courses and a graduation degree with 50-55% aggregate for admission to PG courses.

faqs.question: Does Jamia Millia Islamia accept CUET score?
faqs.answer: Yes, Jamia Millia Islamia accepts CUET scores for UG courses such as BA, BSc and BVoc. Jamia Millia Islamia admission is based on entrance exam score. The university released its prospectus for admissions in March with the schedule for admission to courses accepting national-level and university-level entrance exams. JMI, New Delhi offers over 220 courses in both regular and self-financed modes. The university also provides distance learning courses at undergraduate (UG), postgraduate (PG), and Diploma levels.

faqs.question: What is the reservation percentage for Muslim candidates at JMI?
faqs.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia offers seat reservations in almost all the courses based on the category of the students. Candidates seeking JMI admission under the reserved category can apply for reservation under one category only and are required to fulfil the prescribed eligibility conditions of the course. More details regarding JMI reservation criteria are enlisted below: More details on the reservation criteria and relaxation offered to students across course eligibility are available in the official 2023 prospectus of JMI .

faqs.question: How can I get into JMI for BA or BA (Hons)?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to Jamia Millia Islamia for BA must have passed Class 12 or SSC with a minimum aggregate ranging from 40-50%. The passing percentage is different for different specialisations offered in the BA programme. Admission to Jamia Millia Islamia for BA and BA (Hons) is subject to either CUET (conducted by NTA) or JMI entrance exam. Till 2021, admission was subject to the JMI entrance exam across all specialisations. However, starting 2022, admission to a few BA (Hons) specialisations is CUET-based and for the rest, it is university-level entrance-based. Interested candidates can apply online for all courses on the official website of JMI or CUET.

faqs.question: I've scored less than 60% in 12th boards, can I get admission in Jamia Millia Islamia?
faqs.answer: To get admission at Jamia Millia Islamia in BA course, the score needed is between 45% to 50% based on different specialisations. Interested students need to visit official website of JMI and check admission details and eligibity criteria of course they want to apply.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for BA (Hons) at JMI?

sections.heading: Introduction
text: Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) is one of the premier educational institutions, offering a holistic learning experience blended with vibrant campus life. Jamia Millia Islamia strives to build a modern learning system with a vision to promote the sustainable development of society and betterment for all. It caters to the needs of lakhs of students by being a hub of knowledge, offering a variety of UG, PG, Diploma and Doctoral programs, and fostering intellectual curiosity and innovation in their lives. The University also offers top-notch infrastructure facilities encompassing a vast library, hostels, games & sports facilities, and its affiliated schools. To learn more about the JMI infrastructure details, read the article below:

sections.heading: Jamia Millia Islamia Campus Highlights 2024
text: Jamia Millia Islamia is accredited as the NAAC A++ central university and ranked in the 3rd position under top universities by the NIRF Ranking Report 2024. It is a Delhi-based institution working as a comprehensive research-intensive central (Public) University. It was established in Aligarh by nationalist leaders and students of Aligarh Muslim University in 1920, and relocated to Delhi in 1925. Funded by national and international agencies, it is furnished through cutting-edge research programs, infrastructure facilities and academic collaboration, which help it achieve academic excellence all over the world.

sections.heading: Jamia Millia Islamia Sports Facilities
text: The JMI campus has its indoor sports complex with a separate Cricket ground, basketball and lawn tennis courts designed based on International standards. The outreach of JMI sports and recreational facilities has grown regularly and is used not only by students but also by corporate houses, NGOs, Amateur and Professional Sports Associations and Clubs, DDCA and others. It has hosted Ranji Trophy, Women's Cricket Test matches, Women's World Cup matches, and Blind Cricket World Cup matches on its Jamia Cricket Ground, also known as Bhopal Cricket Ground, in the past.

highlights.summary:
IIT Gandhinagar was founded in 2008 and it is ranked 25 th in NIRF 2025 in the Engineering category. This is also a prestigious college which is ranked 11th by India Today 2024 in Engineering (Government) category and the 12th in Engineering category.
Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar IIT Gandhinagar has got e-Masters degree programme in Energy Policy and Regulation that is offered over 2 years. The institute has also initiated application to batch 2 e- Masters in Energy Policy and Regulation and there is no GATE requirement to be admitted. The qualification criterion of the candidates is that he must have either a Bachelor or a Master degree in any of the related fields like Engineering, Economics, Law, Commerce, Management, or Finance. Moreover, IIT Gandhinagar e-Masters in Energy Policy and Regulation accept at least 60 percent marks or 6.0 CGPA. Applicants are required to submit their application in the official site to IITGN e-Masters programme. Though a fee of INR 1000 is required to be paid by the candidates.
IIT Gandhinagar is a government institute, which was founded in 2008. The best companies like Accenture, Cred, D E Shaw, Oracle, Salesforce, and many more visit the institute. In the current period, IIT Gandhinagar placements 2024 the average package was INR 18.20 LPA. Through different departments, Indian institute of technology (Gandhinagar) provides UG,PG, PhD and online courses to students. Such courses will be offered in Chemical Engineering, Maths, Physics and in other streams. The admissions of IIT Gandhinagar are determined by merit and scores on the entrance examination.
Indian Institute of Technology, Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) has Central Instrumentation facility, Cognitive Science Labs, Molecular and Cellular Biology Lab and provides many facilities to the students. The institute library subscribes core collection (over 70) of e-journals, e-books, databases, and other materials to facilitate the research works of the students. The college is associated with flagship courses of BTech and MTech. The key attractions of IIT Gandhinagar are given in a tabular form as below:

college_info_program.intro:
IIT Gandhinagar popular courses are BTech and MTech. The course curriculum for both courses is flexible. There is a creative learning centre, curriculum-wide project-based learning, a writing studio, and various facilities available for Engineering students. IITGN chemical engineering is also widely pursued by the students. After graduating, BTech and MTech students can work as Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Analysts, or take up various other job roles that are relevant to their profile. Overall, IIT Gujarat students are placed in top companies and grab one of the best opportunities available in the job market.
Apart from this, IITGN e-Masters degree programme is also offered for the duration of 2 years. The institute has started accepting applications for batch 2 e-Masters in Energy Policy and Regulation with No GATE score required for admission. The eligibility requirement for the candidates is to have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline such as Engineering, Economics, Law, Commerce, Management, or Finance. In addition to this, a minimum of 60% marks or a 6.0 CGPA is accepted for IIT Gandhinagar e-Masters in Energy Policy and Regulation. Candidates must visit the official website to apply for IIT Gandhinagar e-Masters programme. However, a fee of INR 1000 is mandatory to be made by the candidates. The course comprises six modules spread over 52 credits, with each module lasting 12 to 14 weeks.
