reviews.review_title: My honest review about my college.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch had almost 25 students, out of which only 11 got placed in companies such as HCL, Tech Mahindra, etc. Packages ranged from 4.5 LPA to 12 LPA. Some mid-sized companies also came for campus recruitment and selected approximately 40% of students who appeared for interviews. The packages they offered ranged from 3 to 10 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The entire curriculum took 18 months to complete. Some aspects covered in the curriculum represented the views on India’s water security. It included the development of learning materials related to the sea security of India. Marine engineering students received special benefits from the course. No, I didn’t opt for the hostel. The hostel fee was Rs. 10,000 per year. The infrastructure was good. Free electricity, free water including hot water, a free table and chair, free Wi-Fi, and free parking for cars and bikes were provided. A guard was present, and reading room facilities were available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were very active and helpful. They even shared their contact numbers to assist us. They did not skip any topic and made sure that everyone understood the concepts clearly. Teachers only came to the university on weekends since we were from distance education. The best part was that the teachers informed us in advance if they were not going to be present. There were 19 subjects taught by my college, each with the best faculty for both theoretical and clinical knowledge. All 19 subjects were divided into 4 professional levels and taught by 4 types of faculty, i.e., Professors, Associate Professors, Assistant Professors, and Lecturers.

reviews.review_title: Overall, it is the best college for a PhD in Chemistry course.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70% of the students qualified in the last batch. The highest salary package offered is 35 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 9 LPA. The average salary package offered is 17 LPA. Top companies like Tata Chemical, Ranbaxy, Sun Pharmaceutical, etc., visit the college to hire students. More than 60% of the students secured internships in industry. Both education and technical training are available. Higher-level roles like research scientist, patent scientist, etc., are offered here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Gandhinagar is located in one of the best locations in India. It has exclusive campuses with a library, exclusive hotels with multiple daily outlets, and two agglomerations. It has a sports stadium with impressive sports facilities, an Olympic-size swimming pool, badminton courts, basketball courts, etc. It also has two cricket and football pitches.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful but their teaching is not at all good. Students are not happy with teachers. Some teachers take 3-4 days leave in a week. Otherwise, the college is good. Semester exams are a little tough and the pass percentage is 57%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Integrated Circuit Design and Technology
reviews.review_title: Placement, campus life, research and growth - IIT Gandhinagar.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2024, IIT Gandhinagar placement has seen a recession. About 164 students have registered for the placements, of whom 125 students successfully secured a job. The average package was Rs 18.20 LPA overall. The average package of BTech CSE students was around 22.73 LPA, while MTech CSE students secured an average package of 21.05 LPA. Still, it is better than last year, in which 398 students registered, of whom 163 were placed, making an average package of 19.60 LPA. This year, one of the 4th year electrical engineering students got an offer of 48 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: One of the best thing I liked the most about IIT Gandhinagar is its sports facilities. If you are a sportsperson, you should definitely opt this. It has a sports complex which has indoor playing facilities for volleyball, badminton, basketball, and table tennis. Also, 2 indoor swimming pools are also available 24/7 except for Monday, which is the cleaning day. The Gym here is very large and fits with AC. Talking of outdoor games: it has 2 big grounds for cricket with big lights, which are typically in stadiums; it also has a big ground for football around which an athletic track was drawn. Net practice for cricket and tennis is also available. Coming to the hostel: All room have AC, which is centrally controlled. One downside for freshmen is that you have to adjust in a 4 sharing, which is built for 3. 4th year students get a single sharing room. All the bathrooms are properly cleaned every day. It has support for both cold and hot water to bathe with. The lights are automated. Each floor in the hostel have a fridge, one water cooler, one microwave and an induction cooker. They also provide laundry facilities twice a week. Mess food are nearly nice for veggies ( as Gujaratis prefer veg more) and you have to pay an amount of $60 for eating nonveg (but egg are free). Inside the campus canteens, Amul shop, general grocery, stationary and sports shops are available. library is best as long as you not opt for story books. All classrooms are connected with ac, 2/3 projectors. Labs are very well maintained and have great facilities. You can go anytime and 3d print a part you want to. Inter-Hotel movement is allowed and there is also no restriction for going out of campus in the night. The college provide bus facility to go out of campus to nearby by market. The unlimited wi-fi is available all places on campus, giving an average speed of 700mbps mbps on the phone and 250mbps mbps on the laptop. Of course you can connect laptop with ethernet to get higher speed. We have a students lounge inside the campus which has games like football, chess, etc. The unique thing I discovered here is the skywalk. Most of the hostels and mess are connected with an overhead bridge.
detailed_review.Faculty: I am joined in the ICDT branch. Of course, after the breakthrough in AI, it will flourish in the future. Also, there is going to be new industries setting up in Gujarat. The curriculum includes VLSE Design, Microelectronics, Physics of Transistors, Asynchronous Circuit Design, Analog CMOS IC Design, IC Design Lab, Nanoscale Device Engineering, Microfabrication and Semiconductor Process, Machine Learning, Memory Device Technologies and Applications.
detailed_review.Other: I choose this course because it is already available in IITH and gained a much more demand in 2-3 years. I also think that similar will happen hear also. The course does not contain more electronics topics, it mighty added for the future batch. Coming to event IIT Gandhinagar is not performing that much good. The Ganesh Chaturthi was held in a smaller way. Not much decoration and not much sounds and stuff like that. I thought that there will be garba nights during Navratri but as soon as holiday announced most of the students gone home. Our cultural fest is going to be held in march or so. Other clubs are also organize their fest from November onwards. But you get lot of extracurricular activities to do. Too much project to keep you engaged. You will be making car models, prepare the design of your own product and making that and lot more. This provides a great platform to show your design and innovative skill.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college infrastructure is very good. I am disappointed by the overall placement.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college has a good placement ratio. This year, its placement was 76.02%, with the college average package being 19.02 LPA. Note the difference in college average package and branch average package; both are different. From my course, 98.9% was placement ratio, and internships are available in Samsung, Microsoft, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have good speed of Wi-Fi around 100 MB/s, with fully furnished labs. The classroom and library are amazing. The library also has a kids' zone and full ACs. It's like a wow! It has a very wide collection of books and resources and even contains CDs. We have various shops inside the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have a different curriculum from all the IITs, which makes our IIT unique. Teachers are very knowledgeable, and if you go to them, they are always ready to help. The curriculum will guarantee you will be industry-ready. The semester exams are at a moderate level, and the pass percentage varies with each subject.

reviews.review_title: Excellent infrastructure and faculty members. Research culture is groundbreaking.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in mechanical engineering are decent. Around 75-80% of students got placed last year in various departments including automobile, manufacturing, and consulting. The median salary package offered is around 17.5 LPA - 18 LPA. Many students get internships in their 5th semester at different companies such as TCS, Wipro, Siemens, L&T, Infosys, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college offers a range of facilities designed to support students in their research and learning. Some of them are well-furnished and fully air-conditioned classrooms along with Wi-Fi, advanced teaching aids, smartboards, and multimedia systems to enhance the learning experience. The library is the core of our college with a vast number of academic-related books, along with a good collection of comics, journals, mythology, self-improvement, and biography books. The main library is accessible for 17 hours a day, and you can also book study rooms in the library to study with your friends. All the hostel rooms are fully air-conditioned and interconnected with common rooms in each hostel. In rooms, you will get a bed, a study table, a chair with a night light just above the table, and a spacious almirah. Apart from that, our college has come up with the new emerging idea of an open culture to encourage learning and demolish the boundaries between opposite genders. As a result, you can go to opposite-gender hostel rooms without any restrictions.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very helpful and well-qualified. Their teaching style has a remarkable impact on students. The course is very relevant and focuses not only on theoretical study but also on practical learning, encouraging students to learn and implement what they have learned. Semester exams reflect what we have learned in the lectures, although exams are not that difficult. The relative grading policy makes it more challenging and encourages continuous learning.

reviews.review_title: IIT Gandhinagar short review.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement here is decent. Not very big companies tend to come here for placements. The main reason for that might be the fact that the computer science branch has been recently introduced here, but definitely it will significantly improve over time as more cs branches such as AI have been introduced here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
It has the best hostel facilities. If you opt for the newly built hostels, they will provide you with triple, double, and single(mostly in final and pre-final year). Each floor has a kitchen with an induction microwave and a fridge. Bathrooms are like for 5-7 people. There is a bathroom mostly all the hostels have bathroom of both ends of the corridor except for the old hostels, which only have 2 bathrooms on each floor, but they are big ones. 
Coming towards the labs for my course, they are also good. They almost have all the machinery which is also accessible to all the students. So far as projects are concerned, they tend to reimburse the material that has been consumed in that.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams here are quite tough as the professor here tries to check your understanding of the topic; therefore, if your basic understanding of the topic is not clear, you will not be able to score well in exams. We follow a 2-examination system followed by multiple quizzes during the semester. Also, there are some assignments which are also part of grading. Grading is totally dependent on the professor, and no one can comment on that. Mostly, the professor follows relative grading compared to absolute grading.
detailed_review.Other: There is very less crowd and campus life here because the intake here is very low. The last year intake was just 400 in BTech and the total strength of students would just be around 2500, which is just 2 years of strength of some bigger IITs. Due to which there is not very diverse culture here. But as the new hostels are being made, intake would also increase.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT Gandhinagar: Pros and cons.

detailed_review.Placements: I am enrolled in B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and the placements were quite good. Almost all the students who were interested in placements got placed. The average package was around 25 LPA for CSE. The top recruiting companies that visited our campus were Graviton, Texas Instruments, Zomato, etc. Talking about internships, around 70% of the CSE students got summer internships in various companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of IIT Gandhinagar is very good and world-class. The hostel and academic buildings have outstanding architecture. High-speed wifi is available all the time. The library is also there where students can go and study; almost all varieties of books are available there. Computer labs are also available for students to use every time.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors here are highly qualified and have quite vast knowledge of their subjects. Students are encouraged to take research projects under the professors, which is quite helpful for the students who want to make their career in academia. The course curriculum is very relevant and latest. There are two exams per semester, i.e., midterm and endterm exams.
detailed_review.Other: The institute offers great facilities for sport. Students are encouraged to take one sport along with their studies.

reviews.review_title: Best IIT campus in India.

detailed_review.Placements: There is campus placement at the college. There are so many companies that select students on the basis of written and oral interviews. There is a 6 lacs per year average package at the college. Students who are in the final semester can take part in the placement process. Students get an internship opportunity based on their academic score and performance. Teachers also recommend students for the internship opportunity. There is some internship opportunity, which is to consider students for foreign study and research.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In the room, there is one cupboard, one bed mattress and a set of tables and chairs. The process of hostel registration is the same as the admission process. In the morning, there is breakfast; in the afternoon, they provide lunch; in the evening, snacks with tea or coffee; and in the night, they serve dinner.
detailed_review.Faculty: In IIT Gandhinagar, the course curriculum is based on semester-wise exams. All of the faculty are well qualified and well versed in their field. Every faculty member is very helpful and you can interact one-on-one with them after the class. I have completed my graduation in the mathematics and IITs are also providing a Masters degree in mathematics, so we chose M.Sc. Mathematics. There were semester-wise exams and in every semester we had a mid-semester exam and an end-semester exam. Apart from this, there were quizzes every 15-20 days.
detailed_review.Other: In the college, there are different kinds of festivals, like the annual fest, Blithchron and the technical fest, Amalthea. There are different kinds of sports events, like CCL and Hall Bol. There are so many sports events in the Hall Bol tournament.

reviews.review_title: Review of B.Tech in Electronics from the IIT, Gandhinagar.

detailed_review.Placements: All the students of this branch of engineering were getting placements opportunities at the IITGN. The average package offered at this college was 4–7 LPA. The top recruiting companies were TCS, Philips, Infosys, Wipro, Tata Motors, etc. Most of the students were also getting internship opportunities at this college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This college had very good infrastructure for our course. The college had labs for our course with all the required equipment. Wi-Fi, library, sports, canteen, etc. facilities were also available on the college campus for the students. The hostel facility was also available for the students. The food in the hostel mess was good to eat. The quality of the rooms in the hostel was also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our college had highly qualified and knowledgeable teachers for our course. All the teachers were giving proper practical and theoretical knowledge to the students. The course curriculum of the IITGN was relevant and made the students industry-ready. Exams were not that easy to pass at this college.

reviews.review_title: Great exposure with next level learnings.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements are excellent and the college has maintained a record of 100% placement results. The average package offered was somewhere around 19 Lacs. The top recruiters were IT companies like Infosys, Oracle, Accenture, Rakuten, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good with the Wi-Fi available across the campus. The laboratories are very advanced and the campus has different laboratories as per various discipline options available. The library is well stocked with the latest resources along with the classrooms being modern.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are very well-experienced and qualified. They are enriched with good industry exposure and are scholars from good Universities. The curriculum is nicely crafted wherein it is made to be rigorous and industry-oriented and focuses on both theoretical and practical aspects.

reviews.review_title: A college with good qualities.

detailed_review.Placements: If I am supposed to talk about the placements given by this institute, I can say that it is very average, not all the students are placed well, only about thirty to forty percent of students got placed every year, which is not bad at all. The average package of the students is about 10 lacs per year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If I talk about the infrastructure of the institution, I can say that buildings were creatively made, they were restricted for outsiders to enter the institute, and there were playing areas, libraries, and cultural activities areas over there. The best part of the hostel is the cleanliness maintained by staff, and it serves good food.
detailed_review.Faculty: If I am supposed to say something about the faculty, the best part of this institute is that the faculty members who are working here are really well qualified. Well-knowledgeable and head students and motivate the students in each and every step of their lives in those four years. The curriculum is well maintained to cover the syllabus in a semester.

reviews.review_title: Perfect infrastructure and facilities .

detailed_review.Placements: Companies like Amazon, Adani, Adobe, Amul, Bank of America, Byju's, Google, etc. are our past recruiters. Students were also offered international internships at RMIT University, University of Washington, etc. More of the placement and internship information is available on CDS IIT Gandhinagar website.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college's infrastructure is undoubtedly exceptional. Since it is a 2nd-generation IIT, it is well built with all the facilities provided. The hostels as well as the academic area have comprehensive infrastructure. The food and medical services are of high quality.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors here are friendly and helpful. Their high qualifications and knowledge contribute to their quality behavior. As far as I have known, the course curriculum does make the students industry-ready. The difficulty of exams depends on professors; they cannot explicitly say if they are difficult or easy; it varies according to different courses .

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the college facilities and decent placements great for research oriented students.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost everyone who applied for the placements got placed; the highest was around 60 LPA and the median would be around 14–15 LPA. Regarding internships, around 40% of students got internships. The internship recruiters were Atlassian, DE Shaw, Oracle, JSW, Puma, and Barclays. While some of these companies also came for placements, some other companies like Zomato, Nike, etc. also came for placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This is the best part of IIT GN. The hostel rooms are very well maintained, and we have AC's that work at night for a peaceful sleep. Good Wi-Fi and LAN facilities are available. Mess food is pretty decent. The sports complex is really the highlight of the campus. It's really well-equipped. There are two libraries: one in the academic area and one in the student hostel area.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are really good over here; they are always ready to collaborate with you if you are willing to work on a project. The course curriculum is dynamic in most of the courses and most of the courses are selected by the students themselves. Passing exams is easier but for scoring a good grade, consistency is important.

reviews.review_title: Good campus infrastructure and amenities along with academics, staff and very good faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80–85% of students get placed during the placement season. The highest package offered is 72 lacs per annum, with the average package being 27–30 lacs per annum. The lowest package varies each time from 9–10 lacs. The top recruiting companies are Google, DE Shaw, Barclays and other government-sector companies. Internships are offered mainly in the 3rd year of B.Tech. In my course, the main scope is a research area pursuing a Ph.D. in a particular field.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Gandhinagar has one of the best infrastructure in India, having separate academic building which includes library, separate hostel area with many outlets of daily routine, two messes (5-star rating by Fssai) and sports area which includes a magnificent sports complex with an Olympic-size swimming pool, badminton courts, indoor basketball court, etc. And two cricket and football grounds.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the faculty members on campus hold Ph.D. degrees in their respective fields, which means they are highly qualified to seek help. The course curriculum is designed with a student mindset in mind, and recently it has been reframed with an industrial and academic aspect. There are two exams in each semester: midsems and endsems, which are quite difficult, according to many students.
detailed_review.Other: Apart from academics, there are two big college fests: Amalthea (the teaching fest) and Blithchron (the cultural fest), which happen in November and March, respectively. Also, there is a sports fest open to the entire college community named Hallabol. If we talk about the location of the campus,  that is somewhat of an issue because it is located outside the city, and the only way to connect is by Uber, Ola or bus service from the college. The campus is located on the banks of the Sabarmati River and has a very beautiful scenic view in the evening and early morning. There are many cultural clubs, like Stepup (a dance club), Sargam (a music club) and many more. There is a very unique feature of hostels: they are co-ed, which means inter-hotel movements are allowed at night as well.

reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure and campus life, along with academics and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 95% of registered students get placed in my course. The average package is 14 LPA for MSE students. Most of the students go for higher education in this branch. Some of the institutions where the students of my branch are selected for higher studies are CALTECH, Clemson University, Illinois University, Colorado State University, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Each and every class and lab is equipped with a Wi-Fi router. Every department has its own building where all the labs and offices of professors of that course are present. There is a separate building for the library, which will be open until 2 a.m. There is also a mini-library in the hostel area, which will be open 24/7. Each and every room in the hostel is equipped with a Wi-Fi router and an air conditioner. The hostels and mess are of top quality. We also have a separate region dedicated to sports. We have an Olympic-size swimming pool, indoor courts made of synthetic material for all sports, and also an athletic track, football field, and cricket field. The sports facilities are also top-notch.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They will always be there for the students to solve doubts and help them regarding their careers. The course curriculum is relevant and also has many lab components, which make the students industry-ready. The difficulty of semester exams differs from professor to professor, but they will mostly be easy. And almost all the students pass. A very small percentage of students fail, and that too in at most 1 or 2 courses.
detailed_review.Other: We have an annual tech festival named Amalthea and an annual cultural festival named BLITHCHRON. We also have summer and winter vacations, which are held at the start of summer and winter.

reviews.review_title: Short Glimpse At IIT Gandhinagar.

detailed_review.Placements: Nearly 60% of students were placed in my course (Chemical Engineering), the highest salary so far was offered 52 LPA by Zomato, the average salary was around 12 LPA, and the lowest salary was around 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Barclay, DE Shaw, media, Oracle, etc. Top roles offered in our course are manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our campus is very nice. All the electricity comes from the solar panel. Currently, the solar panel capacity is 500kwp, 120kwp for hostels, and 190kwp of solar carport. We can see some buildings will have sharp edges which is unique. Also, the mess and canteen facilities are also quite good. There will be a spicy meal counter and a normal meal counter in the mess. The sports complex on our campus is equipped with a wide range of facilities. It offers a diverse array of sports, including squash.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are very friendly to teach the course. The course curriculum will be applicable mostly in our daily life. The content covered in the class will be very much less, only the fundamentals part will teach in the class. From the exam point of view there will be some easy to moderate questions and there will be very challenging and confusing questions that are difficult to approach. The pass percentage is nearly 30%.
detailed_review.Other: With the JEE rank that I got, I have chosen this chemical engineering branch. The best thing about my branch is it is very much hill branch compared to other branches. Also, we can do simultaneous coding, which would be helpful from the computing point of view. One of the events which was organized by our institute is Blitchron. It is a 2 cultural fest. The campus crowd is nearly 2000. In our B. Tech 22 branch, the strength was only 280 students. It is very much less compared to other IITs.

reviews.review_title: A new-generation IIT having excellent Campus Infrastructure named IIT Gandhinagar .

detailed_review.Placements: Placement for Mechanical Engineering is around 90%, and the average package is about 21 Lacs. Top recruiting companies are Amul, Puma, IBM, Amazon, Cognizant, Deloitte, Adobe etc. The highest package is around 76 Lacs and the lowest is 10 Lacs. Around 80-85% students got internship from mechanical engineering in various recruiters are University of Buffalo, Hiyoshi International, University of Wasington, Larson and Tourbo ltd, Texas A&M University etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities at IITGN are designed to provide students with a comfortable and conducive living environment. The institute boasts 12 centrally air-conditioned and furnished hostels, accommodation over 2600 students. Each hostel has a unique name, such Aibaan, Beauki, Chimair, Duven, Emit, Firpeal, Griwiksh, Hiqom, Ijoka, Jurqia, Kyzeel and Lekhaag. IITGN takes pride in being India's first 5-star campus in food safety and healthy eating, offering nutritious and hygienically prepared meals in a hostel mess. All the sports facilities are available. A medical center is also there which includes the qualified doctors and physio.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the teachers are well qualified and helpful to resolve all your doubt and able to create a friendly environment with student. Course curriculum is structured in a way that student can relate with real-life problems and involves industry based projects. Yes, course curriculum makes the students industry ready. The exams difficult level is moderate to high. The pass percentage depends from course to course and professor to professor. But generally it is 40%.
detailed_review.Other: At IITGN, many cultural activities happen. IITGN's annual cult fest, Blithchrone, makes the students feel a different level of enjoyment and entertainment. The yearly teach-summit named Amelthia that make students to feel the teach stardom that an IIT brings in students. Then there comes Hallabol that is 11 to 12 days of sports event, where 6-7 member student teams participate in 6-7 games like seven-stone, gully cricket, footvolly etc. Another event named Ted-x that includes with ted-talks of popular people.

reviews.review_title: Good opportunity for internship.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement is quite good with around ninety percent of the students getting placed. The highest package that was offered was around twenty-five Lacs per annum an the average of our batch was around twelve Lacs per annum and companies like Tata Motors came.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels have central Air conditioning and also in the classroom and the hostel offers single and double sharing options and in both, you have attached the washrooms facility. There is medical support and a sports complex and a few recreational areas are also there.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is up-to-date date and is designed keeping in mind the industry relevancy. The semester are challenging but the passing percent range is around 80 to 85 percent. The faculty members are very knowledgeable and have few industry collaborations.

reviews.review_title: Best Campus in the world.

detailed_review.Placements: Top companies are Atlassian, Skan.ai, Accenture India and Japan, Zomato, and DE Shaw. The highest placement this year was 52 LPA from Zomato, with a package cost of 21,00,000. Due to the recession, there is a lower percentage of people getting placed this year. The highest PPO, as per my knowledge, is 60 LPA by Atlassian.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We all have Wi-Fi in every room, and air conditioning in every room. Every hostel floor is facilitated with a refrigerator, oven, induction stove, and water cooler. As for the classrooms and library, they are attached with all-time running air conditioning. The mess is also of 5-star quality.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and hold Ph.D. degrees from well-known universities with very good knowledge of the subject. The course curriculum is relevant, but too many assignments make it hard for self-study. Regarding the difficulty of semester exams, they will be quite tough.
detailed_review.Other: IIT Gandhinagar has a very good campus. Inter disciplinary facility of the college makes it unique.

reviews.review_title: Empowering the Future : A closer look at IIT Gandhinagar, where excellence meets opportunity.

detailed_review.Placements: The college maintains a commendable placement rate, with 85–95% of students securing job offers. All the disciplines have a good average salary. The average salary of a CSE is 29.29 LPA and the overall average salary is 19.6 LPA. There is a 29% increment in average salary and an 18% increment in median salary. The top companies which offered jobs include Accenture, cred, D.E. Shaw, Oracle, Salesforce, Texas Instruments, etc. About 30% of students got jobs in IT/software companies, 33% in engineering and technology,  13% in Finance,  6% in consulting,  9% in Education,  5% in services and 4% in R&D.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
About infrastructure:
Everything is good, from the library to the mess to the academic blocks. All classrooms come with air conditioning and high-speed Wi-Fi for a comfortable learning environment. The library, which is also air-conditioned, serves as a prime spot for exam preparation. The sports facilities at this institute stand out among all IITs. We have an Olympic-size swimming pool, a cricket ground, a football field, an athletic track, and both indoor and outdoor courts for basketball, volleyball, and badminton. Beyond that, there are squash courts, a table tennis facility, a gymnasium, and even a yoga room.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of our college is very helpful and highly experienced and most of the faculty members are Ph.D. holders with good research experience from the top universities in India and abroad. The curriculum and syllabus are quite accessible and updated on a regular basis.

faqs.question: How can I join IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.answer: IIT Gandhinagar admission process is entirely based on the selection of candidates via popular entrance exams such as JEE Advanced and GATE, etc., for courses such as BTech and MTech, respectively. Further, IIT Gandhinagar conducts an institute-level test for the selection MA and PhD courses. Candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria as per the course requirements and then qualify for the respective entrance exam in order to secure a seat at IIT Gandhinagar. Later on, the final seat allotment is done through counselling process.

faqs.question: When can I apply for PhD admission at IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.answer: Admissions to PhD at IIT Gandhinagar generally opens up toward the beginning and end of each academic year. In addition to the announced admission cycles with a prescribed deadline of application, the institute also considers applications for any time of the year for exceptional candidates. Based on the qualifications of the candidates and the need of the specialisation, applications received are processed via duly constituted selection committees at regular intervals. Currently, PhD admissions are open for Start Early courses and via a Special Drive for OBC (NCL)/ SC/ ST/ PWD catgeory students.

Below are the steps of application:- Go to the official website of GATE and register. Fill the application form with relevant personal, educational, and other details in the empty fields. facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: The students are accommodated in six different hostels, namely: Aibaan, Beauki, Chimair, Duven, Emiet and Firpeal. In each hostel, a resident caretaker follows up on all routine maintenance issues. Each student is issued basic furniture including chair, study table, cot and mattress at the beginning of the academic year. Students in all hostels have access to a common room, laundry and canteen facilities within their respective hostels. There is a general store within the hostel premises to provide the students with basic necessities like stationary, toiletries and snacks.

reviews.course: B.Tech.-M.Tech. Integrated Dual Degree in Bio-Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely loving it, it's a different place, good interactions, lovely nature, and best placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Very good placement states most of the big companies like Google, Microsoft, Nvidia, Adobe, Samsung, and Zomato come for both internships and placements as well, and being honest, most of the interns get PPO as well, and later companies also come for placement, so almost everyone gets placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel is good, I mean nice bus, not as good as it could be because of obvious reasons, the physical location of IIT Mandi is in the mountains and there it is not possible to construct such big buildings, but we are provided with common room, pantry room, vending machines shared between hostels nearby, study room, washing machines, and fridge all.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is good here, we are provided with multiple courses and a chance to gain good and greater knowledge in our own domain. We are also free to do some courses in other domains as well, in case someone wants that knowledge. Semester exams are quite average, and more than 95% pass the exams.
detailed_review.Other: I chose bioengineering because I have interest in pursuing higher studies in this domain only. No such major improvements as of now. College has events like Rann-neeti, Exodia, Expect, and a small fest celebration. All festivals are celebrated.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It's the most beautiful college with such a beautiful environment, It's lovely.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all are placed. We have many companies that visit our college for hiring, including Japanese, Indian, and US companies. It's a very good opportunity to be part of such a college, as there's less competition or fewer students vying for a role, leading to more opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course curriculum is good, and all the required facilities are in the hostel as well. We have laundry, a pantry, sports rooms, a fan, a table, a chair, and an almira (cupboard), everything in our rooms. Wi-Fi facilities, well-established labs, and nice classrooms with a projector, board and AC.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are conducted fairly, and the faculty are helpful and easily approachable. The curriculum keeps changing according to growing requirements, and such a good curriculum is a blessing. Semester exams are at a good level, if you study in class and keep studying, you can perform better.
detailed_review.Other: Events happen thrice every year. We have gym, swimming pool, sports, and club facilities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Collection is awesome, such a beautiful location.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of students got placed. The highest salary is about 1 crore, and the lowest salary is about 5 LPA. Recruiting companies include Atlassian, Nvidia, Google, and Microsoft. 90% of students got internships. Software developer and website developer are the roles offered. Truly speaking in this IIT, we are given everything and because of less strength of students its easy to get placed in top MNCs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteens, medical, classroom with AC, sports, mess, and all are available on campus. We have common room, study room, Wi-Fi, vending machine, pantry room, and laundry room. We also have table, chair, and almirah in hostel. Its a good experience to live on such a beautiful campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and reachable as required for internships and placements. Exams are easy going. I really feel faculty members here are very good, they cover all course related stuff which is quite helpful in industrial work as well. We have lots of projects to do in the semester which are good enough.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course for the IIT tag.

reviews.review_title: Heaven in mountains - IIT Mandi.

detailed_review.Placements: My branch is new, and I am in the first batch of the mathematics and computing branch. But, we can get jobs in the IT sector easily, like CSE and DSE students. The placement percentage in CSE is around 90%, and we also get offers from top companies like Google, Microsoft, and Nvidia
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classes are in very good condition, and the cleanliness is top-tier. For summer, there is air conditioning, and for winter, there are heaters. The Wi-Fi is also good. The mess food is good, and sports facilities are very good. All the grounds are well-maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, and they encourage students to research and ask questions during classes. They are highly qualified. The curriculum is great, and it makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are not that difficult, and the passing percentage is around 95%.
detailed_review.Other: I have a great interest in mathematics, so I chose this course. Along with math, they also teach us the coding aspects. My course is already good, and I don't have any complaints about it. Events and fests are amazing. Expect, Exodia, and Ranneeti are the top fests at my college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT Mandi has excellent placement, infrastructure, faculty and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch contains 568 students. There are 80 students in my course which is CSE. In this year, almost 60 to 70 percent of students were placed in placements. The highest package is 71 LPA offered by Microsoft. The average package is 12 to 13 LPA. The lowest package is 5 LPA. Top recruiter companies in the tech field are Microsoft, Google, Adobe, TCS, etc. All of the above companies recruit students of the 3rd year for internships. And 50 to 60 percent of students were placed for internships. Top roles in these companies are software engineer, web developer, app developer, data analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of courses in IIT Mandi is excellent. Free Wi-Fi is available for students in every hostel, classroom, and library. All buildings of IIT Mandi are new. Classrooms have AC facility, charging points at every bench, a study environment, and are in excellent condition. A central library is present there which contains over 50,000 books. Hostel facility is also excellent in IIT Mandi. There are available indoor games (table tennis, etc.), washing machines, Wi-Fi, theater, geysers, water coolers, iron, security, and much more facilities for students. The health center of IIT Mandi has good connections with excellent doctors. All types of medical issues can be solved there and only 1500 rupees per year are paid for all medical facilities. Mess food is good. Canteen food is highly expensive. All sports facilities are available there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Course curriculum at IIT Mandi is well-structured and focuses on practical application. The curriculum is relevant to industry and practical learning. The faculty of IIT Mandi is highly qualified and expert in their own field. All teachers are helpful, supportive, and encourage students to grow and excel in their life. Teaching quality is good. College takes two exams in one semester. One is mid-semester and another is the final which is the end-semester exam. The level of both exams is easy to moderate. Almost 100 percent of students pass these exams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It has pretty good infrastructure, good research Is going on and has good placements in 2023.

detailed_review.Placements: At IIT Mandi, about 90% of students were placed during the latest placement season. The highest package offered was 60 LPA, while the average was 25.23 LPA. Top recruiters included Microsoft, Amazon, IBM, and TCS. Around 75 pre-placement offers (PPOs) were made, with internships provided by companies like ISRO and Tata Motors. Major roles included software engineering, data analysis, and core engineering.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Since it's a 2009 built IIT, it has pretty good infrastructure. It has all the required labs with all the necessary equipment. Every hostel, mess, and academic block has a Wi-Fi connection. In rooms, they provide a bed, study table, chair, and a locker. Mess and canteen food is okay; South Indians may face issues with the food.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is well-qualified, knowledgeable, and supportive, ensuring quality teaching. Industry relevance and blending theory with practical skills ensure students are ready to join the industry after passing out. The exams are fair and challenging yet ensure a good pass percentage, indicating effective teaching and successful students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely below average as compared to other IITs. Too much restrictions here.

The placement and intern percentage ratio went too low in these 1-2 years much below average as compared to other IITs. I came by seeing the placement ratio previously it was good but now it is worse.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT Mandi genuine review about all things.

detailed_review.Placements: By May 11, 2024, almost 80% of Computer Science students have been placed. The highest package offered this year was 7.4 LPA, almost 40 LPA. The lowest package was 3.5 LPA. The average salary is near 9-10 LPA. Top recruiting companies are BNY Mellon, Samsung Delhi, Nucleus Software, MAQ Software, BPCL, C-Dot, etc. The roles offered were software development, management, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities offered include Wi-Fi in every academic block and library, high-class labs for all domains, and fully digital classrooms. The libraries are outstanding with a comprehensive collection of books, and the infrastructure is excellent. The hostels are also new, with amenities such as study chairs, almirahs for each member in the room, a common fridge, electric iron, water cooler and purifier, and common study rooms on each floor.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, highly qualified, and knowledgeable, they are open-minded and always go beyond the curriculum to explore new things. The curriculum covers all domains like management, AI, robotics, software development, and data science, the semester exams are relatively easy; just one day is enough for above 50% of the students to score well.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course based on the recommendation of one of my seniors, best things about the course are zero ragging, supportive seniors, and open-minded faculty members. The college has a strict 80% attendance policy, which prevents students from exploring courses on their own, all institute seminars are compulsory to attend, even if the topic is not relevant to you. This should be looked into. The annual and technical fests are Ranneeti, Exodia, Frosthack, etc. There are many student-run clubs like music, dance, programming, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Extremely good college for exposure and serenity.

Companies coming for recruitments include Samsung, Honeywell, BNY Mellon and others. Around 70 to 80% of the students from my course have internships. The top role offered is that of a Software development engineer in our course.

There is unlimited Wi-Fi and the speed is good enough for day to day use. The Labs have advanced equipments imported along with other necessities for biomedical, electrical etc. The classrooms have ventilation and heaters installed along with projectors. The library has the latest books and magazines to read. The mess food quality  is moderate. It is good on some occasions. The canteen offers a variety of food items. We have medical facilities too along with a sports complex which also includes a badminton court and a swimming pool.

The curriculum is being updated for the coming batches and is  being made more relevant to the current scenario. They do help in making students ready for the industry and research field. The exams are moderate to slightly difficult and the passing percentage is above 80%.
detailed_review.Other: I was interested in pursuing a Computer Science degree since programming interests me a lot. I think we could add more industry related technologies to the course content. The fests that happen here include a cultural fest called Exodia along with a technical fest called Xpecto. The surroundings of the campus have the most eye catching views that I have ever seen. Being among the nature really helps you focus your mind.

faqs.question: What are the courses that IIT Mandi offers?
faqs.answer: The institute offers over 30 courses in the streams of Engineering, Humanities & Social Sciences, Science, IT & Software. The UG/PG courses offered by the institute are BTech,  MTech,  BS,  MA, etc. In addition, PhD and certificate courses are also offered. IIT Mandi offers courses in full-time and part-time modes, as well as online courses.

faqs.question: How many seats are there in IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: The total seats available across varied courses (excluding MA, PhD, and Certificate) sums up to nearly 666. Seat allotment for each course is carried out in accordance with the seat intake. faqs.question: How to get admission in IIT Mandi in MA Development Studies?
faqs.answer: Candidates who meet the eligibility requirements can fill out the application form by visiting the IIT-M official website (iitmandi.ac.in). Aspirants further need to take the entrance test conducted by the institute followed by a personal interview round. The weightage of the exam score is 60% and for the interview is 40%. Based on candidates' performance in both the selection rounds, seat allotment is carried out.

faqs.question: Does IIT Mandi offer integrated BTech-MTech programme?
faqs.answer: Yes, the institute offers a four-year integrated BTech-MTech course. The dual degree course is offered in only one specialisation, i.e., Bioengineering. Admission to this course is also done through JEE Advanced score, followed by JoSAA counselling. There are a total of 28 seats available for this course at IIT Mandi.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for B.Tech offered at IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: IIT Mandi BTech admission is entirely entrance-based. Aspirants need to appear for the JEE Main exam, secure a valid rank and become eligible for JEE Advanced exam . Candidates who secure a valid rank in JEE Advanced need to participate in JoSAA Counselling for seat allotment. Additionally, rank and cut-off of JEE Advanced score decide the admission status of a student.

faqs.question: What is the fees for B.Tech course at IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for BTech is INR 8 lakh . T his information is from official sanctioning body and can change. In addition, the total course fee will be higher as it will include other components such as admission fee, caution money deposit, hostel charges (if applicable), etc., as well. You also have to pay for hostel fee and one-time payable charges of INR 22,000 .

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for M.Tech at IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: For admission to IIT Mandi MTech, you need Bachelor's degree in Engineering/ Technology or MSc or MCA with at least 60% aggregate in the relevant discipline from a recognised university. In addition, applicants with BE/ AMIE exam scores can also apply.

faqs.question: How to get admission in M.Tech at IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: Aspirants with a valid bachelor’s degree in the relevant specialisation are eligible to apply for the PG course. Admission to M.Tech at IIT Mandi is based on merit in GATE followed by COAP counselling . Candidates with a score equal to more than the cutoff become eligible to participate in the counselling round. In addition, IIT graduates with an 8.0 CGPA or above are exempted from the GATE score requirement and can apply directly.

faqs.question: What is the opening and closing rank for Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Bioengineering at IIT Mandi - Indian Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: Opening and Closing rank depends on the category and quota of candidates. For general category under All India, opening rank was 13364 and closing rank was 15216. Cut off are different when it comes to other categories or female candidates and even domicile of home state. In All India, opening and closing rank for female candidates was 20984 and 22169. Admission to Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Bioengineering in IIT Mandi - Indian Institute of Technology is based on the scores obtained in the entrance exam JEE. Applicants are advised to confirm what category are they applying while checking for cut offs.

faqs.question: What is the fee for MSc at IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for two-year course is INR 20,000 and the hostel fee (excluding meal plan) is INR 88,000. Total course fee will include other components such as admission fee, caution deposit, etc. as well. This fee is as per the first year/semester fees. Thus, the actual fee may vary. Aspirants can further visit the IIT-Mandi official website (iitmandi.ac.in) for more information around the fee structure.

faqs.question: How to get a seat in MSc at IIT Mandi?

IIT Mandi shortlists students for MSc based on their scores in the IIT JAM entrance exam. Further, the shortlisted candidates are called for CCMN Counselling . At the time of counselling, seat allotment is carried out on the basis of exam score, seat intake, reservation policy, and cut-off.

Admission to Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Bioengineering in IIT Mandi - Indian Institute of Technology is based on the scores obtained in the entrance exam JEE. faqs.question: How to get a seat in MSc at IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: Aspirants must meet the eligibility conditions as prescribed by the institute and qualifying exam conducting body. IIT Mandi shortlists students for MSc based on their scores in the IIT JAM entrance exam. Further, the shortlisted candidates are called for CCMN Counselling . faqs.question: Is GATE compulsory for PhD in IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: No, GATE is not compulsory and is only one of the criteria for admission. Aspirants with a valid UGC NET/CSIR NET can also apply. Candidates without any valid national-level exam score can also appear for the written test conducted by the institute.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in IIT Mandi for PhD?
faqs.answer: Candidates must check the eligibility requirements before filling out the IIT Mandi PhD application form. Admission to the courses is based on performance in GATE / UGC-NET / CSIR-NET /written test followed by a personal interview round. Eligible students can further apply by visiting IIT Mandi official website (iitmandi.ac.in), uploading documents, and paying the application fees.

faqs.question: What PhD courses are offered in IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: The institute offers PhD courses in the streams of Engineering, Science, Humanities & Social Sciences. These courses are offered in multiple specialisations, including Mechanical Design, Fluid Thermal, Manufacturing, Materials Engineering, Atmospheric Science, Electrical Engineering, etc. Admission to all these programmes is entrance-based.

highlights.summary:
IIT Jodhpur was established in the year 2008 by the Ministry of Human Resource Development along with different IITs. The institute covers around 852 acres of land. And as the name suggests, the institute is located at IIT Jodhpur. Even the ranking of the institute shows decent growth.
IITJ is ranked 27 among the top Engineering colleges in India by NIRF 2025. Additionally, it has been ranked 66 in the overall category by NIRF 2025. Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur, through its 10 departments and 3 schools of study, offers UG, PG, PG diploma, and PhD courses to students across Engineering, Management, and other streams.IIT Jodhpur flagship courses are BTech and MBA.
Jodhpur admission is based on the entrance exam. Admissions lie on national-level entrance exams such as JEE Advanced and GATE. Further, IIT Jodhpur admissions 2025 for management (MBA) courses are meant according to CAT scores. The previous batch has tracked the 92% placements.
As per the IIT Jodhpur JEE Advanced cutoff 2025, the Round 6 shut down off with ranks 2918 and 15278. On the basis of closing ranks, courses such as BTech in Computer Science and Engineering remained in the highest demand with rank 2918. While courses such as BTech in Bioengineering and BTech in Materials Engineering ranked in the least competitive streak with ranks 15278 and 15034.
The institute offers various facilities, including well-endowed labs, library, computer centres, etc. The facility of the IIT Jodhpur hostel is offered separately to boys and girls. The major highlights of IIT Jodhpur are tabulated below:

college_info_program.intro:
IIT Jodhpur has 10 departments and 3 schools of study. The Institute offers UG, PG and PhD courses. It offers a 4-year BTech in 8 specialisations and a BSc in 2 specialisations at UG level. Further, Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur includes MSc, MTech, and MBA courses at the PG level. It also offers integrated courses like MSc MTech and MTech PhD courses to the students. Further, at the doctoral level, the institute offers PhD across Core Sciences, Engineering Science, Humanities, and Social Sciences streams.
BTech and MBA are the flagship programmes of IIT Jodhpur. The two-year MBA programme is offered by the School of Management & Entrepreneurship. IIT Jodhpur MBA programme has various subjects such as Macro Economics, Global Economy, Human Capital, Marketing, and Finance, among others.In the second year, the institute offers two choices to students leading to either an MBA degree or the MBA Technology degree.
Some of the popular BTech specialisations offered at IIT Jodhpur include Computer Science & Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Bioengineering, Civil & Infrastructure Engineering, and Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, among others. Check out the below video to know more:

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost everyone gets placed, both circuital and non-circuital guys. The highest package, I guess, was 60 LPA (in hand). All renowned companies come here for placements. I don't have data about internships, but 5-6 people get internships at Google every year (3rd year students) and GSoC as well. SDE, SSE, AIML engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi can be a bit slow, but it's fine, sometimes very bad. The Physics and Chemistry lab is good and spacious. Classrooms are air-conditioned with appropriate lighting. The library is not sufficient for the number of students that exist on the campus, but its air conditioning and books are available, as well as computers if needed, and switchboards are available as well. Food in the mess differs, sometimes it's fabulous, sometimes it's very bad. The canteen is good and affordable. There is a PHC on campus, pretty far from hostels, but you can call an ambulance during emergencies, free service, free meds and blood tests.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are awesome and really good, some are not. Teaching quality differs. Most professors come here for their research work. Sem exams aren't difficult if studied properly. The pass percentage is mostly 30 per cent, but there's a relatively grading, so it might differ.

reviews.review_title: They create a system that avoids heatwaves from entering the campus, which I like very much.

detailed_review.Placements: I think almost 100% placements are there. If you work hard, you can get placed. Last year top placement was 53 LPA and hired by  Google. Median package is 15 LPA - 17 LPA. Top companies here are Google, HPCL, and Goldman Sachs. So, top companies come here, and you can get placed easily.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has very good infrastructure. It has 5G+ Wi-Fis. There is 100 MB speed. Canteen food is excellent, and they include some Jodhpur stuff there, and that's fantastic. Sports facility is good. Library is okay. Sports facility is good, and they encourage every student to play some stuff.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and knowledgeable. They teach advanced stuff. If I have any doubt, they always respond and are very helpful with placements kind of stuff. They are very good person, very humble, and have good behaviour. If you call them, they respond as well.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course for this college specifically, and Jodhpur is nearby. Fests are also held.

reviews.review_title: My wonderful journey in an amazing college.

detailed_review.Placements: Above 30% of students got placed from my course. The highest package is 62 LPA, and the lowest package is 13 LPA. The top recruiting companies for my course are Tata Motors, Mahindra, Google, and Microsoft. Maybe 67% of students got internships in Unlox and other companies. Machine learning is the top role offered in my course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has Wi-Fi for every student with an unlimited network. The Wi-Fi works anywhere on the whole campus. The labs are pretty hygienic, and safety protocols are followed by management. The classrooms are very spacious and ideal for students. The library is also very huge and here we can get many types of books and magazines. The quality of food is very good and healthy. There is also a primary health centre available for all students for medical issues. All types of sports games and grounds are here for students, including indoor games.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are highly talented and very famous lecturers. They are professional in their role. They are also very kind. We can contact them via email for our doubts, and they give their personal timings for our doubts. The course curriculum makes the students industry-ready. The semester exams are not too tough nor too easy. The pass percentage is very high, i.e., more than 97%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as my option due to my JEE Advanced rank. The cutoff for this college in this course matched my rank, so I came here with some interest based on other reviews. The course is not bad, it's very good. Ignus fest is the very famous fest here, loved by many, hated by none.

reviews.review_title: IIT Jodhpur college review.

detailed_review.Placements: The college itself really does provide solid knowledge, and students were landing jobs in this course. The salary packages here were quite varied. The highest can go beyond 18LPA, while the lowest starts at around 3LPA. There were some top notch recruiting companies specifically looking for graduates from this course, and over 70% of students were getting internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The colleges infrastructure is made up of the most basic services like a supply of clean water, large laboratories for science, an auditorium and playground for cultural and sports activities, a well stocked library, and well maintained classrooms and canteen. Students can also take advantage of transportation and on campus housing if they do not have their own vehicles. The mess is clean, and if we talk about the food menu, it is quite good, but if more items of students choice are introduced, it will surely be beneficial.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty and staff here may not always excel, but they do their job well. First year teaching was very similar to high school, which made the change quite easy. The yearly tests were not too hard. The college also recognised academic successes and took special care to award the highest achievers.

reviews.review_title: World class infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 70% of students got placed from our course in my batch. The highest package offered in our course is 14 LPA. The average package is around 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Accenture, Goldman Sachs, ICICI Prudential, etc. Top roles offered are research, data analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. Wi-Fi-enabled campus. Labs are well-equipped with advanced instruments and modern machinery. The hostel is also pretty good. Multiple sports complexes and a food court are present.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their respective domains. The teaching quality of our faculty members is extremely good. The course curriculum is relevant. It provides industry exposure. The semester examinations are of a moderate level.

reviews.review_title: Good campus and study, but more industry exposure is needed in the course.

detailed_review.Placements: I was in the M.Sc.  batch of IIT Jodhpur, passed out in 2018. Around 50% students got placed. Highest salary package was 18 LPA, lowest salary package was 5 LPA, average salary package was nearly 8 LPA. Companies like TCS, Wipro, and IBM came. Some got internships in DRDO and ISRO. Roles like research analyst and data job were offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classroom is big and clean with AC and a projector. Labs have good machines, and Wi-Fi works mostly fine. Library is big with many books. Hostel is clean, room is good. Mess food is normal, not so tasty. Canteen has some good items. Medical room is there. Sports ground is also nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and know the subject well. Some teach well, some are just okay. Course is fine, but a little more industry link is needed. Exams are not very hard if you study regularly. Notes and help are also given. Around 90% students pass. Teaching quality is mostly good.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I like research and science. Course is good, practical part is best. But more industry exposure should be there. Fests and events are fun. Campus is big and clean. Crowd was mixed. Scholarship is also given.

reviews.review_title: Life at IIT (BS Programme) Jodhpur .

detailed_review.Placements: There are no placement records as 2025 marks the second batch of applied AI and data science BS programme of IIT Jodhpur. But there is a placement support provided by IIT Jodhpur if a student performs well in the course, as course proceeds, the placement record will be visible.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure at IIT Jodhpur are amazing. Labs and classrooms are equipped with Wi-Fi, and the quality of facilities provided in hostel is also top-notch. Food in mess and canteen is decent, and they also provide medical facilities. Besides, this campus area is very large and supports all sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are quite helpful in nature. They are well qualified in their subject and have a deep knowledge of it, which they deliver to students. Teaching quality is superior. Course curriculum is made according to what industry requires today. It makes the student industry-ready. Semester exams are offline and of medium difficulty.

reviews.review_title: Reviiew of IIT Jodhpur - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Ripik technology, Uber, TATA consultancy, Oracle, Adobe, Qualcomm, Wizards India LLP, Sony group corporation, the world wants, trilogy innovation, and many more companies visit our college to recruit students. You will get a stipend from 5000-200000 per month, depending on company to company and type of internship. In my course, students of the final semester are eligible for placement. Mostly, coaching institutes hire from an M.Sc. Physics with an average package of 10-12 LPA. Not a lot of students go for placements but mostly they opt for higher studies, and a good number of students get Ph.D. in foreign universities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course curriculum was revised very frequently as per the demand and requirements of the students. But some courses were in high demand by the students, but were not provided because of the availability of faculty. Various hands-on courses were compulsory, which provided good experience and learning. The hostel life was awesome due to friends. Talking about the facilities, we had a Hostel Management Committee that took care of all our hostel problems, and the mess food was also appreciable for the cost that we were charged. We pay around 60,000.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of student ratio was good. We had a lot of in-person interaction with the faculty members. Even the faculty was very helpful and friendly. Some people were exceptional, but overall, they were good. A lot of good faculty members were there, but also some people couldn't satisfy students with their teaching methods. There were two minor exams in between and one major exam. Marking was done considering all three of them. Which made scoring good marks easy.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Life at IIT Jodhpur: A comfortable and fun experience at college.

detailed_review.Placements: Till now, more than 60% of students got placed. Around 10% of students are preparing for further higher studies. The average package is around 16 LPA. Companies like Google, Samsung, BNY Mellon, Zomato, etc., come to IIT Jodhpur for placements. The lowest package is around 6 LPA. The highest package is 56 LPA in our college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are separate departments for almost all branches. We have ACs in academic buildings, hostels, mess, labs, etc. It makes us survive in the heat of Rajasthan. The infrastructure of IIT Jodhpur is pretty new and hence has a good quality. A physical health centre is present inside the campus. The mess quality is satisfactory and considered better than most of the IITs.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is fixed for each programme you enrol in. Minor changes are made based on students' requirements. The curriculum mainly focuses on motivating students to go for research and higher studies. However, it prepares us to solve real-world application-based problems. The difficulty level of exams is medium to hard.
detailed_review.Other: The campus is less crowded than tier 1 IITs which is a good thing. You pretty much know everyone which is a good thing for creating a bond with people. Connectivity with the city is bad considering how far it is from the main city. I chose this college because the course I was taking was of my interest. Many fests are seen in this college which creates a good environment for developing extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_title: College have good infrastructure and facilities like hostel and mess.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in my college are at an average level now. Placement rate in Computer Science is the highest and around 98%. The average package is around 17 LPA. The placement rate in the bioengineering branch is not good as I thought. It was around 56% in the previous year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of IIT Jodhpur's hostel is too good. Well-placed sitting of rooms. Every room has one AC, one chair, one almirah, and one study table. In the first year, we have 4 grade courses, 3 labs, and 4 non grade course. A total of 560 students are divided into two groups of the same strength. That's all.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful in class as well as outside the class (doubt-clearing session). Also, course curriculum is too relevant. Exams, course-wise quizzes, one minor exam, and one major exam are conducted. The schedule of minor and major exams is provided at least 10-20 days from the date of exam.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Jodhpur infrastructure features a state-of-the-art permanent campus comprising cutting-edge research labs, smart classrooms, a library, a health centre, etc. The institute also provides hostel accommodation to the students. It has all the modern amenities available to cater to students' academic and research needs. Read further to know in detail about the campus infrastructure:

sections.heading: IIT Jodhpur Campus Highlights
text: Spread over 852 acres of land, IIT Jodhpur's infrastructure offers both residential and academic facilities. Interestingly, it is the first institute in India to install NVIDIA DGX A100 supercomputers at its Central Computing Facility, enhancing AI and Data Science research and education. Located on the campus, IIT Jodhpur has an ISO-certified healthcare centre, which has OPD and ambulance services . The health centre has a constituted medical board of doctors from the Government Medical College and AIIMS. The institute has modern laboratories, which support research and development. The infrastructure of the institute incorporates eco-friendly architecture and smart technologies . A few highlights of the IIT Jodhpur are given in the table below:
Campus Building:

tables.IIT Jodhpur Campus Highlights: Classrooms, laboratories, Smart Technologies, Sports Facilities, Library, Hostels with Mess, Cafeteria and more

sections.heading: IIT Jodhpur Academic and Research Facilities
text: IIT Jodhpur has well-maintained classrooms and labs. The classrooms are equipped with projectors and green boards . The infrastructure is built in a way to promote interaction and growth in all aspects.

In order to promote entrepreneurship among students, IIT Jodhpur has its Incubation Cell - Technology and Innovation and Start-Up Centre (TISC) . It has certain incubation projects that are supported by the Ministry of MSME and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. Facilities such as AI, IoT, surgical robotics, and virtual reality. The institute has seven platforms, supported by the Department of Science and Technology.
IIT Jodhpur is planning to set up its own Tech Park , which will be spread over 100 acres of land and will have the capacity to host 30 companies at once.

sections.heading: IIT Jodhpur Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: IIT Jodhpur is a fully residential campus. There are separate hostel buildings for boys and girls. It offers single-occupancy air-conditioned and semi-furnished rooms, subject to availability. Basic amenities such as a table, chair, bed, almirah and internet connection are available. Additionally, each hostel building has a TV room, reading room , etc. Also, it has space for playing indoor games like carom, table tennis, chess, and badminton .

Each hostel has a dining hall accommodating a large number of students and offering vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. A gymnasium is also available for fitness, and a medical room. Students have access to 24/7 water facilities, RO purified drinking water, geysers and daily cleaning services . Overall, the hostels offers a very calm, peaceful, safe and comfortable atmosphere to the residents.

sections.heading: IIT Jodhpur Library
text: The library located in the clock tower building serves as a central point for knowledge creation. The name of the library is S R Ranganathan Learning Hub . The library has wheelchair accessible entrances and parking.

highlights.summary:
Established in 1959, National Institute of Technology, Warangal is a Deemed University earlier known as the Regional Engineering College. These courses are provided across Engineering, Management, and various other streams. The institute offers BTech and MBA courses as its flagship courses.
The institute has been ranked 28 by the NIRF Ranking 2025 under the 'Engineering' category. The college has experienced faculty members, staff, and has state-of-the-art infrastructure. NITW has a big library which is spread across 4,000 sq. mts of land. The library has around 1.87 lakh books, back volumes, standards, technical pamphlets, CD-ROMs, Video Cassettes, e-books, and others. The various other facilities provided by the college are an auditorium, student activity centre, indoor games complex, seminar halls, big stadium, and others.
NITW is a residential college with around more than 6,000 (UG and PG) students and nearly more than 1,000 PhD (full-time and part-time) scholars. The college has more than 314 staff members.
