reviews.review_title: NIT Warangal is a good college.

detailed_review.Placements: After completing the 4th semester, students are eligible for internships, and mainly companies as I know are Oracle, ITC, TCS, Amazon, and Google, with the highest till I know being 88 LPA, a good percentage of people get placement here, and companies visit for internship, as I know ITC is said by our seniors, and I am not completely aware of what others would be there, as I am still searching on it, in the 7th–8th semester, there should be a project made by all students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are not that good as washrooms are not cleaned every day, which makes it difficult, and the mess is average, though the food kept on special dinner is best, there is a big library through which we can access our books of any kind, many clubs are there which makes it better, Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security, classrooms are spacious and digitally updated, and there are gym facilities in each hostel which can be accessed by all students with hostel timings.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is good and the main reason for choosing it is that it is different from software and a new path which many people might not choose, Chemical Engineering is a good course for challenges in the real world, faculty are friendly and many are good, they readily solve doubts if any, and there are mid-semester exams, end-semester exams, and teacher assessment (minor), which total makes 100 marks in each subject.

reviews.review_title: Good college, good vibes in the college.

detailed_review.Placements: Students are eligible for placement after the 7th semester. In mechanical, I can say mostly all PSU come for recruitment, which includes HPCL, BPCL, ONGC, etc., and also some private core companies came. The highest package is around 28.6 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA, with an average of 14 LPA. I want to go for UPSC after graduation.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a huge central library in the college which consists of almost every book possible. There are whiteboards and projectors in mostly every classroom. There are various societies and clubs. In the first year, there is a hostel named 1.8 K Ultra Mega Hostel, and the hostel room is not that big but fine for 2 persons. Quality of food is good; there is breakfast, lunch, and dinner there.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty-to-students ratio is fine because in our batch the whole department is distributed in 2 sections, and in both sections faculty members are the same but classrooms are different. Mostly all the professors are Ph.D. holders from respective IITs or NITs. There is very rare interaction of teachers and students after the classroom. Including mid-semester and end-semester exams, there are minor tests which are of 15 marks in each subject.

reviews.review_title: Choose better college than this.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements and job opportunities are good. I am from Mechanical Engineering. The highest annual package is 22 LPA in core side and 43 LPA in software side. The average is about 13 LPA. Many companies like Microsoft, Bajaj, Kia, Google recruited many students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have an auditorium where a movie is screened every week with a good sounding atmosphere. Infrastructure of hostel must be improved. The only problem is about washrooms. They don't even clean them properly. In hostel, two persons are adjusted in one room. Two beds and two study tables are provided. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our faculty members are good, friendly in nature. They immediately clarify our doubts in the class. There are some teachers who are excellent in explanation. The examination level of every subject varies. Difficulty level varies from student to student. For me, I feel Math's was the toughest of all in Semester 1 and Chemistry was easy.

reviews.review_title: Good college for Mechanical Engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Internships are there. A lot of companies are tied up with NITW, and Siemens Research Center is inside the campus. Many clubs exist, and students are motivated to do projects and help get patents if needed. National Institute of Technology Warangal is famous for its placement percentage in core and tech side. Everything in detail can be found on the NITW main site, like placement percentage branch-wise and average package.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel costs are affordable. There is an ethernet connection, electricity, fan, and cool mineral water in every hostel. The campus is very good. A big library is available for students for free. Good sports facilities and grounds are there. Gym is available for everyone. Many events and festivals are celebrated well. There are lots of clubs students can join to explore and learn. Gym is available. There are also coffee shops in campus, a food street where you can have food or buy necessary items, and a book stall inside campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: NIT Warangal is famous for Mechanical Engineering among NITs. There are sufficient faculty for learning and helping in academics. There are workshops and industry visits for students. Faculty are always helpful, friendly, and professional. They are highly experienced. There is no faculty that is disliked; everyone is good. Exams are 70 marks: 30 marks mid-term, 40 marks end-sem, and other 30 marks are under professors’ control, which may include assignments or special tests.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Definitely you can join this college.

detailed_review.Placements: The National Institute of Technology is known for its placements. It has excellent placement records. Students get internships from the 3rd year, and they also get pre-placement offers, and 4th year students get excellent placements. The companies that visited are Google, Facebook, Amazon, Deloitte, Flipkart, etc. The highest package of NITW is 88 LPA. The average package in the Computer Science and Engineering branch is 30 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NITW is known for its 1.8k hostel. It’s Asia’s largest hostel. The hostel facilities are very wonderful. They provide beds, fans, and lights. The mess quality is also good, but it can be improved. The mess menu should be diversified and should satisfy both North Indian and South Indian students. The vast library possesses excellent books which give students immense knowledge. There are also excellent sports facilities. There is a huge stadium. Students can also enjoy playing different games like tennis, badminton, cricket, kabaddi, etc. We also enjoy the nightlife by having different items. We have Madras filter coffee, Domino’s inside the campus itself.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members of the institute are wonderful. The faculty-to-student ratio is 1:80. The professors along with assistant and visiting professors are also highly qualified. The course curriculum is very relevant to the present changing technologies in the world. The course curriculum gets updated frequently according to changing technologies and new innovations in the technical field. The course curriculum provides us with vast knowledge. There are three types of exams in a semester, namely minor, mid, and end-semester exams.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Warangal - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 85% of students get selected in campus placements at this NIT. Many companies collaborate with the institute, and there is a strong alumni network. Students can check the NITW website or Instagram page for detailed placement information. So, the overall placement process is nice here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure covers all the basic needs: clean water, spacious Science labs, an auditorium for events, a playground for sports, and a well-stocked library. The classrooms are tidy, and there is transportation and on-campus housing for students who need it. The mess is clean and the food is decent, though a few more options would be nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of our teachers are highly experienced and qualified, and they truly focus on helping students land great placements. The coursework is really geared towards the financial sector, with a special emphasis on subjects like accounting and auditing. Simply put, the staff is talented and usually gets excellent results from the students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Warangal College.

detailed_review.Placements: If you are in ECE, you are in luck. They have some great core placement opportunities, especially if you keep your CGPA decent over the years. A good mixture of companies shows up every year, offering a variety of roles. If you are somewhat competent, you are likely to land a good placement. ECE students seem to have an edge when it comes to software and management roles too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: On the downside, there are not really enough instructors, and the classrooms are well, they are pretty basic. The canteen menu is kind of limited too mostly just samosas and tea. The campus feels more like a place for cramming for exams rather than a real learning environment. There's no medical facility around. The hostel accommodation is not the best, but they offer some comfort. The mess serves hygienic food, and the water supply is pretty well maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty members are really supportive, focusing on helping students individually. I have noticed a few instructors who clean towards being a bit strict and, well, a little old school. Sometimes that can lead to issues like gender bias or discipline trouble.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT, Warangal is the best NIT in India.

detailed_review.Placements:
NIT Warangal is one of the best NIT in India. It offers many courses in Engineering. 
75% of students got placed. Highest package is of 70 LPA. The lowest package is of 20 LPA. Average package is of 30 LPA. Top Recruiting companies are Flipkart, Amazon, Google etc. 
50% of students got internships in start ups.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are big enough. Classrooms are chilled with AC and fans. Library is also big enough. Hostel food contains variety of food daily. Canteen is also available. Medical service is for 24/7.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are so interactive with students. They teach in a good manner. Teachers are qualified and knowledgeable. Time table is so flexible to the students. There are some extra curricular activities for students. Here the fests are so special to the students.
detailed_review.Other: I chose ECE because of it has flexibility towards software and hardware. But in future, India is looking for the establishment of Semiconductor and Battery industries. So there is need of Engineers (core). There are number of clubs related to dance, sports, finance and many more.

reviews.review_title: College is a paved path, if you want a good placement, you have to run fast.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 90% of students got placed from our seniors. Out of 9, 7 got placed in good companies, one with the highest package of 25 LPA, and the lowest package is 12 LPA. 100% of students got internships, but some didn’t sit for placements as they went for higher studies and startups.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All over, the college is good, having a lush green campus and a nature-friendly environment,  Wi-Fi is available in the college, and in the hostel, we have LAN ports. Hostel rooms are good, with single and double occupancy. Mess food is good, it might vary from person to person, but for me, it's good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers and other staff are well-trained and talented, all have great knowledge in their respective fields, and they are supportive and helpful. Labs are conducted by Ph.D. scholars under the guidance of the respective faculty, so the lab is full of knowledge. Each week, we have 2–3 labs, and all are equipped with best-in-class machines.
detailed_review.Other: College is good, and college life is also good. Some might not like the food, but the rest of everything is good.

reviews.review_title: NIT Warangal College review.

detailed_review.Placements: About 80 percent of students from the PED branch in the 2019-21 batch landed jobs. The highest package is 15 LPA which was pretty impressive. On the flip side, the lowest came in at around 4.5 LPA with an average sitting at about 5 LPA. When it comes to companies hiring, we've got some big names in the mix like GE, Intel, Qualcomm, and Microsoft. Speaking of Microsoft. Around 30 percent of my batch snagged internships along with opportunities at Dell and GE. Pretty cool.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has solid infrastructure with helpful amenities which is especially great for Science students. We have well-equipped labs and a decent library. For those traveling from afar, the hostel provides enough room. The mess is clean and while the food menu is alright. It would not hurt to add a few more options that students actually enjoy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some instructors are not always punctual. They know their material. The teaching itself is average and as expected the semester exams are not too tough with about a 90 percent passing rate. It is a pretty good academic experience.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied with the hostel maintenance and the mess food maintenance.

detailed_review.Placements: I think the placement criteria depend on the CGPA, the skills, communication skills, and confidence of the student. So, the ones with skills, good CGPA, and confidence will get the placement, and the ones who do not will not get it.  It's not in our hands, but the companies that come here are not that bad.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Coming to the hostel, it is a nightmare. Really. The cleaning and hygiene are not up to the mark. The food in the mess, we shouldn't really talk about this. I mean, they are providing the same food every week without any change in the menu, and moreover, they don't taste good. They taste land. We really can't continue eating this food. And moreover, we have to pay each and every time to eat non-veg. It was not informed while paying the mess fee that we would be provided only with veg food.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty, I think, should improve their teaching skills. Not everything can be understood by just scrolling through the slides of a PowerPoint presentation, reading it, and feeling like explaining everything and assuming we understand everything. They also need to pay attention to every student.
detailed_review.Other: Everything is not that bad, but I can't say it is really up to the mark.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with faculty members and placement.

detailed_review.Placements: All students are placed. The highest package is 18 LPA, average package is 12 LPA, and the lowest package is 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Micron and ICICI Bank. The roles offered by companies are software developer, data scientist, tutor, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in every room. The infrastructure includes well-built labs, classrooms have good equipments such as projectors and computers. Quality of food available in mess and canteen is decent. Dispensary is available free of cost for students. There are basketball and football grounds.
detailed_review.Faculty: The academics here are rigorous and well-structured. Professors are highly qualified, many with PhDs from IITs/IISc and foreign universities. They encourage research-based learning rather than just written memorization. Semester exams are not that difficult.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of placement and college. There should be more abstract Maths.

reviews.review_title: NIT Warangal College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Warangal really stands out as one of the top engineering colleges when it comes to placements, boasting an impressive average package of about 88 LPA. Now, if you were looking specifically at the B.Tech CSE branch, the average package there was around 26 LPA. Its pretty cool because major companies like Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, Samsung, TCS, and Infosys actively recruit from our college. Uber even offered internships with a sweet stipend of 1LPA. Overall, the placement percentage was quite promising, too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi across the whole campus, as well as LAN in the hostels, was available. The labs were fully equipped and excellent. The library had more than 200,000 books of all kinds. I would rate the food 2 out of 5. Medical and sports facilities were good. The hostels for second year students were not great, but the others were fine. The food was also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers have good qualifications and a long teaching career. Our course was suitable for our environment. Our schools semester exams were very hard, and to get a good grade, we had to work significantly. Overall, the faculty members are good and approachable.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: National Institute of Technology, Warangal.

detailed_review.Placements: 95% of students were placed in my course at my college. The highest package is 80 LPA offered in my course, the average package is 30 LPA offered in my course and the lowest package is 10 LPA offered in my course. 90% of students got an internship from my course in my college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. Provide Wi-Fi, which is very useful for networking. In labs, provide the AC and projector. Classrooms are good, and we provide the AC and a projector for display. The library is good and provides AC and a projector. Hostel is good for the quality of food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very good at teaching. They are approaching students with friendliness. They are very knowledgeable. Teaching is good. In semester, they have conducted two mid exams and a final exam. The pass percentage of exams is 40%. We have got 40% of marks in final exam, so we will pass the entire semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of National Institute of Technology Warangal.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Warangal is the top 1 NIT college in our ECE course, which has demand with other courses. 86% of students were placed in our course. The highest package is 77 LPA, the average package is 22 LPA, and the lowest package is 9 LPA. Amazon, Microsoft, and PhonePe are the top recruiting companies that visited, and 80% of students got internships from our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The NIT Warangal infrastructure is excellent, clean, and neat. The facilities are available 24/7 with a speedy network. Classrooms are clean and neat, with one lab for each subject. The quality of food is good and hygienic, and they keep a variety of food daily. Sports and games are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: In our college, everyone did their PG. Teachers are highly qualified and have good teaching skills. Faculty members are friendly with students, and they explain concepts very well to help them understand. This course curriculum is relevant, it makes the students industry-ready. It is a little bit tough to get a good percentage, but easy to pass.

reviews.review_title: Prefer this college if you are interested in placements and college life.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80% of students are placed. 95 to 96% from CSE, 94% from EEE, and 79.4% from civil (batch 2020-2024), with an overall the highest package of 64 LPA and 34.10 LPA from civil engineering. Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP Labs, Genpact, Godrej (core), L&T (core), and Zomato (health pure).
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in every department with proper safety. Classrooms are like school only (this is the worst part), library is very good, around 10cr budget is for the library only. If we talk about the hostel, some hostels are good, like 1.8k, Bhabha hall of residence, Gokhale hall of residence, and best one (well structured) is Azad Hall and Bose Hall, but the rooms are for single occupancy, and they give us double occupancy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some of the professors are very helpful and qualified from IITS, and they have a vast knowledge about the subject, but they don't know how to teach. Some professors didn't even care if students were getting their point or not. Curriculum is relevant, but we have to do a mandatory internship in core. This one is bad for those who have no interest in the core and are opting for tech placements.

reviews.review_title: College is good only in terms of image, but actual scenarios are the worst.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 85%- 90% of students are placed by the completion of 4th year. The highest package for the core role in mechanical is about 28 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Bajaj, Exonmobil, Tata Motors, etc. About 10% of the students secure internships at top companies on campus. Roles offered are core mechanical roles of design, modeling, and simulations, and other roles offered are of management.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the college buildings are equipped with Wi-Fi, there are no AC in classrooms, but labs are available. In the library space, there is PC and AC for students to study. Hostel infrastructure and facilities for the living area are very poor. No options for a canteen kind of monopoly are there. Sports and games are few, and on practical notes, accessible only to a few.
detailed_review.Faculty: Very few professors are well known about their subject, others are just being egoistic by nature and difficult to communicate with. The course curriculum is not relevant and doesn't help with any practical industry knowledge. Semester exams are not so difficult.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course because I have an interest in power generation devices, which are very important for human logistics. The academic curriculum is followed in the same old style, which is not modified for the current world. Events and fests are decent. College is very focused on academics and restricts students based on grades for extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_title: National Institute of Technology Warangal College.

detailed_review.Placements: We had a 90 to 95% student conversion into actual placements in our course. The highest package was 64 LPA, and the average package was roughly 10 LPA. Top recruiters were Larsen & Toubro, Tata, Mahindra, etc. Students have intern offers across the board as well.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel and mess were good enough to manage. Wi-Fi was available in classrooms, and LAN was available in hostel rooms. We can get anything you want on campus only. Classrooms were well ventilated, and every classroom had a projector. There was a big stadium for cricket and football, and an indoor stadium for badminton.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members were good. You need to be regular in classes. Almost all were passing the exams. The syllabus here was somewhat random dots, we need to connect them to become industry-ready. Semester exams were at a good level, you need to prepare well to pass the semester exams.

reviews.review_title: Food is better for the North students than the South. Though it is South NIT, everything is good.

detailed_review.Placements: Above 85% of students get selected in campus interviews. A lot of companies come to conduct placements. Many companies collaborated with the NIT. There is a good aluminium for NIT, and we can always check more information on the NITW official page or Instagram for full knowledge.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: New hostels and academic buildings are very good, but not average, in the old hostels and buildings. It has good medical facilities because there is a free dispensary on the campus. Mess food is so good for the North students and below average for the South people. The campus life is good. For sports, there is a huge place. The only thing is that there is no swimming pool.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are good and friendly. Academics are good. They help us very much. They always take students' opinions on everything they want to do. They give priority to students. There is no choice in examinations, and 100% attempting is required to get full marks.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Warangal - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Since it's NIT Warangal and the computer science branch, we have a 100% placement rate every year. Recently, only the biotech department saw a CTC of 13 LPA offered from Citi Group to one of our seniors. Apart from companies like Novartis and Dr. Reddy’s Labs, we also have non-core placements in our department with companies such as UBS, United Health Group, TCS, IBM, FIIT JEE, MuSigma, Infosys, OFSS, EXL, Immuno Shop, iQuanti, Teach Mahindra, GEP, and others. Placement packages ranged from ₹3.25 LPA to ₹10.5 LPA
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course curriculum is a bit challenging, requiring students to work hard in every subject, as the college uses a relatively strict grading system. Each subject has one faculty member and two teaching assistants. All facilities are staffed by Ph.D.-qualified personnel with comprehensive knowledge of their subjects. Exams are moderate to difficult, with three minor exams and one end-term exam. The hostel has nine floors and can accommodate 1,800 students. Our hostel, named Ultra Mega Hostel Rs. 1,800, provides LAN-enabled rooms which are spacious enough for one or two persons. Hostel allocation is handled by the college at the time of admission.
detailed_review.Faculty: Generally, instructors teach the subjects during their assigned periods. The curriculum is up-to-date and highly dynamic. Compared to other branches of IITs, BITS, and NITs, the biotech curriculum that we follow has met all the international standards however, would like to mention that the labs need a lot more funds to match the international level, but they are working towards improving the quality as far as faculty is concerned the newly appointed faculty is highly dynamic have to follow the schedule.

data.title: NIT Warangal Placement Report 2025
summary: NIT Warangal has released the official placement data 2025. The highest package offered to the batch 2025 stood at INR 64.3 LPA . The average and median package offered was INR 14.35 LPA and INR 12 LPA , respectively. A total of 1201 students were placed and 1225 offers were made in 2025 as well. More than 290 companies visited the campus and the placed 79.3% students.

The BTech placement rate during NIT Warangal placements 2025 was 86.47% . Similarly, for MTech , MSc and MBA programs were 71.34%, 80.43% and 62.86% . Additionally, the highest package offered to CSE and ECE batch 2025 was INR 53.28 LPA and INR 64.3 LPA , respectively.

Earlier, the overall highest and average package offered during the 2023-24 placement drive was INR 88 LPA and INR 15.6 LPA . The median package offered during was INR 12.5 LPA . The percentage of students placed during NITW placement 2024 was 76% . More than 305 companies visited the campus 1,120 students were placed during the placement drive 2024.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: NIT Warangal residential campus includes administrative blocks, academic buildings, a library, student hostels, sports pavilion, staff quarters and a guest house. The campus area of the Institute is 248 acres. It is situated near Kazipet at 3 Km distance from Kazipet Railway Station and 12 Km from Warangal Railway Station.

reviews.review_title: It is the drastic mistake of my life.

detailed_review.Placements: There are around 75 students, out of which 6 to 7 are placed and 93% are unplaced. Later, some students are able to get placed on their own or through referrals. Students study biotech for 4 years, and the college does not provide even a single core company. We are eligible for very few companies (10 out of 100), mostly in sales or pure technical coding roles. Finance and consulting companies are there, but hardly 1 or 2.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is excellent in terms of hostels and classrooms. But average in terms of labs. As many core experiments are done in groups of 10 people, giving little hands-on experience. Hostel facilities are high class with good food. Classrooms are also good and air-conditioned.
detailed_review.Faculty: I will be blunt and honest with this. Except for 2 or 3 professors, no one is there to help in terms of placement, career, or curriculum. I remember one of my professors telling me to drop the semester as I was short in attendance due to a major surgery. My fault was only requesting him to allow me to sit in the exam and manage my attendance. At the same time, he allowed fest students, but I, with all medical reports, was not allowed, so I had to go to the dean for the same.
detailed_review.Other: If you are getting a CS-related or circuital branch. They have lots of money to spend, or just need a degree with an extravagant college life, you are at the right place. For branches like Biotech, your college life is like a ship destined to nowhere, filled with disappointment, and you will end up wasting four crucial years of your life.

reviews.review_title: Extremely good infrastructure, nice faculty, but the fees are a bit high.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70 per cent of the students in my college were placed. Top recruiters are Nvidia and BAINS. About 40 per cent of the students got an internship in the 5th semester in companies like BAINS, BCG, etc. Top roles offered in my course are A. E. [Assistant Engineer] in PSPSCL.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Superb hostels, nice bathrooms, Wi-Fi speed is mid but manageable. Labs have top-quality, up-to-date machines and instruments. Lecture halls are very good and in nice condition. Roads and stadiums are very good. Overall, nice infrastructure as well as 24th NIRF rank.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are very knowledgeable and well-qualified to teach, as expected of a reputable college. Very nice and friendly lab technician. Overall, the course curriculum is very thorough, and the individual collaborated to fit the course in line with the objective of placements.
detailed_review.Other: I want to get a position of A. E. in CEA [Central Electricity Board]. Things I would like to improve would be to lower the feels a bit. Events are very nice, there are a ton of societies that conduct their events very nicely.

reviews.review_title: This college is something great that everyone should experience. The infrastructure is top-notch.

detailed_review.Placements: I have chosen Computer Science engineering, the top branch. Highest package was 55 LPA, and top companies come to recruit. As heard from seniors, competition is quite tough, we need to be perfectionists in our fields, with overall development.

detailed_review.Other: Events are top-notch. Crowd from different places. Many activities, good placement.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering

reviews.review_title: One of the better choices around 90-96%.

admission.title: Thapar University Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
Thapar University admissions 2026 are merit and entrance-based. The university offers a number of courses at the UG, PG, and Doctorate levels, such as- BTech, PhD, MBA, etc. The application process is conducted striclty in the online mode. For admission in the BTech course candidates must appear for the JEE Mains exam and for MBA they must appear for CAT/XAT/NMAT or the TMAT entrance exam. Thapar University accepts Class 12 scores for merit based admission. The duration of most UG courses extend up to three or four hears while PG courses have a duration of two years. PhD programmes vary in duration, mostly extending to five years.

Read on to know more about Thapar University admission process, fees, eligibility etc.

faqs.question: Can I get Thapar University without JEE?
faqs.answer: No, JEE Main is mandatory for BTech admission in Thapar University. The candidate should have a valid score in JEE Main and attend counseling to get a seat. But for other UG and PG courses such as MSc, MA, and MCA, admissions are made on a merit basis, i.e., JEE is not mandatory.

faqs.question: Are admissions at Thapar University merit or entrance based?
faqs.answer: Admissions at Thapar University are both merit and entrance based. The selection criteria varies depending on the programme chosen. Certain courses like BTech are entrance based with the university accepting JEE MAIN scores for the same while certain courses like MSc, MCA etc. are merit based. The university accepts Class 12 scores for merit based admissions. Ensure that the minimum eligibility requirement is met and check the selection criteria very carefully before applying for admission to the preferred programme.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for Thapar University MBA admission?
faqs.answer: Thapar University offers MBA programmes via the LM Thapar School of Management. Admissions are currently open for Thapar University Patiala MBA courses. Candidates seeking admission must apply online before its last date. To be eligible for Thapar University MBA admission, students are required to have a bachelor's degree in any discipline with a minimum aggregate of 50% or equivalent CGPA or corresponding grade secured from a recognised University/Institute. Candidates with a post-graduation degree in any discipline with a minimum aggregate of 50% are also eligible to apply for MBA admission.

faqs.question: I have scored less than 50% in graduation. What are the college options available for pursuing an MBA?
faqs.answer: The eligibility criteria for MBA admissions in most colleges require a minimum percentage in graduation degree. Most MBA colleges select candidates based on the scores of national or state-level entrance exams. Thapar University MBA course admission requires students to have passed Masters with a minimum aggregate of 50% aggregate to apply. However, selection to the course is entrance-based. Students must secure a valid score in entrance exams such as CAT, SNAP, MAT, etc. and go through the counselling process. Candidates can also pursue MBA at colleges offering Online MBA courses . They can also check out colleges offering Online Executive MBA programmes .

faqs.question: What is the hostel fees for MBA students at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: The hostel fees for MBA students at Thapar University completely depend on the type of accommodation selected by the students. Therefore, it is indicative.

faqs.question: How much is the fee for BTech in Thapar University?
faqs.answer: Thapar University BE/BTech fee range between INR 8.85 Lakh and INR 14.58 lakh. The fee mentioned here is the total tuition fee and is taken from an unofficial source. Hence, is indicative. Apart from the mentioned tuition fee, candidates are also required to pay a one-time fee of INR 23,000 which includes the admission fee and institute security. For a detailed Thapar University BTech fee structure, candidates are advised to contact the admission department of the University.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to BTech at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: Thapar University admission to the BTech course is a two-way process, one is entrance-based and another is merit-based. Interested candidates can apply for TIET BTech admission either way. Thapar University's 50% of seats will be filled on the basis of JEE Main scores and the rest 50% is based on the marks secured in the Class 12 examination. The minimum eligibility criteria is different for both entrance and merit-based admission. sections.heading: Introduction
text: Thapar Institute is one of the oldest and finest educational institutions in the country. The institute was founded in 1956, with a campus spread across 250 acres. The institute has well-equipped classrooms, laboratories, a library, sports facilities and much more. The institute is known for its academic excelence as well as infrastructure facilties. Read further to know more about the TIET Campus infrastructure facilities:

sections.heading: TIET Campus Highlights 2024
text: TIET spans an area of 250 acres and is situated in Patiala, Punjab. The university has hostels, a library, a health centre, and sports facilities. The institute offers the best infrastructure facilities to the students and keeps on improving the facilities whenever the need arises. Read further to have insights into the TIET Campus:
A few pictures of the campus are provided below:

tables.TIET Campus Highlights 2024: Hostels, Library, Health Centre, Sports Facilities

sections.heading: TIET Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology (TIET), Patiala, provides comprehensive and student-friendly dormitory and residential services to over 10,000 students in 16 hostels - ten for boys and six for girls. Accommodation options include single, double, triple, and quadruple sharing rooms in both AC and non-AC configurations. Rooms are well-equipped with necessities like mattresses, study tables, and wardrobes, as well as access to utilities like geysers, RO water, and washing machines. Each hostel has reading rooms, indoor games, TV lounges, and gyms, with Vyom Hall standing out for its modern amenities and cutting-edge gym. Mess facilities, managed by Sodexo or the hostel itself, provide regular meals with vegetarian and non-vegetarian alternatives, and most students consider the cuisine to be of reasonable quality. Laundry services are given twice a week, with optional third-party services such as U Clean available. Wi-Fi is available 24/7; however, speeds may vary during peak hours. Security is provided by biometric access, CCTV, and 24-hour caretakers. With plenty of sports and recreational opportunities nearby, as well as common areas and study lounges, TIET's hostel life offers a good mixture of comfort, safety, and community involvement.

sections.heading: TIET Hostel Fee
text: Students can check the hostel fee of Thapar University below. The hostel provides a number of basic as well as additional facilities to the students. The mess fee is charged separately.
Hostel Fee-LMTSM, Dera Bassi, as well as the Mess Fee, are given below to help students have an idea of the hostel fee at the campus.

sections.heading: TIET Library
text: Nava Nalanda Central Library is a five-storeyed iconic library situated in the centre of the campus. The area of the library building is 7182 square metres, along with 2044 square metres of garden area. The garden area is made of a beautiful combination of red stone, marble stone and precisely arranged internal wooden architecture. The library is built in a way that adequate natural light can be enjoyed. Students can sit in the park to relax their minds. The building of the library is aesthetically designed, and has a seating capacity of eight hundred. Each seat has a radiant cooling air handling unit. The library is fully equipped with modern technology such as an RFID-based security System, Self-Check-in, and Self-Return system with minimal human interference. The library also has dedicated group discussion rooms with AC, LED, a Projector, and comfortable seating. The staff of the library is very helpful and friendly, and offers help relating to matters such as arranging inter-library loans and receiving suggestions for new acquisitions. The library focuses on learning and research by prioritising digital collections and providing excellent study environments and facilities. In the recent period library has shifted swiftly and efficiently to a digital/online mode and procured more than 2 lakh e-books.

sections.heading: TIET Sports Facilities
text: Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology (TIET), Patiala, offers sports facilities to promote the holistic development of students. The institute has well-maintained playgrounds and an international-standard athletic track. To encourage students to take part in different games such as Cricket, Hockey, Football, Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Lawn Tennis and Badminton, the institute has built a synthetic tennis court synthetic Basketball court and a Synthetic Badminton indoor court. The institute also has a gym to promote health and fitness among students. A swimming pool is also maintained with all the modern facilities. Various sporting events such as 'Thaparlympics', 'IGNITE' and URJA are organised every year to increase participation among students.

sections.heading: Places to visit around the TIET Campus
text: Students at Thapar University have a lot of options to visit nearby in their free time. Some of the famous destinations to visit include Qila Mubarak, Moti Bagh Palace, Sheesh Mahal, Lachman Jhula, and Gurudwara Dukhniwaran Sahib. There are many restaurants and shopping complexes nearby, too.
For more information about Thapar University, check out the video below:

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The Library housed in a centrally air-conditioned aesthetically designed building which remains open for 24 hours on all the 365 days. The print collection of over 1,06,000 volumes consists of books, theses and dissertations, back volumes of journals, standards, and reports. Electronic collection of over 4500 units consists of Audio-Visual Materials such as CD/ VCD/ DVD. There is an impressive research and reference collection comprising of reference books, bibliographic databases, research reports, and standards. Adequate provision of professional and supplementary reading material in addition to standard text books has been made in the library collection. The Library also has growing collections of books and multimedia items for leisure, personality development, homemaking and other soft skills. The collection is regularly updated with latest editions and new publications. The Library has four reading halls with a combine seating capacity of 350 seats.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: The Institute has 13 hostels (8 for boys and 5 for girls) with all basic facilities including water coolers with gym room, TV room, AC reading room, table tennis room, night canteen, RO water, washing machines and geyser all the bathrooms, indoor games, lawns, and wi-fi connectivity. The hostel mess caters to all the food and nutritional requirements of students. The menu for all meal sessions is changed regularly to provide variety and wholesome nourishment. For security purposes, the hostel is fully equipped with CCTV cameras along with a security guard for 24 hours.

highlights.summary:
Formerly known as Delhi College of Engineering (DCE), Delhi Technological University (DTU) was established in 1941 yr. Delhi Technological University is ISO-certified & was earlier affiliated with the University of Delhi. Delhi Technological University is one of the best universities offering Engineering courses to students. Delhi Technological University, through 17 departments, offers UG, PG, & various other courses to students. These DTU University Delhi courses are provided across the Engineering, Economics, & various other streams. DTU Rohini is famous for its flagship courses, which are MBA, BDes, & BTech.
DCE Delhi is ranked 700 by the QS Ranking 2026 under the Asian University Rankings. DTU University has also been ranked 214 by the QS Asian University Rankings - Southern Asia. As per the DTU NIRF Ranking 2025, the Delhi Technological University DTU has received 30th position under the Engg category & 62nd under the Overall category by NIRF 2025.
DTU University Delhi offers placement support to students & is visited by top companies like Samsung, Microsoft, Zomato, etc. Lately, Ashwini Vaishnaw, the Union Minister for Electronics & IT, inaugurated the Vinod Dham Centre of Excellence for Semiconductors & Microelectronics. DTU University is rolling out new specialisations under the BTech programme. These new DCE specialisations are available in Semiconductors, AI, & Data Analytics. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing Engineering
reviews.review_title: Chill campus life and great placements.

detailed_review.Placements: I am pursuing B.Tech in Mathematics and Computing Engineering (MnC) from DTU. Since it is one of the tech branches, the placement states are pretty good. All the tech branches here have more or less the same placement states. Talking about my department in particular, the official placement data of the year 2024 placed students 82.89%. The highest package offered was 85.30 LPA. The average package offered was 18.90 LPA while the overall average of the B.Tech course, including all the branches, was 15.45 LPA. Some top recruiters are Microsoft, Atlassian, Sandisk, Accenture, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If I talk about the overall infrastructure of the campus, then it is probably one of the best things here. The classrooms are equipped with all of the facilities, including centralised A/C and projectors. The library is also very well built and provides a very peaceful environment to work. High-speed internet is also available in the library. Although the girls' hostels are newly built and have a well-made modern infrastructure. The boys' hostels, on the other hand, are really very bad and congested. Hostel availability is also very limited here.
detailed_review.Faculty: The quality of faculty varies department to department. My personal experience with faculty members has been pretty decent. The lectures are not that helpful, in the end, we have to study on our own before exams. But the faculty members are not that strict with us and assign very limited work. The labs, although, have been the most painful part of it all. Exams are not that difficult, even if you study well in the last 2 weeks before exams, you are expected to score above average marks. The overall academic life is not that hectic.
detailed_review.Other: One thing that I really liked about this college is the societies here. There are so many societies, and they have so many talented people there who are doing so much with them and achieving so much good. There is a society for almost every interest, and they provide a very useful exposure and learning environment.

reviews.review_title: Review DTU - Delhi Technological University for the 2026 batch.

detailed_review.Placements: 80 percent of students get placed. The highest package is 45 LPA, and the lowest package is 8 LPA. The average package is 13 LPA. Texas Instruments company hires students from the college. 45 percent of students get internships. Non-tech, tech, and core companies visit the college to hire students. Many companies that come have a set of criteria for selecting students. CGPA is a very crucial factor, and getting a good CGPA is very important.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has the best library with many books to concentrate on studies. Windows are installed for ventilation. The library is filled with students because of the atmosphere it provides. I love the library a lot. Hostels are great too. Warden is nice. There is also a TV room.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. The course curriculum is very beneficial. Semester exams are tough, but can be cracked with one week of preparation. Faculty members are helpful, and they are kind like our parents. Hence, I like the faculty members.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it excites me. DTU fests are the best.

reviews.review_title: I am well satisfied..It is one of the best and oldest college in Delhi with a very high alumni base.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 70 percent of students placed in my course. The highest in 2024 year is 31 LPA and in 2022 year is in crores. Teach companies also allow some students who have high CGPA. Students who are serious in studies also get internship in DRDO. All students have to do hard work, but college life is hill.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is not in the first-year hostel. But students can set up Wi-Fi by mutual sharing. Otherwise, from second hostel, Wi-Fi is there. Food quality is awesome. They give non-veg too except Tuesday and Thursday. Medical facility is good. Sports and games are very nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers and facilities are highly qualified and well educated. They help students at every moment. Teaching quality is good. All teachers have done M. Tech, Ph.D., etc. Curriculum is very relevant and according to NEP 2020. It makes students industry ready.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course according to my rank. But every branch in this college is good and has its own importance. Mechanical branch is one of the best in DTU and one of the oldest.

reviews.review_title: Fantastic college, good placement, and college life.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course 75 percent of students got placed. The highest package offered is 82 LPA. The lowest package is 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Google, Apple, Facebook, Amazon, Flipkart, Samsung, and Goldman Sachs. 20 percent of students from my course got internships in companies like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and Adobe. Top roles offered in my course are in SDE, business analyst, and consultant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is top-notch. Classroom, Wi-Fi, library, and sports facilities are all top-notch. The condition of the hostels allotted in the first year is not very good. But the newly constructed hostels, which are allotted to students from the 2nd year onwards, are very good. Mess food is pretty average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are pretty good. They are very knowledgeable. Some teachers are there who teach very well, but some are not good at teaching, even after being knowledgeable. The course curriculum is quite relevant. The fourth-year students are industry-ready. They are very good at what they are doing. Semester exams are not very difficult in our college. If any student studies regularly even for 2 to 3 hours then also he/she can get good marks. Almost all the students pass the semester exam. Only a few students, 5 to 10 percent of students, fail the exam.
detailed_review.Other: The college is very amazing. Top-notch placement. Top sports facilities and events. Seniors are very helpful and supportive. The college has a lot of interesting societies.

reviews.review_title: Review of DTU - Delhi Technological University.

detailed_review.Placements: 40% of students are placed overall, as far as I know. The highest package goes up to 84 LPA, and the lowest can be unplaced. The companies are Deloitte, Texas Instruments, and Nvidia. The internship rate is 2-3%. Roles offered are embedded engineer, software developer, data analyst, and non-tech roles such as consulting and finance.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are bad. Nothing else is satisfactory. Infrastructure, food, and mess are all bad. Recently, a student dies in a hostel due to poor medical facilities, which raises concerns about the quality of medical care. Ambulances always come late, and there is a lack of ambulances. Sports facilities on campus are decent. For hostels, there are some table tennis and badminton courts.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified. They are knowledgeable and decently helpful, but we are not able to use their expertise due to the outdated curriculum. Semester exams are decent, not very tough, not very easy. Checking depends a lot on the professor.
detailed_review.Other: There are 69 students. I chose it because it is a tier-1 college with a strong brand. More customization would be appreciated. There is no attendance policy. Events, fests, campus crowd, connectivity, campus surroundings, scholarships, and extracurricular activities are hyped a lot, but I have yet to see them.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing Engineering
reviews.review_title: It offers average facilities. The college is good.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good, but decreasing every year, and it is the same for every college, except for some IITs. The average offered in my branch is 15 LPA. 60 to 70 percent is the placement ratio here. I am in the first year, so I have only this much knowledge about placements. The department is good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has fewer hostel facilities. I am living 130 KM away from DTU, and I still have not got a hostel. My hostel friend says the food is not good, and sometimes, they find expired items. Rooms are also not in very good condition. The 2nd year boys' and girls' hostels, which are newly built, are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: It charges Rs. 7,500 for one subject back. We have to score 21 from MTE and ETE. We have to score 35 from MTE, ETE, PRS, and PRE to not get a backlog. Some subjects are very tough, like electrical and electronics, in which many students fail. Some subjects are relevant, and some are not.

reviews.review_title: A decent college till now.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 50 percent of students are placed, it might be greater or less than this. In 2025, the highest package is 22 LPA and the average Is 9.81 LPA I am talking about Mechanical Engineering (Automotive). For the teaching posts, only big companies are open for all. I cannot say exactly what the roles are because I am a first-year student.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If you are talking about hostels, then the hostels are decent. We have facilities like water coolers for drinking water, and there is a mess near the hostel which serves food four times a day. There is also a help centre near the first-year hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: This is a subjective topic, but according to me, some of the teachers act like typical college teachers and can be rude sometimes because of their ego. However, some teachers are really helpful and support students not only in the first year but also till the last year, as per seniors’ experience.
detailed_review.Other: I got this course through the physical spot round, so it is not my choice. If I could have chosen, as everyone says, I would have taken Computer Science Engineering. There has been no fest in the first semester so far, but let's see in the future; I hope it will be good.

reviews.review_title: Good campus, which I was expecting.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement cell in college is very good and useful. It gives wide opportunities and internships in many companies. Non-tech students get the highest placement in civil engineering of 17 LPA per annum. Top recruiting companies overall were Amazon, Facebook, Google, and Microsoft.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is very good with zero ragging in college, and the food in the mess is also good. Labs in college are very good with great instruments, so students can do better experiments. I also like the sports culture, as there is an extra fest for sports organized on campus to encourage children more.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and qualified, and also give regular assignments for practice. Exams are not too difficult. They are average. My course is more relevant, and the overall pass percentage is about 80%. Teachers also help weak students with their work.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course not as my first option, but because it is the best based on my rank in JEE, but now I am getting into it, so I get better results.

reviews.review_title: It is a very good college.

detailed_review.Placements: 48 percent of students get placements. The highest is 20 LPA, and the average is 9 LPA. Tata projects and big companies provide good government job opportunities in civil engineering. DTU is a very good college, including top technology firms like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as major Public Sector Undertakings.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: A very good college infrastructure is available in civil engineering with good facilities. Good food and a clean mess. DTU's infrastructure includes a large campus with advanced academic facilities like well-equipped labs, a central library, and numerous departmental libraries.
detailed_review.Faculty: A very good college infrastructure is available in civil engineering with good facilities. Good food and a clean mess. DTU's infrastructure includes a large campus with advanced academic facilities like well-equipped labs, a central library, and numerous departmental libraries.
detailed_review.Other: It provides various opportunities in government and private jobs. Very good fest in college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the placement in 2025, good infrastructure and facilities, and decent faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: I'm in my first year, so I don't have much idea about the current placement inside, but from what I have seen, the placement for CSE is nearly 20 LPA with a batch of around 600 students. I think that's very good for ECE, my branch is around 16 - 17 LPA, since I'm more interested in core ECE and because of the location in Delhi, and being reputed (Formerly DCE), major core companies like Nvidia, Intel do visit the college which is a big plus since specially in ECE in core generally jobs are after M.Tech.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The lecture complex is fine, it has centralised AC, and the desks are not the best, but definitely more than enough. Fine Wi-Fi is available in the library and lecture complex. The speed is fine, just you have to register every time you log in, which is a bit annoying but okay. Labs of the first year are decent, not too much to complain about there. Sports facilities are my personal favourite, especially the cricket and football grounds, which are sublime. There is badminton (indoor and outdoor), lawn tennis, table tennis, kabaddi, volleyball, basketball facilities, and more or less every major sport is available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers depend especially in the first year, when there is no senior faculty teaching, some are assistant professors, or some are post-graduation teachers. It depends, generally, assistant professors are fine, most of them are chill, they provide notes and everything, but only a few teachers explain properly, at least till now. I don't get the point of Chemistry in the first sem of ECE. Semester exams are not very difficult, just do the assignments and previous papers properly, and you can give them easily, but the regulations against cheating are strict, especially at the end of the semester.
detailed_review.Other: I chose ECE over CSE because I think the future in ECE, especially in electronics with semiconductors, is very good, even though I have an interest in coding, but I think ECE is the correct mix of coding with hardware. I feel like if you are not sure between core, coding, software, or hardware, ECE is the branch where you can find your interest. Events and fests of DTU are famous, but for some reason, this year, there are no freshers nor dandiya nights. There was Uphaar (Diwali mela), which was, to be honest, very good, we enjoyed it a lot.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good brand value and decent tech placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Overall placement states may be low. But placements are good for tech branches, like CSE, Maths computing, Software, IT, etc. Students of branches like environment and Biotech are rarely placed. The placement value is good. And the companies are reputable.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not of good quality. Some hostels are good with AC, but 1st year hostels are very old and in terrible conditions. The classrooms lack proper Wi-Fi. But this all being secondary, the primary thing is the lack of clean water on campus. Once, a lizard was found inside the water dispenser near our classrooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty, curriculum and exams are all outdated. There is very little faculty that actually come to teach. Others are just doing formality. The curriculum is very old. Most of the students study from online lectures that are 10-15 years old. The world and technology have come a long way from there.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing would be brand value and the peer group.

reviews.review_title: Delhi Technological University - DTU talks and tables.

detailed_review.Placements: According to the number of students studying in the university, the placements are average. The number of companies that visit is insanely remarkable, thus making the placements in comparison to other colleges comparable and way better than others. Keeping this in mind, the college is very good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Course infrastructure is amazing. The Wi-Fi availability and the library are very well-equipped. The library is also open for 24 hours. When exams are coming, they happen on time.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are held with honesty, and students are helped by professors. Good resources are provided to each and every student, and the accommodation capacity is huge. External viva are held, and many practical-based exams are held to help the students to be ready to take on the real-life learning intake. Only necessary topics are taught in ML, and AI are also captivating and brilliant.
detailed_review.Other: Engifest is the most amazing fest of Delhi, and many more interesting fests are happening.

reviews.review_title: DTU is basically a brand.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80 percent of students get placed. Placement opportunities are good. Top recruiting companies include Amazon, Google, Swiggy, and Zomato. Many students also get internships, with the maximum internship value reaching 1 lakh. There are good internship opportunities for all students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is very good. There are three boys’ hostels and one girls’ hostel. All sports activities are available, including a gym and cricket nets. Wi-Fi is also available. The college has a big library, and the classrooms are well-maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are experienced and friendly. There is a good rapport between teachers and students, which makes studying enjoyable. There is not much exam pressure. The course curriculum is very relevant to the subject. The semester exams are not very difficult.
detailed_review.Other: The gender ratio is not very balanced.

reviews.review_title: Good teacher and good placement.

detailed_review.Placements: There is an overall placement percentage of 70% especially in core branches, with a placement of 65%. The highest domestic package is 85.3 LPA, and the international package is 1.8 crores. The lowest package is 6 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Google, Amazon, Flipkart, etc. The top roles offered in civil engineering are project manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is decent. The classroom is good. The labs have all the equipment required. The food is quite good. Medical facilities are not on the mark. The hostels are decent, but there needs to be improvement in the mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty are really helpful in their field. The course is relevant for the respective background. The exams are not that difficult if you have good concepts of the subjects, you can excel in the exams. The overall student pass rate is 97%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose civil engineering because I have a good interest in this field. The college should have events that are not happening in the college these days.

reviews.review_title: Review of Delhi Technological University.

detailed_review.Placements: As my branch is a newer one, not many students got placed in it. About 50-60 percent got placed, the highest package is 15 LPA, which I heard from students until now, as placement season is still going on. Companies like Bajaj and Maruti come here. One of our seniors from my society is currently working as an intern at Maruti Suzuki. But students in core branches generally prepare for job roles like data analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: 1st year hostels are the worst, no Wi-Fi. Labs and classrooms are good. The library is also good, but timings are limited, which is a bad thing (9:30 to 21:30) and on holidays, they close the library. Holidays are the only days on which we get an opportunity to study in the library, it is supposed to be open on holidays. Hostels-bad, library- okay, crowd - best for me, placements- nice, sports facilities - good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and qualified, and we also get separate lectures only for doubts. Curriculum is updated, in CSE, we get the opportunity to learn web design from the 1st semester itself. Semester exams have a good level of questions, most of the questions are from PyQs.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing Engineering
reviews.review_title: Life at DTU has both problems and benefits.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 75 percent of students get placed in our college in my branch. The highest package is around 85.3 LPA, and the average package is around 15 LPA. Companies like Atlassian, Google, Microsoft, and Goldman Sachs regularly visit our college for placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college is quite poor in terms of providing facilities. The college library Wi-Fi does not work properly. Labs are poorly equipped, and most equipment does not work. However, the outlet areas are quite good with outlets like Hims, Dominos, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are quite good, but the problem is that the course curriculum is not relevant due to technologies like AI, which is a problem in almost every engineering college. However, the examination department is quite good with good teachers. But what benefit do I get if I have to learn academic skills beyond the curriculum.

reviews.review_title: College is good with an excellent placement rate, a good campus view, and a hill vibe.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage of DTU is above 85%. The highest package is 64 LPA, the average package is 20 LPA, and the lowest package is in the range of 7 to 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, and Amazon. The internship rate is above 90 per cent in companies like Google, Amazon, Apple, and Cisco. Top roles include software development engineer, web developer, and full-stack developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities in DTU are quite good, with a good Wi-Fi connection, proper labs, and classrooms with a capacity of around 100 students with comfortable tables. The library is also very good, with many books on different topics, a good Wi-Fi connection, and proper facilities with a lot of space for reading and studying it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and helpful, with great knowledge in their fields. They are experts in their core subjects. The course is curriculum-related and provides a wide scope in the tech industry. It prepares students for the industry and encourages them to go beyond the limits of the industry. Semester exams are quite moderate, with a pass percentage of around 30 to 33%.
detailed_review.Other: I have a great interest in software development, so I chose this course. This course is solid and still allows us to compete in placements with CSE students, which is a good thing about it. I don't think anything needs to be upgraded in my course. Events and fests are quite good in this college, having fests like Yuvaan and Engifest, which are the largest fests in North India. The college has connectivity with metro stations around it; Samaypur Badli and Rithala are the closest to it. It also gives students opportunities for scholarships.

reviews.review_title: Placements were lower in 2024-2025 as compared to previous years.

detailed_review.Placements: In B.Tech, Electrical Engineering, placement offers for 2024-25 were 153 out of 285 registrations on campus. The average CTC offered was 12.89 LPA, with the highest package being 45 LPA. Top roles offered are generally technical roles like SDE, and top firms like Microsoft, Deloitte, and Atlassian, and come for recruiting. Internships are open only to students of a certain calibre.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: First-year hostel rooms are pretty average, but all the facilities are available, like a common room, and there is a central library on campus. The quality of food in the mess is also above average compared to other government colleges. There is a health centre for medicine on the college campus. The sports and games infrastructure is top-notch. There are some cons as well, like Wi-Fi speeds are low, and the rooms don't have proper flooring.
detailed_review.Faculty: Campus life is good, exposure is good, crowd is also good, sometimes mixed. Events and fests this year were not up to the mark, as there has been just one fest, the Diwali mela, and no freshers till now; these things can be improved. Sports activities are good, and the infrastructure, competitions are also held, which are highly competitive.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is good, exposure is good, crowd is also good, sometimes mixed. Events and fests this year were not up to the mark, as there has been just one fest, the Diwali mela, and no freshers till now, these things can be improved. Sports activities are good, and the infrastructure, competitions are also held, which are highly competitive.

reviews.review_title: A short review about DTU.

detailed_review.Placements: For the DTU batch of 2024, many companies arrived, and the placement went well, with the highest being 86 LPA and an average package of 15.33 for the overall college. While talking about the 2024 class of EP, the highest went about 26 LPA or more, whereas the average was around 11 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: 1st year hostels are very poorly built, and they are from old times, like when the university was built, which tells you about their condition. It's safe to say the 1st year's ones are not decent for living. The food quality is also very poor, it's just okay.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are great, but some professors are just too much to bear. Otherwise, most are great. About exam strictness, it has increased significantly in recent years, and the course is also now more oriented towards the subject. The recent exam is a complete mess.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied completely because of the great opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: The overall placement percentage for chemical engineering was 68%. The highest package offered was 16 LPA, and the lowest is 4.5 LPA. Some students may go for higher studies or preparation for government exams. Students who sit in the placements and have worked get the job.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The labs, classrooms, Wi-Fi, etc, are of top-quality and are quite good and have all the facilities. The mess is cleaned, and a quality check takes place 2 times a week. The hostels are equipped with Wi-Fi, they have badminton and table tennis courts, and many more.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified in their own department. Most of the teachers have a PhD degree, or they are pursuing Ph.D. degree. They have great knowledge of their subjects, and some of the teachers can deliver their knowledge to the students, while others do not.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I had an interest in Science. The best thing about this course especially in this college, is that the placements are really good, and you would get placed if you know. The course curriculum can be improved by removing outdated material. Regular events happen in this college; the campus is huge, and events are a regular part. The campus crowd is mostly the Delhi crowd, so it is good. Fest in this college is one of the greatest fests of the country, the Engi Fest. There is a lot to do in this college.

faqs.question: How do I get admission to DTU?
faqs.answer: Delhi Technological University offers various UG and PG courses through its 17 17 departments. These courses are provided across the Engineering, Economics, and various other streams. The famous flagship courses are the MBA and B.Tech.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility and selection criteria for various courses at DTU?
faqs.answer: The eligibility and selection criteria varies course to course depending upon the course level and the field of the programme. Check out the table below to learn more about the same: Class 12 with 60% aggregate Class 12 in any stream

faqs.question: Does Delhi Technological University accept CAT score?
faqs.answer: Yes, Delhi Technological University accepts CAT for admission to MBA programme. DTU offers two years MBA via its own campus, Delhi School of Management (DSM) and University School of Management and Entrepreneurship (USME) across specialisations such as General, Business Analytics, Family Business & Entrepreneurship and Entrepreneurship, Innovation & Venture Development. Admission to all the MBA programmes offered by DTU campus or other off-campus colleges is entrance-based

faqs.question: Who is eligible for the BDes at DTU?

sections.heading: Introduction
text: DTU, originally known as Delhi College of Engineering (DCE), is a famous college with top-notch facilities and services located on a vast 164-acre campus. A centre of academic excellence, the library is extensively digitised and offers online access to many databases and periodicals. With facilities including cricket, football, hockey, and tennis fields, basketball courts, and a gymnasium, DTU's expansive Sports Complex is a hive of activity. DTU features a Central Library with a collection of books, periodicals, and research papers in addition to department-specific labs and equipment.

sections.heading: DTU Campus Highlights 2024
text: Delhi Technological University is one of the largest universities in India. The university has a modern infrastructure encompassing libraries, hostels, sports facilities, labs and more. Read more to know about the infrastructure of the university:
Campus View:

tables.DTU Campus Highlights: Library, Sports Facilities, Cafeteria, Labs, Hostels

sections.heading: DTU Hostel & Residential Facilities
text: DTU offers boys and girls hostel to the students. The hostels at the institute are clean, safe and comfortable. The hostel has a good LAN connection for internet usage. The staff at the hostels are friendly and supportive towards the students. All the necessities such as bed, chair, almirah, 24*7 water and electricity etc are available. The food at the hostel mess is loved by students. The hostel also offers medical facilities at all times apart from the medical treatment and ambulance which is always available. There is a common TV area and sports area as well.

sections.heading: DTU Hostel Fee
text: DTU provides hostels which are not only comfortable and safe but also affordable. The charges for the hostel and mess are to be paid separately. Students can check the hostel and mess fee in the table given below:
*These charges are subject to change from time to time

sections.heading: DTU Hostel Life
text: Amidst the challenges of adjusting to a new routine and environment, DTU hostel life offers opportunities for learning, fun, and making memories that define the college experience. Safety and security are given priority at the DTU hostel and students are exposed to a dynamic environment along with a friendly atmosphere.

sections.heading: DTU Academic and Research Facilities
text: Delhi Technological University is known to be one of the top universities in the country, The university focuses on establishing centres of excellence in emerging areas of science, engineering, technology, management and affiliated areas. The university upholds its golden past and continues to deliver the best in the areas of education, research, innovation, and extension activities. With complete financial, administrative and infrastructural support for its entire fraternity, DTU always strives to add more pages to the book of its glorious history and keeps progressing forward each year by taking inspiration from its past achievements.

sections.heading: DTU Library
text: Delhi Technological University has a Central Library and 15 departmental libraries. These libraries collectively support the teaching, support and extension programme of the institute. All students, faculty members and employees of the college are encouraged to use the library. The library has a huge collection of books on engineering, science and humanities, and also offers various services through different departments. To make DTU library a 21st-century library, and to facilitate the transition of the engineering society to a knowledge base society, the library has adopted modern technologies. The library has been digitalized and is accessible through the intranet and the internet Therefore, along with the traditional library, the institute provides a Virtual Library and a Knowledge Centre.

sections.heading: DTU Sports Facilities
text: The college provides excellent sports facilities to the students to encourage them to participate in sports in/around NCR Delhi, especially engineering colleges. The college has a 400 m track, ground for playing Football, Hockey, and Cricket; two courts for volleyball, two courts for basketball, three courts for tennis and five courts for badminton, table tennis rooms, chess rooms, carrom rooms, and gyms in each hostel of the college campus.

ARENA is a sports festival which is organized to recognise upcoming sportsperson The sports played at the festival include athletics, badminton, table tennis, basketball, carrom, chess, cricket, tennis and volleyball, where a large population of girls and boys participate. Prizes and certificates are awarded to the winners. The sports year also involves the organization of the Inter Hostel Tournaments in various games i.e. badminton, basketball, carrom, chess, cricket, football, table tennis, volleyball and tennis.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the DTU Campus
text: Delhi Technological University is located in North-West Delhi, approximately 32 km from Indira Gandhi International Airport. In their free time, students can explore monuments such as the Red Fort, Hauz Khas, Akshardham, or Lotus Temple. Students can also visit malls in West Delhi for shopping or eating.

The hostels are okay, not too good, but there are new multi-storeyed hostel being constructed, and they all top-notch facilities one needs.
