highlights.summary:
Chandigarh University is a private university and is accreditted A+ Grade by NAAC and NBA. It is UGC, AICTE, BCI, NCHMCT, PCI, NCTE, COA, AIU, and CSI recognised too. CU is also a member of ICAR, AUAP, IAU, ACU, IEEE, ASME, IUCEE, and ACS.
The university ranked among the top 2% out of the 28,500 institutions globally by the QS World University Rankings 2026, CU has made a jump of 125 places and now stands at the global rank of 575. Chandigarh University ranks as India's No. 1 Private University for Three Years in a Row in QS Asia Rankings. Further, the overall rank has improved significantly to 109, up from 120.
Moving up twenty nine spots from last year, it is now at rank 120 among Asian institutions. This has placed it within the top 2% of higher educational institutions (HEIs) in Asia.
Chandigarh University secured the below rank as per NIRF 2025:
In 2019, CU became the youngest university in the country to be assessed and accredited by NAAC and granted an A+ grade in the first cycle itself. Chandigarh University had also become the only state-private university of Punjab to be accredited by NAAC. It is the Only University in Punjab and the region to get accredited by NBA for its Civil, Electrical, Electronics and Communications, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Aerospace Engineering & MBA programs.
Additionally, the university offers ABET-accredited programmes. It is the first Private University in India to have the highest number of engineering programmes accredited by ABET.
The university has achieved an ASSOCHAM GEM 4 rating in Green Building and Sustainability Certification. The university has ranked 7 among the top 10 private institutions in India in the Atal Ranking of Institutions on Innovation Achievements (An Initiative of the Ministry of Education).
Chandigarh Punjab University, through 18 institutes and various departments, offers UG, PG, and PhD courses to students across the Management, Engineering, and other streams. Some highlights for Chandigarh University are mentioned below:

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Placement cell and hostel food quality could be improved. The campus life is very cool.

detailed_review.Placements: Talking about the placement, which is very important for students in my course, the placement percentage is very low and the highest package is 50 LPA. The top companies that come are Flipkart, Amazon, etc. There are no specific requirements for internships. They even take an extra amount from students, approximately 10k at my time, and then increase it every year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel and department infrastructure is very good. We have ACs in our classroom and basic facilities like Wi-Fi, projectors, etc. Now, talking about the hostel, it has a lift and ACs in the rooms. The disappointing factor is the hostel food, which is not worth a penny, and I myself don't like it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Talking about the faculty, some of them are very helpful, but no matter what, there is biasness with students, which should not be there. The course includes informative subjects that enhance our knowledge, but some subjects feel like a waste of time and there is no need to study that.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Campus life is amazing, but I am dissatisfied with the college.

detailed_review.Placements: The number of students placed from my course is just 2 out of 1500, so the ratio is very low. Sometimes, the college uses a cut-off and does not allow students to sit in placement drives. The highest package is around 1.2 crore, but nobody knows for sure. The lowest is about 1–2 LPA, and the average is 3–4 LPA. Top companies that come include Adobe, Samsung, TCS, and Deloitte. The same situation applies to internships. Students mostly have to look outside for opportunities. Mostly, the roles offered by companies are trainee or web developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure in my department are average. In some labs and classrooms, everything works fine, but in others, many things do not work. Hostels require students to adjust to living conditions, and food quality is not very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, but many are less experienced, and concepts are not always clear. The curriculum is very theoretical with little practical exposure, so it does not make students industry-ready. Semester exams are easy to average, but to get good grades, students need to be punctual.

reviews.review_title: It's a private university, but we should aim for a government college.

detailed_review.Placements: The college offers a good number of placement opportunities for postgraduate and undergraduate students. Students become eligible for their placements from the fifth semester (undergraduate) and the third semester (postgraduate). The average package offered is around 6 LPA, and the highest package offered is 10 LPA. Companies that visit the college for placements are Cipla, Microsoft, Unacademy, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: My overall campus experience was good. I met a lot of people, and they are kind to me. There is no ragging at all. There is a library in each block across campus, and we can go anywhere we want. There is a good range of books, from journals to academic to fiction. There are sports events going on every semester, from department level to university level. There are many clubs and societies, which are led by students. There is a Wi-Fi facility in each block. There is a huge number of labs and a library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are brilliant and are experts in their field. They make it easy to understand concepts. They are always there to help students in any possible way. In each semester, for theory subjects, there are 60 marks external (end-semester exams) and 40 marks internals. Internals consist of mid-semester tests (held twice every semester), assignments/term papers, presentations, surprise tests, quizzes, and 2 marks for attendance above 90%. For practicals, there are 60 marks of internals, which consist of 9 practicals and 1 project, along with a mid-semester practical conducted once every semester.

reviews.course: B.E. (Hons.) in CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) in association with IBM
reviews.review_title: Good college, nice atmosphere.

detailed_review.Placements: If a student works hard enough, they will be able to get into a good company. Microsoft and Google are the few companies that offer a package of 35 LPA, but these packages are for the top 5% of students, I guess. There is this joint placement thing in Chandigarh University, where students from other surrounding universities and colleges also come here for the placements. The courses are pretty good in order to shape the student for the industry.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Every department has its own library, and the central library is also available in the university with a good Wi-Fi connection. Classrooms are very well furnished, neat and clean. Projectors and Wi-Fi are also available in the classrooms. The infrastructure of this university is very good, and the university provides all types of facilities, like hostel facilities, medical facilities, and a food court to the students. The university organises lots of sports and extracurricular activities every month for the development of the students. Many social groups and clubs are also there for the welfare of the university and students.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is decent. Some teachers are pretty good and have knowledge about the subject while some just teach from the pdf, PPT's they are provided with. There are approximately 32-40 students in a class, and in combined classes, it can go up to 75 students. Some faculty teachers go with a practical approach like doing the tasks assigned in the class while some will go with giving everything for assignments.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the machine learning course because I am interested in it, and also, it's one of the emerging fields in the upcoming years.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: One of the best colleges for getting placements if we work hard from the beginning.

detailed_review.Placements: Students get placed if they study well. Many companies come, but students are not able to clear the cutoff. Around 20 percent of students get placed. People focus more on coding language, but they should also focus on aptitude because that is the core. If we study hard, we will easily crack placements because many companies start recruiting students from the third year itself. One of my batchmates has just grabbed a package of 32 LPA in the third year itself.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is the best. Even celebrities come here to shoot their stuff. Hostel living is good, but the only concern is the mess. Otherwise, everything is alright. The only lack is that they don't have enough sports grounds for students, which should be taken care.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are very useful, but many teachers are so egoistic. It is easy to clear the semester exams because papers are easy. Many teachers help us like our parents. They are very supportive. Teachers over here have good knowledge of their subjects.

reviews.course: B.E. (Hons.) in CSE (Internet of Things & Artificial Intelligence) in association with IBM
reviews.review_title: Overall good college, but placement support could be better.

detailed_review.Placements: 38 percent of students got placed. The highest is 64 LPA, the average is 4.6 LPA, and the lowest is 2.2 LPA. Major recruiting companies are TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, and Deloitte. 1 percent of students got internships through drives. Roles offered are Data Analyst, SDE, and Web Developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has facilities like high-quality labs with all the required equipment, high-speed Wi-Fi, and classrooms with good projectors, coolers, and a library that contains all types of books needed for research. The quality of hostels is mid. The food tastes very bad, and the canteens are providing overpriced food, but with good medical facilities, and sports are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are well qualified and have all the knowledge required to teach and make us learn, and the quality of teaching is actually average. The course curriculum is relevant. They make us learn the latest courses on a good platform, which makes us industry-ready. The difficulty level of semester exams is mid, and the pass percentage is 90 percent.
detailed_review.Other: The course has been in demand in recent days, and the best thing about the course is that it's easy to learn and has a lot of demand. The projects are listed. Events are mostly very boring, and the campus crowd is very high, which is one of the worst things about CU, and the scholarship is very useful for poor students.

reviews.course: B.E. (Hons.) in CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) in association with IBM
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure. The faculty is good.

detailed_review.Placements: Nearly 80 percent of students are placed. The known package of one of my senior friends is nearly 35 LPA. Companies like IBM, Microsoft, and a lot of mass hiring companies recruit here. A lot of people got their internships, approximately 50 percent in the 2nd semester itself. Roles include AI engineer, data scientist, and data analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Completely Wi-Fi campus. Classrooms are very good and well-equipped. The library is very good. Hostels are top notch. The variety of food is not much, but the taste is not bad. All facilities are available. Sports can be played in hostels, and more indoor sports are being added. Gyms are also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching quality is nice, and their notes are uploaded online, so they are very good. It makes the students industry-ready. The mid-semester exams are quite easy, but the end-semester exams are a bit harder. The end-semester exams test your understanding of the subject, but the mid-semester can be done easily.
detailed_review.Other: I wanted to pursue my career in AI and Data Science, so I chose this course. The university has a lot of fests and provides a lot of scholarships.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: BE CSE 4th year student review.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package of the college is 54 LPA, while the lowest stands at 3.5 LPA, with an average of 6-7 LPA. It’s Seventh semester going on, and around 40 percent students are placed. Top roles offered are SDE 1 and Technical Support. The companies mainly provide internship of 6 months followed by FTE conversion.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The quality of hostel is good as they are regularly cleaned and checked. The mess food is not so good. There are multiple libraries in the college and study rooms for the hostel. There are around 20+ private food shops and 5+ stuck shops for printing and other college work.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers here are mixed, some have good knowledge while some may focus only on the theory part, which is not good. The exams are held thrice: two mid-semester and end-semester. The marks distribution is 70 internal, 30 external. The exams are of moderate level.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College is not so bad at all.

detailed_review.Placements: About 90 percent of students are placed. The highest package depends on student knowledge, and the lowest is 2.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are IBM, Google, Amazon, etc. CU offers many internship opportunities for students. CU organizes many programs, seminars, and certifies the students to help grow their career journey.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: CU offers high-speed Wi-Fi, which works all the time and is also available in the labs. Labs are modern with modern digital equipment. A full educational environment is provided. The quality of hostel food is better initially, but over time, the quality has declined.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers at CU are very helpful, qualified, well-educated, and full of knowledge. Teaching quality is good, but there is not sufficient time for the semester syllabus. The course curriculum is mostly relevant. Semester exams are not very difficult, but it depends on how you prepare.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course BE CSE (IOT & AI) because of its future demand.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of CU CSE 2027. Go for it.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in our college are above average. Most big MNCs visit the campus, such as Capgemini, Cognizant, Wipro, Samsung, and Josh, among others. Most companies offer packages between 6–8 LPA, with mass hiring at 4.5 LPA. We can sit for placements from the 6th semester.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We are provided with all facilities like AC classrooms with projectors and Wi-Fi. Labs have all the equipment and the latest software installed for good practical exposure. Hostel facilities are available. Hostels are allotted on a first-come, first-served basis. The hostels are maintained regularly and have study rooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very supportive in the first year when you need them the most. Then you figure it out on your own. Teachers are there to guide and mentor. They focus more on practical knowledge than theory. Exams are not that hard, and the syllabus is covered before exams.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My college experience in a few words.

detailed_review.Placements: As I am in 3rd semester, I don't know much about real-time placement data, but I can make some points based on my experience, views, and what I have seen. Top companies like IBM, Adobe, Microsoft, Amazon, Google, and more visit our college. The role and the amount of the package are all dependent on the company. The highest package is 54 LPA, the average is around 10, and the lowest is never disclosed. Students also get internships in these companies, plus additional companies offer internships separately, and the stipend is totally dependent on the student and the company.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I have not opted for the hostel facility, but according to students living there, there are 4 and 5-seater rooms. The food is not very good. They serve one type of food with different names. About the infrastructure, we have huge, clean libraries, computer labs, and classrooms equipped with whiteboards and projectors. We can access free Wi-Fi anytime we want.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and friendly, not just in class but also after their class times. They have good knowledge about their subject and teach very well, except for some. The course curriculum is so well designed according to future industry needs and is easy to understand for every student. Semester exams are neither very easy nor very difficult. They are well designed according to students' understanding ability.
detailed_review.Other: There are various kinds of events happening almost every day, like hackathons, workshops, events, and many more. Students can participate in any of these and can get a chance to explore and connect with other people. As the crowd is very large, we can connect with anyone we want. We can find every kind of person inside the college. We can also participate in any sports or other extracurricular activities. The campus infrastructure is very huge, quiet, and peaceful. To join the college, there are scholarship opportunities of up to 100%.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the teaching faculty infrastructure and hostels, but the food could be improved.

detailed_review.Placements: The average number of students is placed every year, and the most important factor is the knowledge and skills the student has. The highest package had gone to 1-2cr, and the average package is about 4-6 LPA, and the roles for which top companies came are mostly software engineer and full-stack developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Personally, I like my hostel and my department block. We have ACs in our rooms as well as in our classrooms with Wi-Fi facility, and the library in our block is very huge and very spacious. What I don't like is the food, which I am most dissatisfied with, but we can eat from outside, which is very delicious.
detailed_review.Faculty: Talking about teachers, they are very helpful with professional development and personal issues. The course curriculum is also relevant, as we learn many technologies every semester. The bad thing is that the exams don't have any pattern. They give very random questions, which are just set by the computer.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I agree with good infrastructure, but the course curriculum is not good and changes could be made.

detailed_review.Placements: About 30-40% of students are placed, even less than that. The highest package is around 1 crore, and the lowest is around 2-3 LPA. Many companies come, such as Adobe, PayPal, TCS, etc. There are many students, and the number of opportunities is very limited. In a recent case, out of 1500 students who sat for the Adobe drive, only 2 of them got selected. They come for different roles: data analyst, software engineer (mainly).
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities provided in the course and department are good. One thing that is not good is the old lab. Some have been changed now, but some are old, where some PCs do not even work. The new labs are very good and built nicely. Hostels are not up to the mark. Initially, they will show you their best rooms and some different hostels, and then, at last, will allot you something else. We don't have ACs, and coolers barely work. We do have a cafeteria, snack shops, and many other shops from where we can get food.
detailed_review.Faculty: This is the part which I don't like. Just think, you are studying CSE and you have subjects like Biology, which are mandatory but not grade courses. We already have many deadlines to deal with, and they are adding more and more, which are not even matching the skills we should have. Teachers are good and helpful, but only if you are also a bit cooperative. Semester exams are not that difficult to pass.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great infrastructure but poor curriculum.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 40 percent of students get good placements above 5 LPA. Many students do not get any placements because they lack the skills that companies require. The highest placement is 38 LPA. The lowest is 3–4 LPA. Approximately 70 percent of students get internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are good, but some labs are in old buildings. They are normal, while labs in new buildings are good and fast. Wi-Fi is present in classrooms, labs, and the library. The hostel is good, but the mess food is the worst. I suggest choosing a flat if you can, rather than a PG, because PGs are worse than hostels, so choose wisely.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty in the CSE department is not good. Many teachers are unable to explain topics clearly. They just read from the PPT. The curriculum is okay but not very good, as most of the real learning still depends on self-study. Overall, the academics are manageable, but the quality of teaching definitely needs improvement.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It offers a comprehensive industry program with an industry-ready curriculum.

detailed_review.Placements: Over 90% of CSE students get placed in 2025, with Chandigarh University recording 9,124 job offers from 900 companies. The highest package is international 1.7 crore per annum, domestic package is 54.75 LPA offered by Palo Alto Networks, and the lowest package is 3–4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Adobe, Deloitte, and Hitachi. The percentage of students securing internships is 70–80%, with companies like PayPal and Nutanix. Top roles offered are software engineer, full-stack developer, and cybersecurity analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Chandigarh University CSE department offers labs, smart classrooms, 24/7 Wi-Fi, and a central library with digital resources. Hostels are modern with AC and non-AC options, hygienic meals, canteens, medical centers, dispensaries, and extensive sports facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are generally well qualified. Many holding doctorate degrees and industry experience. They are approachable, helpful, and supportive, and emphasize practical learning alongside theory. The curriculum is designed to be industry-oriented. It includes emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence and machine learning. Semester exams in Chandigarh University are moderately challenging.

reviews.review_title: A well-rounded experience with strong placements and good campus life

detailed_review.Placements: I am from B.Tech Mechatronics, and the placements in my course have been fairly strong. Around 70 to 80 percent of students get placed if they maintain good academics and skills. The highest packages usually cross 25 to 30 LPA from top tech companies, while the average package for our course stays around 5 to 6 LPA. The lowest offers depend on the company but usually stay above 3 LPA. Companies like Bosch, Tata, Mahindra, Cognizant, Infosys, and several automation and robotics startups visit regularly.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for engineering students is one of the strong points. Labs for electronics, robotics, mechanical machines, and programming are well-equipped and used regularly. Classrooms are fitted with projectors or smart boards, and the Wi-Fi on campus works well in most academic blocks. The library has a good range of books, digital journals, and quiet study areas. Hostel facilities are decent with options for AC and non-AC rooms. The mess food is average but hygienic, and the canteen has multiple choices. There are medical facilities, a decent gym, and a wide range of sports like cricket and football.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers in my course are experienced and explain topics well with practical examples. They are approachable and helpful if you ask doubts after class. The curriculum is relevant because Mechatronics involves coding, electronics, mechanical concepts, and robotics, and the subjects reflect that mix quite well. Exams are held on time and are moderate in difficulty if you follow classes. Internal marks, lab work, and assignments also contribute, so the pass percentage is high for students who attend regularly. Overall, the course feels industry-oriented and useful.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Mechatronics because it blends electronics, mechanics, programming, and automation, which matches the direction industries are moving towards. The best parts of the course are the labs, the variety of subjects, and the exposure to both hardware and software. I wish there were even more hands-on projects built into the curriculum. The campus crowd is large, but it creates a lively environment. Events like CU Fest and Tech Invent make the atmosphere fun. Connectivity to the campus is decent, and there are many extracurricular clubs to join.

reviews.course: B.E. (Hons.) in CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) in association with IBM
reviews.review_title: Balanced academics and campus life with scope for improvement.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course 85 percent students are placed. The highest package is 12 LPA the lowest is 3.5 LPA and average is 6.5 LPA. Top recruiters included TCS Infosys and Wipro. 70 percent students secured internships in companies like TCS Cognizant and PwC. Common roles offered are analyst developer and support engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our course has modern labs high speed Wi-Fi smart classrooms and a well stocked library. The hostel provided clean spacious rooms good security and decent mess food with a canteen for extra options. Medical facilities are available round the clock and sports areas like gym courts and fields are well maintained. Overall the infrastructure and hostel environment are comfortable and supportive for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is helpful qualified and knowledgeable and the teaching quality is clear and practical. The curriculum is relevant and aligned with industry needs offering good hands on learning. Semester exams are moderate difficult but fair and most students passed with ease with an overall pass percentage of 85 to 90 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it aligned with my interests and offered strong career potential. I appreciated most is the practical learning through labs projects and supportive faculty who guided us well. Placements and industry exposure are also helpful. I wish the course included more updated tools software and extra workshops. The campus has a friendly crowd with enjoyable events fests and active clubs. Connectivity to the city is good and the surroundings felt safe. Scholarship options are available for eligible students. Overall it is a positive and balanced experience with room for improvement.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Bad placement hope and bad management.

detailed_review.Placements: I’m in the 2026 batch, pursuing Bachelors of Engineering in Computer Science. The highest package is always made up for the students who are good to the management. Also, they flex the CTC, not the TC. Nobody tells it actually. The average is 5 LPA. That’s what the top private university in India makes today. It’s very poor. Top recruiters are MAANG. Mostly students got internships for the sake of credit completion, and it is offered from the college which is a setup, they never tell the whole information. The placement percentage is 70 percent due to that. They do this for the image.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the course is good, but the management is poor. I hope they invest in good human resources. Hostel facilities are bare minimum and can be improved. Medical facilities are a scam here, and they make bills on you without your acknowledgment.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are not well qualified. The starting semesters are like getting the worst faculty, but later it improves. The course doesn’t make you industry-ready at all. I don’t know which industry they follow. Exams are easy, and passing is 75 percent.
detailed_review.Other: The campus culture is very nice compared to any other college I’ve gone to. Many talented people come here from all sorts of backgrounds. The university can really improve if they focus on quality and management. They allow every student who can afford the university, which weakens the mindset of students. Courses are really good, but faculty needs improvement. Events are very nice. Connectivity is sometimes hard because it’s on the highway. Extracurricular activities are excellent.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement but poor infrastructure and hostels.

detailed_review.Placements: In my particular course, there is a wide scope of placement and many students to get placed also, 30-40 percent of students got placed. The highest has got to 1.5 crores per annum, and the lowest is about 2 LPA-3 LPA. Students do get internship opportunities. There are different roles for which companies come.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Talking about the infrastructure and hostel, this is a part of my college life, and I don't like it. There is no good quality. The mess food is also not good. There are canteens, which are the only savior present to help from that hostel's mess food. Also, in classes, there is humidity.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some of the teachers are helpful and provide us with a lot of knowledge to learn, but on the other hand, some teachers seem to know nothing. The course curriculum in the 1st year is not good because I don't understand what I will do with the knowledge I gain from learning carpentry and wiring. Semester exams are okay sometimes, but they can also be difficult.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The side of our university that people do know but don't speak about.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed is not so good. Firstly, they will remove some students from the drive by giving the CGPA criteria. Then, some by aptitude test, after which you will be able to sit in the drive. Now talking about the highest package, like the rarest, it is approximately 1 crore, but seeing the average or the lowest, both are like 3-4 LPA. Internship getting is also very difficult from the university. Companies came for different roles like data analyst, software engineer and many.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities they provide are very basic for the amount of fees they charge. The classes are normal and have a lot of humidity in class, and some classes are also smelly. On some floors, the Wi-Fi is also not working, and in the basement, the phone network also doesn't work. The library is so normal, only one in D6 is good, every other is normal. Hostels are very bad, there are no ACs, we only have a cooler, which makes a lot of noise and hostel times are also very restrictive for girls.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are not helpful and are very biased towards their favourite students. They don't even teach well, we won't be able to understand whether they are teaching us or themselves. The curriculum is good, but some courses are a waste of time, and they make them mandatory even though they don't have any value. Getting passed is easy in semester exams, even if you study for 1 day, you can easily pass (but only pass, for good marks, you need to put more effort).

admission.title: Chandigarh University (CU) Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
Chandigarh University admission to the UG and PG courses is primarily based on Chandigarh University Common Entrance Test ( CUCET ). While CUCET is primary criteria, students can also submit valid scores of JEE Main, NATA, CAT, MAT, XAT, etc. for both admissions and scholarships to relevant courses. The application process can be completed online and the the admission occur in two phases.

For admission to the following courses, CUCET is compulsory: B.E, MBA, Integrated Law Programmes, PharmD, MPharma, MPT, BPharm, MCA, LLM, etc. Find below all about the process, criteria, and other admission-related details about Chandigarh University .

Candidates can check out the exam pattern and CUCET syllabus to prepare for the exam, which will help them score well.

faqs.question: Is CUCET compulsory for Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Chandigarh University conducts Chandigarh University Common Entrance Test (CUCET) for admission to all of its UG and PG courses. This is a common entrance exam that is applicable for admission of candidates in every stream such as Management, Humanities, Science, Commerce, Engineering, etc. To get admission to any of the courses offered at Chandigarh University, students have to apply for this exam on the official website of CUCET and appear for the exam. This exam is conducted in an online mode in two phases. For admission to any of the courses, there are two decisive factors that are considered by the university for admission. These are eligibility criteria and CUCET scores.

faqs.question: What is the last date for MCA registration in Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: Admission to the MCA programme is based on CUCET scores. Candidates can apply in two phases after reviewing the complete registration details. Phase 1 registration was held on April 29, 2024, followed by the Phase 1 entrance exam conducted on April 30, 2024.

faqs.question: Is it possible to take admission to MCA at Chandigarh University without CUCET?
faqs.answer: No, there is no option to take admission to MCA course at Chandigarh University without giving CUCET. Admission to this course is entrance-based. Whoever want to take admission to MCA must appear and qualify for CUCET with a valid score as it's a mandatory step of the selection process. To appear for this exam, students have to visit the official website of CUCET and fill an application form along with paying an examination fee of worth INR 2,000. Click here to know about the in-depth details around CU MCA admissions.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for lateral entry (BPharm LE) at Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: For BPharm lateral entry admission to Chandigarh University, candidates must hold a Diploma in Pharmacy with at least 50% aggregate marks from an institute affiliated with a university or a state Board of Technical Education, approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI).

faqs.question: How is admission to the BPharm programme at Chandigarh University conducted?
faqs.answer: Admission to both the regular and lateral entry BPharm programmes at Chandigarh University is based on the candidate's performance in the CUCET (Chandigarh University Common Entrance Test). Meeting the eligibility criteria is also mandatory.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: Located in the city of Mohali, Chandigarh University is a popular private university in Punjab. Chandigarh University’s campus is widespread over 150 acres , which surely covers a large green area. The college’s campus is popular for providing modern amenities with state-of-the-art infrastructure to its students. Students can facilitate AC/ Non-AC Hostel rooms, Sports, Transport facilities, Banking services, Medical Facilities, Restaurants, Libraries, Media Centers and many more inside the campus of Chandigarh University. Read on to learn more about the Chandigarh University campus, hostel, student life, and more.
Have a glance below at the Chandigarh University campus:

text: Chandigarh University campus provides a lively and dynamic experience to students with its modern amenities and state-of-the-art infrastructure. Find below the key highlights around Chandigarh University campus:
Check out the following video for detailed highlights around the Chandigarh University campus:

sections.heading: Chandigarh University Hostel
text: Chandigarh University hostels are built inside the vast campus of the university. The hostel premises ensure the safety and comfort of students with its vigilant rules and policies. There are separate hostels available for boys and girls. The university promotes lively hostel life by providing spacious accommodations, entertainment resources, and affordable & savoring food services while ensuring proper cleanliness along with regular sports & cultural activities. Check out the following services, fees and the life provided inside the Chandigarh University hostel premises:

sections.heading: Chandigarh University Hostel Facilities
text: Find below the list of facilities available at the Chandigarh University campus:
list: Good Power Supply: The hostel has a 24*7 power supply with a supportive power backup for the smooth functioning of the regular tasks and activities.

Free Wi-Fi Internet Services:Hostels are provided with free Wi-Fi services with good speed. The internet services are easily accessible with login credentials provided to students staying in the hostel rooms.
Well-furnished common rooms:There is a 24*7 well-furnished room available to play indoor board games. The hostel also has a separate TV room for relaxation time in the free hours.

Gymnasium:For fitness freaks, Gym facilities are also provided to students. Many modern equipment and special trainers are provided for the proper guidance. The gym is open at particular times and has enough space to accommodate around 10-25 students.

Well-equipped reading rooms:To study with focus, students get separate reading rooms. These rooms maintain the ambiance of libraries and facilitate resources such as newspapers, magazines, and other reading materials.
Night Canteen & Tuck Shops:To provide groceries and essential items, tuck shops are available inside the hostels. There are canteen also available, which remains open till night.
Salon:For girls' students, a salon is given inside the hostel premises that provides all the essential services.

Visitors and Guest Room:For special visitors from the side of students’ families, separate guest rooms are available with clean and attached bathrooms. To book these rooms, prior notice must be given to authorities.

sections.heading: Chandigarh University Hostel Fee
text: As per the availability of the rooms, Chandigarh University hostel rooms for 5, 2 and 1-seater capacities are only available for boys, whereas the 3-seater rooms are provided only to international girl candidates . However, the 4 seater room sharing option is open to both boys and girls, separately. The hostel fee for Chandigarh University is the same for male and female students. Alongside, various tuck shops are also available for the basic necessities. Other than this, there is a dedicated area established for food lovers where popular food joints such as SUBWAY, NESCAFE, Punjabi Dhaba, Sip ’N Bite, etc. are open to offering delicious options at affordable rates.

For weekend getaways, students can plan to visit nearby hill stations such as Kasauli, Morni Hills, Barog and Parwanoo, etc., which are only a one-hour drive away from Chandigarh. Further, for spiritual relaxation, one can visit Anandpur Sahib and cherish the "Langar" there.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Here, it's a good campus life with strong academics.

detailed_review.Placements: In B.Tech CSE, around 85% are placed, with the highest package of approximately Rs 66 LPA, average of Rs 22 LPA and the lowest Rs. 3.5 LPA. Top recruiters are Google and DE. Shaw, Pattern, Arista, Accenture, Oracle, Sprinklr, Texas Instruments, Microsoft, etc. Top roles are SDE roles and Data Analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All departments have labs, classes, and seminar halls, with high-speed Wi-Fi. Along with this, there is a well-equipped central library and Auditorium. The hostel offers clean rooms, 24/7 water, electricity, and Wi-Fi. There are 3 messes in the institute, which offer decent food. Along with this, there is medical support and sports facilities like a gym, cricket, football, basketball, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very supportive, qualified, and teach well. Curriculum taught here is industry-relevant with practical labs and projects. Exams are moderate to hard with fair evaluation. For most of the courses, you should score 30% to pass, so most students pass comfortably.
detailed_review.Other: My batch and I chose this course for tech interest and career scope. The best parts of this are coding labs, group projects, placements, and internships. Campus has good fests, active clubs, helpful seniors and professors, scholarships and strong connectivity.

reviews.review_title: Campus life and internships at IIT Ropar

detailed_review.Placements: Since I am in the 3rd year of my degree, I am sharing about the internships at IIT Ropar, in my batch of 70 students, about 5 are selected for software development roles in companies like Microsoft, Arista Networks, and Razorpay. Almost 35 students got internships in mechanical core companies like TATA Steel, Trident, DRDO, etc. Two students got internships in product management roles at OLA, and one got an internship at JPMCt.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college provides Wi-Fi facilities throughout the 500 acres of campus area and also LAN facilities in the hostel rooms. The common rooms in all the hostels provide facilities like gym, television, and sports equipment. Some hostels also have a snooker table in the common area. The library is big and contains books on almost every subject, from novels to course books and research papers. Food available in the canteen is better than what is available at the mess; however, after visiting 3 other IITs, I can assure that our mess food is much better.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty at IIT Ropar is highly qualified, and most of them have pursued their PhDs from abroad. 75% attendance is mandatory in almost every course, and the teachers are mostly good except for a few exceptions. There are regular class committee meetings where students can give their feedback to all the professors throughout the duration of the course. The course curriculum is relevant and is regularly updated, which really helped me during my internship drive. The semester exams are not very tough but also not very easy; passing them is really easy with around 30% marks.

reviews.review_title: IIT Ropar College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements had been decent. A lot of students were really keen on applying to certain companies. The reason the pay was not that great was that there seems to be a lack of growth opportunities in the industry. Its frustrating, for sure. On the bright side, our placement cell was pretty proactive. They had a bunch of options for us to consider when applying to different companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel and the mess were decent. We had Wi-Fi in the classrooms, and you can easily access the LAN from your room in the hostel. Everything you need was right on campus. The classrooms were spacious and had projectors, which was nice. A big stadium for cricket and football, not to mention an indoor stadium for badminton.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members were good, but you really have to show up to class regularly to succeed. Most students pass, but those who barely attend do not. The curriculum could use a better structure, so students often have to figure things out on their own to be ready for the industry. The semester exams were just right in terms of difficulty, so if you want to pass, you definitely need to prepare.

reviews.review_title: IIT Ropar College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: Every student heads straight for placements. Some actually land foreign Ph.D. positions, which is pretty impressive. Others might choose to stick around in academia.  Most students placements were on campus or off. There were some academic internships out there from companies like Doubtnut and Toppr, which could be a great opportunity. The coaching industry was always on the lookout for students from the M.Sc. Chemistry branch, especially for NEET JEE, and JAM prep. There were plenty of paths to explore.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was practical, with solid facilities for both sports and academics. You can always plug into a LAN port for unlimited public Ethernet. The campus was buzzing with organized events, and the various clubs really enhance diversity and opportunities for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were definitely qualified and offered plenty of assistance. Their teaching methods were top notch, and the training programme was relevant, really gearing students up for the industry. Semester exams sit at a medium difficulty level, but the pass percentage often reflects the class average, which was around 50%.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the placement results.

detailed_review.Placements: As 98% of students from our discipline of Master of Science in Chemistry got placed, with the best package of 18.5 LPA and an average package of 5.8 LPA. Some companies, including Venkatasai Life Sciences, Syngene, Turning, and Innodata, took part in the recruitment process offering expected packages.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As there is limited access provided to students for using the laboratories, students are asked to pay a breakage fee even if they are not involved in any such incidents. Also, the classrooms are air-ventilated and equipped with water and other teaching facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are known for their solid knowledge and are paid higher salaries. They want to make their classes meaningful and understandable, so they take their own time to complete every topic. To cover the whole portion within time, most tests and exams are avoided.

reviews.review_title: Great college, should definitely consider it.

detailed_review.Placements: 80% happen to get placed. Top recruiting companies for electrical core are Nvidia and Texas. The highest salary is 65 LPA. The lowest salary is 7 LPA, and the average salary is 20 LPA. There are many companies like Nvidia and Texas for core electrical and some people go to non-core like Goldman Sachs. Some go into software development at Google, Flipkart, etc. Top role offered is software engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everything is great up to date equipments. Hostels are great as the building was made in 2019 itself so its very new. Food quality is average. Sometimes food is bad so we just go to cafeteria to eat. There is no problem in Wi-Fi. Library is open 24X7. Medical facilities and games are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: It's more about the students who come there which makes the college great. Teachers are helpful. Teachers know what to teach students sometimes not directly related but you have to increase your way of thinking by taking difficult courses. Difficult is moderate as if you study for 3-4 days you get a decent CGPA of 8. Pass percentage is 30%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: Best infrastructure among the IITs with quite good placement ratio and also a good campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 80% of students were placed last year. The highest package is around 40 LPA. The average package is around 16 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Tata Steel, JSW Paints, JP Morgan, etc. Around 45% of students got internships at Tata Steel and JP Morgan in the role of banking and marketing.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The metallurgical and materials engineering department is in Hargobind Khurana block (SAB). We have hi-tech labs with equipment like SEM, TEM, XRD, other microscopes, and other devices. We have full air conditioning and Wi-Fi network classrooms. We have 4 hostels for boys and 2 hostels for girls. We have a sports complex which has cricket, football, hockey, volleyball, tennis, basketball grounds, and gym also.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and kind. They are easily available on week days from 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM in their office. They are qualified from very respected universities like IIT, IISC, MIT, and others. The teaching quality is moderate. The course curriculum is moderately relevant. It makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams are quite tough.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Ropar - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Engineering physics is a great branch that offers a good amount of placement opportunities for students at IIT Ropar. Multiple companies come here for campus placement like Google, Microsoft, IBM, and many more which helps students to get placed easily and be satisfied.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is great, design is inspired by foreign colleges like MIT. The course infrastructure is not that great students deal with multiple issue during their courses and it is difficult to cope up with your batchmates still it is still doable.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams can be beneficial. If you study well, you can easily achieve great marks. Faculty members are also excellent, making it easier for students to adjust to college life. It primarily depends on how well the student can adapt to the college environment. Wishing everyone the best!

reviews.review_title: A deep dive into IIT Ropar.

detailed_review.Placements: 100% of students are placed in my course. The highest package, according to me, last year was 61 LPA, and the average package was 19 LPA. The top companies were HCL and Google. 74% of students got internships from my course, and they were good companies. I got to work on a good project under a professor.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Ropar provides good Wi-Fi, good labs, big classrooms, and a small library. Facilities at my hostel are good, but we don't have a balcony, and the room is too small for two students. The mess food is good sometimes and very bad at other times. The sports facilities are also very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. They explain everything clearly to everyone. Teachers are highly qualified and have good knowledge. The teaching quality is also so good. The semester exams in the college are moderate, and the passing percentage is 30%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I did not get a good rank. The campus crowd is not big, but we have a big college.

reviews.review_title: Experience in IIT Ropar (the most progressing IIT).

detailed_review.Placements: 70% of students got placed in chemical engineering in 2024. The highest package is 41 LPA, and the lowest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 22 LPA. Top companies like Google, Amazon, Oracle, and Tata Steel come to recruit. Approximately 80% of students got internships from IIT Ropar in Microsoft, Google, etc. Top roles like processing, petroleum, chemical, material, energy, and environment are provided.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are seven hostels in IIT Ropar, all having the best Wi-Fi facilities and good infrastructure. We have electrical, mechanical, chemical, CS workshop, and civil labs. We have a full-fledged LHC with six large classrooms. We have a large library containing all sorts of books. Hostels provide good facilities like proper lighting and proper sports facilities. The mess provides tasty food three times a day. Medical facilities are on the top level. We have a large sports complex which includes a football ground, cricket ground, lawn tennis court, volleyball court, basketball court, hockey ground, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are most useful, friendly, qualified, and knowledgeable. They teach tremendously. Their teaching style is awesome. The course curriculum is of utmost relevant for our future aspects. It helps in our overall understanding. Semester exams are not that difficult. They are based on what your professor has taught. The pass percentage generally depends on each course but it is mostly 30%.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen the course because my JEE rank was not sufficient. The best thing about our course is that we do not have to study much. The courses they provide could be better. The fests that took place here are Aditya (the teach fest), Aarohan (the sports fest), Zeitgeist (the cultural fest), etc. For extracurricular activities, there are many societies and clubs for each, like music, dance, robotics, coding, sports, etc. There are many scholarships for students whose family income is less than 1 lakh or between 1 lakh and 5 lakhs.

reviews.review_title: Average placements, but overall life is good at IIT Ropar.

detailed_review.Placements: By late December, less than 40% of the overall batch had been placed, with many securing PPOs. In the Civil department, placements are particularly low due to companies often excluding non-circuital students. The highest package offered in Civil is 18 LPA, the lowest is 6 LPA, and the average is around 10 LPA. Top recruiters include BPCL, Trident, and LnT. For internships, only Bechtel visited for Civil Core, hiring 1 student out of 33. However, about 50% of Civil students secured internships, mainly in non-core roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are really good. We have a whole new block for the Civil department, centrally air-conditioned, and have all kinds of equipment in all kinds of labs with all the modern technologies. Now, if we talk about the facilities in my hostel, we are given really beautiful hostels with good-quality furniture. There are issues with Wi-Fi, but everything else is good, whether you talk about the mess and canteen, sports and games, or medical facilities. Medical facilities are also available anytime, which is a good thing.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are qualified and knowledgeable, but some professors are unhelpful and do not create a friendly environment for doubts, occasionally displaying bias in grading. The course curriculum is industry-relevant, supported by industrial visits that aid practical understanding. The difficulty is moderate (6/10), with a 30% pass percentage for most courses, though the outcome can vary depending on the professors.

reviews.review_title: IIT Ropar : Journey to the future.

detailed_review.Placements: In IIT Ropar, approximately 80% of students get placed. The average package of IIT Ropar is 25 LPA. Some of the top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Tata Steel, Amazon, etc. Almost 80 to 85% of students got internships at IIT Ropar. Top roles offered in my course are software development, web development (front end or backend), etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college is fantastic. Our hostel and department building have wi-fi, classrooms are fully air conditioned, and we have the facility of a smart board and projectors. The library has AC and wi-fi. It has a variety of books. The campus is well maintained and has greenery all around. The mess food is average but not bad. The medical facility is available 24 hours a day, and there is a fantastic sports complex at IIT Ropar that has grounds for basketball, volleyball, cricket, football, lawn tennis, badminton, athletics, and many more.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, the teachers are well qualified and knowledgeable. There are very helpful at various steps. The teaching quality is very good because mostly it is practical-based so that it can help us in our future career development. Yes, this course is very useful for the student in the current technological-based era. The semester exam is both moderate and difficult; mid-semester exams are moderate, but end-semester exams are quite difficult. Almost 90 percent of students passed the exams.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I loved mathematics, and there are many job opportunities in the computer field nowadays. The passed batch of mathematics and computing in 2023 had 28 students; out of them, 24 got placed, 2 went for further studies, and 2 remain unplaced. The campus is far from the city, so it has no disturbance. There are many events, but 4 main events are conducted in our college: Zeitgeist (cultural fest), Advitiya (tech fest), Aarohan (sport fest), and Malhar (literacy fest). The scholarship at IIT Ropar is based on the family income of students.

reviews.review_title: Campus life of IIT Ropar.

detailed_review.Placements: Talking about the placement scenario, it is quite good, as our seniors are currently placed in companies like Google, Oracle, Pattern, Flipkart, BPCL, etc. The average package of the college, including all the branches of engineering in our college, is around 35 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is imposing, as we are one of the new-generation IITs. The infrastructure is maintained well by the authorities, and every year, lacs of rupees are spent to renovate the infrastructure. The hostel rooms are also well-maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers and faculty members are highly qualified in their respective domains. Every professor has certain Ph.D. students who work as Teaching Assistants (TA) under the professors. These TAs generally evaluate our quiz papers and exam answer sheets.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great hostel rooms, amazing crowd to hang out with makes my experience worth it.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement record at IIT Ropar is excellent. In the Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) department, over 80 percent of students were placed. The average package offered was 28 LPA and the highest package was between 50 and 60 LPA. Top companies that recruited from IIT Ropar include Oracle, JP Morgan, Google, EBay, Amazon and Arista.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I live in Chenab Hostel, and I think it's quite good. The rooms are spacious enough for two people, and the Wi-Fi is decent. If we need more bandwidth, we can use the LAN. The lecture halls are also pretty good with six of them; the largest holding 180 people. The mess food is decent and much better than what I've heard about other colleges. There is a main canteen with several outlets and a medical office that's always open in case of an emergency.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers do a good job of explaining everything in class. If we attend class and review the class slides, we should be able to get a good grade. The course curriculum includes things like data structures and algorithms, which will help us become industry ready.

reviews.review_title: Good faculty, good placements, and above-average infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: About 75 percent of the students were placed. The highest package was about 65 LPA, the lowest was about 12 LPA, and the average package was about 22 LPA. The top recruiting companies include Texas Instruments, Qualcomm, and Nvidia. The percentage of students who got internships was about 70 percent, with companies like Accenture, Intel, Qualcomm, and Texas Instruments.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms here are good, with air conditioning and comfortable seating. The labs are well-equipped with modern equipment, and the institute has a strong ranking in research. There is Wi-Fi available in classrooms, labs, the library, and all hostels, except for the newly built ones. The library is spacious and has many amazing books to explore and read.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course prepares students to be industry-ready, and besides electrical engineering, they also teach electronics, which helps students enter the electronics industry. The teachers are helpful and qualified. The pass percentage is about 30-35 percent.
detailed_review.Other: Our campus hosts four major fests, including Zeitgeist, which is North India's biggest cultural fest. Extracurricular activities are also available, with several clubs such as tech clubs, literature clubs, and cultural clubs. Various events are held throughout the year, serving as a stress buster for students. Our college also offers many merit scholarships.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My experience at IIT Ropar.

detailed_review.Placements: The college has excellent placements. The maximum package was great this year despite the recession and the median was also great. This year, I have done a lot of duties and served as the branch representative of my branch. The top recruiting companies are Google, Zomato, Microsoft, De Shaw, Oracle, and Sprinkler.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are fully equipped, classrooms are also very good and a special library is also available 24 hours a day. There was perfectly fine food in the mess and canteen. The sports and games are fully equipped, so everything is perfectly fine. The library has a lot of books in all genres.
detailed_review.Faculty: Very helpful, qualified and knowledgeable teachers are there. The teaching quality is simply excellent; the course curriculum is also very relevant and it is very industry-generic as we are provided with the project. The semester ranges from easy to medium and is not very difficult.
detailed_review.Other: Computer science is a very good branch with great professors and great classmates. The only thing I would like to improve is that I would like to increase the number of projects that make the courses more industry-specific. Other than that, the fest is good and campus connectivity are well connected to Chandigarh.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I have Completed one year of my IIT Journey. It was awesome, made a lot of memories. It was fun.

detailed_review.Placements: Here comes the main part of the story, the last dance of your college life. As I am currently in First Year, I don't have any personal experience of it. But you are ensured to get a job with a good package. All the data of placement of recent years are mentioned on the placement website of IIT Ropar. The name of the Placement Cell of our college is CDPC. FYI, the last year average package of CSE (my branch) was 28 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If you are looking out for this College, then you must have seen the iconic four pillars structure and the Spiral at its Entrance. These are inspired by the Ancient Indus Valley Civilization. The other one is our Super Academics Building (SAB). It's outstanding. We have all types of sports facilities ranging from indoor to outdoor. We have gym facilities and a common room (having TV) at each Hostel. Hostel facilities are also good. Hostel life is the best part of College life.
detailed_review.Faculty: Talking about Faculty at IIT Ropar, I would say they are quite younger in comparison to other IITs. Being a new-gen IIT, professors are also highly energetic. Theory can be approached very easily. The faculty ratio here is 1:9, i.e., for every student, there is a professor. These numbers are a little higher looking at other institutes' statistics. Classes are more interesting as students can interact with professors freely.

reviews.review_title: Our college provided good placements in 2022.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 85% of students got placed with an average salary package of 18 LPA. The highest salary package offered is 50 LPA. The average salary package offered is 13 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Amazon, L&T, Adobe, Microsoft, Flipkart, and Oracle.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a separate block for electrical engineering. We have all equipment in the lab. All labs and classrooms have 24X7 Wi-Fi. The library has 24X7 Wi-Fi. It has only a few seats. The course books are very few. The hostel rooms are very good. Many washrooms are not in good condition. The quality of the food in the mess and canteen is very good. We have 24X7 medical facilities. We do not have an indoor badminton court. We have a cricket ground and a football ground. The campus is small.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. They always motivate us to study. They have very good knowledge of the course. They try to teach all things in-depth. We can understand every concept. The course curriculum is relevant but does not make students industry-ready. Students have to study on their own. Semester exams are very difficult. Our college conducts exams from time to time. The pass percentage is average.
detailed_review.Other: Events and fests are not much good. The connectivity with the market and railway station is good.

reviews.review_title: Our college provides good education.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are decent. Our college offers core and non-core jobs. Internships are a bit difficult to get in the core field. Our college has a placement cell. It helps students to get placements and internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our department is very well-designed. Our college provides all the required elements in any subject. All hostels are new. They are very good in condition. The hostel provides double seater rooms for 1st and 2nd-year students and one seater room for 3rd-year students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our college is famous for its faculty members. They are great. Our professors are more oriented toward students rather than their research. They are friendly and helpful. Our college makes it easy for us to communicate with our professors.
detailed_review.Other: Our college provides great exposure.

reviews.review_title: Our college has good value for money.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80% of students got placed in our college. The highest salary package depends on students. The average salary package offered in our course is 15 LPA. sections.heading: Introduction
text: Nestled in the serene embrace of Punjab’s Rupnagar by the banks of the Satluj River, IIT Ropar has a huge campus spread over 525 acres of lush green land. IIT Ropar infrastructure features academic, residential, sports, training and career development, transportation, and healthcare facilities. The institute's building has three independent blocks connected via skywalks. IIT Ropar provides well-furnished hostels to the students. IIT Ropar housed a library building, a data centre, boys' and girls' hostels and Kendriya Vidyalaya. It has a separate medical centre that has a dedicated team of medical and paramedical staff. Students requiring immediate yet basic medical attention can be directed to the medical centre. Talking about the IIT Ropar central library, it is open 24*7 and has more than 22,000 books (on shelves) and thousands of e-books and journals. For more details, watch the below video:

sections.heading: IIT Ropar Campus Highlights
text: The IIT Ropar campus has all the modern infrastructure to cater to the students' academic and research needs. It has multiple departments, seminar halls, an auditorium, etc. The auditorium has spacious interiors with cutting-edge audiovisual technology and acoustics, which is perfect for hosting seminars, lectures, and cultural events. Besides academic resources, the campus also has a utility block and a student activity centre that provides rooms and equipment for various clubs and related activities. The IIT Ropar campus also has a huge sports complex catering to the holistic development of the students. It has plenty of sports grounds for outdoor games, such as cricket, football, hockey, etc. The institute also has the infrastructure for indoor games. It has state-of-the-art classrooms, equipped with modern teaching equipment to enhance the learning experience. The entire campus is wifi enabled. For the security of the students, IIT Ropar hostels are under 24/7 CCTV surveillance. It has 1 CAD/CAM laboratory with 16 workstations for the students. sections.heading: IIT Ropar Hostel Facility
text: IIT Ropar has eight hostels, six for boys (Satlej, Beas, Sindhu, Mercury, Jupiter, and Neptune) and two for girls (Ravi, Venus) to house approximately 3000 students. IIT Ropar is a residential institute; therefore, all the students are required to reside in the hostels. All the hostel rooms are spacious and have all the basic furniture, such as a study table, chair, cupboard, single bed, etc. The rooms are allocated on a single and double occupancy basis. IIT Ropar hostels consist of dedicated rooms for recreational activities, providing a holistic environment for the students. It also has a common dining area for socialising with friends over food. All the hostels have water coolers and RO systems. Inside the hostel campus, there are four shops to supply the basic needs of the residents. IIT Ropar hostels are managed by a warden who is responsible for the smooth running and for maintaining the rules and regulations of the hostels.

For providing healthy and hygienic food, the institute has a mess facility for the students. The IIT Ropar mess is very spacious with an air-conditioned dining room, a well-equipped kitchen, a cold storage room and a storage room. The mess offers multiple cuisines from different regions of the country to meet the needs of the mixed population residing in IIT Ropar hostels. Some of the other hostel facilities are as follows:

sections.heading: IIT Ropar Library
text: The Nalanda Library of IIT Ropar acts as a knowledge hub for academic and research purposes. It has a vast collection of books, journals, theses, etc. Apart from books of study and reading material prescribed for courses, the library has a collection of research monographs, reports, dictionaries, encyclopaedias, etc. The library facilitates access to over 13,000 electronic journals from 30 publishers through its participation in the One Nation One Subscription (ONOS) initiative by the Government of India. The library is well furnished with comfortable tables and chairs, which are suitable for long working hours. The IIT Ropar library is automated using the Koha Integrated Library Management System. The library is operational all seven days in a week except a few national holidays. All library spaces are open from 08:00 am to 02:00 am , and Stack & Reading Area 2 is open from 02:00 am to 08:00 am .

sections.heading: IIT Ropar Sports Facility
text: The IIT Ropar campus caters to the sports needs of students. It has a cricket ground, football ground, hockey ground, badminton court, basketball court, and tennis court for outdoor activities. The institute also has an indoor facility for table tennis. The institute has a huge sports complex with plenty of sports options to encourage students to participate in indoor and outdoor sports activities. It also organises several sports festivals and events for the students. Sports and recreation activities are also available in the hostel blocks of IIT Ropar. It also has a well-equipped gymnasium to maintain a healthy lifestyle.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the IIT RoparCampus
text: The IIT Ropar campus has a picturesque view to enjoy a sunset with friends. Situated on the banks of the river Sutlej, IIT Ropar students have multiple options to explore, such as the Archaeological Museum, Virasat-e-Khalsa museum, the Bhakra Nangal Dam and Naina Devi Temple, among others. These are a few nearby places which students must visit during their free time. Some of the famous eateries include Annapurna Dining Hall, The Pizza Store, The Urban Chinese, Shama Chicken Point, and Guru Nanak Bakery for baked food, which are quite popular among the students. highlights.summary:
KARE is a Deemed to be University, formerly Arulmigu Kalasalingam College of Engineering which was established in 1984. The university is located in Virudhunagar, TN, and was established under the trust ‘Kalasalingam and Anandam Ammal Charities’. Kalasalingam University Madurai is accredited by NBA, ABET, and with A++ Grade by NAAC. It obtained the status of Deemed to be University in 2006. Further, the university is approved by UGC, AICTE, and COA.
Kalasalingam University Madurai through 10 schools of study, offers UG, PG, and PhD courses to students across the Science, Engineering, Technology, and Humanities streams. The deemed-to-be university provides a BTech in Engineering for differently able (hearing and speech impaired) students. Kalasalingam University Tamil Nadu is ranked 30 under the ‘University’ category by NIRF 2024. The university has a panel of guest lecturers to inspire students in their respective careers and to give them tips and invaluable insights in every course. Most importantly, KARE Tamil Nadu courses are provided to students at reasonable fees, to enable students to acquire knowledge and skills in their preferred area of interest. The average package offered is 10 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the highest is 25 LPA. The placement cell provides good guidance and training, helping students secure opportunities in top companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has good lab facilities, classrooms, Wi-Fi in hostel and department, and recorded lectures on LMS. A central library with core books is available. Hostel food is average but canteen is better. Medical facilities are good with their own hospital. Sports include 2-3 acres of ground. We have badminton and boxing courts.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in our college are highly knowledgeable, helpful, and well-qualified. They always guide students in the right direction. The curriculum is well-structured and industry-oriented, making students ready as freshers. The exam level is moderate, not too tough or too easy, ensuring fair assessment.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty & decent placements at Kalasalingam University

detailed_review.Placements: It is a part of the B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering batch of 2021 to 2025 at Kalasalingam University. Placements for our course are fairly strong, with around 80 to 85% of eligible students placed. Companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, Deloitte, Amazon, and Capgemini actively recruit from our course. Around 65 to 70% of students also secured internships in reputed organizations, including Amazon, Deloitte, Microsoft, TCS, and a few startups.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The university has a well developed infrastructure with spacious classrooms, well equipped computer labs, a large central library with digital resources, and 24/7 Wi-Fi access across campus. Our department labs are modern and regularly upgraded with the latest software tools. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms, RO drinking water, power backup, and Wi-Fi.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are well qualified, helpful, and approachable. Many of them held PhDs and industry experience, which added value to our learning. The curriculum is designed to be industry oriented, including programming, AI/ML, and elective subjects aligned with current technologies. Regular workshops, coding contests, and industry interactions are part of the course.
detailed_review.Other: Nothing

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college has good infrastructure and faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: Due to many criteria, we did not become eligible for good companies, but many got placed in service-based companies. More than 50% were unemployed. Many students got placed but did not get joining due to business requirements or other issues of the company.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is neither very good nor bad, it is average. In some classes, the projector works, and in some classes, the projectors don't work. Radhakrishnan hostel for means is very, very bad. It contains 8 floors, but only 2 lifts are available. Mostly in the lift, all the time, crowds are available, and it doesn't work mostly due to many issues.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good enough to help. The curriculum should be more practical. We got an average curriculum, which is based on AICTE requirements, but mostly we did not get good practical classes. Faculty members come and tell us to write lab records in the lab classes.
detailed_review.Other: They charge some additional fees in the name of certificate fees, alumni fee, and Sparkz fee that were not added in Bonafide.

reviews.review_title: I am fully satisfied because of the faculty, placements in 2025, infrastructure, laboratory, etc.

detailed_review.Placements: Above 8.5 CGPA students got nice companies with nice packages, and 7 and above CGPA students got a package that ranges from 3-4 LPA. In my course, the lowest package is 4 LPA, and the highest package ranges from 12-14 LPA this year. Caterpillar and some mechanical core companies visit the college for placements. 30-40% of students got internships, and the other students did not try properly. If they tried, then they also might get internships at Caterpillar and in some mechanical core companies. Roles like aerodynamics engineer, propulsion and combustion engineer, structural engineer, material engineer, etc., are offered here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities in the department are very nice. There are laboratories for every subject. It has Wi-Fi and good classrooms with digital techno classes, and also a department library. Hostel food is average, but it's okay. Medical facilities are available. The hospital is available on the campus of the same college. It is the biggest hospital in this area. It has every facility. There are sports facilities. Every holiday is an enjoyable day as we will play sports and games in the hostel grounds. It has equipped labs with better quality.
detailed_review.Faculty: The pass percentage is nearly 85-95%. Faculty members here are very knowledgeable, so we can learn everything here. Students can become industry-ready because every year they will take us on industrial visits, so that we can know about the reality outside. It is also very useful.
detailed_review.Other: Our college organises many events on campus. In my department, we will learn the subject both in a practical and theoretical way. It will be very easy when it comes to understanding subjects because of more practical knowledge.

Established in the year 1935, Zakir Husain College of Engineering and Technology (ZHCET) is a government college located in Aligarh. ZHCET is affiliated to Aligarh Muslim University (AMU).
