reviews.review_title: A good college with decent placements and nominal fees.

detailed_review.Placements: A good percentage of students were placed this year and last year too. The highest package in B.Tech AI was 18 LPA, and the average package was 8 LPA. The top roles in doing B. Tech in artificial intelligence are AI ML engineers or data enthusiasts, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is equipped with full network Wi-Fi coverage, and it is very widespread. The classrooms are equipped with high-quality labs. The hostels are very good and large in size, and are based on an old style. We have various games to play, like table tennis, chess, carrom, hockey, cricket, football, and there is a swimming pool in which we can dive.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They help the students focus on their studies, and they give appropriate answers to students who are confused about the syllabus. Teachers are accessible on WhatsApp, and we can contact them easily and ask any doubts.

reviews.review_title: Great university with job opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 75 to 80% students are placed by our university. One crore is the highest package of our university, and 3 to 4 LPA is minimum package of our university, and 5 to 6 LPA is average package of our university. Almost 80 students are interning at kasimpur thermal power plant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our course is best. Infrastructure of our university is excellent with greenery park and hostel facilities are too good, like food servicing, cleanliness, and rooms are with large space and personal cupboards. Provide Wi-Fi with good speed, and medical facilities are free and available quickly for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are well qualified with higher degree like PhD. Every teacher has good knowledge of our subjects. Our teachers are provided with doubt-solving. Our subjects are good for industry without any training. Our semester exam passing percentage is 75 %.
detailed_review.Other: This course has a great opportunity for government jobs. Regular fests are organised by the students.

reviews.review_title: Best college in India for engineering

detailed_review.Placements: About 70% of students got placed. Highest package this year is 1.75cr. Lowest is about 25lakhs. After this course, you will have many jobs like quality manager or a parts designer. There are several companies offering internships in well-reputed companies like Narora Power Plant and thermal power plants.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is very neat and clean. Quality of food is also great with a tasty food. Canteen is also on every hostel. Wi-Fi facilities also provided with a good internet speed for watching online lectures. If one wants to study library is also built.
detailed_review.Faculty: Every teacher is highly qualified. Every single subject that is taught to us is very useful. Exams are set tough as the syllabus taught is also great. The papers question help us to get ready for industries and get a good job. Teachers help us in academic as well as other problem.
detailed_review.Other: Placement for this course is good in India as well as outside of India. There is also scope for government jobs. Events are also held at every big festival, and every month a fest is held.

reviews.review_title: A good value-for-money college, best for students from lower backgrounds.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 70% of the students got placed in my course, the highest package is 18 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3 LPA. Top recruitment companies are TCS, Wipro, HCL, and more than 50% of students got internships. One student got an offer of manager in the department.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The condition of Wi-Fi is not so good, but classes, reports, and peaceful infrastructure of RS College is not luxurious, but better, with screens on the board, so it is very convenient for the teacher to teach. Hostels are good, but it is not easy to get the hostels, so these are the problems that we face. Overall, medical, sports, and games facilities are great.
detailed_review.Faculty: I don’t think the teachers are that qualified and knowledgeable, their teaching style is good, but I don’t know why I don’t understand anything; I always have to study on my own. I don’t think the course curriculum is very good in the first year with respect to industry, because no college has followed the new education policy. For that, it is very difficult for us to study from the second year and get the same understanding.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college because I wasn’t getting Computer Science in any other colleges. The best thing about this course is that the placement percentage is very high. I wish I would have got a better college. If I talk about improvements, it is equal to more placement with higher packages.

reviews.review_title: Their facilities are very good and their placement is also very good for everybody.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements are very good for our AMU students. Companies usually offer packages up to 20 LPA, only for diploma students. Many companies visit here for placements, and many students get jobs through this university. Overall, the placement is too good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good, and the hostel is good too. There is a canteen and dining hall for you, and there is a sports area also. There is turf for playing cricket and a football area. The dining fees are too low, and the food is very good, they provide healthy food.
detailed_review.Faculty: There is an AMU Entrance Exam. You can give this exam, and if you pass this, you can join the course. The exams are conducted by the university. Polytechnic faculty members are very good. They help every student in any case, and they all provide boats.

reviews.review_title: I must have risen by saying my college is like a normal, average college and eco-friendly.

detailed_review.Placements: 60 to 70% of students get placed in my college. The highest package is 18 LPA, the lowest package is 2 LPA, and the average package is about 9 LPA. TCS, Wipro, and some other famous companies come to our college. The top recruit company is TCS. About 50% students get internships. AI data structure design is the top role offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities are average, they are like normal classes. Ice cream on the front of the table, which is in normal structure without AC. Wi-Fi, lab, classrooms, and library all exist in our college, so there is no problem regarding that, but it is not the type of college. The hostel is good, but it is not awarded for everyone because the rooms are limited. The food quality of the mess is great, we get good food that you like very much. There are medical personnel participating.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable and qualified, but whatever they taught in our class, I never got it. They are a little bit helpful, but not caring, because they are professors. There is strict attendance in our college. Most teachers are good at their subjects, but some classes are harder to follow. Our semester exams are tough, and they are held at the college examination center. Usually, about 82 to 85 percent of students pass.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because there is a future in this course, and the best thing about this course is that it is emerging in the market, and I don't think it will end very soon. There is nothing to improve. There are many alumni in different places to go, which is very helpful for us to apply anywhere.

reviews.review_title: Campus chronicles experience.

detailed_review.Placements: 75% of students got placed in computer engineering branch. 16,00,000 LPA is the highest package, 8 LPA is the average package, and 6 LPA is the lowest package. Recruiting companies are Infosys, Samsung, TCS, etc. All the students got internships in British Petroleum and other companies. Software engineer is the role offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the amenities are available for students at the lowest hostel fee. Free Wi-Fi, library book bank, and reading room for studying are available. Food is decent not much delicious. Canteen and sports facilities are available. The medical health centre and JNMC hospital provided free of cost.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are highly qualified and very experienced. Teacher quality is intellectual to each faculty. Curriculum is relevant but for skill purposes, its not relevant. Students can be ready for industrial training. Semester exams are too easy to get good marks.

reviews.review_title: Studying Mechanical Engineering at AMU: An insider's perspective.

detailed_review.Placements: About 75–76% of eligible Mechanical students got campus offers. The highest / the lowest / average package: the highest touched 57 LPA, most offers fell 3–4 LPA (the lowest), with an average of 6.5–7 LPA. Top recruiters are L&T, Cummins, Siemens, Tata Projects, NBTC Kuwait, ONGC, Honda, Yamaha, Accenture, and TCS. Internship percent & companies: Roughly 60–70% secured training in firms like ONGC, BHEL, L&T, Indian Railways, Yamaha, and Honda. Top roles offered are graduate engineer trainee, design/CAD engineer, production & quality engineer, maintenance/plant engineer, and a few technical analyst profiles in IT.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Mechanical Engineering Department at ZHCET, AMU offers spacious classrooms with projectors, Wi-Fi, and well-equipped labs for Heat Transfers, Fluid Mechanics, IC Engines, CAD/CAM, and Materials Testing, supported by licensed software like AutoCAD and ANSYS. Students have access to both a departmental library and the Maulana Azad Library with rich e-resources, hostels provide twin-sharing rooms, study furniture, and routine maintenance, the mess serves affordable north-Indian and Mughlai meals, with canteens for snacks, the AMU Health Centre ensures round-the-clock medical support, sports facilities include playgrounds, courts, gymnasium, and indoor arena, creating a balanced environment for academic work, research, recreation, and overall student well-being.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty in Mechanical Engineering at ZHCET, AMU are generally well-qualified (most hold M.Tech or Ph.D.) and approachable, offering guidance in labs, projects, and career planning, teaching quality is moderately good, combining lectures with practical sessions, though some classes still follow traditional methods, the curriculum aligns with core mechanical fundamentals and includes design, thermal, and CAD courses, with moderate exposure to industry software and internships, adequate, but could include more recent trends. Semester exams are of moderate difficult if one follows lectures and lab work regularly. The pass percentage typically stays above 85–90%, making overall academic pressure manageable with consistent study.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because Mechanical Engineering gives a broad technical foundation: design, thermals, manufacturing, and materials, ZHCET has a strong heritage and alumni network. The best aspects are the experienced faculty, well-equipped laboratories, access to Maulana Azad Library, green campus, and diverse peer group, which together make learning engaging, areas for improvement include more exposure to cutting-edge tools (automation, additive manufacturing), stronger industry linkage, structured internships, and updated electives reflecting emerging technologies.

reviews.review_title: This college is best if you want to study with less money and get an average placement.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed in Mechanical Engineering in 2024 is 60%. The highest package is an international package of ₹52 LPA given by a company in Kuwait, and the lowest package is ₹4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are L&T, Siemens Energy, Zia Semiconductor, and Engineers India Limited. 20% of students got internships from Mechanical Engineering in companies like ONGC, Yamaha Motors, and Honda, etc. The top roles offered in my course are design engineer (who works on CAD), production engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In Zakir Hussain College of Engineering and Technology, many facilities are provided by the department. You will get an unlimited Wi-Fi connection. The labs in the department are very good, and the classrooms are also good with ventilation. Here is Asia's biggest university library, named Maulana Azad Library, and a library inside the department is also available. Hostel facilities are also good, the quality of food in the hostel mess is okay but not good. Medical facilities are always available for students, and there are big opportunities for sports and games like volleyball, cricket, football, badminton, skating, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and helpful, with a maximum of them being Ph.D. qualified from many top IITs. They are so knowledgeable, except for some. The curriculum is relevant. It makes the students industry-ready a little bit. The semester examinations in the college are of average difficulty, and 90% of students pass.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest in machines and robotics. In this course, we learn about machines, robotics, and energy plants, etc. The faculty members' teaching style is excellent. Faculty members should adopt modern education like IITs.

reviews.review_title: Supportive faculty and good campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: 35% students were placed in mechanical course. 6 LPA is highest package, 2.5 LPA is lowest, and average is 3.5 LPA. L&T and Siemens are the biggest companies that recruit. Almost all the students got an internship at Aligarh Power Plant. Maintenance Engineer role is offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good amenities provided by hostel, such as Wi-Fi, 2,4, and single seater rooms available in the hostel. Asian, the largest library, Molana Abul Kalam Azad Library. Food is decent, and all the workers are adept at cleaning. Health centre and all sports grounds are available for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, and most of the faculty hold a doctorate from Indian Institute of Technology. Syllabus provided by AICTE. It's relevant for industrial knowledge. Easy to score in semester examination. Previous year questions asked by teachers which is easy to pass.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I want to become a production engineer. I think college adopts modern education inspired by Gulf countries.

reviews.review_title: The best thing here is hostel life.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is Decent. In Tech Courses like Computer Engineering, Computer Engineering (A.I.), and Electronics and Communication Branch. You can expect a good Package of around 8 to 9 LPA if you work hard, then you can exceed 18+ LPA, but in core branches, you get a decent Package of 5 to 6 LPA or maybe 8 LPA. No one knows the Future! Lets Hope for the best!
detailed_review.Infrastructure: One of the best infrastructures in India, a legacy of old structures. Their culture and TEHZEEEBB are still present in the college. Seniors are very supportive. This year, fees are high because of the protests that are going on. Lets hope for the best. Regular B.Tech Courses: It is 29,900/year, excluding mess fees. It includes hostel fees, book fees, and other types of Fees.  Semi Self Finance courses like AI and VLSI. It is 74,900/year for the same Facilities. You will get a college hostel too. For Self Finance, It is 1,00,000/Year. No College Hostel allotment in the Entire Duration of the Course. Mess charge in Nadeem Tarin Hall is 1400/Month, including breakfast.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching facilities are excellent, and labs are fully equipped. You get time to learn new skills. You may get Friday & Saturday off. It depends on your section. You will have more classes on the remaining days, so think twice. In my schedule, I have labs on Friday and Saturday, but the schedule is perfect, only 8 to 10 30 in the Morning.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it is 100% affordable, and AMU has old legacy. It has good connectivity worldwide. In arab countries, one of the Famous events in AMU is Sir Syed Day. The best day for the hostelers.

reviews.review_title: Is this college worth it? - Full review inside.

detailed_review.Placements: 30% of students got placements. The highest package is Rs 6 LPA, average package is 3 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA. L&T and Siemens are the top recruiters. All the students get internships every year. Machine design engineering is the best choice and is highly paid by the company.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are decent. They provide better facilities like Wi-Fi and rooms. Quality of the food is not so much good. They give us equal veg and non-veg. Free medical facilities are available. We have a big ground for all the sports. There is a private canteen for hostel students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified. Teaching style is not like modern education because AICTE syllabus is followed by the university. It's helpful for industrial training. Semester exams are easy, two mid-semesters taken by college. 95% students score good marks.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest in it. More opportunities in government sector as well as gulf countries. I think they should be taught modern education which is helpful for placement. Sir Syed Day celebrated every year to remember Sir Syed Ahmad Khan who was the founder of this university. A lot of scholarships are provided by alumni for poor students.

reviews.review_title: This college is totally worth it.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% of students get placed, with the highest package reaching 19.36 LPA last year; companies like L&T, Avitron Aerospace, and Wonder Cement visit for placement drives, and about 60 to 70% of students receive internship offers for roles such as production in-charge and site engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In the department, labs are very well-maintained and functional, with Wi-Fi and AC classrooms available, and a separate library is provided. Hostel fees are around 4-5k per year, with very good mess food quality, and the campus boasts grounds for every sport, including a gym, swimming pool, hockey ground, skating club, cricket ground, tennis court, and badminton court.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and well-qualified, with most holding Ph.D.s from top IITs. The course curriculum is relevant. Semester exams are pretty hard, and the pass percentage is around 70%; others get backlogs, which they need to clear in the next semester. .
detailed_review.Other: Lots of fests are held in the department and in the hostel as well.

reviews.review_title: It has an excellent library and mess facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: There are 7 students in my batch, including myself. 2 girls got married during course and other 5 are doing PhD somewhere. No highest or the lowest salary packages are offered to students. It's the fellowship of a PhD we are getting from the government of India. All students get placed in the top institutes of India, including IITs. Students are engaged in rigorous research work whole year, and sending material sample for testing in different institutions. So there is no time for internships in all that. One student got an offer letter for a project associate and converted that project into a PhD already.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms and the library system are top-notch in AMU. There's enough flexibility for doing lab work in any department. This department also has expensive equipment for labwork. Hostels are decent with decent quality of mess. The main feature is the reasonable cost of mess, i.e., Rs. 1600 per month. Food quality is satisfactory. Students have access of JN Medical College Aligarh free of cost and a separate student health service is operation 24x7. Sports facilities are also quite good. From athletic ground to swimming pool, horse riding, tennis, hockey, cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, etc., all facilities are available for bonafide students of AMU.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are the most positive part of the department. Faculty members are extremely supportive and well-qualified. Teaching quality is top-notch. The course curriculum was recently updated with all the current industrial subjects, such as quantum mechanics and smart intelligent materials. Semester exams are quite engaging with the syllabus taught to us and are pretty balanced. An average student does not feel any difficulty in cracking it. For labs, it's 60% and for theory work, it is 40%.
detailed_review.Other: I have an interest in biodegradable materials for environmental sustainability, so I chose M.Tech. in Materials Science & Technology. The placement area is the weakest part of the department. It needs an improvement immediately. The campus is vibrant and filled with different people from different parts of the world. Scholarships are available from MHRD, and central scholarships are also there. As the strength is very low, extracurricular activities in the department are rare.

reviews.review_title: Highly Satisfied with the infrastructure of the college and teaching style of the teachers.

detailed_review.Placements: About 50% of students got placed in reputed companies in India and the Gulf as well 30%-40% opted for higher education. The highest package is 9.6 LPA, the average is 3.6 LPA, and the lowest is 1.8 LPA. Among top recruiters are IFFCO Dubai, and Pavna Industries Aligarh. Most of the students completed their internships at Harduaganj Thermal Power Station, Quasmipur, Narora Atomic Power Station, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms are equipped with world-class infrastructure with smart boards, Wi-Fi-enabled college, and hostel. Book bank is there in the college along with libraries in hostel and college. Wi-Fi and AC are provided in the libraries with the latest books with no additional fees. The quality of food is excellent compared with other hostels but you may miss the homemade foods. Medical facilities are provided 24/7 and ambulance reaches within minutes just on a single call. We have 3 hospitals and 1 small clinic forever. Indoor games, volleyball, badminton, etc., are provided in the hostel apart from AMU.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the teachers are highly qualified having a minimum of masters as a qualification level they teach every topic with in-depth knowledge. However, the syllabus gets updated from time to time but some teachers may provide old notes. Coming to semester exam if a student is attending classes regularly it is very easy to pass the exams but if absentees is higher he may face multiple backlogs. My batch have 93.75% passing percentage.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Diploma in Mechanical Engineering for my interest and I found it very interesting with the infrastructure of the campus but some of the machines of the laboratories are outdated and not working which I think must be updated to match cutting-edge technology.

reviews.review_title: In my college, infrastructure is good, and quality professors provide high-level education.

detailed_review.Placements: In my college, 70-80% got placed in MNC companies just like Siemens etc. The highest level package is 22 LPA and the lowest level is 3 LPA and the average package is 6 LPA. I also applied for internships but in my college average number of students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In my college, classrooms and labs are mostly good and labs faculty is very helpful to students and hostel facility is also good. In my hostel, mess is also good, and very good food is served by the staff members. Games in hostel are organized every year.
detailed_review.Faculty: In my college, faculty members are knowledgeable and very good and helpful to every student studying in college and in my college all professors are well-qualified. In my college, semester exams are high level and the pass percentage is 90%. For my college mid sem is also tough.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course for my future job in MNC like Siemens.

reviews.review_title: There is a fantastic life at Aligarh Muslim University.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 90% of students get placed in the mechanical engineering course. The highest package last year is 12 LPA and the lowest is the same as the average package, which is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are LnT and Simens along with other MNCs. Almost every student gets internships, and the internship is also a part of the curriculum in mechanical engineering. Top roles like MEP engineer, HVAC engineer, design engineer, etc., are offered here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi speed is very good all over campus. The library and labs are far better than any other college. Classrooms contain projectors and smart boards. The hostel is the main life of the university. Hostels have all types of facilities, from RO water to hot water in winter. Food is quite good as the food is regulated by the senior students with administration. Every hostel has its own canteen, and along with this, there are other canteens like college canteens and central canteen. Many sports events are held in the university.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very supportive and helpful. They are well-qualified from foreign universities with the best knowledge of their field. The course curriculum is very relevant to the industry and the fluid part is very good ready for industries. Semester exams are not very difficult, but the pattern is based on the GATE exam. The pass percentage is 33%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest in mechanics and mechanical equipment. The best thing about this course is the lab of the course and this course targets all fields whether it is machine learning, etc. Things that should be improved are the labs, which should be performed seriously like the foreign universities. An annual fest of the college named Zarf is the largest event of the university. Many other events like a hostel, cultural events, university day, etc., are organsied here. The campus crowd is mixed. Many Scholarships are there based on merit.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of its faculty members and good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Upto 70% of students got placed in our course. The lowest package offered in our course is 5 LPA. The highest package offered os 22 LPA. Recruiting company is Larsen and Toubro. 80% of students got internships at Ultra Tech and L&T. Roles offered are quality control engineer, structure engineer, and environment engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities are very good and satisfying. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement support and decent campus life, but it needs better faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80% of the students were placed with an average package of 6 LPA, and the highest is around 18 LPA. There is an honors programme that can really boost your chances as it provides project-based learning, makes you industry-ready, and helps you to get placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is great, every room has Wi-Fi, and there are many rooms, such as a game room, clubhouse, and study room. It even has a swimming pool, a library is great and really cool, it boosts the study morale, and also there are so many games you can play.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty at KL University is decent, with some knowledgeable and supportive teachers, while others rely too much on theory-based teaching, and some are genuinely good, and you can learn a lot, while others are just okayish and not up to mark, especially in terms of language.
detailed_review.Other: I chose CSE because it was the strongest course here, and I have a very strong interest in coding and have always wanted to become a game developer, and I feel this will help me a lot.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The campus is good and large, but there are strict rules and almost no exposure.

detailed_review.Placements: Students get placement, the highest as we know of this year is 75 LPA, and the average is about 6 LPA-7 LPA. The maximum placement is for the engineering department students. They provide CRT training before the campus placement grounds to make you well aware of the placement environment.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are very good, and the infrastructure is also very good when compared to any other college, but the fuller utilisation of the infrastructure is still needed. There are clubs for exposure, but the clubs do not have a lot of infrastructure. There is Wi-Fi nearly everywhere, but do note that only an Airtel SIM works here, so get your sim card changed.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is good and experienced. They explain every topic very nicely and will solve your doubts with patience, and you will get clarity regarding the topics. The exams here are quite difficult, and they will keep you engaged in a lot of activities as well as assignments till the very last day, so it becomes a burden on us in the end.
detailed_review.Other: Get an Airtel sim as no other sim network works inside the campus.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Faculty members and the infrastructure are good. Placements are satisfying.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 85 percent of students in my CSE batch got placed. The highest package is 32 LPA, and the average package ranges from 6-7 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Deloitte, and Capgemini, and a few product-based companies like Amazon and PhonePe. Many students also got internships. The major roles offered are software engineer, data analyst, QA engineer, support engineer, and associate developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has good labs, Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Hostel rooms are clean and basic, with decent mess food and medical help. Sports and indoor games facilities are available on campus. The hostel facilities are decent, and rooms are clean. Drinking water and electricity backup are available. The mess food is average but hygienic. The canteen offers better options.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are helpful and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is updated with industry topics like AI, DBMS, and cloud. Exams are moderate, and most students clear them with proper preparation. Most teachers explain concepts clearly and support students during projects and labs.
detailed_review.Other: Considering placements, facilities, and academic support, the course offers good value for money compared to other colleges, so I chose it.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college with best placement record.

detailed_review.Placements: College ensures that every student who has enrolled in campus recruitment training gets placed in some of the other companies. 100 percent is the placement rate. The highest package is around 70 LPA, while the lowest is around 1 LPA - 2 LPA. Average salary is 6 LPA - 7 LPA. Top recruitment companies include JPMC, Juspay, TCS, etc. Top roles offered in the course are full-sack developed, SDE, front-end and back-end developed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-ventilated and spacious. It has well-structured laboratories with a campus-wide range of Wi-Fi, ensuring connectivity throughout the college grounds. The food is good enough in the mess, and so are the canteens. That is all for this.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well-educated, tutored, and communicate well in the class. They are solving all the doubts that students usually ask in the class. The exams are well put and test our actual knowledge, not just the textbook knowledge, so overall it’s a well-structured curriculum. Teachers are well-trained, well-educated, and teach perfectly.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good university with best placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 30-35 percent of students from our course got placed through campus recruitment drives. The highest package offered is 40 LPA by a top multinational company. Top recruiters include Amazon, Microsoft, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, and Deloitte.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled with high-speed internet access, allowing students to work on projects, access online resources, and collaborative efficiently. Multiple well-equipped computer labs with the latest configurations and licensed software for programming, data analytics, cloud computing, networking, AI/ML, and cybersecurity. Specialized labs include AI & Machines learning lab, cloud and big data lab, red hat certified lab, IoT, & embedded systems lab.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members in the CSE Department are highly qualified, experienced, and supportive. Most of them hold Ph.D. or M.Teach degrees from reputed institutions and have both academic and industry experience. They are approachable, conduct regular mentoring sessions, and encourage students to take part in projects, internships, and research. The teaching quality is excellent. Classes are interactive, supported by practical sessions, case studies, and real-world problem-solving activities that enhance understanding.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It’s too good college with all the facilities for students.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80 percent of students are placed. The highest package is 40 LPA, the lowest is 10 LPA, and the average is around 20–25 LPA. Most of the offers are from international companies. Top recruiters include Wipro, TCS, Accenture, HCL, and Amazon. About 70 percent of students get internships, mostly in the 3rd year, in roles such as full-stack developer, web application designer, and UX designer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus provides all facilities such as washrooms, a library, modern labs, and a dedicated research center. There is also a startup hub that helps students work on new ideas. There are labs for computer science, biotech, and space-related clubs like cinematic, research, space, and startup clubs.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly qualified. All of them are NPTEL certified and most are highly experienced. We had a proper course structure and are well qualified for industry needs. The pass percentage is around 80 percent, and all the faculty help students pass their subjects without backlogs.
detailed_review.Other: We had the best faculty for this course, and I am interested in the development of web apps. The library and computer labs are good, and we had fests and curricular activities as well.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college placements and faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: KL University in Guntur provided excellent placement opportunities. 85–90 percent of students are placed every year. The average package is about 7–8 LPA. Top companies like Amazon, Deloitte, and Infosys visited the campus. The university also offered good internship support and helped students gain real-world experience through various industry collaborations.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is excellent at KL University in Guntur. It had Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, modern labs, a digital library, and smart-learning facilities. Hostels are well-maintained and provided clean rooms, 24/7 Wi-Fi, and good security. The mess food is decent and had multiple menu options. The canteen is clean and affordable. The campus also offered good medical services and sports facilities for both indoor and outdoor games.

faqs.question: What should I do to get a direct admission in K L College of Engineering for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: The university offers direct admission to UG and PG courses based on the marks secured by the candidates in the previous qualifying examination. For B.Tech, the basic eligibility criteria are 10+2 from a recognized board with at least 60% marks in the related subject group. Students with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) are eligible for all B.Tech programs including Bio-Technology, and students with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) are eligible for B.Tech (Bio-Technology) and B.Pharmacy In addition you can contact the college directly for further information

data.title: KL College of Engineering Placement Report 2024
summary: KL College of Engineering placements 2025 has begun, and the highest package offered for EEE and ECE branch as of now stood at INR 31 LPA and INR 27 LPA . A total of 28 and 185 students are also placed in these branch during placements 2025.

The overall placement record in 2024 was also good. The overall highest package offered during placements 2024 was INR 56.5 LPA . KL College of Engineering average package offered in 2024 stood at INR 11 LPA . The average package offered in 2024 increased by nearly 27% as compared with previous year. The overall median package offered in 2024 was INR 8.2 LPA .

A total of 2,023 offers were made and 123 companies visited the campus during BTech CSE placements 2024. The highest package grabbed by BTech CSE students in 2024 was INR 56.5 LPA . Other than this, the highest and average package offered to the Department of Mechanical Engineering in 2024 stood at INR 8 LPA and INR 4.2 LPA , respectively.

The overall highest package offered during MTech placements 2024 was INR 15.5 LPA . KL College of Engineering MTech average and median package offered in 2024 stood at INR 7.47 LPA and INR 6 LPA , respectively.

highlights.summary:
Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) started offering undergraduate and postgraduate courses in 1997. Initially, Engineering, Management and Computer Applications courses were introduced. KIIT introduced many schools, including the School of Law, Biotechnology, Medical Sciences, Dental Sciences, Nursing, Mass Communication in 2007. Now, the institute is recognised as a private institution, that offers courses at the UG, PG and PhD levels. Locates in Bhubaneshwar, KIIT campus is speread across8,900 acres, with 3K+ faculty and researchers and 15K staff members. It owns accreditations and affiliations from various national and international rewarding bodies. The institute is ranked 1001-1200 by theQS World University Rankings 2026. In the 'Overall' category, KIIT is ranked 28 by NIRF. KIIT is also accredited with A++ Grade by NAAC. As per the Times Higher Education, ‘World University Ranking 2024’ recognises KIIT among the rank-band of 601-800.
KIIT offers 8 scholarships based on various criteria such as merit, economic status, international, PhD students and a few more. The Institute also has scholarships based on government schemes and multiple scholarships offered by the industries.
KIIT Bhubaneshwar also has KIIT Kareer School to provide placement training and student assistance. Around 700+ companies visited the Institute during the campus placement and made 5K+ offers to eligible students.
To know more about KIIT Bhubaneshwar highlights, check out the table given below:

college_info_program.intro:
KIIT's popular courses include MBA, BTech, and MCA. The institute offers 200 courses via its 28 schools that operate on the same campus. Known as one of the top B-schools, KIIT offers UG and PG degrees in business administration, covering multiple specialisations, such as business analytics, operations, and supply chain management. Offered at KIIT for a duration of two years, the minimum eligibility criteria for MBA admission requires candidates to graduate with a minimum aggregate of 50% or equivalent. Along with this, a valid score is also required in any one of the entrance exams, such as KIITEE MGT/CMAT/CAT/MAT/XAT/GMAT/ATMA. KIIT MBA fees are around INR 3.5 Lakh – INR 10.3 Lakh.
KIIT offers 18 specialisations in BTech and MTech through the Schools of Computer Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology. Aspirants must have at least 60% marks with the scores of eligible entrance results of JEE, KIITEE, Odisha CHSE and CBSE 12. The tuition fee of BTech is around INR 3.8 Lakh – 19 Lakh.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really glad for its first class facilities, infrastructure and greenery campus.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90 percent students are placed from CSE. The average package offered is 6 LPA, and the highest package offered is 21 LPA. Many companies like Accenture, Infosys, BNY, Meesho, JP Morgan, Philips, Optum, etc., have visited our campus. Almost 50 percent of the students got their internship in the third year itself. Top roles offered are SDE, product manager, business analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are top notch. The environment is a fully greenery campus. We also have high-class classrooms, labs, and high-speed Wi-Fi. The hostel is also very good. We also have IIMS hospital for any kind of medical issue. Sports and games are also really encouraged.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are really very helpful and knowledgeable. We are also assigned personal mentors who really help us when we need them. Besides, the course curriculum is really relevant and industry ready. The semester exams are not so hard to pass if you regularly attend classes and study hard. Almost 90 percent students pass their exams.
detailed_review.Other: I am from the Computer Science Engineering batch passing out in 2026. The college society events and especially the fest are really exciting. Besides studies, this college also provides a lot of extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great campus life and placement reality of KIIT University, Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: Although KIIT claims 100 percent placement, many students opt out or join mass recruiting companies, with top recruiters like Amazon, Microsoft, and Flipkart, highest packages around 50–60 LPA mostly off campus, lowest 3–4 LPA, an average of 7–8 LPA, fewer on-campus internships, and common roles such as SDE, web developer, analyst, and consultant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of KIIT is the best you can get. High-tech classrooms, Wi-Fi and AC in hostels and classrooms, aesthetic libraries are a part of regular life. Research facilities, project opportunities, and exploration in academics have no boundaries for someone who’s eager to learn. Hostels are great, the mess food is above average depending on hostel to hostel. Mess charges are 22.5k per semester, and hostel fee is around 50,000 approximately per semester that includes Wi-Fi, AC, laundry and everything. For medical facilities, we have KIMS which is our own medical college where our checkups are free.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful in general and definitely too qualified, as a lot of them are IITians and everyone’s a Ph.D. holder. Teaching quality and marks giving vary from teacher to teacher. The course curriculum is mostly relevant, but a lot of extra subjects are there for no reason, which hinders the actual studies required for placement. Semester exams aren’t that difficult if studied routinely. Everyone passes, and even if they don’t, they are made to appear again to clear backlogs. No year losses.
detailed_review.Other: I am in my 6th Semester B. Tech CSE. Computer Science is a vast subject with a lot of domains. I am getting to know a lot of things on technologies, and given the market, if you have skill in tech you get a nice pay. I wish the course was more placement focused, like AIML, Cybersecurity, Full Stack, SQL, Python, Cloud, which are more industry-based knowledge. We have almost 30 societies, and the fest and extracurricular scene is very strong here. We have crowd from foreign countries as well. The campus surroundings and connectivity are top class.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: KIIT comprehensive review.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90 percent of students get placed. The average package is 6 LPA. The highest package was 52 LPA last year, offered by Yugabyte. A few companies that recruit from campus are Accenture, Cognizant, TCS, Infosys, Deloitte, and Dell. Internships are offered by companies like Dell, JP Morgan, Cisco, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Classrooms, labs, and libraries are well-maintained and great places for studying. Mess food is okayish, canteen food is good, and lots of variety is available. New hostels have games rooms to play TT, chess, carrom, etc. Sports facilities are great here.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is mostly good and helpful. They guide you if they see you're sincere. Semester exams are not that difficult, it is okay. The course curriculum is relevant, a lot of core CSE fundamentals are taught, like OOPJ, can, DBMS, and OS, which are important from a placement perspective.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Balanced choice strong placements modern infrastructure and decent.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements improve provided CGPA is more than 7.5 and attentiveness to aptitude. Many will be placed within IT services with a 5 to 8LPA range but some secure 12 to 20LPA roles, 40 to 50+ LPA are rare. 80 to 85 percent of eligible students receive offers per season. HighRadius Deloitte, Amazon and Yugabyte are some of the top recruiters that came for the placements this year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In CSE we have smart classrooms with air conditioning strong Wi-Fi in labs updated PCs equipped with rides and an extensive digital library. Hostel facilities are clean and offer full day Wi-Fi with quick maintenance and good security.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most professors are pretty qualified and helpful enough although the teaching quality can sometimes vary by course. Mentoring and access to pros are solid. The curriculum is well rounded mix of core CS classes, electives and projects. If you want to prepare for the industry be sure to add some DSA/ dev practice to your plan. The exams are moderate and you will have continuous evaluation too. The passing grade is above 50 percent or grade D.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review for KIIT University.

detailed_review.Placements: Most of the students get placed by the end of their course. On average, the package is 8 LPA, with a minimum of 4 LPA and the highest being more than 60 LPA. You will be getting offers from your third year only. Here, all domains are available, such as teaching, administration, medical science, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: You will be getting 24/7 access to the library, Wi-Fi, and labs at no cost. The menu is quite good, and the menu changes every month, so you will not be bored. There is a sports complex on every campus. You will get free medical facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: You will have a great bond with the faculty members. The way they teach is just unexplainable. Some of them might be concerned about attendance, but in the end, they also give good internals. The course provided is totally relevant to current industry needs.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am satisfied with teachers, infrastructure, and environment.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement percentage is approximately 83% for the overall engineering batch. The highest package is 53 LPA. The average package is 8.5 LPA (median approximately 7.5 LPA). Top recruiting companies include High-Radius, Deloitte, Capgemini, Bosch Global Software, and Yuga-byte, among others. Internship percentage is 40–60 percent, depending on the type of internship. Top roles include Software Engineer/SDE, Data Analyst/Data Scientist, DevOps/SRE, Quality/Test Engineer, and Consultant.

The sports facilities are great and well-supported by the college. All other research facilities are excellent, and the equipment provided is industry-ready.

Teachers help with any topics if doubts arise. The pass percentage is above average. The curriculum is maintained according to industry standards.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Exploring Growth At KIIT.

detailed_review.Placements: I am in 1st year, and in our batch, there are around 5000 students. Last year, there was the highest package of around 52 LPA, and the average is about 7-8 LPA. There are recruiting companies like TCS, Infosys, Microsoft, etc. Companies came and top roles are provided.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms are neat and clean with clean washrooms, good Wi-Fi, and smart boards, and all classrooms are fully air-conditioned. The hostel is also very good. There are AC and non-AC rooms with Wi-Fi and clean toilets. The library has AC as well.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Most of the teachers have a Ph.D. degree. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students ready for the industry. The semester exams are moderate; they are not that hard, not so hard that it is.
detailed_review.Other: The university has a very good campus, and besides studies, there are many open-air theatres where many events happen often, and you can showcase your talent there. There are also many sports complexes and many indoor and outdoor stadiums. The placement is also good, and many hackathons and guest lectures happen frequently to build your character and for a good college life. To become industry-ready, you can come here. And you know, there is a placement training cell that helps students get trained for placements.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Top roles offered in our college are for data analytics, buisness manager, and portfolio developer. The college is also providing software development engineer roles but that is very less as demand for that in market is low. 50-60 percent of students have their internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Food is average. Wi-Fi, labs, and hostel are very chill. Wi-Fi connection is fast and sometimes it fails to meet our necessities. But talking about the infrastructure of our college hostel is good. Rooms are also in good position. Medical facilities are very good, and free treatment for KIIT students is available at IIMS.
detailed_review.Faculty: Curriculum is followed as in other colleges. Teachers are heavily qualified and knowledgeable, and the difficulties faced during semester exam are timing-related. Pass percentage is about 33 percent, or 40 marks in total of 100 marks exam and students are able to gain that.
detailed_review.Other: Fest of our college is good. Scholarship program is also available for students who score 8 or above CGPA.

reviews.review_title: Best college in Odisha for engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: From the end of 6th semester, companies started to visit our college. Some companies were Tata Technologies, Optum, Deloitte, Accenture, Wipro, JSW, AMNS, Maruti Suzuki, Bosch, State Street, GE Healthcare, PWC, TVS, LTI Mindtree, etc. The highest package varies from branch to branch, in mechanical the highest was 13 LPA with an average of 7 LPA in core sector. One best thing about college was that it gave 100% placement. Various companies came for internships like Wipro, Genpact, Deloitte, Tata Technologies, High Radius, etc. They all provided stipend around Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000 per month.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Various range of books and books were available in library with a world class library infrastructure. Sports facilities at KIIT were commendable with various grounds for different sports. There were many student run social groups and clubs. In hostel, there were various types of rooms available with 3 bed non-AC, 2 bed non-AC, 2 bed AC, 2 bed AC premium,  3 bed AC, etc. We had international hostels for students who came from abroad. Meal was tasty and hygiene was maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty to student ratio was good. Faculty had a nice relationship with their students. They were always available for the students whenever they needed. Faculty members clear doubts in various ways and also guide the students so that they don't get confused. Exams were normal to little difficult in terms of applications. So that student who further test their knowledge. Per semester two exams were held, mid semester of 20 marks and end semester of 50 marks, and practical and viva of 30 marks.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Most expensive college in Odisha.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement scenario is good for KIIT as compared to other private colleges. Median packages are around 5 LPA - 7 LPA. The highest package is around 30 LPA. Most students get placed in atleast one company. Mass recruiters such as Infosys, TCS, etc., are the biggest recruiters like all over India. CS, IT, and electronics graduates have slightly better luck at placements. You will get plenty of internship offers via the KIIT mail ID. But you would have to pay for them on your own.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are multiple options provided while looking for a hostel room. It can either be AC or non-AC. You can also choose how many roommates there are going to be. Common options are 2 sharing and triple sharing. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and have air conditioning. Library is centralized AC and has all the books. There are swimming pool, multiple grounds, garden, stages, etc., on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Finished way quicker as compared to other colleges. Semester 1 ended in January, and semester 2 ended in May. The faculty-student ratio is better than in other colleges. Maximum is around 60 students in a class. Teacher quality varies but most are very willing to teach. Mostly of the faculty members are knowledgeable, approachable, and supportive. They use both traditional methods and modern teaching aids to explain concepts clearly. Few professors also encourage research.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Decent college, if the intake of students is less, I think it can excel more.

detailed_review.Placements: Looking at the fee structure, the ROI of our college is very low, in which only 40%-50% of the students get placed with an average of 8 LPA. The companies that give the most frequent placements will be Deloitte and TCS. The roles would be from software developers to managers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: KIIT has unarguably the best infrastructure, I think, in terms of almost everything, such as classrooms. The library and hostels have above-average mess food as compared to other colleges. Looking at the high fee structure of hostel accommodation, the quality of rooms and the amount of facilities we get is justified.
detailed_review.Faculty: The majority of the faculty members are really experienced and have a very unique way of teaching. But talking about the course, I don't know why they teach us C language, and as for the sem exams, it is moderate, and if prepared well, they are easy. We get a lot of freedom to do research, and KIIT has helped a lot of industries across Bhubaneswar to grow more by providing them with technologies that would have cost them way more than they can imagine.
detailed_review.Other: I'm pursuing B.Tech in CSE (Data Science), which I thought would be helpful for me as I'm good at Maths and have a keen interest in coding. College fest is too good, but the crowd is immensely high, so we have competition for almost everything.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Decent if you do not have options.

detailed_review.Placements: I am at 1st year, and about the information I have received, placements are just like what an average private college has. Mass recruiters like TCL are common. The highest package offered is 53LPA last year, and the average package offered is 7LPA. Never heard of tech giants like Google, Amazon, and Microsoft hiring here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good, and the infrastructure is decent. The library is there. Every hostel has a separate reading room. Mess food is okay, not so good, not too bad. KIMS is there for medical emergencies. Sports and games facilities seem to be decent. Wi-Fi is not good at all, 30 to 40 Mbps speed, and very frequent cuts.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are good, some are like themselves, struggling to understand the theory. They are qualified. I am in 1st semester of the CSE branch, and till now we have not done anything related to CSE. Semester exams are not that difficult if you study well. No idea about the pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: I have always had an interest in software, which is why I wanted to learn more about it and hence took this branch. I think having more CSE related courses than these unrelated subjects should be more beneficial to students for 1st year. The campus is not in a close area, and hostel life is too restrictive. Hostel check in time is 6 pm, which is bad. Students who got less than 1000 rank on KIITEEE got a scholarship of Rs. 10,000 per month.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)
reviews.review_title: Good college and value for money.

detailed_review.Placements: Values for money and guaranteed moral values are being taught to every student.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The huge campus has lots of facilities, including a massive library with around 4 floors and more than 1000 books.
detailed_review.Faculty: The college staff are very supportive and help students in every possible way.
detailed_review.Other: A massive fest organized by the seniors.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am not satisfied with my college, its decent, but not worth it.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course last year, according to seniors, 70% of students got placed. The highest package is 52LPA. The average package is around 5LPA to 6LPA. Not sure about roles, but most are sales based. Internship opportunities are like 20% to 30%. Overall, very poor placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, with decent Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, and okay classrooms. The library is excellent, offering a great place for study and resources. Overall, very nice in these things. Mess foods are best, I mean, for non vegetarian food, its hygiene is proper. The number of sports and games options is too many.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are good, some are not, it totally depends. The teachers are mostly qualified from IITs and NITs. The course is somewhat decent, not the best, it is average. I don't think it makes industry-ready. The semester exam is very easy. A minimum 6 CGPA is required to pass.
detailed_review.Other: I have no other options left, so I chose this university.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college, faculty, excellent infrastructure, bad ROI, average placements, and good campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: The ROI is not that great because the average package is around 9 LPA. For my course, Computer Science, it is 10 LPA while the fees are around 25-27 LPA. Around more than 70% of students get placed, but the LPA is low and only a few students get good packages like 1 crore. However, if you work hard, this college provides a good package.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is top-notch. Everything is built perfectly. The library is very huge, classrooms are fully AC with centralized AC, and labs are good too. Sports facilities are top of the line, and the hostel is also very good. The food is average and sometimes good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are super helpful, experienced, and kind-hearted. They are very knowledgeable, and teaching quality is also good. The course is relevant according to me, though I don’t know deeply as it is my first year. Semester exams are moderate to hard for midsems, and for endsems, they are mostly on the harder side. With regular study, you can get very good marks. Overall, exams are moderate to hard.
detailed_review.Other: I chose CSE because I have interest in it and it is the most relevant course for today’s time. It is the age of AI and computer science. Events are great, but I think they could be better. Campus life is good, but there is too much hookup culture, which is the worst part after a certain limit. Fests are good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: KIIT, the way to success.

detailed_review.Placements: Currently in 2nd year. According to the information, placements are a little poorer this year than last year. 50 to 60 per cent of students are placed in CSE. The total no of students in CSE is around 5000. Placements should be increased, as the course fee is very high.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: CSE campus is very beautiful and very well-maintained. All types of facilities, like a lift, AC, light, and a smart board, are available. The campus is full of trees that make a healthy environment. Hostels are also good, but the mess's food quality should be increased, especially the amount of chicken they offer.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some of the teachers are very helpful, and some of them are not so helpful. But overall, teachers are very good, qualified and well-informed. The curriculum is also relevant for industry purposes. The semester exams are a little bit on the tough side.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Till now, I am satisfied.

detailed_review.Placements: KIIT has one of the best placements in terms of private universities. As per the news from the sceneries, the highest package last year was of 53 LPA. Whereas the average package was around 8 to 10 LPA. Overall, almost 85% students got jobs across the university. The strong point of KIIT is that every year the number of companies increases. KIIT also support students in their startups who think more widely in life, like owning a company. However, the placement rate is not uniform across all branches (the majority is in CSE and electrical). Keep this in mind, too much competition, a huge crowd.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: KIIT infrastructure is huge in an open city, at least covered under specific boundaries, which is very much refreshing for everyday life, with a huge number of street-side food stalls and vendors. It has football, cricket, hockey, basketball, tennis, and many more ground sports, with a minimum of 2 to 4 in quantity uniformly distributed. The classrooms are equipped with multimedia aids, projectors, air conditioning and overall a smart classroom. The best part of the KIIT for me is the hostel, it's too much premium and we'll be maintained, but the mess food varies from hostel to hostel, on the majority of the days in a week, they serve tasty food.
detailed_review.Faculty: In the case of the faculty, it's well qualified for the case of a private university. Every student gets their personal mentor for guidance and other stuff, but this mentor and teacher are only helpful when you are in the 2nd year and above, they help you with research and higher studies. I am personally doing this, so I know this thing very well. Exam patterns are very common, like other colleges, one mid-term and one end-of-semester exam, every semester and continuous evaluation. In the case of curriculum, you have all the options possible, anything, dancing, singing, playing, anything, all available in KIIT.
detailed_review.Other: In KIIT, the crowd is too much. For example, only CSE branches consist of 3000 to 4000 students, and other branches have around 500 to 600 students. So students in CSE face a huge competition in the placement period. Other than this, a good thing is that I have not seen any case of ragging that was promoted by the KIIT. They protect and protest every case of ragging possible by them, from that side, students are quite safe.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A good infrastructure, skilled teachers, and promising placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is pretty much decent, better than other private colleges. You just need to focus on yourself and try to develop a skill. Highest package that was offered is 52 LPA, and the lowest is somewhere around 5-6 LPA. Many good companies, such as Adobe, Deloitte, and HighRadius, do recruit a bunch of students, so overall it is good. Computer Science is a very good branch, and it's the future.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Rooms are cleaned every day. Campus is very clean, you won't find any littering around the campus or corridors. There are multiple bins where you can throw garbage. Wi-Fi connectivity is good throughout the campus. You won't find any network issues. The central library is accessible 24/7, you can study peacefully, and there are many books that you can access. There is a sports complex with many gyms.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are quite knowledgeable, helpful, and they are quite smart. They know how to teach properly, they won't only teach from PPT and go, they will explain everything in detail and give proper efforts to every student. You can ask them doubts not only related to academics, but they can also give you good life lessons.

reviews.review_title: KIIT is good. Although the fees are a bit much compared to other universities, it is worth it.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 80%-90% of students get placed each year. This year, 60%-65% of students are already placed. Many go for a doctorate and higher studies. Some go for UPSC. Many companies come, and they have 5-6 students for each company, it's not like engineering, where a huge number of people get placed, but placements are there. So no need to worry much. The salary may not be that high at the beginning, but as time passes, it will increase just like in engineering.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the course and hostel is good. There are two girls' hostels. Maintenance is okay. Hostel food is not nice everywhere. Wi-Fi is available everywhere. The campus library is a little bit small, but the central library is huge, spacious, and very pretty.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is quite relevant. Different courses are available that help students become experts in the field in all possible ways. Well, I am just in 1st semester, so I don't know much about the difficulty level of the exams. The faculty is helpful.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college if you are dedicated.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement on the campus is great. Companies do come, and everyone gets equal opportunity. It is just a matter of fact that whoever has better skills and grabs the opportunity. College supports the companies to come to the campus. Big companies like Google and Microsoft do not come directly.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college is indeed one of the best, and the hostels are amazing with great facilities like AC messes and wonderful transportation within the campus. There are various societies on campus that can give a large scope of opportunities and can help to learn a lot.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are good and helpful if you are a student serious about studies. There are wonderful facilities for research and development. The curriculum is also the latest one with great lab facilities and classrooms. The semester exams are easy to crack with the guidance of the teachers and regular attendance in classes.

admission.title: KIIT Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) Bhubaneswar admission 2025 is mainly entrance-based. Also known as KIIT Bhubaneswar, the institution offers over twenty five courses at undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral levels through its 24 schools. The university provides admission to most of the programmes based on KIITEE. KIIT also accepts scores from other examinations for specific programmes. Interested students can go through the following article to learn all about the courses, admission criteria and procedure for KIIT - Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology.

faqs.question: What entrance exam scores are accepted by KIIT Bhubaeswar for admission MBA?
faqs.answer: KIIT Bhubaneswar accepts the following entrance exam scores for admission to its MBA program: KIITEE MGT, CMAT, CAT, MAT, XAT, GMAT, and ATMA.

faqs.question: How can candidates join KIIT School of Management, Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology?
faqs.answer: KIIT University offers UG, PG, and Research programs in various disciplines through its different schools. For UG and PG courses admissions at KIIT, candidates are required to appear for the KIITEE examination and participate in the counseling for final seat allotments. KIITEE is conducted by KIIT University for admission to B.Tech, MBA, BBA, BCA, and other UG and PG courses. The minimum eligibility criteria for B.Tech is 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics/ Biology with 60% marks in aggregate. For B.Arch program,  10+2 (60%) with Mathematics as the main subject is mandatory. KIIT conducts KIITEE to offer admission in B.Tech course followed by counselling. B.Arch admission is based on a valid score in NATA . Final admission is confirmed through counselling. KIIT also offers admission to B.Tech+M.Tech (Integrated)/ B.Tech+MBA (Dual Degree) and B.Tech (Lateral Entry) on the basis of performance in KIITEE followed by coiunselling.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for admission to BBA programme at KIIT?
faqs.answer: For admission to the BBA programme at KIIT, candidates must have completed Class 12 in any stream or equivalent with a minimum of 50% aggregate and having Mathematics/ Business Mathematics/ Economics/ Statistics as one of the subjects in Class 12. Also, the candidates need to qualify, KIITEE entrance.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description:
KIIT central library has successfully built up a comprehensive collection of over 
6,83,616 books covering different branches of knowledge. Besides, there are also more than 1,27,541 books available in electronic form covering varied subjects.The library subscribes to 718 print journals (both Indian and Foreign) specific to the academic and research needs of the academic community of the university. There are more than 28,000 electronic journals and 3.7 million e-theses & dissertations available in full text through the online databases subscribed by the library. There are also 6806 bound volumes journals in the library. 555 educational videos are available for academic consultation in the library. Also holds a collection of VSS reports, MTS reports, Project reports, case studies, working papers, annual reports etc. in all subject areas being taught at the University.

facilities.name: Cafeteria
facilities.description: There are 15 food courts specialized in cuisines from different parts of the world. They serve a wide selection of national of national and international dishes. These food courts are in addition to 20 canteens attached to as many hostels.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: There are 20 hostels for boys and 11 hostels for girls are available with accommodation capacity of 10180 and 5648 students respectively. About 30% of the hostel rooms are air-conditioned and all the hostels have attached canteens serving good quality food. Each hostel has 24-hour reading room, the facility for indoor and outdoor games and wireless internet and intranet connectivity. There is a dedicated international hostel accommodates foreign students.

facilities.name: Sports Complex
facilities.description: University is facilitated by KIIT stadium, central indoor stadium and 10 sports complex distributed in different campuses.KIIT’s Central Indoor Stadium – Biju Patnaik Indoor Stadium – is the hub for indoor sports activities. reviews.review_title: Great teaching staff and student diversity.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 30% students got placements in my department, with the highest package being 5 LPA, the lowest being 2 LPA, and the average being 3-4 LPA. The top recruiting companies were Dhanuka, Coromandel, and DeHaat. We got internships from PCF Agritech, Dhanuka, and KrishiJagran. The top roles offered are mainly sales, marketing, and research.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our department has 2 labs dedicated for agricultural research. The classrooms are big enough for 50-60 students. We have a big library in our university. We have Wi-Fi facilities seperate for both students and teachers. Hostels are of good quality and the food offered in the canteen is clean and tasty. We do have a medical block and the facilities are pretty average. We have a big sports ground with equipments for various sports and games, and the quality of these equipments are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have very qualified and knowledgeable teachers in our department, and their quality of teaching is great. The course content is also up-to-date and valuable for our careers. The difficulty of the semester exams depends on the subjects, but generally they are not too hard. The pass percentage is 35%.
detailed_review.Other: The facilities in our department specifically could've been improved, like the washrooms and the quality of the labs.

reviews.review_title: Great faculty and labs, but average facilities and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: My course is not the kind where you get placed after B.Sc.. It's a research-oriented field, and from that point of view, our faculty and department provide us with ample backing and opportunities. As our faculty are already researchers themselves, we get the bonus advantage of gaining experience by joining their research projects.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our classrooms can definitely use an upgrade. Some of the chairs in our class are broken. The Wi-Fi does not work all the time. The fans and their switches are a little too messed up. The library is excellent infrastructure-wise, but there are barely any books from my syllabus. The labs are extremely well-maintained and ideal for research. The quality of food, however, could use improvement. Sports and games are all great. Medical facilities are also pretty good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are definitely qualified and knowledgeable in their fields. However, their teaching style can be hard to cope with considering they are researchers. Most of the faculty are open to criticism and willing to work with students to solve any kind of issue. The course curriculum, for the most part, is helpful. However, the course flow could be better. Exams depend on the teachers, they can be pretty hard and expected, as well as predictable and easy, depending on the teacher.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about the course is the faculty and the facilities provided by the department, like the labs. So far, things are pretty fresh. Department-wise, things are great for the most part. However, the events feel very low-key for a university this big. Our university-level freshers are conducted as if it is some coveted secret event, allowing only CRs and Department Mr. and Ms. Freshers to attend. That is incredibly disappointing, to say the least.

The leading recruiting firms are CFSL and AFSL. Nearly 80% of students who complete our course go on to complete internships in their industry.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus features a central library with a wealth of study materials, smart classrooms, well-equipped psychological labs, and free Wi-Fi. Hotels provide round-the-clock security and are kept up nicely. However, the quality of the mess meals may be lacking. Students have access to the gym, basic sports facilities, and medical help on campus. The majority of the hostel rooms are shared, however, there are also single rooms available. It has regular housekeeping and is extremely clean.
detailed_review.Faculty: Wonderful and passionate educators. Incredibly kind and supportive when it comes to uncertainties. They do a great job of explaining everything, and even if you don't understand something, they'll explain it to you repeatedly in a really kind manner until you comprehend it completely. I adore the quality of them.

admission.overview_text:
Amity University Noida admissions are open now. The Amity Noida admissions are offered via both entrance and merit basis . Interested candidates can visit the official website to apply for the course of their choice. Amity University Noida MBA admission is based on a valid score of entrance exams such as CAT/ MAT/ XAT/ CMAT/ GMAT. For the remaining courses, admissions are based on the performance of candidates in the last qualifying exams.

The university offers over 100 programmes under several streams, including Engineering , Science , Arts, Commerce, Management, Design, Law and many more. Apart from the full-time programmes, the university also offers distance learning programmes via its Online and Distance Learning schools. Read the following article to get the details around the Amity University Noida admission criteria.

faqs.answer: Yes, Amity University Noida course admissions to most of its courses are based on the merit performance of candidates in their previous qualifying exams. faqs.question: How can I get admission to Amity Noida for BTech?

The final selection is based on Personal Interview round, which is mandatory to qualify in order to get admission. The university also provides a few direct admissions on first come first basis based on a valid score of JEE Main. Such candidates receive scholarships and get exempted from the admission process.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria to get admission to BTech programmes at Amity Noida?
faqs.answer: For admission in BTech course at Amity Noida in both Sponsored and Non-Sponsored categories, pass Class 12 with PCM/ PCB as subjects from a recognised board. For Non-Sponsored categories, pass Class 12 with at least 60% aggregate and for Sponsored category candidates, at least 55% aggregate is required.

faqs.question: What is the criteria for MBA at Amity University Noida?
