Candidates who passed graduation with 50% aggregate in any stream from a recognised board are eligible to apply for this course. For some specific MBA specialisations candidates are required to get a bachelor’s degree in Engineering with 50% or any degree in Mathematics /Statistics/ Science/ Computer Science/ Computer Applications/ Data Science/ Information Technology/ Information Science or an equivalent qualification in relevant discipline. It's a mandatory step to qualify before applying for Amity Noida MBA admission.

faqs.question: What is the minimum percentage required for Amity University MBA?
faqs.answer: Amity University Noida MBA admission is entirely entrance-based. To apply for this course, candidates have to pass Class 12 and graduation with minimum percentage. Candidates have to obtain minimum of 50% aggregate in their last qualfiying exam of graduation. This is basic educational requirement that every candidate has to fulfil before applying for the course. Later on, the admission will be grated based on a valid percentile received by candidates in the respective entrance-exams.

highlights.summary:
The IIIT Hyderabad full form stands for International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad and was first founded in 1998 as a not-for-profit public-private partnership (N-PPP). IIIT Hyderabad Gachibowli is the first IIIT set up in the country under the N-PPP model and has since become a well-known higher education institution of National Importance, receiving an ‘A++’ Grade accreditation from the NAAC.
The latest International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad ranking information has been released by the 2025 QS rankings standing at the 601-650 rank (QS WUR Ranking By Subject) (Computer Science and Information Systems). Other important rankings of IIIT Telangana include 89th (Overall category - NIRF 2025), 55th (NIRF 2025- University category), and 38th (NIRF 2025 - Engineering category).
IIIT Hyderabad courses are extended at the UG, PG, and PhD levels with its BTech and MTech courses being the flagship programmes and are majorly preferred by students during the course choice/selections. Students also have options for Dual Degree (BTech & MSc) and Part-Time (PG courses) modes of learning. These courses have been recognised/approved by national bodies such as the UGC and AICTE.
Further, International Institute of Information Technology (IIIT Hyderabad) features over 20 domain and applied research centres. Nine of every 10 International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad alumni work in Product Architecture, ICT Research, Design, or Development at top-notch Information Technology companies worldwide. reviews.course: B.Tech.+ M.S. (by Research) in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A college that actually prioritizes studies.

detailed_review.Placements: IIIT Hyderabad consistently records excellent placements, as 95-99 percent of students get placed each year. In the B.Tech CSE course, the highest package recently touched is 128 LPA. The average package ranges from 32-34 LPA. The lowest package is 6 LPA. Major recruiters include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, Adobe, Meta, Uber, Goldman Sachs, and top product companies. Most roles offered are software engineer, research engineer, ML/AI, system developer, and security. Internship statistics are not formally published, but many students secure internships in companies like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, or through research labs. Overall, placements are among the best in India.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good and is not short on anything. Keeping in mind the shortage of space in the college, there might be a few luxuries missing. The campus has very small-sized hostels, so they might be congested. We have rooms called workplaces where most students spend their time.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers and teaching assistants are very helpful and approachable. There are tests on a regular basis. Tests are kind of a difficult level, and not just that, the previous year or the most probable questions are repeated. Lab subjects also have a rigorous curriculum.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Completely satisfied with studies, but not about entertainment.

detailed_review.Placements: About 97% of students were placed in my course, with the highest being 74 LPA and the lowest being 12 LPA, with an average of 27 LPA. Some of the top companies include Amazon, Qualcomm, and Google. Almost everybody in our course got the internship; it is somewhere around 99%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It is a wonderful college when it comes to labs and a library with a very good infrastructure, and there will be 24/7 availability of Wi-Fi. When it comes to the hostel, we were triple sharing, so it will be somewhat uncomfortable. The quality of food will be good, and sports are compulsory on the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, and there can be no doubt about teaching, and the courses are definitely relevant, and which also makes students industry-ready. The semester exams are a bit tougher, but most of the students pass the courses; almost 95-98% of students pass the course.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science + M.S. (by Research) in Computational Natural Science
reviews.review_title: Overall satisfied with faculty and infrastructure. Placements are good.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, i.e, 2025, 100% of registered students are placed. The highest package is 18 LPA, the lowest is 12 LPA, and the average is 15 LPA. Many of the students got PPOs, which are not considered in official placement states. These include companies like Uber, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, and Google.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have CCNSB labs dedicated to CND research. Most of the classrooms have AC, but hostels do not. Wi-Fi is all over the classes and labs. Hostels are provided with LAN support. Food quality is good in all four of the messes available. Recently, 2 of the messes, North mess and South mess, were combined and are called Palash mess. Sports are mandatory for the first 4 semesters for all branches.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified and knowledgeable in terms of the lectures they teach. They do respond to our emails. Every Semester has 4 exams in total, quiz-1, mid-sem, quiz-2, and the end-sem. Quizzes carry a lower percentage in total, followed by mid-sems and end-sems. Exams are pretty challenging. Most of the courses are graded relatively, so relative performance over others matters the most.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science + M.S. (by Research) in Computational Natural Science
reviews.review_title: One of the best decisions you can take.

detailed_review.Placements: At least 70% of students got placed. Nearly 40 LPA is the package offered. Many students go abroad to pursue higher studies. Many students got an internship. Some individuals got to CERN too. You can work as a TA to earn money in your third year or above, too. For the CND course, recruiters sometimes have a science background too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available for first-year students, but it is not available or is poor. The bathrooms are clean, but we have to triple share a single room. Mess food is as expected. Nothing out of the ordinary is manageable, but since there are four messes in IIITH. There are options for everyone. Jains included.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers, tho fast-paced, are extremely well qualified and strict about punctuality and attendance. The course curriculum is very much relevant. The exams, on the other hand, are stressful and difficult, keep this in mind. The peers competing with each other for a grade are top-notch and clever. The pass percentage is uncertain and depends on the course, but it shouldn't be that hard if you pay attention in class.

reviews.course: M.S. by Research in IT in Building Science
reviews.review_title: It provided good placements in 2024 as well as 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college offers courses like B.Tech in Computer Science, Master's in Data Science, and MS in Research. Many students from the UG background will get internships in top companies, and it is somewhat difficult in some areas like a master of science in data science. The course structure is not aligned properly, which causes students to face trouble during placements. Furthermore, courses in B.Tech and M.Tech are good. It can be recommended if anyone is interested in technical skills and would like to do hard work to get a good job.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everything is good. The food facilities are also divided widely with 4 mess partitions. Hygiene is something that is not fully satisfactory, but compared to other institutions, this place is very clean and serves moderately tasty food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Everyone has to prepare their own strategies, even though we have faculty members to ask for help. There are every one who can help us at any time with our academics. Faculty helps us to understand and clear doubts. Exams are not very stressful but require effort. The MSIT course structure is not good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very satisfied because of curriculum, electives, opportunities, clubs, and good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: 97% students placed in our electronics and communications engineering batch. Highest package is 36 LPA, and lowest package is 12.36 LPA based on 2024-2025 placements. Qualcomm, Nvidia, Texas Instruments, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Uber, Samsung, Amazon, and Oracle are recruiters. At least 40-50 % students got internships during their course. Roles offered are Analog and Digital Design Engineer, RTL and VLSI engineer, machine learning engineer, SDE, SWE, hardware and embedded systems engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Well-equipped and AC classes, and many computer labs. Students can spend considerable time in labs and research centers. Adaptable timetable and many open electives, and only 4-5 hours of academic sessions. Fascinating library sources, 20-hour library. Currently, 2025 has 3 messes, Palash, Yukthar, and Kadamba. Sports there need a requirement that every student must complete 4 sports credits per semester, one credit, and also includes many sports like yoga, martial arts, badminton, basketball, and football. Food quality was very reasonable, price, and flexible meal locations. Medico, Aarogya Center for basic and emergency needs.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Exams are relatively difficult, but not much. Teachers are very well qualified, certified, and fully experienced and knowledgeable. 
Curriculum makes students super freakin perfectly industry-ready.
Pass percentage is above 90% most of the time. Research centers like SERC, CVest, CVit, SPRC, and many more.
detailed_review.Other: Best thing is curriculum and open-ended college sources. Infrastructure and alumni connections need to improve. Many events take place, with almost 50+ events and fests taking place yearly. Many sports tournaments are held, and campus surroundings are very decent, and a nearby stadium is also there. I chose this course because I'm interested in electronics and computer Science. IIITH provides college pay-forward loans for low-income students called alumni fund. Currently, IIITH has helped me a lot and given me an alumni fund. Now I'm paying zero rupees for studying. After getting a job in 3 years' time, I need to pay for that duration.

reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.S. (by Research) in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It has good placements, infrastructure, facilities, and location. There is a hectic schedule.

detailed_review.Placements: As far as I know, placements at IIIT Hyderabad are very good. I have seen my seniors who are currently getting passed out going into good companies like Apple, Rubrik, Allegro, etc. Top recruiting companies are Texas Instruments, Nvidia, Allegro, Qualcomm, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities are excellent. We have a library, a reading room, well-maintained workplaces and labs. Free college Wi-Fi is available on campus except in hostels and mess. In hostels, ethernet ports are provided but not Wi-Fi which is also good. The mess food quality is good, and there are various choices among the four different messes for each meal. There are canteens all across the campus which remain open from 10 AM until 2 AM. There is a medical facility inside campus only with basic medicines and an ambulance for an emergency.
detailed_review.Faculty: All professors are from an excellent background and have published good works in their domain. The course curriculum of IIIT Hyderabad is updated to the latest and one year ahead of other colleges. Many courses provide knowledge relevant to the industry, internships, and placements. The toughness of courses and exams depends on the professor teaching that course, and it is the same for the pass percentage. The grading is done relatively among students. There is no fixed pass percentage but we should maintain a minimum of 5.5 CGPA as per college policy.

reviews.review_title: Great Infrastructure and Facilities

detailed_review.Placements: 90 percent of students get placed in our course. The highest package is 40 Lacs and the lowest is 8 Lacs. reviews.course: B.Tech.+ M.S. (by Research) in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My experience at IIIT Hyderabad.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements at IIIT Hyderabad are excellent, with the highest package of 46 LPA in my course and in B. Teach computer science and engineering is 74 LPA. The average package in my course is 30 LPA. And the percentage of students who got placed in my course is 100 percent. The top recruiting companies are Adobe, Alpha Grep, Amazon, Apple, Deloitte, Bloomberg, Jio, Microsoft, Samsung, Google, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is just awesome with all the requirements. In the central library, all study materials are available for all semesters, and all books are available. Classrooms and labs are equipped with smart boards, and unlimited Wi-Fi facilities are available throughout the campus. There are many grounds for sports like cricket, football, volleyball, and basketball. The quality of the food in the mess is good and hygienic.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty were very experienced and very friendly with all students; they taught us in a unique way so we could easily catch it. They are highly qualified to teach us. My course is curriculum relevant and they make us ready to the current industry. For each semester, there are mid-semester, end-semester, quizzes, and lots of assignments will be given. We have to study hard to pass the semester Each semester will include a midterm and an endterm, as well as quizzes and numerous assignments. The pass percentage is 50 percent.
detailed_review.Other: The campus life is great because it has all the required facilities. I have left the top NITs and chosen this college because it has the best placements. There is nothing changing. There are many extracurricular activities like sports, events, festivals, and clubs. Connectivity is also good because transportation is easily available. Scholarships are also available, so we can pay our fee easily.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Exceptional learning place for students.

100% of students were placed. The highest package is 70 crores, the lowest is 10 crores, the average is 30 crores, and international offers were also given.
Apple, Google, Traceable AI, Rubrik, Oracle, Goldman Sachs, etc. and many more startups like sprinklr, plivo, come here for placements.
60% is the internship rate.
Software developer, product Engineer, Data scientist are the top roles offered.

detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very qualified researchers. Our college mainly focuses on research development of software or in any Science field. Semester schedule is fully occupied with quizzes, mid exams, end exams, projects and tons of assignments with other club activities like OSDG and hacking etc.
detailed_review.Other: One of the top colleges in India, it has the best CSE curriculum. Good fest culture is there.

reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.S. (by Research) in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am highly satisfied with this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 100% of students got placed in our course. The top recruiters are FAANG companies, and software roles are offered to the students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Our college teaches us many things to be balanced in life.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements at IIIT Hyderabad are phenomenal. Due to the strictly implemented anti-plagiarism policy, students have their skill set and in-depth understanding of various subjects. Many companies offer great salary packages to students. Every year, FAANG recruits more than 20 students from our college. The placement drive in IIIT is fair compared to other IITs.

Hostels are well-maintained and are well-equipped with gyms and exercise areas. There is a vending machine in each hostel to fulfill daily requirements.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are qualified from reputed foreign universities. Their main focus is on the world-class research that students have to offer. Many teachers believe in keeping their courses flexible. Core CS subjects are from 1st year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great option to choose Computer Science and Engineering .

But placements are official in our college which happens after 4-1. Last year it was 100% in placements. Last year, the highest package was 74 LPA and the lowest package was 18 LPA. One of the top recruiting companies is Google. It takes more students every year. The top roles offered in our course depends on what field we choose in our electives. The library contains various books in all fields including story and magazines. There are workplaces as well. Hostel facilities aren't that good though, but they can be resolved when we talk with hostel administration. There are around 5 canteens in IIIT which provide different types of food. Among them, one is a health canteen, which provides healthy food. There is aarogya center which provides basic medication and there is a 24/7 ambulance facility for emergency cases. They mainly help in our research if we are interested. Many courses help us to work for companies. Design and analysis of software systems is a course where we directly work for a company as a part of our course project which helps in gaining real time experience. Semesters are slightly hectic. There are 2 quizzes, one mid semester, and one end semester exams. But these can be managed with the help of friendly seniors.
detailed_review.Other: During my counselling, I got IIT Bhubaneswar CSE and IIIT Hyderabad CSE among them I chose IIIT. Because at the beginning what I came to know was there a good coding culture in this college which is true and also placements were good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure. Top class facilities and pros of IIIT Hyderabad.

This course curriculum is relevant and it make the students industry ready. The semester exams in this college is average. You can clear the examination with good ranks if you concentrate in study.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a good college with good teaching and placements but has bad equipment.

Hostel rooms are good but washrooms are pretty bad, they are cleaned every day. The mess has four different types of foods available north, south, kadhamb, and yuktahar. Medical facilities are okay, neither good nor bad. Sports facilities in our college are football, volleyball, basketball, badminton, and tennis grounds, but not cricket.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, well qualified and they have very good knowledge in their field except for some. The teaching quality is good. The curriculum is relevant and it makes students industry ready. The difficulty of the semester exams depends upon the courses that are taken in the semester. The pass percentage is about 95%.
detailed_review.Other: I did not get CSE, so I chose ECE, ECE has not had many perks as most of the placements are towards CSE. I wish to improve and have better lab equipment in our college. There is an event called felicity which happens once every year and we have some events based on the festivals. The campus is near DLF so we have better connectivity to all of the city via metro. Extracurricular activities are okay in IIIT Hyderabad.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It has an amazing campus with a relaxed atmosphere. You should work smart from the beginning.

detailed_review.Placements: Except for those considering further studies, everyone who has decided to sit for placements will receive it. The top recruiting company is Texas. The highest salary package offered is 56 LPA, the lowest is 9 LPA, and the average is 30 LPA. About 50% of members will get internships, but most of them will be in the CS field.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The best facilities are available. LAN spots are provided in hostel rooms. Wi-Fi is available in labs and classrooms. They provide almost all the required books in the library. We have all the required facilities in different kinds of labs. We have four different messes where we can change our registrations every day as per our convenience. We have 2 huge grounds, named "football ground" and "felicity ground." We have separate courts for different sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are extremely qualified and knowledgeable. They give the best quality teaching. Exams were extremely difficult. Grading will be done on a relative basis. The majority of students will pass, but due to a few circumstances, some may fail a course and retake it the following year/semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is the best place for those who couldn't get a good rank in JEE advanced.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost everyone with a decent CGPA gets placed with above 25 LPA. I prefer to go into the analog field in ECE. Almost everyone got placed either into software roles, testing, or designer roles. Top recruiting companies include Microsoft, Qualcomm, Google, Texas Instruments etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is present in labs, workplaces, library and classrooms but not in rooms. In rooms, there is LAN available. The hostel is good, and mess food is one of the good things. Sports are good enough but not great due to the unavailability of indoor courts.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are good enough, but for my course, mainly analog in ECE, the curriculum seems quite rushed. The faculty are not of industry standards. The semester exams are of moderate difficulty, and with enough effort, it is easy to get an A. Labs are a great place for one to explore their interest.
detailed_review.Other: I chose ECE because I could not get into CSE, but after I got into this course, I started liking it. Now, I am pursuing my career in the analog field and not any software development. So, the opportunities are present in every branch you take up here.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Best in placements, faculty, but not that good for whom were much interested in sports activities.

detailed_review.Placements: 95percent of the students in our college is been placed this year and remaining students too stopped due to some research work. 56 LPA is the highest package and average is 30lpa and the least is 6 LPA. Google, microsoft, postman, oracle are top recruit.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We will get a LAN facility in the hostel rooms from the second year, and for the first two years the rooms are a bit tight and from 3rd year they will be quite comforting. Classrooms are pretty good, AC, the library is also well-conditioned. Grounds for games are not all-sufficient. Too feeling bad that there is no indoor badminton court in this college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are the best source to learn directly from classes but besides that our learning skills should be a lot. The teaching quality is great. Semester exams are quite challenging, sometimes hard, and not at least answerable,  95%pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: We can get any course-based placements from this college, even though I'm from ECE I can easily get the placement on the CSE side. Events are almost running once per week or something, the fest will be once a year and reaches good, campus crowd is too low, at max 1800 will be there in this college, campus surroundings are the best which we would get, all the things are available in this locality.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Our college provides the best environment.

detailed_review.Placements: All students got placements. The highest salary package was 56 LPA and the lowest salary package was 12 LPA for CSE students. Amazon, Microsoft, Uber, and Google were the top recruiting companies. Students were mainly offered software development roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and other facilities are decent. College is renovating old buildings for extra comforts. Classrooms, labs, mess, canteen, etc. are good in all aspects. Wi-Fi is available in our rooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, knowledgeable, and highly qualified. The course structure is the best. The pass percentage is around 35% but might vary for specific courses based on the students performance.
detailed_review.Other: I always wanted to pursue CSE at a good engineering college.

admission.title: IIIT Hyderabad Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text:
IIIT Hyderabad admission 2025 session will start with the registration of JEE Main. IIIT Hyderabad admission is completely entrance-based for the majority of the programmes. Candidates seeking admission must apply online on the official website. IIIT Hyderabad admission for BTech programmes is done basis of JEE Main score/ Olympiad (KVPY) or through SPEC (Special Channel of Admission). In addition to these courses, IIIT Hyderabad also offers MTech, MS by Research, MPhil and PhD programmes along with a few courses, namely MSIT and PGSSP courses at PG and doctoral levels. sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIIT Hyderabad infrastructure is well-equipped with all the basic amenities, including hostels, air-conditioned computer laboratories , and a library , among others. The campus is properly monitored by 24-hour security at the hostels, main gate, and all academic and other buildings. The IIIT Hyderabad campus is located on Gachibowli Road (Old Bombay Highway) and is very well connected by various means of transport. It also features additional facilities such as sports, a mess, and a gymnasium with a physical trainer. Furthermore, there is a dedicated yoga room with a trained instructor to guide students in enhancing their mental and physical health. The IIIT Hyderabad campus includes three separate canteens for vegetarians and one non-vegetarian mess (Kadamb) for non-vegetarian students.
Check out more on IIIT Hyderabad Infrastructure in the video below:

tables.IIIT Hyderabad Campus Highlights: Library, Cafeteria, Hostel, Auditorium, Research centres, Medical services, etc.

sections.heading: IIIT Hyderabad Hostel Facilities
text: IIIT Hyderabad is a residential institute, meaning all admitted students must reside on campus. The IIIT Hyderabad hostel is separate for girls and boys. There are a total of five on-campus hostel facilities, of which three are dedicated to boys and two are allocated to girls. There is a single entry and exit point for the hostel, ensuring that the safety and security of the students are never compromised. The hostel campus is under 24-hour CCTV surveillance. Surrounded by lush green trees, the campus features a perfect pathway for an evening walk, providing a break from studying and helping students to relax. The hostels are supervised by wardens and the hostel in-charge to maintain discipline on campus.

The hostel rooms are spacious and come with basic furnishings, including beds, study tables, chairs, and wardrobes . The hostels generally offer single, double, and triple occupancy rooms on a sharing basis. On-campus facilities include a bank extension counter, an ATM, a stationery shop , and laundry services . The institute has three vegetarian ( North, South, and Yuktahar ) messes and one non-vegetarian ( Kadamb ) canteen, with Kadamb serving non-vegetarian meals five times a week. Some of the on-campus hostel facilities are listed below:

sections.heading: IIIT Hyderabad Library &Workspace
text: The International Institute of Information Technology - Hyderabad (IIIT-H) has a library facility for students. It has a rich collection of textbooks, reference books, thesis, dissertations, etc. The library has a strict rule to avail the services. No student is allowed to use the library services without their ID card. Personal books, printed books, and printed materials are not allowed inside the Library. IIIT Hyderabad library has a new reading room for students. It also has a stack area-cum-reading space where students can bring their books to study. There are a total of five library staff and four Library Committee members to manage the work load. A detailed number-wise break-up of Print Journals / Magazines, etc., availble at the institute library are tabulated below:

The institute also has a new workspace that can accommodate up to 200 students at one time. This workspace is designed keeping in mind all the modern facilities such as ergonomic chairs and desks , discussion rooms , whiteboards , etc. The space is designed for students so that they can work in a quiet and focused environment. IIIT-H has an additional two new teaching labs that are equipped with projectors, TV screens, and theater-style seating with a capacity to accommodate a total number of 100 students.

sections.heading: IIIT HyderabadSports Facilities
text: The International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad (IIIT-H) also encourages multiple sports for the holistic development of the students. The institute offers several indoor as well as outdoor games, ranging from cricket, volleyball, and soccer to basketball, table tennis , etc. IIITH also has an understanding with nearby stadiums for other sports facilities such as badminton, hockey, swimming , etc. IIIT Hyderabad also provides a gym and a yoga room to the students for their better mental and physical health. For girl students, a mini gym is also available inside the girls' hostel campus.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the IIIT HyderabadCampus
text: The International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (IIITH), has a very well-located campus. Students studying at IIIT Hyderabad can explore multiple nearby places such as Charminar, Golconda Fort, Birla Mandir, Osman Sagar Lake, Qutb Shahi Tombs , etc. These are some of the popular tourist attractions of HITEC City. The institute is surrounded by many academic and research institutions, including Hyderabad Central University , Indian School of Business (ISB), TCS-CMC, Indian Immunologicals and Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Development Banking (JNIDB), and is just minutes away from the bustling HiTech City Center and Lingampally.

highlights.summary:
The Indian Institute of Bhubaneswar was established in Bhubaneswar, Odisha and is one of the premier engineering institutions of the region with various national such as the NIRF 2025 ranked IITB as 80th and 39th under the Overall and Engineering categories respectively.
Furthermore, the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bhubaneswar is ranked by several international organisations. It ranks between 951-1000 by QS World University Rankings 2026 in the University category.
The establishment year of IIT Bhubaneswar was is 2008. It was formed by the Government of India. It is one of the eight new IITs. The institute offers UG, PG, and PhD courses through seven schools of study. The flagship course at IIT Bhubaneswar is BTech. IIT Bhubaneswar BTech cutoff is generally most competitive for the CSE branch. The highest package offered to BTech students during the IIT Bhubaneswar placements 2024 was INR 64 LPA. IIT Bhubaneswar course admissions are entrance-based. The institute accepts JEE Advanced scores for admission to its BTech programme.
IIT Bhubaneswar has signed 5 MOUs that help in student exchange programmes, the exchange of scholarly and pedagogical materials, the coordination of collaborative research programmes, joint workshops and conferences, and facilitating student internships and entrepreneurship. The institute receives support from sister institutions like IMMT (a CSIR institution) and Central Tool Room & Training Centre Bhubaneswar for additional workshops and laboratory facilities. reviews.review_title: About the Indian Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: As of now, around 50 percent of students were placed. Top companies are Zomato, Flipkart, Visa, HSBC, etc. For Mechanical students, top companies are ZS, Zomato, Skyroot Aerospace, Reliance, etc. Most of the students didn’t get internships as expected, but the placements are going good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are three boys’ hostels and three girls’ hostels. In new hostels, Wi-Fi is provided, but in all hostels, LAN network is available. There is a hostel for couple Ph.D. students as well. There is a night canteen facility also. Mess food items are not too bad, but not too good also.
detailed_review.Faculty: In second and third year, almost every branch has more exams, but not for CSE students. The number of courses is more in those years compared to remaining years. Faculty are also talented, and many of them provide projects to students to work under them or with their guidance.
detailed_review.Other: Throughout the year, so many events happen in the college. There are two fests and various competitions across the branches.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: The review of IIT Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: Metallurgical and Materials Engineering at IIT Bhubhaneshwar's B.Tech in metallurgical & materials engineering is doing great in placements 89.4% placement rate, the highest package of 44 Lacs per annum, average package of 18.7 Lacs per annum and much more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Bhubhaneshwar's campus spreads over 936 acres with a modern academic block, labs, a central library, sports and green space. Hostels are fully residential with Wi-Fi, mess, recreation and single/ shared rooms offering a comfortable, secure and self-sufficient student life.
detailed_review.Faculty: IIT Bhubaneswar offers experienced faculty, a research-driven curriculum with core & electives courses, lab work and project-based learning. Exams include midterms, end-of-semester exams, quizzes and practicals emphasising understanding, problem-solving etc.

reviews.review_title: Strong academics with modern facilities at IIT Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: Last year, from mechanical, around 60 percent of students got placed. But this year, more companies are coming, maybe this time a larger percentage of students will be placed. The highest package is 72 LPA, the lowest is 4.5 LPA, and the average is around 20 LPA, according to all branches.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Bhubaneswar classrooms are too good with high-speed internet, neat and clean. There are so many different types of labs that provide more practical knowledge. Hostels are also clean, and the food is also good, but for someone, it may not be good because of taste differences.
detailed_review.Faculty: IIT Bhubaneswar's faculty members are among the topmost scientists in the world. All the faculty members provide both technical and practical knowledge as well. The college is starting a new curriculum from the 2026 batch. Exams are also not too tough. One can pass the exam with minimal preparation.
detailed_review.Other: I chose mechanical because I am interested in robotics. Throughout the year, so many events will happen in the college. Fest name is Pravah and Ashvameda.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Bhubaneswar - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: It's pretty impressive that about 80% of students from our course land jobs. Seriously, the top salary package is a whopping 64 LPA, while the average sits around 17 LPA. We've got big names like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon. Now, when it comes to internships, it is higher than job placements. In fact, only about 100 students across the entire campus manage to snag internships each year. If you're looking at roles, we see quite a few opportunities in areas like power systems, electronic engineering, and control systems.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has pretty solid infrastructure and decent amenities. You know, the on-campus housing is actually quite comfy and well-managed. A lot of students choose to live there. As for the food service, it's okay. It meets the basic standards, nothing fancy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Honestly, teachers are fantastic. Every single member really knows their stuff when it comes to their field. They are super accessible and are always ready to lend a hand to students. The way they teach works well, giving students a solid grasp of the material. The curriculum is modern, and the test questions strike a nice balance, not too easy, not too hard.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT Bhubaneswar college review.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT is widely recognised as one of the premier universities in India, and that so many students are flocking to my course. I want to be part of something like that. We have got some big names in the industry showing UPAT on our campus. Google, Amazon, Tesla, and a bunch of other major companies. Its pretty impressive, In just three years, a lot of students have managed to land internships, which is no small feat. Its exciting to see all these opportunities unfolding.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: One standout feature of the university is its modern infrastructure paired with some extra resources. The library has a wide range of books and academic journals. The canteen is spacious and offers lots of dishes and drinks in a friendly atmosphere. Students really appreciate living in the well managed hostel where the food is not just okay but meets basic quality standards.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are approachable, and they break things down step by step, making examples relatable and easy for students to grasp. The exams are manageable, mainly focusing on understanding the concepts. Semester assessments are closely tied to the high school curriculum and are generally pretty simple.

reviews.review_title: My college life is what I like the most.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement opportunities at IIT Bhubaneswar are getting better day by day. Initially, it was not so good, but now it's developing a lot. Good companies with higher placement opportunities used to come here. Most of the students get placed. The average package is of 60 to 70 LPA. Mostly good for core branch members.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is very amazing. Starting from the main GATE, we move to the admin building, then the auditorium. Then seven different schools for different branches. Three large lecture halls. Then three boys' hostels and three girls' hostels. Playground for all types of sports. Then a space area for extra activities like yoga, gym, and many more. Then the community center and faculty quarters.
detailed_review.Faculty: Semester exams are moderate here. Two times exams are conducted here. Mid seems and end seems. Faculty members teach very well, and yes, attendance is also compulsory here. Assignments, quizzes, and test helps a lot in writing the exams. This also includes practical knowledge, like labs for industrial exposure.

reviews.review_title: A very good college in its developing phase.

detailed_review.Placements: From Mechanical (My course), 93.7% of students are placed. The highest package is 20.1 LPA, the lowest package is 5.5 LPA, and the average package is 14.77 LPA. The recruiting companies are Tata Steel R&T, Engineers India Limited (EIL), Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL), Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL), Oil India Limited (OIL), and Jindal Steel & Power.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities provided are decent, but need improvement, to be honest. In our department, many machines are very old and need to be replaced. Classrooms are well-furnished and comfortable, with whiteboards, blackboards, and projectors. The mess is average, and the canteen provides good food. The sports facilities are decent, but the cricket facilities need to be upgraded.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers here are very highly skilled in their respective courses. But there are some faculty members who might not be able to deliver the lectures properly, not because of a lack of knowledge, but because they are only good students and not good teachers. To be honest, I wouldn't say a complete yes or a complete no when it comes to industry-ready curriculum. Some courses are there that are really of no use. Semester exams are hard, but not the Everest to climb. Studying regularly and hard, especially before the exams, will yield good grades. The pass percentage here is 90+.
detailed_review.Other: The world of machines has always fascinated me, and this was the reason that the driving force me to go ahead with this course. The best thing about Mechanical is its direct link with the fascinating realm of machines. I would really like to see in my course is to include a semester, where we would only learn software related to the theoretical courses. Pravaah 2.0 is a new fest that started in 2024-25. The campus has very high aesthetic value, with it being amidst the hills. The campus crowd is decent, connectivity is expensive, scholarships are available, and we have good extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: A good 2nd gen IIT. Recommended to take admission.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2025, 90.07% of students got placed. The highest CTC is 67.6 LPA, and the average CTC is 14.5 LPA. Total number of PPOs is 22. Top recruiters are Google, Zomato, Accenture Japan, Goldman Sachs, Nvidia, and Meesho. In the core sector, PSUs such as BEL, BPCL, HPCL, and EIL are major contributors. The season also has an international core offer from Niterra Japan.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All classrooms, library, and some labs are fully air-conditioned and equipped with all modern amenities such as Wi-Fi, smart boards, projectors, etc. In every room, there is a single LAN port with which you can use the internet 24X7. All hostels (except the 1st year girls' hostel) have single-occupancy rooms. There are various canteens on the campus, such as Nescafe, Domino's, and some tiffin centers. There is a small hospital for all types of medical emergencies.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most professors are qualified and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is also not that stressful. Semester exams are sometimes tough and sometimes easy. Students also get help for placements from the placement cell. Various reputed companies also provide paid internships to our students.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely good hostels and teachers.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 85% of students are placed. The average package is 12 LPA, the highest package is approximately 48 LPA, and the lowest is 8 LPA. Top companies are Oracle, Amazon, and many more. The percentage of students get internships is like 40% only.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are good as well as the library. There is free Wi-Fi all over the place. The quality of food is not so good but medical facilities are very good, I am really impressed. There is also a place to play every game and a gym.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good. The course is also very interesting. The course should be more industry-based. The semester exams are quite moderate to tough. Almost 90% of students pass the exam. Some teachers have very high qualifications but do not have the experience.

reviews.review_title: About IIT Bhubaneswar experience.

detailed_review.Placements: Overall placement in B.Tech students is around 90%. The highest package is 67 LPA. A lot of well-known PSUs and MNCs come to the campus. This year, 88% students are placed from civil engineering department. The highest package for my branch is 21 LPA, minimum is 6 LPA, and average is 14.8 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Sports facilities are good. Classrooms are amazing. There are always Wi-Fi issues throughout the campus. Mess food is very bad. Hostel facilities are good. One big problem is the attendance policy. Our college has a 100% mandatory attendance policy which is complete madness.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable and helpful. The course curriculum is a bit old but this year it has improved quite a bit. The course curriculum is very relevant to industry and academia. Semester exams are not very hard. But some courses are very difficult.

reviews.review_title: Good placements, faculty members are average in terms of teaching, and hostels are good and clean.

detailed_review.Placements: Generally, the placement percentage stays between 80 to 90% in our course. This year, the highest CTC is 67.4 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA. The average is 19.4 LPA, and median is 12 LPA. This year, 54 students registered for placements, out of which 50 get placed. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Zomato, etc. Around 30% of our batch got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Regarding hostels, male students get single occupancy room. Wi-Fi connectivity fluctuates from time to time in the hostels. Labs are fully equipped with the required instruments. Labs and classrooms are mostly air-conditioned. Library has plenty of books and reading rooms. There are many eateries out there on the campus. But the mess food is not good at all. We have a health center that is like a mini hospital inside the campus itself. Weekly free checkups are also provided there. Every major sports facility is there, along with a gym.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very much qualified but many of them don't have good teaching quality. They have a lot of knowledge but many times their teaching style does not fit us. The course content is average like any other college. I won't say it's out of date but does NIT completely fit current industry standards. The exams are quite difficult, and the grading system is relatively. It's an IIT so to score well like 8.5 or 6 CGPA, one has to study regularly.
detailed_review.Other: I chose electrical engineering here because I liked electro dynamics in my JEE time. I wish that the fests would improve a bit. Events and fests are very good here but there is only one major fest in a year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement in our course is around 85–90%. The highest package offered in our course is 24 LPA. The lowest package is 7 LPA. The average package is 9 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Tata, Vedanta, Coal India, etc. Almost all students got internship offers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are very good. Wi-Fi is present, labs had all the required instruments and machinery. A central library is present. Hostel facility is also good. Food in the canteen and mess is also good. Sports facility is also present.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their respective fields. The teaching quality of our faculty members is excellent. They not only taught theory but also explained real-life uses. The course curriculum is relevant. Semester exams are a little tough.

reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure, facilities, faculty members, and various clubs for extracurricular activities.

detailed_review.Placements: Roles offered are power electronics engineer, control system engineer, telecommunication engineer, autonomous vehicle engineer, electrical designer, and sustainability engineer. Microsoft, Google, NTPEL, and other companies are present. Internship percentage is less. The highest package is 63 LPA. Average package is 17 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has a building for electrical, electronic and computer science school of electrical, computer sciences. Labs are good, and classes are held in learning halls. Our college has good infrastructure. Wi-Fi facility is available in both hostel and learning halls. There is a central library on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable and interactive with students. Course curriculum is relevant and makes students industry-ready. Exams are slightly difficult. More than 95% is the pass percentage. Exams are difficult, and consistent study is required.
detailed_review.Other: Course is interesting. Teaching and labs help to explore the contents of course with a deep understanding, and working on projects helps to know about real-life applications. Annual fest, where we can enjoy and explore about tech world, clubs, and societies for technology, business, dance, drama, singing, sports, etc.

reviews.review_title: Life of an IIT Bhubaneswar student.

detailed_review.Placements: In the B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering course, more than 70% of students get placed. Companies like Google, Microsoft, Lenovo, Motel, etc., visit the college to recruit students. The highest package is 63 LPA, and the average package is 17 LPA. Roles offered are control system engineer, power system engineer, etc. Internship is offered to nearly 100 students from the whole batch, but the percentage of students who got internships is less.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi facility is available in the college and the hostel. The infrastructure is good. A night canteen is available. Sanjeevani Hospital is available. There are different courts for sports like basketball, badminton, etc. Gym facilities are also available. Food items are not so spicy, but a variety of items are present. Wi-Fi facility is available 24 hours on premises.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers have a doctorate degree. They are highly professional. Exams are difficult but can be cracked using systematic planning. The pass percentage here is more than ninety. Different labs are there to make students industry-ready. They conduct different industrial visits and guest talks from industry professionals.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my passion for electrical engineering. Practical applications and use made me interested in this course. Onefest is conducted every year for 3 days, and celebrities come for the star night. The DJ night is also for entertainment. Different stalls are kept, and games are conducted for fun. More than 500 students are present in every batch. NSO and NSS are there for extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_title: I am satisfied with my college at IIT Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: As I am a first year student here at this college, I have learned that placement opportunities from this college are not so good but developing and will develop soon. Students have to learn most of the things by themselves, and have to get ready for internships also by themselves. Average package is about 50 LPA to 60 LPA for top branches only, not good for normal branches.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of this college is good. Starting from the main gate then the auditorium, then moving to administrative building for all admission and other processes, then further moving to schools for different branches. After that, there are girls hostels on one side and boys hostels on the other side of L-gate. There is shopping complex both new and old. There is space for playing. Also, there are large lecture halls. Classrooms are huge with all types of facilities like AC, board, furniture, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, very helpful, and motivating. Their teaching quality is also good and acceptable. They try their best to teach us. They take tests, quizzes, and give assignments. Exams are held two times in one semester, end semester, and mid-semester exams, which are also very easy.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are held once every year but celebrations are usually held for a duration of about 2 to 3 months. Clubs and societies are also there which are highly helpful for achieving self-confidence.

reviews.review_title: It is a good college with a nice infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Bhubaneswar is a second-generation IIT, and hence, its placement opportunities are not so good. No top companies come here for placement opportunities only. The highest package ranges from 60-70 LPA for the computer science students. We can also get internships in our second or third year, and not only in the fourth year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is very large and beautiful. It has its own overbridge. Nescafe's and Domino's are there. The library is also present, and during exams, it is open all the time. It is full of greenery. There is also a big auditorium. Mess food is good. Rooms are also of good capacity. Lecture halls are also very big and fully furnished with all requirements.
detailed_review.Faculty: According to me, our faculty members are brilliant. They teach us very well. Every topic they cover in the class, almost the same comes in the exams. Exams are also of a moderate level. The pass percentage is less than 50% but attendance is necessary.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: My college review, and I am satisfied with it.

detailed_review.Placements: This college provides limited placement opportunities. Companies like Google, Microsoft, and others visit every year for internship and placement programs. The highest package for a CS student, according to the 2023 list, is Max 64 LPA. Others receive packages that are lower than this.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is impressive. It has all the necessities required at any college. Medical assistance, a sports area, a gym, Nescafe, and restaurants are also available. Wi-Fi is accessible throughout the campus at all times. The hostel is spacious and well-maintained. Some construction work is still ongoing, but the facilities are aesthetically pleasing in every respect.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is not so good because study as the education here is primarily classroom-based. Even though we are prepared in the labs but not so in any effective manner. All the faculty members are IIT graduates. They teach concepts related to exams only. Exams are also classroom-based. Based on tutorials and assignments.

reviews.review_title: Satisfaction of college life.

detailed_review.Placements: About 40 LPA to 50 LPA is the average package offered by the companies on our campus for high-branch students. Companies like Microsoft and Google come for placements here. About 30 to 40% of students get internships here. Also, students have to go in search off-campus internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College is very good. Our college is very big and very much area is available. So many buildings and 7 schools of different departments. Wi-Fi is always available. Labs are also there in every school. Mess food is also good. Canteen is also there in every hostel. Hostel is also very big and beautiful.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly educated also they all belong to different IITs. They teach very well. All the stuff that comes in the exam comes from their notes only. Exams are also easy. Pass percentage is 50%. There is also relative grading every time.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with my college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are very much limited to some particular branches only like that of computer science, electrical, and EC ig. Other branches have to look for off-campus placements and internship offers. About 30 LPA to 40 LPA is the average package on our campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very big and good. Buildings are very large and beautiful. Wi-Fi is all the time available. Library is very big and has many books in it. Labs are also so much sufficient for practical. Hostels are also large and good. Mess food is also hygienic and tasty.
detailed_review.Faculty: I will rate faculty members as average only. They are highly educated but still focus on course learning only. What they teach in the class, only that thing came in the exams. Also, they don't give good grades. They are also from IITs. That's why they are very good at guidance and motivation.

reviews.review_title: Placement and overall review of our college.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 30 to 40% of students only get internships from the on-campus companies, while others have to look for out-campus internships. As I remember, a student of civil engineering got a package of about 10 LPA this year. This shows that very less package is offered by these companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College campus is outstanding. As it is a college of the new generation, it is beautifully designed. Hostel rooms are big enough as well. The library is very large and contains a large number of books. Mess food is also acceptable. Wi-Fi is always available everywhere.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are okay. They're highly educated, and I think most of them are IIT students of their time. Their teaching quality is very good. They give most of their efforts and time for the guidance, teaching, and motivation of the students. Exams are also very easy, they're mostly based on the notes from the classroom.

text: IIT Bhubaneswar has an area of 30,000 sq. m. for academic use and 12,500 sq. m. for residential use. list: Hostel:IIT Bhubaneswar is a fully residential campus and has four accommodation halls, one for girls and three for boys, with a capacity to house a total of 2,000 students.

Library:The Central Library at IIT Bhubaneswar is well-equipped with over 18,600 volumes of books, with access to various magazines, journals, theses, reports, e-books, e-journals, and online databases in streams like Engineering and Technology, Sciences, Humanities, Social Sciences, and Management.

Healthcare:IIT Bhubaneswar has a 24*7 healthcare facility on the premises with a dedicated team of doctors and pharmacists. In case of emergency, a 24*7 ambulance service can take the patient to nearby hospitals.
E-Cell:Established in 2013, Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell) is a student-run organisation that aims to promote the spirit of entrepreneurship.

highlights.summary:
Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy, or SASTRA Deemed University Thanjavur, is one of the popular deemed-to-be universities in Tamil Nadu. SASTRA University Thanjavur was established in 1984 as Shanmugha College of Engineering and conferred the deemed-to-be university status in 2001. The National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) has re-accredited SASTRA Deemed University Thanjavur with an 'A++' grade. It is also recognised as a Category I institution by the UGC. Further, the engineering programmes offered by the university are recognised by the Institution of Engineering & Technology (IET), UK and the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). The Government of India has also recognised the university as a Scientific & Industrial Research Organisation. SASTRA Thanjavur is ranked 51 by NIRF 2025 under the Overall category, 29 by NIRF 2025 under the University category, and 40 by NIRF 2025 under the Engineering category.
The university has two branches, namely the Shanmugha Polytechnic College and the Srinivasa Ramanujan Centre. Shanmugha Polytechnic College is a part of the SASTRA University main campus, while the Srinivasa Ramanujan College is located in Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu. SASTRA also comprises several schools and centres, through which it offers various undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across different streams such as Science, Engineering, Medicine, Education, Arts, Law and Management. BTech, MTech and MBA are the popular programmes. The university also offers online and distance education programmes. SASTRA online and distnace learning courses include BCom, BBA, BCA, MBA, MSc, and MA, among others.
The SASTRA Tanjore admissions are both merit and entrance-based. SASTRA College accepts the scores of several national-level entrance exams, such as CAT and JEE Main for admission to its specific courses. SASTRA Deemed University Thanjavur, has collaborated with many international universities and industries to facilitate students' internships in their final semester. The university has collaborated with Arizona State University, the University of Cambridge, the University of Alabama, the University of Pittsburgh, the University of Washington, and various other universities. The university offers scholarships to meritorious students. The major highlights of SASTRA University are presented below in the following table:

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a college that gives life.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good. The highest package reached 27 LPA, and the average packages are around 4 to 8 LPA. This indicates strong industry connections for engineering and technology students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is limited, as the signal is often low. The campus offers robust infrastructure, including a green campus, modern labs, a library, sports facilities, a gym, a hospital, banks, and good transport. Hostel rooms are available in 2-sharing and some 4-sharing.
detailed_review.Faculty: There are three midterms, which are hectic. Professors are very experienced. Exams are rigorous, involving internal assessments and end-of-semester tests. Selection is typically based on merit in the JEE and intermediate examinations.
detailed_review.Other: Campus is situated on 300 acres. Campus life is marked by a strict dress code and disciplined environment. They often designed for parents’ comfort rather than student freedom. This creates mixed feelings about creativity and personal expression due to hierarchy and control. The university provides an industry-oriented curriculum and has good infrastructure.

reviews.review_title: Best for students' careers.

detailed_review.Placements: 100 percent placement for students without backlog. The package is 6 to 24 LPA. Accenture, Comcast, PayPal, Amazon, Caterpillar, and many more companies recruit. Max of the role is a software engineer and technical support based only, and also in a product role, they are hiring.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure with the best classrooms and labs. Free Wi-Fi for only pc and laptops with some restrictions. In our hostel, there are 2 in 1, 3 in 1 and single rooms for both girls and boys, and also AC and non-AC rooms are available. 24/7, there is medical support on campus. Sports and games are there, but mainly focusing on academics only.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty are IIT graduates with Ph.D. and also with several projects. They have a clear understanding of the industry and future demand, and they train students based on that demand. Exams are difficult only when compared to other universities, and paper evaluation is also not strict, and the faculty are so friendly. They will help you with doubts anytime.
detailed_review.Other: I took this department because of my own interest, and I got a lot of hands-on experience in it. Events and culturals are there, but not that big when compared to other universities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It’s overhyped, but still better than other colleges in our state.

detailed_review.Placements: In the past, a good percentage of students got placed. But now, due to the IT slowdown and the rise of AI, placements are not as high as before. Those who have enough knowledge of the subjects still have good opportunities. I am not blaming the college for this, but students are also lacking the basic required grip on the subjects.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It is not up to the mark as they claim, like being a world class university. It is just average for the fees they collect from us. They can upgrade and provide a better environment for us. There is no need to change much. Just replace basic required things like benches for sitting and some basic infrastructure.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified enough, but the curriculum they are following is too old and not sufficient to compete in the present advanced world. I hope they will rectify this and use a better curriculum. The subjects they are following in the very first year are almost useless and senseless. They can provide the respective branch core or the basic required skills for students.

reviews.review_title: SASTRA University life is amazing where we can meet people from various parts.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 90 percent of the students get placed each year. The salary is Rs 50,000 per month or more. Recruiting companies are Tata and many reputed companies. Roles offered are TL, project manager, and back-end research. The internship opportunities are available even at the college, and long-term internships are also given based on your performance. Companies easily recruit people from this university.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has good Wi-Fi system with supportive faculty members. All lab facilities are available. Food in hostel is planned according to healthy habits. Classrooms are so sophisticated. Quality of food and water is also available at any time. Clubs help in enhancing your skills even during these times but the timing is little tiering.
detailed_review.Faculty: We can get good internals with a well-planned study. We could score easily. Exams are easy. If we study with a good plan and strategy, internals will help in boosting our CGPA. Exams are probably 70 percent, easy to pass. Faculty members are so supportive in scoring well, making the concept understandable.
detailed_review.Other: I want to be an advocate, and SASTRA helps in career building with supportive faculty members and the best research ideas from the faculty. Events and fests are really enjoyable where each club conducts different events.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied with the placements in our college last year and about the faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: I am studying in computer science engineering course at SASTRA University. Above 75 percent of students have been placed. The average package of our branch is 8 LPA, and the highest package is 20 LPA. Top recruiters are Bajaj and Aerosol.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very well-equipped. We have a big library with hundreds of books. The building has many water purifiers for drinking water for students. The students have the facility of Wi-Fi in computer science laboratory and AC facility in laboratory.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well-equipped with skills and technology. The curriculum followed in our college is very useful and helpful for students to gain knowledge. The system followed in our college is semester exam system, and exams are held as per semester.
detailed_review.Other: There are hardly one or two cultural events per year.

reviews.review_title: The college has very good infrastructure and average placements.

detailed_review.Placements: 85 percent of students are getting placed in our college, and the highest package is nearly 20 LPA in my course, while the least is 3-4 LPA. The top recruiting companies in my course are TCS, Ashok Leyland, and Infotech, and 40 percent of students get internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in every classroom of our college, and it is also available in the hostel rooms. Every lab is equipped with the required equipment, and the library is very large and of high quality. There are all sports grounds in the college, including volleyball, cricket, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful if we have more interaction with them. They are highly qualified, and the medium to high quality of teaching is good. It prepares the students for the industry. Semester exams are tough when compared to other colleges or universities.
detailed_review.Other: There are very limited fests. Only a few events are held, and class timings are more extensive.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied because of the faculty and good placements in recent years.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 95% of students got placed. The salary package offered is 29 LPA. The lowest salary package is 2.4 LPA. Almost 50% of students got internships in the core and IT branches. Bosch, Rockwell Collins, Cisco, Caterpillar, Coreel, Cypress, TCS, CTS, Wipro, Zoho, Amazon, PayPal, L&T, Cognizant, Accenture, Infosys, these are the top companies that visited in the past years.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good facilities and infrastructure available for your course/department, for example- Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library. A better quality of the facilities in your hostel. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen. The college provides medical, sports, and games facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is very good. The curriculum is relevant mostly practically, as students learn together in labs. The level of difficulty is moderate when studying one day before, as you can't get good grades.
detailed_review.Other: An ECE-focused post indicates about 50% placement for core roles and coding/IT roles, with approximately 100 ECE students placed in a batch. Another comment suggests that only a smaller number of core recruiters visit for ECE, making coding roles more common.

reviews.review_title: I think this is the best college to enhance the future of an individual.

detailed_review.Placements: About 75% of students are placed in different companies. The highest package is 30 LPA, while the lowest package is 3.5 LPA, and the average package is 6 LPA. TCS is the top recruiter of our college. Other than that, Infosys and HCL are minor recruiters.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classes have projectors and extraordinary batches. We have a library that consists of books related to all branches and articles. The college has a good environment. Overall, Wi-Fi is available across the campus, which can be accessed using laptops.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching was good. They prepare different PPTs and notes to boost knowledge in both academics and non-academics. Faculty helps students in doing projects and participating in hackathons. The technical skills taught enhance students’ confidence in performing well in interviews.

reviews.review_title: It is a good college with decent environment

detailed_review.Placements: In the last academic year, 75% of students are placed in different companies. The highest package is ₹43 LPA, while the lowest was approximately ₹6 LPA. TCS is the top recruiter of the college; other than that, Infosys and HCL are minor recruiters. The internship percentage is nearly 45% over three years.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in the hostel and college (in the library and classrooms). Classrooms consist of projectors with proper seating arrangements according to the strength of students. The library consists of study halls and at least 10,000 books. Labs are equipped with all necessary equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: The lecturers are Ph.D. graduates who encourage students to solve problems by participating in hackathons. This helps not only in studying for college exams but also in gaining practical knowledge. The level of study is quite hard compared to others.

reviews.review_title: SASTRA (Deemed to be University)

detailed_review.Placements: In the academic year 2025, nearly 250 students are placed in our branch in both IT. The placement percentage may be approximately 70 to 75% across the campus. The highest package is 34 LPA for a CSE branch student, but the lowest package is 6 LPA. I think in 3 years, few will get internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms have suitable sitting arrangements for students and are provided with projectors. Wi-Fi is available across the campus. The library is filled with over 10,000 books and has a study hall. The labs consist of all the equipment required for academics. The mess is good, but it is a vegetarian college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The lecturers are mostly Ph.D. graduates, who are also enrolled in projects based on the IT sector in the college. We also have practical work, either for studying for college exams or industrial visits. It is quite hard as compared to other colleges. The pass percentage is nearly 56%.

reviews.review_title: The college is a value for money. The college is best for placements and gives high returns.

detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite poor compared to other colleges, and the labs are quite good and better. detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are friendly and they clear all your doubts. The curriculum is good and related to industry, and coming to the difficulty of semester exams, the exams are quite hard, and CIA exams are also tough, and the teachers are highly knowledgeable.
detailed_review.Other: There are no cultural activities and fests, but only held 1 or 2 per year.
