reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college is good for studying and placement purposes.

detailed_review.Placements: 95% of students got placed through my course, with the highest package of 22 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, TCS, and Google. 40% of students secured internships. Final year CGPA determines placement chances. Campus selection begins at the start of the fourth year, and almost everyone gets a job.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has well-equipped CSE laboratories and a well-designed library. Hostel facilities are not within the college, but a canteen is available. The campus supports sports and games, with NCC training provided by experienced faculty. Mechanical and EEE labs are highly equipped.
detailed_review.Faculty: Experienced teachers are available, providing a thorough core education. The syllabus for exams is well-defined, with strict invigilation. The pass percentage in each subject is above 50%. Attendance must be at least 80% in each subject, and total attendance should exceed 80%.
detailed_review.Other: I opted for this course because it provides quality core education and certifications. Efforts to improve gym facilities and indoor games are ongoing. Theta 2k25 is an event that keeps the campus exciting throughout the year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: If you want to achieve new things, come to Sastra.

detailed_review.Placements: During this academic year, nearly most of the students are placed in our branch in both IT and core sectors. The placement percentage is approximately 75 to 80 across the campus. The highest package is 40 LPA for a CSE branch student. But in our branch, the highest is 25 LPA and the lowest is 5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classes are good enough with a sitting arrangement for 60 students, provided with a projector. The library contains more than 10,000 books. Wi-Fi is available across the campus. Labs contain all the equipment that is required. The hostel rooms are quite good, but the mess is average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the lecturers are Ph.D. graduates, who are also enrolled in projects in the college research center. This course is relevant with proper lessons. We also have practical work, which is quite hard compared to other colleges. It feels tricky in the MID exams, but in the semester exams, it is easy to score.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall, it is a good place to get a job if you utilize the resources.

detailed_review.Placements: Here, the top package is 37 LPA this year. The average package is 6-8 LPA. The lowest package is 3 LPA for Electronics and Communication Engineering. Both core and software jobs are available. Even startups are funded.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a wide range of labs, especially if you’re into research. There are many specialized labs. The Ministry of Heavy Industries (MHI) has offered funding to many more labs. The classroom infrastructure is also good. As for the hostels, the new ones are good, while the old ones are manageable.
detailed_review.Faculty: The scores are based on CGPA, with SGPA calculated for each semester. Each subject’s score is composed of 50% internals and 50% externals. All faculty members for this course hold doctorates. They are knowledgeable and approachable. You can learn a lot from them, and they are always ready to help.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Data Science)
reviews.review_title: Nice infrastructure but focus on internal.

detailed_review.Placements: If you have a CGPA above 8.5 or 8, you can attend more companies. The highest package is 26 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is 10 LPA. Deloitte and TCS recruit students. If you have a decent CGPA of 7.00 or above, you can have an average salary package. Network engineering, software development, and so on are the roles offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Food and the hostel are below average for girls, other than the new hostel. Last semester, you could enjoy academic life if you were placed at the beginning of 7 or 8 semesters.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well knowledgeable. You can do a research paper with the staff if you are interested. They make students ready for placements. Semester exams are very easy if you prepare for one month before. But your internal is so important. Faculty members are friendly. They are very talented, and you gain more knowledge from them.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty and good placements in recent years.

detailed_review.Placements: 95% placements with packages ranging from 29 LPA to 2.4 LPA. Zoho, TCS Digital, FACE, Cisco, and Amazon offer around 50% of core and IT roles. Bosch, Rockwell Collins, Cisco, Caterpillar, Coreel, Cypress, TCS, CTS, Wipro, Zoho, Amazon, PayPal, L&T, Cognizant, Accenture, and Infosys are the top companies that have visited in the past years.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good facilities and infrastructure are available for our course and department, such as Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. The hostel provides better quality facilities, and the food available in the mess and canteen is good. There are also medical facilities, sports, and games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is very good. The curriculum is relevant, and students mostly learn practically together in labs. The level of difficulty is moderate. By studying one day before, you cannot get good grades.
detailed_review.Other: An ECE is focused on about 50% placement in core roles and coding/IT roles. Approximately 100 ECE students get placed in a batch. Another comment suggests that only a small number of core recruiters visit for ECE, making coding roles more common.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: SASTRA University (Deemed to be University) is one of the leading institutions offering various undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs in the fields of Science and Technology, and law, among others. Situated in Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu, SASTRA university covers an area of 300000 square feet. SASTRA is highly sought after by students, both domestic and international, for those looking for value-driven higher education that fosters service to humanity and society.

sections.heading: SASTRA University Highlights
text: The university is spread over 232 acres of land. Its infrastructure features multiple canteens, a guest house, campus shopping stores, banks & ATMs, a post office, transport availability and a Ghoshala. It also boasts a ten-bed hospital, as well as a modern senate hall for meetings and a multi-purpose hall.
The list of SASTRA University campuses is provided below:

sections.heading: SASTRA University Sports Facilities
text: The university emphasises the importance of physical education and sportsmanship. With its top-notch and state-of-the-art sports facilities, covering both outdoor and indoor, it promotes excellence in sports. SASTRA University outdoor sports facilities include a cricket ground with pitch and nets, playing fields for football and hockey, plus basketball, volleyball, and throwball courts. It also includes a standard 200-meter running track with outdoor courts for badminton and tennis.

SASTRA University infrastructure also includes indoor badminton courts with wooden flooring, useful when the weather might not allow outdoor fields to be accessible. It also features table tennis, billiards table and carrom halls with indoor lighting facilities available. The indoor facilities include a multi-purpose gym with treadmills, weights and fitness training zone as well as a Chess room.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the SASTRA University Campus
text: Due to its location in the temple city of Thanjavur, students of the university are blessed and surrounded by many historical and recreational sites such as the Brihadeeswara Temple , Thanjavur Palace , Sivaganga Park and Saraswathi Mahal Library . These places are ideal to experience India's rich culture and are favourable for picnics and team outings.

Other local attractions around the city include Poondi Math , Rock Fort Temple (Trichy) , and Srirangam Temple , which offer a serene environment for relaxation and a peaceful environment ideal for personal explorations.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The central library contains over 1,02,600 books, the library also subscribes to 290 journals and magazines related to management, engineering, law, and many more. It also subscribes to over 35 online journal databases like science direct, IEEE, ACM, ASME, and more. The library has purchased over 18,000 Springer e-books from the various subjects. The transactions of the library are fully automated and automation covers the entire gamut of the library. The library has reprographic facilities and attracts an average of over 600 students over a day.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: SASTRA University has 9 boys hostels and 6 girls hostels which are equipped with all amenities for living, dining, and recreation that makes each inmate feel at home. Wi-Fi facility is also available for students in the hostel. SASTRA has always believed in catering to the palate and providing wholesome and balanced nutrition in a hygienic environment. A completely balanced South & North Indian Vegetarian diet is served in all hostels.
